# Multi-source SI network — Plan S3-E1: stage-3 P5 wire, ingress and data plane (arbiter-proto, housegate, arbiter-core) Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

> **Status (2026-10-16): draft.** Tasks 57, 58, 59, 60, 61, 62, 63 are drafted and were verified by their drafters in scratch exports; no task has had its adversarial review yet, and the plan consistency pass (which also writes Appendices B and C in final form) and the cross-plan pass have not run. Do not execute this plan before those passes; `2026-10-15-multi-source-si-s3cf-status.md` lists what remains and how to finish it.

**Goal:** Fix and release every wire number of the stage-3 v21 format, teach every host's ingress the two new admission codes, and ship in arbiter-core everything the arbiter and the members need before the v21 activation: the canonical signing types with a normalizer that keeps every field, the authority, consent, member-ready and checkpoint purposes, the wire converters and Raft tags 38–42, the registry view of groups, the incarnation-scoped Keeper paths, and the member consensus mode (verify role, `hg_member_unsafe` reconciler, readiness and checkpoint signing, the hardlink byte source, purge reports with a quiescence hook). Nothing here changes consensus state or devnet2 behaviour: every new field, tag and code stays off the wire until an S3-E2–E4 switch puts it there, the member consensus mode is off unless configured, and the only new behaviour a deployed binary shows is that `CORE_TAG_P5` binaries advertise `stage3_v1` and the owner SNode reports (never repairs) unexpected Keeper replicas.

**Architecture:** arbiter-proto adds the whole P5 wire contract in one additive release: the `VerifierEntry` host fields, the `stage3` parameter (with its switches), the five stage-3 commands as Raft tags 38–42, admission codes 12 and 13, the header `group_key`, the stage-3 read fields of `BlockVerification`, the registry view of groups (each member with its host, filled when the view is served), checkpoint sequences, scoped Keeper paths and purge members, the activation and switch cutovers in `ConsensusParamsState`, and two `ConsensusAdmin` plus two `VerifierGateway` RPCs, with a conformance ledger that pins every number (Task 57, `PROTO_TAG_P5`). housegate pins it and classifies the two new codes at the ingress: code 12 as a retryable, session-preserving 733 refusal, code 13 as session-preserving 252 back-pressure (Task 58, `HG_TAG_P5`). arbiter-core pins it and adds, in order: the canonical Go types, `Stage3Params.Validate`, a `NormalizeConsensusParamsUpdate` that copies and checks every `VerifierEntry` field, the six signing purposes with their frozen vectors (Task 59); the wire converters, the Command union for tags 38–42, the registry snapshot's groups, sequences, scoped flags and purge members, and the `BlockVerification` selection record, with encoded-tag goldens (Task 60); incarnation-scoped Keeper paths through `ddl.KeeperScope`, both roots in every listing, drop and sweep, and an owner Keeper audit that reports unknown replicas and non-incarnation roots (Task 61); a shared `dataplane/evidence` component that the verifier now delegates to byte for byte, and on top of it the member's VERIFIER registration and verify role over `hg_member_unsafe`, the quiescence ledger, and the group-scoped `hg_member_unsafe` reconciler that runs as `si_member_ddl` (Task 62); the member gateway clients, readiness and checkpoint loops and signers with a durable `checkpoint_seq`, the hardlink byte source, purge reports, the member status fields, `stage3_v1` in `LocalNodeFeatures`, and the release (Task 63, `CORE_TAG_P5`). Plans S3-E2, S3-E3 and S3-E4 (`2026-10-15-multi-source-si-s3e2-p5-activation-encoding.md`, `…-s3e3-p5-groups-checkpoints.md`, `…-s3e4-p5-floor-release-activation.md`) build the arbiter on these releases; S3-E4 rolls them to devnet2 and activates v21.

**Tech Stack:** Go 1.26.3; protobuf + buf with protoc-gen-go v1.36.11 and protoc-gen-go-grpc v1.5.1 (arbiter-proto `Makefile:3-4`); Bazel 9.1.0 + Bzlmod + gazelle (housegate, arbiter-core); ClickHouse 26.3 (`clickhouse/clickhouse-server:26.3.37.3`) with ClickHouse Keeper for the gated tests; `crypto/ed25519` and the ES256K compact JWS of arbiter-core `authority`; `shasum`, Foundry `cast` and `protoc --encode` for vectors computed outside Go (the Plan S2-A pipeline); `gh` for PRs and the three release workflows.

**Spec:** housegate `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-14-multi-source-si-stage3-database-groups-design.md` (spec branch `urwt/claude/ms-si-stage3-spec` at `a815dd0`, PR housegate#236, on `main` as `fb83a97`; §8.2 as amended in the stage-3 plans PR: `si_member` holds exactly `SELECT, INSERT, ALTER, CREATE TABLE, DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE, OPTIMIZE` on `hg_rstage.*`, never `ALL`, cross-plan decision D36) — binding: §6.1 (the `verifiers` entry fields and the `stage3` parameter: wire, canonical form, static rules), §6.2 (the registry view of groups), §6.3 (the salt rule, recorded only: K61), §6.4 (`RebalanceGroup` and `MemberReady` wire and signing), §7.1 (the header `group_key` field, the transition record: K62), §7.3 (`VERIFIERS_UNAVAILABLE` on the wire and at the ingress, the eligible-ring read fields), §7.4 (`ReselectVerifiers` wire and records), §8.1–§8.3 (the member verify role and the `hg_member_unsafe` reconciler), §8.6 first bullet (the hardlink source), §8.8 (incarnation-scoped Keeper paths, purge members on the wire, the owner sweep's alerts, member purge reports), §9.1–§9.2 (`MemberCheckpoint`, `checkpoint_seq`, classes on the wire), §9.3 (the strict-mode backpressure code: K59), §10.3 (`stage3_v1`), §10.4 (the switch fields), §15 (the arbiter-proto, arbiter-core and housegate lines), §17 (the data-plane tests named in contract §42), as clarified by Plan S3-A's K1–K10, Plan S3-B's K11–K22 and this plan's K58–K67. **Prerequisites:** Plans S3-A (`2026-10-14-multi-source-si-s3a-p0-guards.md`, contract §0–§6) and S3-B (`2026-10-14-multi-source-si-s3b-p0-hosts-rollout.md`, contract §7–§15) apply unchanged, as do the contracts of S3-C1 (§16–§19: the replay helpers in `HG_TAG_P1`, the ledger tool), S3-C2 (§20–§24: the member role, `ddl.MemberPinned`, `MemberUnsafeIntent`, `member/sources`, `member/install`, `wire.BlockVerification`), S3-C4 (§29–§32: `member/serve`, `HG_TAG_P3`) and S3-D (§33–§37: `CORE_TAG_P4`, and `PROTO_TAG_P4`, produced unconditionally (S3-D K53, cross-plan decision D26) with the settle RPCs `ConsensusAdmin.SettleTrack` (method 14) and `GetTrackSettle` (15) and the additive, non-Raft stream fields `PromotionCommand.settle` and `SNodeHello.settle`); ## Global Constraints

- **Earlier plans apply.** Every Global Constraint and clarification of Plans S3-A and S3-B applies, and through them those of S1-A, S1-B, S2-A and S2-B (strict decoder, request-only signatures, signed claims, tracks, golden files, worktrees, commits, remote actions); the contracts of S3-C1, S3-C2, S3-C4 and S3-D bind every name this plan consumes from them (contract §43 lists each with its source).
- **Activation model (contract §38):** no consensus state changes and no devnet2 step runs in this plan; every new field, tag and code is absent from every message a pre-P5 binary writes and from every message a P5 binary writes before the matching S3-E2–E4 switch; the member consensus mode runs only when `member.Config.Consensus` is set; the releases are additive and every component can still return to its previous image.
- **Ordering:** `PROTO_TAG_P4` (S3-D Task 49, the base of Task 57 and of its `buf breaking` gate, D26) → `PROTO_TAG_P5` (Task 57) → `HG_TAG_P5` (Task 58, pins it) and arbiter-core Tasks 59–62 (pin it) → `CORE_TAG_P5` (Task 63, pins both); S3-E2 Task 64 pins all three, and no arbiter release happens between that pin and S3-E4 Task 78 (K65).
- **Irreversible steps:** none here; the §39 numbers become consensus constants when S3-E4 activates v21; until arbiter pins `PROTO_TAG_P5` a numbering mistake is fixed by a new arbiter-proto release, and after that pin never by renumbering.
- **arbiter-proto numbers and names:** contract §39, verbatim; a task that needs another proto name stops and reports a contract conflict.
- **Canonical forms:** every Go field added to a type that is hashed today (`arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate`, `arbiter.VerifierEntry`) is `omitempty`, so every pre-stage-3 digest, `TestActivationUpdateVector` and every existing golden stay byte-identical; the normalizer copies every field (K58; the scoping proposal's defect D3, a defect label and not one of the decisions D1–D40).
- **Pre-existing pins learn the additions, exactly those listed in contract §39 (arbiter-proto count pins), §40 (one housegate example code) and §42 (the feature list);** no golden constant, vector or `.binpb` fixture changes; a red test outside the lists stops the task.
- **Never edit, and its one exception (cross-plan decision D25):** every golden or vector file S2-A and S3-A list, `pre_tracks_golden.json`, the `l3_track_golden_test.go` constants and S3-A's arbiter-proto `conformance/stage3_reads_test.go`. D25 lets Plans S3-D and S3-E1 change only that file's count literals: S3-D Task 49 the `ConsensusAdmin` method count (14 → 16), this plan the `ConsensusAdmin` method count (16 → 18), the `RaftCommand` tag count (36 → 41, tags through 42) and the `BlockVerification` field-ledger length (13 → 22 tokens, the nine new tokens appended after the 13 P0 tokens), exactly as contract §39 lists them; every existing ledger token, table row, helper and assertion stays byte-identical, and arbiter-core's same-named S3-A file is not edited at all.
- **New frozen fixtures:** `arbiter-proto:conformance/stage3_test.go`; `arbiter-core:authority/authoritytest/stage3.go` and `authority/stage3_golden_test.go` (authority, consent, member-ready, checkpoint and stage-3 update vectors); `arbiter-core:wire/stage3_golden_test.go` (tag 38–42 encodings); consensus constants once committed, computed outside Go and never regenerated.
- **production rule:** this plan changes no production file and runs nothing on sea; its remote actions are pushes, PRs, merges, the three release workflows and the three ledger records.
- **Runbook conventions:** no runbook and no live task in this plan; commands handed to the user are fish (`bash -c '…'` wrappers allowed), the agent's own blocks bash.
- **Passwords and keys:** no password anywhere in this plan; every key in a test or vector is an `authoritytest` fixture key (never a real one), and no key, seed or token is printed, logged or put on argv.
- **Repository commands, worktrees, commits, releases, ledger:** contract §43; every remote action needs explicit user confirmation in chat, each for its own step.
- **Hunks are anchored on the base revisions.** Tasks were drafted in parallel and S3-A through S3-D move many of the anchored lines (`wire/command.go`, `dataplane/tableset/reconciler.go`, `verifier/*`, the conformance files); when a hunk overlaps an earlier change, apply this plan's intent on top of it. The contract and the named tests are binding; line anchors are guidance.
- **References.** `contract §N` points to Appendix A of Plan S3-A (§0–§6), S3-B (§7–§15), S3-C1 (§16–§19), S3-C2 (§20–§24), S3-C3 (§25–§28), S3-C4 (§29–§32), S3-D (§33–§37) or this plan (§38–§43); a task group's "Facts" point to Appendix B; Appendix C records `PROTO_TAG_P5`, `HG_TAG_P5`, `CORE_TAG_P5` and the run records. `D25`–`D40` are the cross-plan decisions taken after the stage-3 front matter (they continue S3-B's D1–D24); this plan states the substance of each one it applies where it applies: D25 (the never-edit exception above), D26 (the base tag), D27 (member hosts in the registry view), D30 (S3-E4 Task 79's widened scope, which wires this plan's reconciler and metrics), D31 (`lag_advances` saturation), D33 (unserved fields), D34 (the ledger copy), D36 (the `hg_rstage` rights), D40 (member keys).

## Plan clarifications (binding)

The spec leaves these P5 wire and data-plane details open; each is resolved here and binding for Plans S3-E1 through S3-F.

- **K58 — "True by default" flags and the default weight (spec §6.1, line 104).** The spec gives `verifiers` entries `weight` "(1–64, default 1)" and the flags `verify`, `replicate`, `counts`, `shared_rmt` "all true by default"; proto3 cannot express absent-means-true, and every devnet2 entry is hashed into the params digest of every epoch. Resolution: `VerifierEntry` gains plain proto3 fields 4–11 and `optional uint64 host_indexer_id = 3` (indexer 0 is valid); an entry without `host_indexer_id` (the network pool) must leave fields 4–11 zero, so it keeps its exact v20 bytes, canonical JSON and digest; on an entry with `host_indexer_id` every field is explicit (absent = false or 0, `weight` must be 1–64), and the "true" and "1" defaults are supplied only by `arbiter-admin`'s `--verifier` parser (S3-E2 Task 65), never by a decoder; `Stage3Params` is explicit too (`group_size` ≥ 1, `min_safe_copies` ≥ 1, `arbiter-admin --stage3` supplies 3, true and 1). Why: no hidden default in a consensus encoding, one digest for every existing epoch, and auditors read exactly what was signed.
- **K59 — Strict-mode backpressure needs a code (spec §9.3, line 245).** The spec asks for "a retryable refusal" without a code. Resolution: `ADMISSION_CODE_COPIES_BACKPRESSURE = 13`, released now with code 12; the FSM returns it only with `stage3.strict_copies` on (S3-E4 Task 76), state unchanged and the coordinate unspent; HouseGate answers it as session-preserving back-pressure (ClickHouse 252, `storage_integrity: back-pressure:` prefix). Why: an older HouseGate maps an unknown code to `OutcomeUnknown` (housegate `pkg/storageintegrity/arbiter_proto.go:426-427`), so the code must ship in the same host release as 12, and 252 is the refusal every client already retries for part pressure.
- **K60 — Purge-set representation (spec §8.8, line 215).** "Every non-evicted node that has been a member of its group at any generation since the incarnation was recorded" needs history. Resolution: `TableIncarnation.purge_members` (field 20), sorted unique node ids, set by Apply when the incarnation is recorded (the group's members then) and grown at every member addition while the incarnation is physical (RebalanceGroup add, the placement backfill); a node leaves it only through `EvictNode`; published in the registry view (S3-E2 Task 69, S3-E3 Task 71). Why: exact and restore-checkable without generation intervals, and a member learns from the registry which incarnations it must report.
- **K61 — Placement salt (spec §6.3, line 117).** "The `TableCreated` event of d's first physical incarnation" is ambiguous at the backfill and after a group is removed and re-placed. Resolution: the salt is `Created.BlockHash` of the lowest-seq incarnation of (O, d) that is physical when the group is placed, or the genesis snapshot id when that incarnation is genesis-origin; it is stored with the group and published as `DatabaseGroup.placement_salt` (field 9) (S3-E3 Task 71). Why: a pure function of committed state at the placing Apply that an auditor re-derives from the published value, and still an L2 block hash the user does not choose.
- **K62 — The transition-block restore rule needs a stored list (spec §7.1, line 135).** Restore must check that every change of a transition block belongs to a database "whose group was recorded in the block's `BlockVerification` with the header's `group_key` at seal", but the spec records only members and fill. Resolution: at seal `BlockVerification` records the (database, `group_generation`) of every group whose key it carries, published as `BlockVerification.group_databases` (field 20) (S3-E3 Task 72). Why: restore checks it without re-deriving history.
- **K63 — Purposes, digest domains and the excluded-reason set (spec §6.1, §6.4, §7.4, §9.1 line 228).** The spec names only the consent and member-ready purposes and says checkpoint exclusions carry "reasons". Resolution: contract §41's table of six purposes and domains: three ES256K authority commands bound to a `ConsensusContext` (`arbiter-rebalance-group-v1`, `arbiter-reselect-verifiers-v1`, `arbiter-mark-member-lagging-v1`, each with a `-command-v1` domain), the ES256K consent signed by the host's `si_indexers` signer (`arbiter-group-member-v1`), the ed25519 member-ready message under its own domain (`arbiter-member-ready-v1`), the ES256K checkpoint signed by `replica_signer` (`arbiter-member-checkpoint-v1`); member messages bind network and genesis, Apply records the epoch; exclusion reasons are the closed enum `CheckpointExclusionReason` (`NOT_INSTALLED`, `DIVERGED`, `FOREIGN`, `DISK_THRESHOLD`, `AUDIT_PENDING`, `RETIRING`), `UNSPECIFIED` and unknown values refused at decode. Why: every signed message gets its own token family, the authority commands follow the quarantine precedent and the member messages the SNode/verifier-message precedent, and a closed set is restore-checkable.
- **K64 — No `GetStage3State` RPC (spec §15).** Resolution: no new read RPC; `ConsensusParamsState.stage3_state` (field 9) carries the activation epoch and cutover and each switch's cutover, beside the `stage3` parameter `GetConsensusParams` already returns; `GetTableRegistry`/`WatchTableRegistry` carry groups, checkpoint sequences, scoped flags, purge members and the committed `stage3` parameter (`TableRegistrySnapshot` fields 10–12), each current group member with its host (`GroupMember.host_indexer_id`, filled from the member's entry in the committed `verifiers` when the view is served, never stored in FSM state and not Raft-reachable, D27; S3-E4's `replica_hosts` reads it); `GetBlockVerification` carries rings, keys and re-selections (fields 14–22). Why: three existing reads cover every runbook and auditor need, and members learn the switches through the registry follower they already run. (`Stage3Params` is defined in `table_registry.proto` for that reason, the `ClientLaneParams` precedent.)
- **K65 — The `stage3_v1` release rule (spec §10.3).** `arbiter.Stage3Feature = "stage3_v1"` joins `LocalNodeFeatures()` in `CORE_TAG_P5` (Task 63), so every SNode and verifier built with it advertises it at `RegisterNode` and every arbiter binary that pins it reports it in `GetProtocolInfo`. Resolution: arbiter pins `CORE_TAG_P5` only in S3-E2 Task 64 on branch `urwt/claude/multi-source-s3e`, and no arbiter release happens between that pin and S3-E4 Task 78; S3-D's `ARBITER_TAG_P4` is cut before. A data-plane binary on `CORE_TAG_P5` may run against an earlier leader, whose feature book keeps unknown strings without acting on them. Why: an arbiter release claiming `stage3_v1` without the v21 decoder would let the activation gate pass on a voter that cannot restore v21.
- **K66 — The member consensus mode ships in `CORE_TAG_P5` (spec §8.1–§8.3, §8.6, §8.8, §9.1; §16 P6 "parameter updates").** Resolution: Tasks 62–63 ship the verify role, the `hg_member_unsafe` reconciler, readiness and checkpoint signing, the hardlink source and purge reports, reachable only through `member.Config.Consensus` (nil keeps the P2 member byte for byte) and its `Register` and `CreateReplicas` gates; sentio-node's config keys (S3-E4 Task 79) and production values (S3-F Task 83) turn them on. Why: S3-F needs no code release in the middle of the switch sequence, and S3-E4 Task 78's harness runs real members.
- **K67 — Member and stage-3 RPC gating (spec §6.4, §7.4, §9.1, §10.4).** Resolution: before its switch every stage-3 RPC answers FAILED_PRECONDITION, without a NotLeader detail, with the verbatim texts of contract §39 (`member readiness is refused until the placement switch is on`, `member checkpoints are refused until the checkpoints switch is on`, `group rebalancing is refused until the placement switch is on`, `marking a member lagging is refused until the checkpoints switch is on`), and Apply refuses the same commands with the same texts, plus `re-selection is refused until the reselection switch is on` for tag 39 (S3-E3 Tasks 71, 73, 74, 75); the data-plane client maps the RPC answer to `dataplane.ErrStage3SwitchOff`, and the member treats it as "not yet", retries at its interval and never pages. Why: a member deployed ahead of its switch must neither alarm nor be counted, and one text per refusal keeps every voter's answer identical.

## Review Focus

1. **A field silently dropped, or a pool entry's bytes changed.** `VerifierEntry` is rebuilt field by field in arbiter-core's normalizer (`authority/consensus.go:125`) and wire converters (`wire/consensus.go:139-149`), and every devnet2 entry is hashed into the params digest of every epoch. Expected: every new field survives normalize, clone and the pb round trip; a pool entry with any member field set is refused, and a pool-only update hashes and encodes exactly as under `CORE_TAG_P4` (the existing `ActivationUpdateHash` and every existing golden pass unedited); a member entry is explicit in every field, with weight 1–64 and its failure domain equal to `stage3.indexer_failure_domains[host]`. Tests: Task 59 `TestVerifierEntryEveryFieldSurvivesNormalize`, `TestPoolVerifierEntryKeepsItsV20CanonicalForm`, `TestPoolVerifierEntryRefusesMemberFields`, `TestMemberVerifierEntryRules`, `TestStage3CanonicalMirrorsMatchProto`; Task 60 `TestVerifierEntryEveryFieldSurvivesThePBRoundTrip`, `TestConsensusParamsUpdateWithStage3RoundTrips`; Task 57 `TestStage3ConsensusFieldNumbers`, `TestStage3ConsensusHostIndexerZeroIsDistinctFromAbsent`.
2. **A pre-P5 binary meets P5 bytes, or a number is wrong.** Every number of contract §39 becomes a consensus constant at the v21 activation, and the strict decoder refuses an unknown field at any depth. Expected: every appended field left unset produces exactly the bytes `v0.11.0` writes and, set, only appends its own tags; tags 38–42 are the only new oneof members and tag 29 stays unused; no read-only message (groups, cutovers, the selection record) is reachable from `RaftCommand`; the two descriptor baselines and `buf breaking` against `PROTO_TAG_P4` are clean; S3-A's `conformance/stage3_reads_test.go` differs from `PROTO_TAG_P4` only in D25's three count changes; `GroupMember.host_indexer_id` keeps indexer 0 distinct from absent and is the only proto3 optional among the new messages; the encoded bytes of every tag-38–42 fixture are frozen; an unknown exclusion reason is refused at decode, never applied. Tests: Task 57 `TestStage3ConsensusFieldsAbsentLeaveTheWireUnchanged`, `TestStage3ConsensusRaftCommandTags`, `TestStage3ConsensusReadMessagesAreNotRaftReachable`, `TestStage3ConsensusFieldLedgers`, `TestStage3ConsensusHostIndexerZeroIsDistinctFromAbsent`, the unedited `TestSnapshotQueryDescriptorFixtureIdentities`; Task 60 `TestStage3CommandBytesAreFrozen`, `TestStage3CommandsRoundTripThroughEncodeAndDecode`, `TestDecodeRefusesAnUnknownExclusionReason`, `TestGroupMemberHostIndexerKeepsAbsenceAndIndexerZero`.
3. **Admission code 12 or 13 reaches a host's ingress.** A HouseGate older than `HG_TAG_P5` maps an unknown code to `OutcomeUnknown` and sends the statement to status probing (housegate `pkg/storageintegrity/arbiter_proto.go:426-427`). Expected: with `HG_TAG_P5` both are coded terminal rejects whose prepared parts are removed and whose coordinate is unspent; code 12 reaches the client as a retryable 733 with the exact verifiers-unavailable message and the session survives; code 13 as 252 back-pressure with the `storage_integrity: back-pressure:` prefix, counted in `storage_integrity_backpressure_total`, session preserved; code 14 stays unknown. Tests: Task 58 `TestVerifiersUnavailableIsATerminalRejectWithItsCode`, `TestCopiesBackpressureIsATerminalRejectWithItsCode`, the edited `TestIndexerQuarantinedIsATerminalRejectWithItsCode`, `TestVerifiersUnavailableMessage`, `TestCopiesBackpressureMessage`, `TestRelay_StagedVerifiersUnavailableRejection_KeepsSessionAndServesNextQuery`, `TestRelay_StagedCopiesBackpressureRejection_KeepsSessionAndServesNextQuery`, `TestRelay_DeferredUpstreamVerifiersUnavailable_KeepsSessionAndServesNextQuery`, `TestVerifiersUnavailableReachesTheClientAsARetryableRefusal`, `TestCopiesBackpressureReachesTheClientAsARetryableBackpressure`.
4. **One table name on both Keeper roots.** A key can have an unscoped incarnation from before the purge switch and a scoped one after it; ClickHouse removes every child of a path when its last replica drops (S3-A M10). Expected: the unscoped path and every existing call are byte-identical; a scoped path is never under `/sentio/<shard>/unsafe`; create, drop, purge, sweep and `clearDecommissioned` each act on the incarnation's own path; dropping a stale last replica on the unscoped path after a scoped re-create leaves the scoped table's Keeper tree and writes intact; the owner's audit reports an unknown replica or a root above an incarnation path and drops nothing. Tests: Task 61 `TestZooKeeperPathForUnscopedIsByteIdentical`, `TestScopedZooKeeperPathIsNeverUnderTheLegacyRoot`, `TestReconcilerPurgesAndSweepsBothPathKinds`, `TestClearDecommissionedCoversTheScopedRoot`, `TestSweepPurgedKeeperPathsCoversBothRoots`, `TestScopedRecreateSurvivesDroppingTheStaleLastUnscopedReplica`, `TestSameNameRecreateAfterAPurgeOnBothPathKinds`, `TestOwnerKeeperAuditReportsAnUnknownReplica`, `TestOwnerKeeperAuditReportsANonIncarnationRoot`, `TestOwnerKeeperAuditDropsNothing`.
5. **A member deployed ahead of its switches, or one that lost its state.** `CORE_TAG_P5` reaches hosts in S3-E4, long before S3-F's steps 4–8. Expected: without `member.Config.Consensus` the member is the P2/P3 member byte for byte; with it, nothing registers until `Register` and no replica is created until `CreateReplicas`, the purge switch, registration and placement all hold; a switch refusal maps to `ErrStage3SwitchOff`, is retried at the interval and never pages; `checkpoint_seq` is above both the journal and the published value, durable before submit, and restarts when `replica_signer` rotates, so a member that lost its state resumes; `REPLICA_ALREADY_EXISTS` stops that table and never runs `SYSTEM DROP REPLICA`; a purge is reported only after the drop and quiescence (at once for an incarnation never held). Tests: Task 62 `TestUnsafeReconcilerCreatesReplicasOnlyWhenRegisteredPurgeOnAndPlaced`, `TestUnsafeReconcilerStopsOnReplicaAlreadyExistsAndNeverDropsAReplica`, `TestUnsafeReconcilerKeepsTheReplicaThroughRetiringAndDropsItAtPurgingWhenQuiet`, `TestMemberVerifyRoleRefusesToRegisterWhenRegisterIsOff`; Task 63 `TestConsensusConfigNilKeepsTheP2Role`, `TestSubmitMemberCheckpointAcksAndMapsTheSwitchRefusal`, `TestCheckpointLoopIdlesUntilTheCheckpointsSwitch`, `TestCheckpointSeqIsAboveTheJournalAndThePublishedValue`, `TestCheckpointSeqIsDurableBeforeSubmit`, `TestCheckpointSeqRestartsWhenTheReplicaSignerRotates`, `TestMemberThatLostItsStateResumesFromThePublishedCheckpointSeq`, `TestMemberReportsAPurgeOnlyAfterTheDropAndQuiescence`, `TestMemberReportsAtOnceAPurgingIncarnationItNeverHeld`.

## Task order and dependencies

`PROTO_TAG_P4` (Plan S3-D Task 49, D26) and `CORE_TAG_P4` (Task 50) recorded → 57 (`PROTO_TAG_P5`) → 58 (housegate, `HG_TAG_P5`) in parallel with 59 → 60 → 61 → 62 → 63 (arbiter-core, one branch; Task 63 pins `HG_TAG_P5` and cuts `CORE_TAG_P5`). Tasks 57–61 need only the names of contract §39 and the `CORE_TAG_P4` base; Tasks 62–63 also need the S3-C2 (§20–§24) and S3-C4 (§29–§32) names listed in contract §43. Task 58 needs `PROTO_TAG_P5`; Task 63's release step needs `HG_TAG_P5`. A task that reads a ledger value starts only once the recording task's record has passed its R4 check. Plan S3-E2 Task 64 starts when `CORE_TAG_P5` is recorded; S3-E2 and S3-E3 may be drafted against this contract before it is.

Notes (facts recorded for Appendix B):
- **Additive only, names and numbers verbatim from contract §39.** Step 3 proves every new name is free at `PROTO_TAG_P4`, that each appended field takes its message's next number (no message reserves anything), that `ConsensusAdmin` ends with Plan S3-D's `GetTrackSettle` (16 methods) and `VerifierGateway` with `SubmitByteSideScan` (4), and that `TrackSettle` is the last message of `consensus.proto`. No release from `v0.1.0` to `v0.12.0` ever used a number this task appends: each watched message's highest number and `AdmissionCode`'s highest value never exceeded today's in any of the thirteen tags (read in drafting; Step 3 repeats it over every tag, `PROTO_TAG_P4` included), so no old binary gives one of them another meaning. If a line differs, stop and report a contract conflict; never rename or renumber.
- **Every proto hunk is a pure insertion.** `git diff -U0 -- proto/` is eighteen hunks whose old side is `,0` (nineteen insertions; the nine `BlockVerification` fields and the two messages after it share one hunk): the contract's comments are binding in substance, so `VerifierEntry` and `L3BlockTrack` keep their existing comment lines and gain the contract's stage-3 text (the `VerifierEntry` paragraph after its five comment lines, the `group_key` comment above the field) instead of replacing them. `table_registry.proto` gains its first import beyond `empty.proto`: `replay.proto`, for `TrackFrontier` (`replay.proto` imports nothing, so there is no cycle; `consensus.proto`, `arbiter.proto` and `raftlog.proto` already import both files).
- **Raft-reachable versus read-only.** `RaftCommand` reaches the parameter (through `ConsensusParamsUpdate.stage3`), `VerifierEntry`'s new fields and the five commands with everything they embed (`MemberCheckpoint`, `CheckpointGroup`, `ExcludedTable`, `CheckpointExclusionReason`, `TrackFrontier`): those numbers are what arbiter-core's strict decoder (`wire.Decode` → `validateCommandBytes`, `wire/command.go:387`, `wire/snapshot_query.go:1328`) will check at any depth once arbiter-core pins the release (Task 59), and a voter on an older decoder refuses tags 38–42, which is why Plans S3-E2–E4 propose them only after the v21 activation and their switch. The registry view of groups, the cutover view, the selection record and the messages that carry them (`TableIncarnation`, `TableRegistrySnapshot`, `BlockVerification`, `ConsensusParamsState`) stay unreachable, so `GroupMember.host_indexer_id`, the one served value that is not FSM state (D27), can never enter a command.
- **Wire inertness.** Every new field except the two `host_indexer_id` is a plain proto3 field: unset or zero, it is absent from the wire, so every message an older binary writes, and every message a `PROTO_TAG_P5` binary writes before the switch that sets the field, keeps its bytes; set, it only appends its own tags, because each new number follows every older one (`TestStage3ConsensusFieldsAbsentLeaveTheWireUnchanged`, which populates every older field and recurses into nested messages). The two `host_indexer_id` fields are proto3 `optional` because indexer 0 is devnet2's founding indexer: an explicit 0 is on the wire and differs from absent (`TestStage3ConsensusHostIndexerZeroIsDistinctFromAbsent`), and `GroupMember.host_indexer_id` is the only optional field among the new messages (`TestStage3ConsensusFieldLedgers` counts exactly one).
- **Two pins outside contract §39's list (found in drafting).** Appending the fields fails fifteen pre-existing tests (Step 10). Thirteen are the pins contract §39 lists. The other two are `TestConsensusUpdateContract` (`conformance/consensus_test.go:11-76`, which pins the field names and kinds of `ConsensusParamsUpdate`, `ConsensusMutableParams` and `ConsensusParamsState` in number order: `field count = 14, want 13` and twice `field count = 9, want 8`) and `TestSnapshotQueryEveryFieldWireRoundTrip` (`snapshot_query_test.go:23`, whose `snapshotQueryFields["L3BlockTrack"]` entry, `snapshot_query_fields_test.go:61`, says `indexer_id:uint64`: `field count = 2, want 1`). Neither file is frozen: Plan S2-A taught both of them the stage-2 additions (its Task 1 edited `consensus_test.go` rows 17-19 and 23-25 and added the `L3BlockTrack` entry). They learn the additions the same way, the `stage3`/`stage3_state` names with `MessageKind` appended to the three lists and `group_key:string` appended to the ledger entry, and nothing else in either file changes. Appendix B records this as an amendment of contract §39's pin list.
- **The other pins (contract §39).** The three pre-existing `AdmissionCode` value counts become 14; the field-count maps learn the new counts; `TestConsensusAdminRPCSignatures` 18 methods and two rows; `TestTableRegistryReadContract` five rows. `TestTracksFieldsAbsentLeaveTheWireUnchanged` populates only the fields numbered below the one under test (`f.Number() < tc.number`), because `stage3` now follows `tracks_enabled` and `groups`…`stage3` follow `quarantined_indexers`, and a populated later field would sit after the field under test in the deterministic encoding (in drafting the unchanged loop failed with `setting field 13 changed the bytes before it` for `ConsensusParamsUpdate`, and the same for field 8 of `ConsensusMutableParams` and field 9 of `TableRegistrySnapshot`). In `assertSnapshotBaselineDescriptors` the `stage3AppendedFields` exemption runs first, before `tracksFields`, because `stage3` and `stage3_state` are now the last fields of the three baseline messages (unexempted, `TestSnapshotQueryMainDescriptorsUnchanged` fails with `ConsensusMutableParams tracks addition must be exactly tracks_enabled = 8`); only `main_f7d9f070_descriptor.binpb` contains `consensus.proto`, and no other modified message (`VerifierEntry`, `TableIncarnation`, `TableRegistrySnapshot`, `L3BlockTrack`, `BlockVerification`) exists in either baseline. `AdmissionCode` and `RaftCommand` exist in both baselines but already allow appended values and tags.
- **D25.** In Plan S3-A's frozen `conformance/stage3_reads_test.go` exactly six hunks change: the `BlockVerification` ledger entry (34, the nine tokens appended after its thirteen P0 tokens, which stay byte-identical), the `ConsensusAdmin` count (231, 16 → 18), and in `TestStage3MessagesAreNotRaftReachable` the doc comment (252), both field counts and the failure message (284-285), the loop bound (287) and the failure message (289). Plan S3-D's `p4_settle_test.go` pins no count this task changes and passes unedited (in drafting, as its Notes predicted).
- **`stage3_test.go` pins what later plans need and no total a later plan could change except the contract's three** (`RaftCommand` 41 fields, `AdmissionCode` 14 values, the field counts of the eight extended messages); the `ConsensusAdmin` total stays with `TestConsensusAdminRPCSignatures` and `TestStage3RPCSignatures`, and the `VerifierGateway` total is not pinned (positions 0–5 are). Its tests walk names in sorted order, so `go test -v` lists subtests in a fixed order. Its prefix `TestStage3Consensus` also matches Plan S3-A's `TestStage3ConsensusHoldModeValues`, so the commands below that run only this task's tests anchor the regular expression. In drafting three mutations each failed the intended tests: `host_indexer_id` made non-optional (a compile error at `stage3_test.go:156`), a `DatabaseGroup` field added to `RebalanceGroupCmd` (`TestStage3ConsensusFieldLedgers` and `TestStage3ConsensusReadMessagesAreNotRaftReachable`), and tag 42 renumbered to 43 (`TestStage3ConsensusRaftCommandTags` and S3-A's `TestStage3MessagesAreNotRaftReachable`).
- **Downstream compile safety and the expected test fallout.** Every `ConsensusAdminServer` and `VerifierGatewayServer` implementation in arbiter and arbiter-core embeds the generated `Unimplemented…Server`, none embeds `Unsafe…Server`, and no repository hand-writes a client of either service (Step 3). In drafting, arbiter-core `cfd4f42`, arbiter `526a721`, sentio-node `5d2f169` and housegate `862a7a8` built and vetted against this task's tree through a `replace`, and the packages that import arbiter-proto passed their tests except four mirror tests that fail only because they see a new field: arbiter-core `conformance` `TestArbiterMirrorsMatchProto` (`ConsensusParamsUpdate: proto field "stage3" has no Go mirror json tag` and `VerifierEntry: proto field "<f>" has no Go mirror json tag` for fields 3–11; Task 59 adds the canonical fields), arbiter-core `wire` `TestPromotionOutcomesConvertersCopyEveryField` (`arbiter.L3BlockTrack.group_key is unset`: the `PromotionOutcome.track` converter of Plan S3-A Task 4 has no `GroupKey`; Tasks 59–60, see Appendix B), arbiter `server` `TestBlockVerificationToPBCarriesEveryField` (`BlockVerification.eligible_ring is not set by the test literal`) and `TestTableRegistryMirrorsProto` (`TableIncarnation: proto field "scoped_keeper_path" has no json tag`, the same for `purge_members`; both in Plan S3-E2 Task 64's pin commit). No repository pins `PROTO_TAG_P5` in this task, so no `main` turns red; Step 14 repeats the check at the revisions it meets, where later plans may add mirror tests that fail the same way, and stops on any failure that names no new field. housegate maps codes 12 and 13 to `OutcomeUnknown` until Task 58 (its tests pass unchanged); network-da vendors an old arbiter-proto and is not pinned by this plan.
- **Only six generated files change.** Cross-file references in generated code go through Go types, so `replay.pb.go`, `table_registry_grpc.pb.go`, `da*.pb.go` and `artifact_disposition*.pb.go` keep their bytes.
- **`make breaking` is not the gate.** It compares with the clone's local `main` (stale at `bb1823f`); the gate is `buf breaking --against ".git#tag=$PROTO_TAG_P4"` (contract §43, D26), which works from a worktree whose `.git` is a file, and CI repeats it against `origin/main` on the PR. Its `FILE` rules accept the new import, the appended fields (the synthetic oneofs of the two optional fields included), messages, enum values, tags and RPCs (checked in drafting against the `PROTO_TAG_P4` scratch tree: no output, exit 0).
- **`make tools` reads the Go module proxy** (`go install …@v1.36.11`), so Step 10 checks the installed generators against `Makefile:3-4` and Step 13 runs the contract's chain with `make tools` after a confirmation; Step 14 runs offline (`GOPROXY=off`) from the module cache.
- **The release number is never predicted.** `cut-release.yml` derives `vX.Y.Z` from the last tag's UTC day (a cut later on the day `PROTO_TAG_P4` was cut gives the next patch, on a later day the next minor); Steps 19–20 read it from the run, check its `PREVIOUS` is `PROTO_TAG_P4`, and Step 21 records what the run cut.
- **Every value a later block needs is in a file.** The Bash tool keeps no variables between calls, so each block sets `W`, `T57` and its paths itself and reads earlier results from `$HOME/.cache/s3e1-task57/`; no block contains a value to type in. The blocks are bash and run unchanged in the Bash tool's zsh; `bash -n` and `shellcheck -s bash` pass on every block, and in drafting Steps 1–3, 5–13, 15–21 ran end to end against mock origins of arbiter-proto (`PROTO_TAG_P4` stand-in) and housegate (the plan files with their Appendix C) with a fake `gh`, ending with `PROTO_TAG_P5=<tag>` from R4.

```go
// stage3ConsensusFields is the frozen field ledger of every message the
// multi-source SI stage-3 P5 wire contract adds (housegate spec 2026-10-14
// §6.1-§6.4, §7.1-§7.4, §9.1-§9.2; Plan S3-E1 contract §39), in the style of
// stage3Fields: the i-th token is field number i+1, "[]T" is repeated, and T
// is the scalar kind, the message name or the enum name. Every number is a
// consensus constant once the v21 activation commits. The two arbiter.proto
// entries are the every-field coverage TestSnapshotQueryLedgerCoversEveryNewMessage
// asks for; the others are pinned here only.
var stage3ConsensusFields = map[string]string{
	"Stage3Params":           "group_size:uint32 network_fill_default:bool min_safe_copies:uint32 strict_copies:bool indexer_failure_domains:[]IndexerFailureDomain max_lag_publications:uint32 lag_low:uint32 evidence_timeout_l2_blocks:uint64 max_uncleaned_parts_per_partition:uint32 max_uncleaned_parts_per_table:uint32 exclude_quarantined_hosts:bool purge:bool eviction_voiding:bool owner_aware_selection:bool placement:bool reselection:bool checkpoints:bool narrowed_drain:bool",
	"IndexerFailureDomain":   "indexer_id:uint64 failure_domain:string",
	"CheckpointGroup":        "database_id:string group_generation:uint64 excluded:[]ExcludedTable",
	"ExcludedTable":          "table_id:string reason:CheckpointExclusionReason",
	"MemberCheckpoint":       "node_id:string owner_indexer_id:uint64 checkpoint_seq:uint64 groups:[]CheckpointGroup snapshot_id:string entry:TrackFrontier",
	"MemberCheckpointCmd":    "checkpoint:MemberCheckpoint replica_jws:string",
	"MemberReadyCmd":         "node_id:string owner_indexer_id:uint64 database_id:string generation:uint64 ed25519_signature:string",
	"MemberCheckpointRecord": "checkpoint:MemberCheckpoint replica_jws:string epoch:uint64",
	"GroupMember":            "node_id:string joined_generation:uint64 ready_generation:uint64 member_class:MemberClass checkpoint:MemberCheckpointRecord observed_entry:TrackFrontier lag_advances:uint64 host_indexer_id:uint64",
	"LeavingMember":          "node_id:string removed_generation:uint64 release_entry:TrackFrontier frozen_members:[]string frozen_domains:uint32 released:bool",
	"DatabaseGroup":          "owner_indexer_id:uint64 database_id:string members:[]GroupMember network_fill:bool generation:uint64 past_members:[]string leaving:[]LeavingMember group_key:string placement_salt:string",
	"MemberCheckpointSeq":    "node_id:string owner_indexer_id:uint64 checkpoint_seq:uint64 replica_signer:string",
	"RebalanceGroupCmd":      "owner_indexer_id:uint64 database_id:string expected_generation:uint64 add:[]string remove:[]string network_fill:bool authority_jws:string",
	"ReselectVerifiersCmd":   "l3_block_seq:uint64 expected_set:[]string authority_jws:string",
	"MarkMemberLaggingCmd":   "node_id:string owner_indexer_id:uint64 database_id:string observed_entry:TrackFrontier authority_jws:string",
	"Stage3SwitchCutover":    "switch_name:string epoch:uint64 cutover_block_seq:uint64 cutover_promotion_seq:uint64",
	"Stage3StateView":        "activation_epoch:uint64 activation_block_seq:uint64 activation_promotion_seq:uint64 switches:[]Stage3SwitchCutover",
	"BlockGroupRef":          "database_id:string group_generation:uint64",
	"BlockReselection":       "replaced:[]string replacements:[]string ring_position:uint32 cursor_block:uint64 authority_jws:string authority_epoch:uint64",
}

// stage3ConsensusMessageFiles names the file each stage-3 P5 message is
// defined in: the parameter, the member commands and the registry view of
// groups in table_registry.proto (consensus.proto and arbiter.proto import it,
// and TableRegistrySnapshot carries them), the authority commands and the
// cutover view beside ConsensusAdmin in consensus.proto, and the selection
// record's two messages beside BlockVerification in arbiter.proto.
func stage3ConsensusMessageFiles() map[string]protoreflect.FileDescriptor {
	files := map[string]protoreflect.FileDescriptor{}
	for _, name := range []string{"Stage3Params", "IndexerFailureDomain", "CheckpointGroup", "ExcludedTable", "MemberCheckpoint", "MemberCheckpointCmd", "MemberReadyCmd", "MemberCheckpointRecord", "GroupMember", "LeavingMember", "DatabaseGroup", "MemberCheckpointSeq"} {
		files[name] = pb.File_table_registry_proto
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"RebalanceGroupCmd", "ReselectVerifiersCmd", "MarkMemberLaggingCmd", "Stage3SwitchCutover", "Stage3StateView"} {
		files[name] = pb.File_consensus_proto
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"BlockGroupRef", "BlockReselection"} {
		files[name] = pb.File_arbiter_proto
	}
	return files
}

// stage3AppendedFields pins the singular message field the stage-3 P5 wire
// contract appends to each consensus message that exists in the hash-pinned
// baselines: ConsensusMutableParams.stage3 = 9, ConsensusParamsUpdate.stage3 =
// 14 and ConsensusParamsState.stage3_state = 9. Each is now its message's last
// field, so assertSnapshotBaselineDescriptors strips it first, before
// tracksFields inspects the then-last tracks_enabled. Every existing baseline
// predates them, so the exemption applies unconditionally.
var stage3AppendedFields = map[string]*descriptorpb.FieldDescriptorProto{
	"ConsensusMutableParams": tracksMessage("stage3", "stage3", 9, ".arbiter.Stage3Params"),
	"ConsensusParamsUpdate":  tracksMessage("stage3", "stage3", 14, ".arbiter.Stage3Params"),
	"ConsensusParamsState":   tracksMessage("stage3_state", "stage3State", 9, ".arbiter.Stage3StateView"),
}

// TestStage3ConsensusFieldNumbers pins every field the stage-3 P5 wire
// contract appends to an existing message: name, number, kind, cardinality
// and message type, and each message's new field count. arbiter-core's strict
// Raft decoder refuses any field its descriptor does not know, at any depth,
// so a voter that disagrees on one of these numbers forks on the first
// command that carries it. Only VerifierEntry.host_indexer_id is proto3
// optional (indexer 0 is a valid host), inside its synthetic oneof; every
// other field is plain, outside any oneof, so it is off the wire while unset.
func TestStage3ConsensusFieldNumbers(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		msg      proto.Message
		name     protoreflect.Name
		number   protoreflect.FieldNumber
		kind     protoreflect.Kind
		repeated bool
		optional bool
		msgType  protoreflect.FullName
	}{
		{&pb.VerifierEntry{}, "host_indexer_id", 3, protoreflect.Uint64Kind, false, true, ""},
		{&pb.VerifierEntry{}, "replica_signer", 4, protoreflect.StringKind, false, false, ""},
		{&pb.VerifierEntry{}, "consent_jws", 5, protoreflect.StringKind, false, false, ""},
		{&pb.VerifierEntry{}, "weight", 6, protoreflect.Uint32Kind, false, false, ""},
		{&pb.VerifierEntry{}, "failure_domain", 7, protoreflect.StringKind, false, false, ""},
		{&pb.VerifierEntry{}, "verify", 8, protoreflect.BoolKind, false, false, ""},
		{&pb.VerifierEntry{}, "replicate", 9, protoreflect.BoolKind, false, false, ""},
		{&pb.VerifierEntry{}, "counts", 10, protoreflect.BoolKind, false, false, ""},
		{&pb.VerifierEntry{}, "shared_rmt", 11, protoreflect.BoolKind, false, false, ""},
		{&pb.ConsensusMutableParams{}, "stage3", 9, protoreflect.MessageKind, false, false, "arbiter.Stage3Params"},
		{&pb.ConsensusParamsUpdate{}, "stage3", 14, protoreflect.MessageKind, false, false, "arbiter.Stage3Params"},
		{&pb.ConsensusParamsState{}, "stage3_state", 9, protoreflect.MessageKind, false, false, "arbiter.Stage3StateView"},
		{&pb.TableIncarnation{}, "scoped_keeper_path", 19, protoreflect.BoolKind, false, false, ""},
		{&pb.TableIncarnation{}, "purge_members", 20, protoreflect.StringKind, true, false, ""},
		{&pb.TableRegistrySnapshot{}, "groups", 10, protoreflect.MessageKind, true, false, "arbiter.DatabaseGroup"},
		{&pb.TableRegistrySnapshot{}, "member_checkpoint_seqs", 11, protoreflect.MessageKind, true, false, "arbiter.MemberCheckpointSeq"},
		{&pb.TableRegistrySnapshot{}, "stage3", 12, protoreflect.MessageKind, false, false, "arbiter.Stage3Params"},
		{&pb.L3BlockTrack{}, "group_key", 2, protoreflect.StringKind, false, false, ""},
		{&pb.BlockVerification{}, "eligible_ring", 14, protoreflect.StringKind, true, false, ""},
		{&pb.BlockVerification{}, "ring_position", 15, protoreflect.Uint32Kind, false, false, ""},
		{&pb.BlockVerification{}, "marked_cursor_block", 16, protoreflect.Uint64Kind, false, false, ""},
		{&pb.BlockVerification{}, "group_key", 17, protoreflect.StringKind, false, false, ""},
		{&pb.BlockVerification{}, "group_members", 18, protoreflect.StringKind, true, false, ""},
		{&pb.BlockVerification{}, "group_fill", 19, protoreflect.BoolKind, false, false, ""},
		{&pb.BlockVerification{}, "group_databases", 20, protoreflect.MessageKind, true, false, "arbiter.BlockGroupRef"},
		{&pb.BlockVerification{}, "reselections", 21, protoreflect.MessageKind, true, false, "arbiter.BlockReselection"},
		{&pb.BlockVerification{}, "reselections_at_latch", 22, protoreflect.Uint32Kind, false, false, ""},
	} {
		d := tc.msg.ProtoReflect().Descriptor()
		t.Run(string(d.Name())+"."+string(tc.name), func(t *testing.T) {
			f := d.Fields().ByName(tc.name)
			if f == nil || f.Number() != tc.number || f.Kind() != tc.kind || f.IsList() != tc.repeated || f.IsMap() || f.HasOptionalKeyword() != tc.optional {
				t.Fatalf("field = %v, want number %d kind %s repeated %v optional %v", f, tc.number, tc.kind, tc.repeated, tc.optional)
			}
			if oneof := f.ContainingOneof(); (oneof != nil) != tc.optional || (oneof != nil && !oneof.IsSynthetic()) {
				t.Fatalf("field %s oneof = %v, want only the synthetic oneof of a proto3 optional field", tc.name, oneof)
			}
			if tc.msgType != "" && f.Message().FullName() != tc.msgType {
				t.Fatalf("message type = %s, want %s", f.Message().FullName(), tc.msgType)
			}
		})
	}
	for msg, want := range map[proto.Message]int{
		&pb.VerifierEntry{}: 11, &pb.ConsensusMutableParams{}: 9, &pb.ConsensusParamsUpdate{}: 14, &pb.ConsensusParamsState{}: 9,
		&pb.TableIncarnation{}: 20, &pb.TableRegistrySnapshot{}: 12, &pb.L3BlockTrack{}: 2, &pb.BlockVerification{}: 22,
	} {
		if got := msg.ProtoReflect().Descriptor().Fields().Len(); got != want {
			t.Fatalf("%s field count = %d, want %d", msg.ProtoReflect().Descriptor().Name(), got, want)
		}
	}
	// The generated optional field is a pointer, so 0 and absent stay apart.
	var _ *uint64 = (&pb.VerifierEntry{}).HostIndexerId
	var _ *uint64 = (&pb.GroupMember{}).HostIndexerId
}

// TestStage3ConsensusFieldLedgers pins every stage-3 P5 message field by
// field: name, number (contiguous from 1, in ledger order), cardinality and
// type, none in a map, and the file the message lives in. No field is proto3
// optional or in a oneof, with exactly one exception: GroupMember.host_indexer_id
// (field 8), the served host of a member, which keeps indexer 0 distinct from
// absent and sits only in its synthetic oneof. It then runs the every-field
// wire round trip of TestStage3FieldLedgers on the generated bindings: every
// field set (two items per list, nested messages filled recursively), each
// field encoded alone under its own tag, and the whole message decoded back
// unchanged.
func TestStage3ConsensusFieldLedgers(t *testing.T) {
	files := stage3ConsensusMessageFiles()
	if len(files) != len(stage3ConsensusFields) {
		t.Fatalf("%d stage-3 P5 messages have a home file, %d have a ledger", len(files), len(stage3ConsensusFields))
	}
	names := make([]string, 0, len(stage3ConsensusFields))
	for name := range stage3ConsensusFields {
		if _, ok := stage3Fields[name]; ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s is in both stage-3 ledgers", name)
		}
		names = append(names, name)
	}
	sort.Strings(names)
	optionals := 0
	for _, name := range names {
		spec := stage3ConsensusFields[name]
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			file, ok := files[name]
			if !ok {
				t.Fatalf("%s has no home file", name)
			}
			md := file.Messages().ByName(protoreflect.Name(name))
			if md == nil {
				t.Fatalf("%s is not defined in %s", name, file.Path())
			}
			mt, err := protoregistry.GlobalTypes.FindMessageByName(md.FullName())
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			in := mt.New()
			fields := md.Fields()
			want := strings.Fields(spec)
			if fields.Len() != len(want) {
				t.Fatalf("field count = %d, want %d", fields.Len(), len(want))
			}
			for i, item := range want {
				fieldName, typ, ok := strings.Cut(item, ":")
				if !ok {
					t.Fatalf("bad ledger token %q", item)
				}
				fd := fields.ByName(protoreflect.Name(fieldName))
				if fd == nil {
					t.Fatalf("missing field %s", fieldName)
				}
				repeated := strings.HasPrefix(typ, "[]")
				typ = strings.TrimPrefix(typ, "[]")
				optional := name == "GroupMember" && fieldName == "host_indexer_id"
				if fd.Number() != protoreflect.FieldNumber(i+1) || fd.IsList() != repeated || fd.IsMap() || fd.HasOptionalKeyword() != optional {
					t.Fatalf("%s allocation changed: %v", fieldName, fd)
				}
				if oneof := fd.ContainingOneof(); (oneof != nil) != optional || (oneof != nil && !oneof.IsSynthetic()) {
					t.Fatalf("%s oneof = %v, want none but a proto3 optional's synthetic one", fieldName, oneof)
				}
				if optional {
					optionals++
				}
				if got := stage3LedgerType(fd); got != typ {
					t.Fatalf("%s type = %s, want %s", fieldName, got, typ)
				}
				populateSnapshotField(in, fd, uint64(i+1))
				single := mt.New()
				populateSnapshotField(single, fd, uint64(i+1))
				raw, err := proto.Marshal(single.Interface())
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				number, _, n := protowire.ConsumeTag(raw)
				if n < 0 || number != protowire.Number(i+1) {
					t.Fatalf("%s encoded tag = %d", fieldName, number)
				}
				restored := mt.New()
				if err := proto.Unmarshal(raw, restored.Interface()); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if !proto.Equal(single.Interface(), restored.Interface()) {
					t.Fatalf("%s single-field round trip lost data", fieldName)
				}
			}
			raw, err := proto.Marshal(in.Interface())
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			out := mt.New()
			if err := proto.Unmarshal(raw, out.Interface()); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if !proto.Equal(in.Interface(), out.Interface()) {
				t.Fatalf("round trip lost data: %v", out)
			}
		})
	}
	if optionals != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("%d proto3 optional fields among the stage-3 P5 messages, want exactly GroupMember.host_indexer_id", optionals)
	}
}

// TestStage3ConsensusEnumValues pins the two stage-3 P5 enums by number and
// name. CheckpointExclusionReason is the closed set of checkpoint exclusions
// (Plan S3-E1 K63): a decoder refuses UNSPECIFIED and any value it does not
// list, so a new reason needs a new release. MemberClass is a member's class
// in one group (spec §9.2), published in the registry view.
func TestStage3ConsensusEnumValues(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		enum   protoreflect.EnumDescriptor
		values []protoreflect.Name
	}{
		{pb.CheckpointExclusionReason(0).Descriptor(), []protoreflect.Name{"CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_UNSPECIFIED", "CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_NOT_INSTALLED", "CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_DIVERGED", "CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_FOREIGN", "CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_DISK_THRESHOLD", "CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_AUDIT_PENDING", "CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_RETIRING"}},
		{pb.MemberClass(0).Descriptor(), []protoreflect.Name{"MEMBER_CLASS_UNSPECIFIED", "MEMBER_CLASS_BOOTSTRAPPING", "MEMBER_CLASS_CAUGHT_UP", "MEMBER_CLASS_BEHIND", "MEMBER_CLASS_LAGGING"}},
	} {
		t.Run(string(tc.enum.Name()), func(t *testing.T) {
			if tc.enum.ParentFile() != pb.File_table_registry_proto {
				t.Fatalf("%s is not defined in table_registry.proto", tc.enum.FullName())
			}
			if tc.enum.Values().Len() != len(tc.values) {
				t.Fatalf("%s has %d values, want %d", tc.enum.FullName(), tc.enum.Values().Len(), len(tc.values))
			}
			for i, name := range tc.values {
				if v := tc.enum.Values().Get(i); v.Number() != protoreflect.EnumNumber(i) || v.Name() != name {
					t.Fatalf("%s value %d = %v, want %s = %d", tc.enum.FullName(), i, v, name, i)
				}
			}
		})
	}
	// The generated constants later plans name, checked by the compiler.
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		got  protoreflect.Enum
		num  protoreflect.EnumNumber
		name string
	}{
		{pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_NOT_INSTALLED, 1, "CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_NOT_INSTALLED"},
		{pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_DIVERGED, 2, "CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_DIVERGED"},
		{pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_FOREIGN, 3, "CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_FOREIGN"},
		{pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_DISK_THRESHOLD, 4, "CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_DISK_THRESHOLD"},
		{pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_AUDIT_PENDING, 5, "CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_AUDIT_PENDING"},
		{pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_RETIRING, 6, "CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_RETIRING"},
		{pb.MemberClass_MEMBER_CLASS_BOOTSTRAPPING, 1, "MEMBER_CLASS_BOOTSTRAPPING"},
		{pb.MemberClass_MEMBER_CLASS_CAUGHT_UP, 2, "MEMBER_CLASS_CAUGHT_UP"},
		{pb.MemberClass_MEMBER_CLASS_BEHIND, 3, "MEMBER_CLASS_BEHIND"},
		{pb.MemberClass_MEMBER_CLASS_LAGGING, 4, "MEMBER_CLASS_LAGGING"},
	} {
		if tc.got.Number() != tc.num || string(tc.got.Descriptor().Values().ByNumber(tc.num).Name()) != tc.name {
			t.Fatalf("%v = %d, want %s = %d", tc.got, tc.got.Number(), tc.name, tc.num)
		}
	}
}

// TestStage3ConsensusAdmissionCodes pins the two stage-3 admission codes by
// number and name: HouseGate maps arbiter codes through their enum name and
// treats an unknown one as an unknown outcome, so a renumbering would send a
// refused statement to status probing (Plan S3-E1 K59).
func TestStage3ConsensusAdmissionCodes(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		code pb.AdmissionCode
		num  int32
		name string
	}{
		{pb.AdmissionCode_ADMISSION_CODE_INDEXER_QUARANTINED, 11, "ADMISSION_CODE_INDEXER_QUARANTINED"},
		{pb.AdmissionCode_ADMISSION_CODE_VERIFIERS_UNAVAILABLE, 12, "ADMISSION_CODE_VERIFIERS_UNAVAILABLE"},
		{pb.AdmissionCode_ADMISSION_CODE_COPIES_BACKPRESSURE, 13, "ADMISSION_CODE_COPIES_BACKPRESSURE"},
	} {
		if int32(tc.code) != tc.num || tc.code.String() != tc.name {
			t.Fatalf("%s = %d, want %s = %d", tc.code, int32(tc.code), tc.name, tc.num)
		}
	}
	if n := pb.AdmissionCode(0).Descriptor().Values().Len(); n != 14 {
		t.Fatalf("AdmissionCode has %d values, want 14", n)
	}
}

// TestStage3ConsensusRaftCommandTags pins the five stage-3 Raft commands as
// tags 38-42 of RaftCommand's cmd oneof, the only oneof members above the
// stage-2 tag 37, with tag 29 still unused. A voter whose decoder lacks them
// refuses the command, so none is proposed before the v21 activation and its
// switch (placement: 38, 40; reselection: 39; checkpoints: 41, 42).
func TestStage3ConsensusRaftCommandTags(t *testing.T) {
	raft := (&pb.RaftCommand{}).ProtoReflect().Descriptor()
	cmd := raft.Oneofs().ByName("cmd")
	if cmd == nil || raft.Fields().Len() != 41 || cmd.Fields().Len() != 41 {
		t.Fatalf("RaftCommand has %d fields, want 41 oneof tags", raft.Fields().Len())
	}
	tags := map[protoreflect.FieldNumber]struct{ name, typ string }{
		38: {"rebalance_group", "RebalanceGroupCmd"},
		39: {"reselect_verifiers", "ReselectVerifiersCmd"},
		40: {"member_ready", "MemberReadyCmd"},
		41: {"member_checkpoint", "MemberCheckpointCmd"},
		42: {"mark_member_lagging", "MarkMemberLaggingCmd"},
	}
	for number := protoreflect.FieldNumber(38); number <= 42; number++ {
		tc := tags[number]
		if f := cmd.Fields().ByNumber(number); f == nil || f.Name() != protoreflect.Name(tc.name) {
			t.Fatalf("RaftCommand tag %d = %v, want %s", number, f, tc.name)
		}
		assertSnapshotVariant(t, &pb.RaftCommand{}, "cmd", tc.name, number, tc.typ)
	}
	for i := 0; i < raft.Fields().Len(); i++ {
		if f := raft.Fields().Get(i); f.Number() > 37 && tags[f.Number()].name == "" {
			t.Fatalf("RaftCommand tag %d (%s) is not a stage-3 command", f.Number(), f.Name())
		}
	}
	if f := raft.Fields().ByNumber(29); f != nil {
		t.Fatalf("RaftCommand tag 29 must stay unused, got %s", f.Name())
	}
	if f := raft.Fields().ByNumber(37); f == nil || f.Name() != "release_indexer" {
		t.Fatalf("RaftCommand tag 37 = %v, want release_indexer", f)
	}
	// The generated oneof wrappers and getters later plans use, checked by the
	// compiler.
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		cmd *pb.RaftCommand
		get func(*pb.RaftCommand) proto.Message
	}{
		{&pb.RaftCommand{Cmd: &pb.RaftCommand_RebalanceGroup{RebalanceGroup: &pb.RebalanceGroupCmd{}}}, func(c *pb.RaftCommand) proto.Message { return c.GetRebalanceGroup() }},
		{&pb.RaftCommand{Cmd: &pb.RaftCommand_ReselectVerifiers{ReselectVerifiers: &pb.ReselectVerifiersCmd{}}}, func(c *pb.RaftCommand) proto.Message { return c.GetReselectVerifiers() }},
		{&pb.RaftCommand{Cmd: &pb.RaftCommand_MemberReady{MemberReady: &pb.MemberReadyCmd{}}}, func(c *pb.RaftCommand) proto.Message { return c.GetMemberReady() }},
		{&pb.RaftCommand{Cmd: &pb.RaftCommand_MemberCheckpoint{MemberCheckpoint: &pb.MemberCheckpointCmd{}}}, func(c *pb.RaftCommand) proto.Message { return c.GetMemberCheckpoint() }},
		{&pb.RaftCommand{Cmd: &pb.RaftCommand_MarkMemberLagging{MarkMemberLagging: &pb.MarkMemberLaggingCmd{}}}, func(c *pb.RaftCommand) proto.Message { return c.GetMarkMemberLagging() }},
	} {
		if !tc.get(tc.cmd).ProtoReflect().IsValid() || tc.get(&pb.RaftCommand{}).ProtoReflect().IsValid() {
			t.Fatalf("getter does not report exactly the command of %v", tc.cmd)
		}
	}
}

// TestStage3ConsensusRPCSignatures pins the four stage-3 P5 RPCs: unary, with
// exactly these request and response types, ConsensusAdmin's RebalanceGroup
// and MarkMemberLagging at indices 16 and 17 after Plan S3-D's GetTrackSettle
// (15), VerifierGateway's SubmitMemberReady and SubmitMemberCheckpoint at 4 and
// 5 after SubmitByteSideScan (3), the generated full method names and client
// and server signatures, and that a server embedding the generated stub
// answers Unimplemented until the arbiter implements them (Plans S3-E3 and
// S3-E4). The request of each is its Raft command. ConsensusAdmin's total is
// pinned by TestConsensusAdminRPCSignatures and TestStage3RPCSignatures.
func TestStage3ConsensusRPCSignatures(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		file          protoreflect.FileDescriptor
		service       protoreflect.Name
		previous      protoreflect.Name
		previousIndex int
		index         int
		method        protoreflect.Name
		input, output protoreflect.FullName
		fullName      string
		server        any
	}{
		{pb.File_consensus_proto, "ConsensusAdmin", "GetTrackSettle", 15, 16, "RebalanceGroup", "arbiter.RebalanceGroupCmd", "arbiter.Ack", pb.ConsensusAdmin_RebalanceGroup_FullMethodName, pb.UnimplementedConsensusAdminServer{}},
		{pb.File_consensus_proto, "ConsensusAdmin", "GetTrackSettle", 15, 17, "MarkMemberLagging", "arbiter.MarkMemberLaggingCmd", "arbiter.Ack", pb.ConsensusAdmin_MarkMemberLagging_FullMethodName, pb.UnimplementedConsensusAdminServer{}},
		{pb.File_arbiter_proto, "VerifierGateway", "SubmitByteSideScan", 3, 4, "SubmitMemberReady", "arbiter.MemberReadyCmd", "arbiter.Ack", pb.VerifierGateway_SubmitMemberReady_FullMethodName, pb.UnimplementedVerifierGatewayServer{}},
		{pb.File_arbiter_proto, "VerifierGateway", "SubmitByteSideScan", 3, 5, "SubmitMemberCheckpoint", "arbiter.MemberCheckpointCmd", "arbiter.Ack", pb.VerifierGateway_SubmitMemberCheckpoint_FullMethodName, pb.UnimplementedVerifierGatewayServer{}},
	} {
		t.Run(string(tc.service)+"/"+string(tc.method), func(t *testing.T) {
			svc := tc.file.Services().ByName(tc.service)
			if svc == nil {
				t.Fatalf("service %s missing from %s", tc.service, tc.file.Path())
			}
			if m := svc.Methods().ByName(tc.previous); m == nil || m.Index() != tc.previousIndex {
				t.Fatalf("%s.%s = %v, want it to keep index %d", tc.service, tc.previous, m, tc.previousIndex)
			}
			m := svc.Methods().ByName(tc.method)
			if m == nil || m.Index() != tc.index || m.Input().FullName() != tc.input || m.Output().FullName() != tc.output || m.IsStreamingClient() || m.IsStreamingServer() {
				t.Fatalf("%s.%s = %v, want unary %s -> %s at index %d", tc.service, tc.method, m, tc.input, tc.output, tc.index)
			}
			if want := "/arbiter." + string(tc.service) + "/" + string(tc.method); tc.fullName != want {
				t.Fatalf("full method name = %q, want %q", tc.fullName, want)
			}
			fn := reflect.ValueOf(tc.server).MethodByName(string(tc.method))
			if !fn.IsValid() {
				t.Fatal("generated stub missing")
			}
			result := fn.Call([]reflect.Value{reflect.ValueOf(context.Background()), reflect.New(fn.Type().In(1).Elem())})
			if !result[0].IsNil() || result[1].IsNil() {
				t.Fatal("new RPC returned success before implementation")
			}
			if code := status.Code(result[1].Interface().(error)); code != codes.Unimplemented {
				t.Fatalf("code = %s, want Unimplemented", code)
			}
		})
	}
	// The generated client and server signatures, checked by the compiler.
	var (
		_ func(pb.ConsensusAdminClient, context.Context, *pb.RebalanceGroupCmd, ...grpc.CallOption) (*pb.Ack, error)    = pb.ConsensusAdminClient.RebalanceGroup
		_ func(pb.ConsensusAdminClient, context.Context, *pb.MarkMemberLaggingCmd, ...grpc.CallOption) (*pb.Ack, error) = pb.ConsensusAdminClient.MarkMemberLagging
		_ func(pb.VerifierGatewayClient, context.Context, *pb.MemberReadyCmd, ...grpc.CallOption) (*pb.Ack, error)      = pb.VerifierGatewayClient.SubmitMemberReady
		_ func(pb.VerifierGatewayClient, context.Context, *pb.MemberCheckpointCmd, ...grpc.CallOption) (*pb.Ack, error) = pb.VerifierGatewayClient.SubmitMemberCheckpoint
		_ func(pb.ConsensusAdminServer, context.Context, *pb.RebalanceGroupCmd) (*pb.Ack, error)                        = pb.ConsensusAdminServer.RebalanceGroup
		_ func(pb.ConsensusAdminServer, context.Context, *pb.MarkMemberLaggingCmd) (*pb.Ack, error)                     = pb.ConsensusAdminServer.MarkMemberLagging
		_ func(pb.VerifierGatewayServer, context.Context, *pb.MemberReadyCmd) (*pb.Ack, error)                          = pb.VerifierGatewayServer.SubmitMemberReady
		_ func(pb.VerifierGatewayServer, context.Context, *pb.MemberCheckpointCmd) (*pb.Ack, error)                     = pb.VerifierGatewayServer.SubmitMemberCheckpoint
	)
}

// TestStage3ConsensusReadMessagesAreNotRaftReachable is the read-only rule of
// Plan S3-E1 contract §39 at the descriptor level: no RaftCommand field
// reaches the registry view of groups, the cutover view, the BlockVerification
// selection record or any message that carries them, at any depth, so no
// command can carry a served value (GroupMember.host_indexer_id among them)
// into consensus. The parameter, the five commands and what they embed are
// Raft-reachable, which is what makes their numbers consensus constants.
func TestStage3ConsensusReadMessagesAreNotRaftReachable(t *testing.T) {
	reachable := reachableTypes((&pb.RaftCommand{}).ProtoReflect().Descriptor())
	for _, name := range []protoreflect.FullName{
		"arbiter.DatabaseGroup", "arbiter.GroupMember", "arbiter.MemberClass", "arbiter.MemberCheckpointRecord",
		"arbiter.LeavingMember", "arbiter.MemberCheckpointSeq", "arbiter.BlockGroupRef", "arbiter.BlockReselection",
		"arbiter.Stage3SwitchCutover", "arbiter.Stage3StateView", "arbiter.TableIncarnation", "arbiter.TableRegistrySnapshot",
		"arbiter.BlockVerification", "arbiter.ConsensusParamsState",
	} {
		if reachable[name] {
			t.Errorf("RaftCommand reaches read-only %s", name)
		}
	}
	for _, name := range []protoreflect.FullName{
		"arbiter.Stage3Params", "arbiter.IndexerFailureDomain", "arbiter.RebalanceGroupCmd", "arbiter.ReselectVerifiersCmd",
		"arbiter.MarkMemberLaggingCmd", "arbiter.MemberReadyCmd", "arbiter.MemberCheckpointCmd", "arbiter.MemberCheckpoint",
		"arbiter.CheckpointGroup", "arbiter.ExcludedTable", "arbiter.CheckpointExclusionReason", "arbiter.VerifierEntry",
	} {
		if !reachable[name] {
			t.Errorf("RaftCommand walk does not reach %s", name)
		}
	}
	// The walk has teeth: each read response reaches every read-only message
	// it serves.
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		root  proto.Message
		names []protoreflect.FullName
	}{
		{&pb.TableRegistrySnapshot{}, []protoreflect.FullName{"arbiter.DatabaseGroup", "arbiter.GroupMember", "arbiter.MemberClass", "arbiter.MemberCheckpointRecord", "arbiter.LeavingMember", "arbiter.MemberCheckpointSeq", "arbiter.Stage3Params", "arbiter.TableIncarnation"}},
		{&pb.ConsensusParamsState{}, []protoreflect.FullName{"arbiter.Stage3StateView", "arbiter.Stage3SwitchCutover", "arbiter.Stage3Params", "arbiter.VerifierEntry"}},
		{&pb.BlockVerification{}, []protoreflect.FullName{"arbiter.BlockGroupRef", "arbiter.BlockReselection"}},
	} {
		served := reachableTypes(tc.root.ProtoReflect().Descriptor())
		for _, name := range tc.names {
			if !served[name] {
				t.Fatalf("%s walk does not reach %s", tc.root.ProtoReflect().Descriptor().Name(), name)
			}
		}
	}
}

// TestStage3ConsensusFieldsAbsentLeaveTheWireUnchanged is the wire half of
// the activation model (Plan S3-E1 contract §38): every message that gained a
// stage-3 P5 field encodes, with every older field set and the new one unset
// or zero, without any trace of it, so whatever a P5 binary writes before the
// switch that sets a field is byte for byte what a PROTO_TAG_P4 binary writes.
// Setting the field only appends its own tags after those unchanged bytes,
// because the new fields follow every older one. host_indexer_id is proto3
// optional, so its explicit zero is on the wire by design
// (TestStage3ConsensusHostIndexerZeroIsDistinctFromAbsent).
func TestStage3ConsensusFieldsAbsentLeaveTheWireUnchanged(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		msg         func() proto.Message
		first, last protoreflect.FieldNumber
	}{
		{func() proto.Message { return &pb.VerifierEntry{} }, 3, 11},
		{func() proto.Message { return &pb.ConsensusMutableParams{} }, 9, 9},
		{func() proto.Message { return &pb.ConsensusParamsUpdate{} }, 14, 14},
		{func() proto.Message { return &pb.ConsensusParamsState{} }, 9, 9},
		{func() proto.Message { return &pb.TableIncarnation{} }, 19, 20},
		{func() proto.Message { return &pb.TableRegistrySnapshot{} }, 10, 12},
		{func() proto.Message { return &pb.L3BlockTrack{} }, 2, 2},
		{func() proto.Message { return &pb.BlockVerification{} }, 14, 22},
	} {
		for number := tc.first; number <= tc.last; number++ {
			msg := tc.msg()
			m := msg.ProtoReflect()
			fd := m.Descriptor().Fields().ByNumber(number)
			t.Run(string(m.Descriptor().Name())+"."+string(fd.Name()), func(t *testing.T) {
				fields := m.Descriptor().Fields()
				for i := 0; i < fields.Len(); i++ {
					if f := fields.Get(i); f.Number() < tc.first {
						populateSnapshotField(m, f, uint64(i+1))
					}
				}
				legacy := deterministicBytes(t, msg)
				for _, n := range wireFieldNumbers(t, legacy) {
					if n >= tc.first {
						t.Fatalf("stage-3 field %d is on the wire before it is set: %x", n, legacy)
					}
				}
				if fd.Message() == nil && !fd.IsList() && !fd.HasOptionalKeyword() {
					m.Set(fd, fd.Default())
					if got := deterministicBytes(t, msg); !bytes.Equal(got, legacy) {
						t.Fatalf("explicit zero of field %d encodes as %x, want %x", number, got, legacy)
					}
				}
				populateSnapshotField(m, fd, 1)
				full := deterministicBytes(t, msg)
				if !bytes.HasPrefix(full, legacy) {
					t.Fatalf("setting field %d changed the bytes before it: %x, want prefix %x", number, full, legacy)
				}
				tail := wireFieldNumbers(t, full[len(legacy):])
				if len(tail) == 0 || slices.ContainsFunc(tail, func(n protowire.Number) bool { return n != number }) {
					t.Fatalf("setting field %d appended fields %v", number, tail)
				}
			})
		}
	}
}

// TestStage3ConsensusHostIndexerZeroIsDistinctFromAbsent pins why the two
// host_indexer_id fields are proto3 optional: indexer 0 is a valid host
// (devnet2's founding indexer), so a member hosted by indexer 0 must reach the
// wire as an explicit 0 that differs from a network-pool entry, respectively a
// member served without a host, and decode back with its presence.
func TestStage3ConsensusHostIndexerZeroIsDistinctFromAbsent(t *testing.T) {
	zero := uint64(0)
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name          string
		absent, host0 proto.Message
		number        protowire.Number
		host          func(proto.Message) *uint64
	}{
		{"VerifierEntry", &pb.VerifierEntry{NodeId: "member-a", Ed25519Pubkey: []byte{1, 2, 3}}, &pb.VerifierEntry{NodeId: "member-a", Ed25519Pubkey: []byte{1, 2, 3}, HostIndexerId: &zero}, 3,
			func(m proto.Message) *uint64 { return m.(*pb.VerifierEntry).HostIndexerId }},
		{"GroupMember", &pb.GroupMember{NodeId: "member-a", JoinedGeneration: 1, LagAdvances: 2}, &pb.GroupMember{NodeId: "member-a", JoinedGeneration: 1, LagAdvances: 2, HostIndexerId: &zero}, 8,
			func(m proto.Message) *uint64 { return m.(*pb.GroupMember).HostIndexerId }},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			absent := deterministicBytes(t, tc.absent)
			host0 := deterministicBytes(t, tc.host0)
			if want := protowire.AppendVarint(protowire.AppendTag(bytes.Clone(absent), tc.number, protowire.VarintType), 0); !bytes.Equal(host0, want) {
				t.Fatalf("host 0 encodes as %x, want %x", host0, want)
			}
			back := tc.absent.ProtoReflect().New().Interface()
			if err := proto.Unmarshal(host0, back); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if got := tc.host(back); got == nil || *got != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("decoded host = %v, want present 0", got)
			}
			none := tc.absent.ProtoReflect().New().Interface()
			if err := proto.Unmarshal(absent, none); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if got := tc.host(none); got != nil {
				t.Fatalf("decoded absent host = %d, want nil", *got)
			}
		})
	}
}
```

```proto
  // sorted by (node_id, owner_indexer_id); kept through group removal.
  repeated MemberCheckpointSeq member_checkpoint_seqs = 11;
  // The committed stage-3 parameter, so data-plane nodes learn the switches
  // through the registry follower (plan S3-E1 K64); absent before the v21
  // activation. Every committed change bumps version.
  Stage3Params stage3 = 12;
```

After the closing `}` of `message RecordTablePurgedCmd` (150), with one blank line on each side (the `// TableRegistry read API (sub-project 2c)` banner follows), insert the member commands, each both a `VerifierGateway` request and a Raft command (the `RecordTablePurgedCmd` precedent):

```proto
// CheckpointExclusionReason is why a checkpoint excludes a table (plan S3-E1
// K63): a closed set; UNSPECIFIED and unknown values are refused.
enum CheckpointExclusionReason {
  CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
  CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_NOT_INSTALLED = 1;
  CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_DIVERGED = 2;
  CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_FOREIGN = 3;
  CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_DISK_THRESHOLD = 4;
  CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_AUDIT_PENDING = 5;
  CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_RETIRING = 6;
}

message ExcludedTable {
  string table_id = 1;
  CheckpointExclusionReason reason = 2;
}

// CheckpointGroup is one group a checkpoint speaks for; excluded is sorted by
// table_id without duplicates.
message CheckpointGroup {
  string database_id = 1;
  uint64 group_generation = 2;
  repeated ExcludedTable excluded = 3;
}

// MemberCheckpoint is a replicate member's statement that its copies of the
// listed groups' tables equal the manifest snapshot_id at entry =
// track_frontiers[owner] (spec §9.1). checkpoint_seq strictly increases per
// (member, owner); groups is sorted by database_id without duplicates.
message MemberCheckpoint {
  string node_id = 1;
  uint64 owner_indexer_id = 2;
  uint64 checkpoint_seq = 3;
  repeated CheckpointGroup groups = 4;
  string snapshot_id = 5;
  TrackFrontier entry = 6;
}

// MemberCheckpointCmd (Raft tag 41): replica_jws is the ES256K compact JWS of
// the member's verifiers-entry replica_signer, purpose
// "arbiter-member-checkpoint-v1", over the checkpoint bound to the network id
// and genesis snapshot id. Proposed only after the checkpoints switch.
message MemberCheckpointCmd {
  MemberCheckpoint checkpoint = 1;
  string replica_jws = 2;
}

// MemberReadyCmd (Raft tag 40): a member reports its hg_member_unsafe
// replicas of group (owner_indexer_id, database_id) at generation (spec
// §6.4). ed25519_signature is hex, by the node's verifiers-entry ed25519 key,
// over the "arbiter-member-ready-v1" hash of {node_id, owner_indexer_id,
// database_id, generation} and the network context. Proposed only after the
// placement switch.
message MemberReadyCmd {
  string node_id = 1;
  uint64 owner_indexer_id = 2;
  string database_id = 3;
  uint64 generation = 4;
  string ed25519_signature = 5;
}
```

After the closing `}` of `message PurgeNodeSet` (262), with one blank line on each side (`message WatchTableRegistryRequest` follows), insert the registry view of groups (read-only: no `RaftCommand` field reaches any of these):

```proto
// MemberClass is a member's class in one group (spec §9.2). A Leaving member
// is not in DatabaseGroup.members; its record is in DatabaseGroup.leaving.
enum MemberClass {
  MEMBER_CLASS_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
  MEMBER_CLASS_BOOTSTRAPPING = 1;
  MEMBER_CLASS_CAUGHT_UP = 2;
  MEMBER_CLASS_BEHIND = 3;
  MEMBER_CLASS_LAGGING = 4;
}

// MemberCheckpointRecord is a stored checkpoint with its signature and the
// consensus epoch whose replica_signer verified it.
message MemberCheckpointRecord {
  MemberCheckpoint checkpoint = 1;
  string replica_jws = 2;
  uint64 epoch = 3;
}

// GroupMember is one current member of a group. ready_generation is 0 until
// a MemberReady is recorded; the member is ready once ready_generation >=
// joined_generation. checkpoint is the stored checkpoint for this group, absent
// before the first; observed_entry is set only while member_class is LAGGING;
// lag_advances counts the owner's published advances after the checkpoint
// entry, saturating at stage3.max_lag_publications + 1, and is 0 without a
// checkpoint (plan S3-E3 K76). host_indexer_id is the host_indexer_id of the
// member's entry in the committed verifiers parameter, filled by the server
// when it serves the view (never stored in FSM state; fixed for the entry's
// life, plan S3-E2 K68); it is absent while the node has no host-bound
// verifiers entry (a delisted member stays in members, plan S3-E3 K73), and a
// consensus update that lists or delists a member changes the view, so it
// bumps version. optional because indexer 0 is a valid host.
message GroupMember {
  string node_id = 1;
  uint64 joined_generation = 2;
  uint64 ready_generation = 3;
  MemberClass member_class = 4;
  MemberCheckpointRecord checkpoint = 5;
  TrackFrontier observed_entry = 6;
  uint64 lag_advances = 7;
  optional uint64 host_indexer_id = 8;
}

// LeavingMember is a member a RebalanceGroup removed (spec §6.4):
// release_entry is the owner's latest published entry when it applied;
// frozen_members and frozen_domains are E (node ids, sorted) and |E| as they
// were then, for the release outside strict mode; released is set the first
// time the release condition holds and never cleared.
message LeavingMember {
  string node_id = 1;
  uint64 removed_generation = 2;
  TrackFrontier release_entry = 3;
  repeated string frozen_members = 4;
  uint32 frozen_domains = 5;
  bool released = 6;
}

// DatabaseGroup is G(owner, database) (spec §6.2). members is sorted by
// node_id; past_members is sorted without duplicates; leaving is sorted by
// node_id; group_key is the current GroupKey (spec §7.1); placement_salt is
// the salt the placement used (plan S3-E1 K61).
message DatabaseGroup {
  uint64 owner_indexer_id = 1;
  string database_id = 2;
  repeated GroupMember members = 3;
  bool network_fill = 4;
  uint64 generation = 5;
  repeated string past_members = 6;
  repeated LeavingMember leaving = 7;
  string group_key = 8;
  string placement_salt = 9;
}

// MemberCheckpointSeq is the highest accepted checkpoint_seq of one member for
// one owner under replica_signer (spec §9.1); a member signs its next
// checkpoint above both its journal and this value.
message MemberCheckpointSeq {
  string node_id = 1;
  uint64 owner_indexer_id = 2;
  uint64 checkpoint_seq = 3;
  string replica_signer = 4;
}
```
