- [ ] **Step 7: Write the failing converter, command and golden tests**

`wire/stage3_test.go` proves that every `VerifierEntry` field survives the converters and the bytes (a pool entry with arbiter-proto `v0.11.0`'s exact bytes, host 0 distinct from no host, no shared pointer), that the `stage3` parameter round-trips in an update and alone and stays absent when absent, that each command encodes at its tag and comes back identical with every field seeded, that the strict decoder refuses an unknown field inside every new message, that `Canonical` and `Body` give the signing forms, and that an unknown exclusion reason is refused. Create `wire/stage3_test.go`:

```go
package wire

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/encoding/protowire"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/reflect/protoreflect"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
)

// stage3ParamsFixture sets every Stage3Params field and passes Validate: every
// switch is on, so strict copies and min_safe_copies 2 are allowed.
func stage3ParamsFixture() *arbiter.Stage3Params {
	return &arbiter.Stage3Params{GroupSize: 3, NetworkFillDefault: true, MinSafeCopies: 2, StrictCopies: true,
		IndexerFailureDomains: []arbiter.IndexerFailureDomain{{IndexerID: 0, FailureDomain: "node:test-a"}, {IndexerID: 1, FailureDomain: "node:test-b"}},
		MaxLagPublications:    4, LagLow: 2, EvidenceTimeoutL2Blocks: 30, MaxUncleanedPartsPerPartition: 2400, MaxUncleanedPartsPerTable: 20000,
		ExcludeQuarantinedHosts: true, Purge: true, EvictionVoiding: true, OwnerAwareSelection: true, Placement: true,
		Reselection: true, Checkpoints: true, NarrowedDrain: true}
}

// memberVerifierEntry is a member entry with every field explicit (plan S3-E1
// K58); key fills the 32 key bytes.
func memberVerifierEntry(nodeID string, host uint64, domain string, key byte) arbiter.VerifierEntry {
	return arbiter.VerifierEntry{NodeID: nodeID, Ed25519Pubkey: bytes.Repeat([]byte{key}, 32), HostIndexerID: &host,
		ReplicaSigner: fmt.Sprintf("0x%040x", 0xe0+uint64(key)), ConsentJWS: "c.o.n", Weight: 2, FailureDomain: domain,
		Verify: true, Replicate: true, Counts: true, SharedRMT: true}
}

// wireFieldNumbers lists the top-level field numbers of an encoded message.
func wireFieldNumbers(t *testing.T, b []byte) []protowire.Number {
	t.Helper()
	var out []protowire.Number
	for len(b) > 0 {
		num, typ, n := protowire.ConsumeTag(b)
		if n < 0 {
			t.Fatalf("invalid tag in %x", b)
		}
		b = b[n:]
		n = protowire.ConsumeFieldValue(num, typ, b)
		if n < 0 {
			t.Fatalf("invalid field %d", num)
		}
		b = b[n:]
		out = append(out, num)
	}
	return out
}

// eachFlagAlone calls check with a copy of base for every bool field of its
// type, that field true and every other bool false, so a converter that swaps
// two flags fails even where a seeded value sets them all.
func eachFlagAlone[T any](base T, check func(name string, v T)) {
	rt := reflect.TypeOf(base)
	for i := 0; i < rt.NumField(); i++ {
		if rt.Field(i).Type.Kind() != reflect.Bool {
			continue
		}
		v := base
		rv := reflect.ValueOf(&v).Elem()
		for j := 0; j < rt.NumField(); j++ {
			if rt.Field(j).Type.Kind() == reflect.Bool {
				rv.Field(j).SetBool(j == i)
			}
		}
		check(rt.Field(i).Name, v)
	}
}

func mustMarshal(t *testing.T, m proto.Message) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := proto.Marshal(m)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return b
}

// TestVerifierEntryEveryFieldSurvivesThePBRoundTrip: every field of
// arbiter.VerifierEntry, seeded by reflection with its own value, reaches the
// message, survives the wire bytes and decodes back (plan S3-E1 contract §41;
// the stage-2 converters copied only node_id and ed25519_pubkey). The Go
// type and the message have the same field count, so a field added to either
// fails here until both converters carry it. A pool entry encodes exactly as
// under arbiter-proto v0.11.0, host 0 stays distinct from no host, and no
// slice or pointer is shared with the caller.
func TestVerifierEntryEveryFieldSurvivesThePBRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	if got, want := reflect.TypeOf(arbiter.VerifierEntry{}).NumField(), (&pb.VerifierEntry{}).ProtoReflect().Descriptor().Fields().Len(); got != want {
		t.Fatalf("arbiter.VerifierEntry has %d fields, pb.VerifierEntry %d", got, want)
	}
	var seeded arbiter.VerifierEntry
	var serial uint64
	seedSnapshot(reflect.ValueOf(&seeded).Elem(), "entry", &serial)
	pool := arbiter.VerifierEntry{NodeID: "verifier-1", Ed25519Pubkey: bytes.Repeat([]byte{7}, 32)}
	hostZero := memberVerifierEntry("member-a", 0, "node:test-a", 0x0a)
	entries := []arbiter.VerifierEntry{seeded, pool, hostZero}

	ms := VerifierEntriesToPB(entries)
	assertEveryFieldPopulated(t, ms[0].ProtoReflect(), nil)
	if got, want := hex.EncodeToString(mustMarshal(t, ms[1])), "0a0a76657269666965722d311220"+strings.Repeat("07", 32); got != want {
		t.Fatalf("pool entry bytes = %s, want arbiter-proto v0.11.0's %s", got, want)
	}
	if ms[1].HostIndexerId != nil || ms[2].HostIndexerId == nil || *ms[2].HostIndexerId != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("host_indexer_id presence: pool %v, host 0 %v", ms[1].HostIndexerId, ms[2].HostIndexerId)
	}
	var decoded pb.ConsensusMutableParams
	if err := proto.Unmarshal(mustMarshal(t, &pb.ConsensusMutableParams{Verifiers: ms}), &decoded); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	got := VerifierEntriesFromPB(decoded.GetVerifiers())
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, entries) {
		t.Fatalf("round trip\n got %+v\nwant %+v", got, entries)
	}
	if got[1].HostIndexerID != nil || got[2].HostIndexerID == nil || *got[2].HostIndexerID != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("decoded host: pool %v, host 0 %v", got[1].HostIndexerID, got[2].HostIndexerID)
	}
	*ms[0].HostIndexerId, ms[0].Ed25519Pubkey[0] = 999, 0xff
	if *seeded.HostIndexerID == 999 || seeded.Ed25519Pubkey[0] == 0xff {
		t.Fatal("VerifierEntriesToPB shares the caller's host pointer or key bytes")
	}
	if back := VerifierEntriesFromPB(ms); back[0].HostIndexerID == ms[0].HostIndexerId {
		t.Fatal("VerifierEntriesFromPB shares the message's host pointer")
	}
	eachFlagAlone(hostZero, func(name string, e arbiter.VerifierEntry) {
		if got := VerifierEntriesFromPB(VerifierEntriesToPB([]arbiter.VerifierEntry{e})); !reflect.DeepEqual(got[0], e) {
			t.Errorf("%s alone: round trip = %+v", name, got[0])
		}
	})
}

// TestConsensusParamsUpdateWithStage3RoundTrips: the stage-3 parameter with
// every field set, and member entries beside a pool entry, survive both
// converters and an UpdateConsensusParams Raft command; an absent parameter
// stays absent (nil both ways, no field 14 on the wire), and an empty
// failure-domain list decodes to nil.
func TestConsensusParamsUpdateWithStage3RoundTrips(t *testing.T) {
	u := legacyGoldenUpdate()
	u.TracksEnabled = true
	u.SIIndexers = []arbiter.SIIndexerEntry{siEntryW(0, 100, "snode-1"), siEntryW(1, 200, "snode-2")}
	u.Verifiers = []arbiter.VerifierEntry{memberVerifierEntry("member-a", 1, "node:test-b", 0x0a), memberVerifierEntry("member-b", 0, "node:test-a", 0x0b),
		{NodeID: "verifier-1", Ed25519Pubkey: bytes.Repeat([]byte{7}, 32)}}
	u.Stage3 = stage3ParamsFixture()

	m := ConsensusParamsUpdateToPB(u)
	// Indexer 0's failure domain has indexer_id 0, a value proto3 leaves off the wire.
	assertEveryFieldPopulated(t, m.GetStage3().ProtoReflect(), map[protoreflect.FullName]bool{"arbiter.IndexerFailureDomain.indexer_id": true})
	if got := ConsensusParamsUpdateFromPB(m); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, u) {
		t.Fatalf("update round trip\n got %+v\nwant %+v", got, u)
	}
	m.Stage3.IndexerFailureDomains[0].FailureDomain = "changed"
	if u.Stage3.IndexerFailureDomains[0].FailureDomain != "node:test-a" {
		t.Fatal("ToPB shares the caller's failure domains")
	}
	mustRoundTrip(t, Command{UpdateConsensusParams: &UpdateConsensusParams{Update: u, AuthorityJWS: "h.p.s"}})
	mutable := &pb.ConsensusMutableParams{Stage3: Stage3ParamsToPB(u.Stage3)}
	if got := Stage3ParamsFromPB(mutable.GetStage3()); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, u.Stage3) {
		t.Fatalf("ConsensusMutableParams.stage3 round trip = %+v", got)
	}

	without := u
	without.Stage3 = nil
	if ConsensusParamsUpdateToPB(without).GetStage3() != nil || ConsensusParamsUpdateFromPB(ConsensusParamsUpdateToPB(without)).Stage3 != nil {
		t.Fatal("an absent stage3 parameter must stay absent both ways")
	}
	for _, num := range wireFieldNumbers(t, mustMarshal(t, ConsensusParamsUpdateToPB(without))) {
		if num == 14 {
			t.Fatal("an update without stage3 carries field 14")
		}
	}
	eachFlagAlone(*stage3ParamsFixture(), func(name string, p arbiter.Stage3Params) {
		if got := Stage3ParamsFromPB(Stage3ParamsToPB(&p)); !reflect.DeepEqual(*got, p) {
			t.Errorf("%s alone: round trip = %+v", name, *got)
		}
	})
	if Stage3ParamsFromPB(nil) != nil || Stage3ParamsToPB(nil) != nil {
		t.Fatal("nil must convert to nil")
	}
	if got := Stage3ParamsFromPB(&pb.Stage3Params{GroupSize: 3, IndexerFailureDomains: []*pb.IndexerFailureDomain{}}); got == nil || got.IndexerFailureDomains != nil {
		t.Fatalf("an empty failure-domain list decoded to %+v; want nil", got)
	}
}

// TestStage3CommandsRoundTripThroughEncodeAndDecode: each stage-3 command
// encodes at its Raft tag (38-42) and decodes to the identical command, owner
// 0 and generation 0 included; every field of each command, seeded by
// reflection with its own value, reaches the request message and survives the
// Raft bytes, and each Go type has its message's field count, so a field
// added to either fails here until both converters carry it; empty lists
// decode to nil; two commands never encode together; and the strict decoder
// refuses an unknown field inside every new message at any depth (plan S3-E1
// contract §39, §41).
func TestStage3CommandsRoundTripThroughEncodeAndDecode(t *testing.T) {
	entry := replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: 0, SafeBlockSeq: 90, AppliedPromotionSeq: 40}
	checkpoint := arbiter.MemberCheckpoint{NodeID: "member-b", OwnerIndexerID: 0, CheckpointSeq: 7,
		Groups: []arbiter.CheckpointGroup{
			{DatabaseID: "dex", GroupGeneration: 1, Excluded: []arbiter.ExcludedTable{
				{TableID: "dex.pools", Reason: arbiter.ExclusionNotInstalled}, {TableID: "dex.swaps", Reason: arbiter.ExclusionRetiring}}},
			{DatabaseID: "lend", GroupGeneration: 3},
		},
		SnapshotID: "0xsnap", Entry: entry}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		tag protowire.Number
		cmd Command
	}{
		{38, Command{RebalanceGroup: &RebalanceGroup{OwnerIndexerID: 0, DatabaseID: "dex", ExpectedGeneration: 0,
			Add: []string{"member-c"}, Remove: []string{"member-b"}, NetworkFill: true, AuthorityJWS: "h.p.s"}}},
		{38, Command{RebalanceGroup: &RebalanceGroup{OwnerIndexerID: 1, DatabaseID: "lend", ExpectedGeneration: 4, AuthorityJWS: "h.p.s"}}},
		{39, Command{ReselectVerifiers: &ReselectVerifiers{L3BlockSeq: 100, ExpectedSet: []string{"member-b", "verifier-1", "verifier-2"}, AuthorityJWS: "h.p.s"}}},
		{40, Command{MemberReady: &MemberReady{NodeID: "member-b", OwnerIndexerID: 0, DatabaseID: "dex", Generation: 1, Ed25519Signature: "ab"}}},
		{41, Command{MemberCheckpoint: &MemberCheckpoint{Checkpoint: checkpoint, ReplicaJWS: "r.j.s"}}},
		{42, Command{MarkMemberLagging: &MarkMemberLagging{NodeID: "member-b", OwnerIndexerID: 0, DatabaseID: "dex", ObservedEntry: entry, AuthorityJWS: "h.p.s"}}},
	} {
		b, err := Encode(tc.cmd)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if num, typ, n := protowire.ConsumeTag(b); n < 0 || num != tc.tag || typ != protowire.BytesType {
			t.Fatalf("outer tag = (%d, %d), want (%d, bytes)", num, typ, tc.tag)
		}
		mustRoundTrip(t, tc.cmd)
	}

	var (
		serial    uint64
		rebalance RebalanceGroup
		reselect  ReselectVerifiers
		ready     MemberReady
		submitted MemberCheckpoint
		lagging   MarkMemberLagging
	)
	for _, v := range []any{&rebalance, &reselect, &ready, &submitted, &lagging} {
		seedSnapshot(reflect.ValueOf(v).Elem(), reflect.TypeOf(v).Elem().Name(), &serial)
	}
	// A seeded reason is no CheckpointExclusionReason; give each a known one.
	for gi := range submitted.Checkpoint.Groups {
		for ei, reason := range []arbiter.CheckpointExclusionReason{arbiter.ExclusionDiskThreshold, arbiter.ExclusionAuditPending} {
			submitted.Checkpoint.Groups[gi].Excluded[ei].Reason = reason
		}
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		goValue any
		request proto.Message
		cmd     Command
	}{
		{rebalance, RebalanceGroupToRequest(rebalance), Command{RebalanceGroup: &rebalance}},
		{reselect, ReselectVerifiersToRequest(reselect), Command{ReselectVerifiers: &reselect}},
		{ready, MemberReadyToRequest(ready), Command{MemberReady: &ready}},
		{submitted, MemberCheckpointToRequest(submitted), Command{MemberCheckpoint: &submitted}},
		{lagging, MarkMemberLaggingToRequest(lagging), Command{MarkMemberLagging: &lagging}},
	} {
		desc := tc.request.ProtoReflect().Descriptor()
		if got, want := reflect.TypeOf(tc.goValue).NumField(), desc.Fields().Len(); got != want {
			t.Errorf("%T has %d fields, %s has %d", tc.goValue, got, desc.FullName(), want)
		}
		assertEveryFieldPopulated(t, tc.request.ProtoReflect(), nil)
		mustRoundTrip(t, tc.cmd)
	}

	got := mustRoundTrip(t, Command{RebalanceGroup: &RebalanceGroup{DatabaseID: "dex", AuthorityJWS: "h.p.s"}})
	b, err := Encode(Command{RebalanceGroup: &RebalanceGroup{DatabaseID: "dex", Add: []string{}, Remove: []string{}, AuthorityJWS: "h.p.s"}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got, err = Decode(b); err != nil || got.RebalanceGroup.Add != nil || got.RebalanceGroup.Remove != nil {
		t.Fatalf("empty add and remove must decode to nil: %+v, %v", got.RebalanceGroup, err)
	}
	b, err = Encode(Command{MemberCheckpoint: &MemberCheckpoint{Checkpoint: arbiter.MemberCheckpoint{NodeID: "member-b",
		Groups: []arbiter.CheckpointGroup{{DatabaseID: "dex", Excluded: []arbiter.ExcludedTable{}}}}}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got, err = Decode(b); err != nil || got.MemberCheckpoint.Checkpoint.Groups[0].Excluded != nil {
		t.Fatalf("an empty excluded list must decode to nil: %+v, %v", got.MemberCheckpoint, err)
	}
	if _, err := Encode(Command{RebalanceGroup: &RebalanceGroup{}, MemberReady: &MemberReady{}}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("two commands encoded together")
	}

	unknown := protowire.AppendVarint(protowire.AppendTag(nil, 9, protowire.VarintType), 1)
	excluded := mustMarshal(t, &pb.ExcludedTable{TableId: "dex.pools", Reason: pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_DIVERGED})
	frontier := mustMarshal(t, &pb.TrackFrontier{IndexerId: 0, SafeBlockSeq: 90})
	for name, tc := range map[string]struct {
		raw  []byte
		want string
	}{
		"RebalanceGroupCmd":    {unionMessage(38, append(mustMarshal(t, &pb.RebalanceGroupCmd{DatabaseId: "dex"}), unknown...)), "wire: unknown arbiter.RebalanceGroupCmd field 9"},
		"ReselectVerifiersCmd": {unionMessage(39, append(mustMarshal(t, &pb.ReselectVerifiersCmd{L3BlockSeq: 1}), unknown...)), "wire: unknown arbiter.ReselectVerifiersCmd field 9"},
		"MemberReadyCmd":       {unionMessage(40, append(mustMarshal(t, &pb.MemberReadyCmd{NodeId: "member-b"}), unknown...)), "wire: unknown arbiter.MemberReadyCmd field 9"},
		"MemberCheckpointCmd":  {unionMessage(41, append(mustMarshal(t, &pb.MemberCheckpointCmd{ReplicaJws: "r.j.s"}), unknown...)), "wire: unknown arbiter.MemberCheckpointCmd field 9"},
		"MemberCheckpoint":     {unionMessage(41, unionMessage(1, unknown)), "wire: unknown arbiter.MemberCheckpoint field 9"},
		"CheckpointGroup":      {unionMessage(41, unionMessage(1, unionMessage(4, unknown))), "wire: unknown arbiter.CheckpointGroup field 9"},
		"ExcludedTable":        {unionMessage(41, unionMessage(1, unionMessage(4, unionMessage(3, append(excluded, unknown...))))), "wire: unknown arbiter.ExcludedTable field 9"},
		"MarkMemberLaggingCmd": {unionMessage(42, append(mustMarshal(t, &pb.MarkMemberLaggingCmd{NodeId: "member-b"}), unknown...)), "wire: unknown arbiter.MarkMemberLaggingCmd field 9"},
		"TrackFrontier":        {unionMessage(42, unionMessage(4, append(frontier, unknown...))), "wire: unknown arbiter.TrackFrontier field 9"},
	} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if _, err := Decode(tc.raw); err == nil || err.Error() != tc.want {
				t.Fatalf("Decode = %v, want %q", err, tc.want)
			}
		})
	}
}

// TestStage3CanonicalizeSortsAndDeduplicates: Canonical drops the token and
// sorts and deduplicates the node lists into fresh slices, nil when empty, so
// a signer and the FSM hash one form; Body drops the member-ready signature.
func TestStage3CanonicalizeSortsAndDeduplicates(t *testing.T) {
	add, remove := []string{"member-d", "member-c", "member-d"}, []string{"member-b", "member-a", "member-b"}
	r := RebalanceGroup{OwnerIndexerID: 2, DatabaseID: "dex", ExpectedGeneration: 5, Add: add, Remove: remove, NetworkFill: true, AuthorityJWS: "h.p.s"}
	want := arbiter.RebalanceGroupCommand{OwnerIndexerID: 2, DatabaseID: "dex", ExpectedGeneration: 5,
		Add: []string{"member-c", "member-d"}, Remove: []string{"member-a", "member-b"}, NetworkFill: true}
	got := r.Canonical()
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("rebalance Canonical = %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
	got.Add[0], got.Remove[0] = "changed", "changed"
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(add, []string{"member-d", "member-c", "member-d"}) || !reflect.DeepEqual(remove, []string{"member-b", "member-a", "member-b"}) {
		t.Fatal("Canonical modified or shares the command's lists")
	}
	for _, empty := range [][]string{nil, {}} {
		if c := (RebalanceGroup{DatabaseID: "dex", Add: empty, Remove: empty}).Canonical(); c.Add != nil || c.Remove != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%#v: Canonical lists = %#v, %#v; want nil", empty, c.Add, c.Remove)
		}
	}
	set := []string{"verifier-2", "member-b", "verifier-1", "member-b"}
	s := ReselectVerifiers{L3BlockSeq: 100, ExpectedSet: set, AuthorityJWS: "h.p.s"}
	if c := s.Canonical(); !reflect.DeepEqual(c, arbiter.ReselectVerifiersCommand{L3BlockSeq: 100, ExpectedSet: []string{"member-b", "verifier-1", "verifier-2"}}) {
		t.Fatalf("reselect Canonical = %+v", c)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(set, []string{"verifier-2", "member-b", "verifier-1", "member-b"}) {
		t.Fatal("Canonical modified the expected set")
	}
	entry := replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: 0, SafeBlockSeq: 90, AppliedPromotionSeq: 40}
	l := MarkMemberLagging{NodeID: "member-b", OwnerIndexerID: 0, DatabaseID: "dex", ObservedEntry: entry, AuthorityJWS: "h.p.s"}
	if c := l.Canonical(); c != (arbiter.MarkMemberLaggingCommand{NodeID: "member-b", OwnerIndexerID: 0, DatabaseID: "dex", ObservedEntry: entry}) {
		t.Fatalf("mark lagging Canonical = %+v", c)
	}
	ready := MemberReady{NodeID: "member-b", OwnerIndexerID: 0, DatabaseID: "dex", Generation: 1, Ed25519Signature: "ab"}
	if b := ready.Body(); b != (arbiter.MemberReadyBody{NodeID: "member-b", OwnerIndexerID: 0, DatabaseID: "dex", Generation: 1}) {
		t.Fatalf("member ready Body = %+v", b)
	}
}

// TestDecodeRefusesAnUnknownExclusionReason: an exclusion reason outside the
// closed CheckpointExclusionReason set, UNSPECIFIED or any future number, is
// refused at decode, on every voter alike, in the body, the request and the
// Raft command (a stored checkpoint of the registry view:
// TestTableRegistrySnapshotRefusesCorruptStage3Views); the six known reasons
// map to their arbiter spellings both ways, and a Go reason outside the set
// encodes as UNSPECIFIED, which Decode refuses (plan S3-E1 K63).
func TestDecodeRefusesAnUnknownExclusionReason(t *testing.T) {
	known := map[pb.CheckpointExclusionReason]arbiter.CheckpointExclusionReason{
		pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_NOT_INSTALLED:  arbiter.ExclusionNotInstalled,
		pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_DIVERGED:       arbiter.ExclusionDiverged,
		pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_FOREIGN:        arbiter.ExclusionForeign,
		pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_DISK_THRESHOLD: arbiter.ExclusionDiskThreshold,
		pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_AUDIT_PENDING:  arbiter.ExclusionAuditPending,
		pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_RETIRING:       arbiter.ExclusionRetiring,
	}
	body := func(r pb.CheckpointExclusionReason) *pb.MemberCheckpoint {
		return &pb.MemberCheckpoint{NodeId: "member-b", CheckpointSeq: 1, SnapshotId: "0xsnap", Entry: &pb.TrackFrontier{SafeBlockSeq: 90},
			Groups: []*pb.CheckpointGroup{{DatabaseId: "dex", GroupGeneration: 1, Excluded: []*pb.ExcludedTable{{TableId: "dex.pools", Reason: r}}}}}
	}
	for r, want := range known {
		got, err := MemberCheckpointBodyFromPB(body(r))
		if err != nil || got.Groups[0].Excluded[0].Reason != want {
			t.Fatalf("%v decoded as %+v, %v; want %q", r, got, err, want)
		}
		if back := MemberCheckpointBodyToPB(got).GetGroups()[0].GetExcluded()[0].GetReason(); back != r {
			t.Fatalf("%q encoded as %v, want %v", want, back, r)
		}
	}
	for _, r := range []pb.CheckpointExclusionReason{pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_UNSPECIFIED, pb.CheckpointExclusionReason(7)} {
		t.Run(r.String(), func(t *testing.T) {
			want := fmt.Sprintf("wire: member checkpoint excludes dex.pools with reason %v, which is not a known CheckpointExclusionReason", r)
			if _, err := MemberCheckpointBodyFromPB(body(r)); err == nil || err.Error() != want {
				t.Fatalf("MemberCheckpointBodyFromPB = %v, want %q", err, want)
			}
			req := &pb.MemberCheckpointCmd{Checkpoint: body(r), ReplicaJws: "r.j.s"}
			if _, err := MemberCheckpointFromRequest(req); err == nil || err.Error() != want {
				t.Fatalf("MemberCheckpointFromRequest = %v, want %q", err, want)
			}
			raw := mustMarshal(t, &pb.RaftCommand{Cmd: &pb.RaftCommand_MemberCheckpoint{MemberCheckpoint: req}})
			if _, err := Decode(raw); err == nil || err.Error() != want {
				t.Fatalf("Decode = %v, want %q", err, want)
			}
		})
	}
	made := Command{MemberCheckpoint: &MemberCheckpoint{Checkpoint: arbiter.MemberCheckpoint{NodeID: "member-b", CheckpointSeq: 1,
		Groups: []arbiter.CheckpointGroup{{DatabaseID: "dex", Excluded: []arbiter.ExcludedTable{{TableID: "dex.pools", Reason: "made_up"}}}}}}}
	raw, err := Encode(made)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := Decode(raw); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "with reason CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_UNSPECIFIED") {
		t.Fatalf("a reason outside the set must encode as UNSPECIFIED and be refused, got %v", err)
	}
}
```

```go
// stage3ActivationGoldenUpdate is the shape of the v21 activation (housegate
// spec 2026-10-14 §10.3): legacyGoldenUpdate with two enrolled indexers, the
// tracks activation, a pool verifier and the stage3 parameter of
// authoritytest.Stage3Update (plan S3-E1 contract §41), every switch off.
func stage3ActivationGoldenUpdate() arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate {
	u := legacyGoldenUpdate()
	u.ExpectedEpoch = 5
	u.MaxWriters = 2
	u.ArtifactDispositionCapability = 1
	u.ClientLanes = &arbiter.ClientLaneParams{MaxLanesPerAccount: 256}
	u.SIIndexers = []arbiter.SIIndexerEntry{
		{IndexerID: 0, ActivationBlock: 100, Signer: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001", SNodeNodeID: "snode-1", EnrollmentJWS: "h.p.s"},

	}
	u.Verifiers = []arbiter.VerifierEntry{{NodeID: "verifier-1", Ed25519Pubkey: bytes.Repeat([]byte{7}, 32)}}
	u.TracksEnabled = true
	u.Stage3 = &arbiter.Stage3Params{GroupSize: 3, NetworkFillDefault: true, MinSafeCopies: 1,
		IndexerFailureDomains: []arbiter.IndexerFailureDomain{{IndexerID: 0, FailureDomain: "node:test-a"}, {IndexerID: 1, FailureDomain: "node:test-b"}},
		MaxLagPublications:    4, LagLow: 2, EvidenceTimeoutL2Blocks: 30, MaxUncleanedPartsPerPartition: 2400, MaxUncleanedPartsPerTable: 20000}
	return u
}

// stage3MemberGoldenUpdate is the update of spec §10.4 step 4: the activation
// shape after switches 1-3 (purge, eviction_voiding, owner_aware_selection),
// listing the first member entry, hosted by indexer 1, with every member
// field explicit (plan S3-E1 K58; counts false between true flags), before
// the pool verifier.
func stage3MemberGoldenUpdate() arbiter.ConsensusParamsUpdate {
	host := uint64(1)
	u := stage3ActivationGoldenUpdate()
	u.Verifiers = []arbiter.VerifierEntry{
		{NodeID: "member-b", Ed25519Pubkey: bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x0b}, 32), HostIndexerID: &host,

			Verify: true, Replicate: true, Counts: false, SharedRMT: true},
		{NodeID: "verifier-1", Ed25519Pubkey: bytes.Repeat([]byte{7}, 32)},
	}
	u.Stage3.Purge, u.Stage3.EvictionVoiding, u.Stage3.OwnerAwareSelection = true, true, true
	return u

// TestStage3CommandBytesAreFrozen pins the RaftCommand bytes of every stage-3
// command, of the v21 activation update and of an update listing a member
// entry (plan S3-E1 contract §38, §41). From the v21 activation every voter
// decodes these bytes, so tags 38-42 and the field numbers of contract §39 are
// consensus constants: a diff here is a consensus break. Never regenerate
// these values.
func TestStage3CommandBytesAreFrozen(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range stage3Golden() {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			got, err := Encode(tc.cmd)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("Encode: %v", err)
			}
			if hex.EncodeToString(got) != tc.want {
				t.Fatalf("encoded bytes changed:\n got %s\nwant %s", hex.EncodeToString(got), tc.want)
			}
			back, err := Decode(got)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("Decode(own bytes): %v", err)
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(back, tc.cmd) {
				t.Fatalf("Decode(own bytes) = %+v, want %+v", back, tc.cmd)
			}
		})
	}
}
```

```go
// VerifierEntriesFromPB copies a repeated VerifierEntry including each key's bytes;
// an empty list and an empty key decode to nil.
func VerifierEntriesFromPB(ms []*pb.VerifierEntry) []arbiter.VerifierEntry {
	return mapSlice(ms, func(m *pb.VerifierEntry) arbiter.VerifierEntry {
		return arbiter.VerifierEntry{NodeID: m.GetNodeId(), Ed25519Pubkey: cloneBytes(m.GetEd25519Pubkey())}
	})
}

// VerifierEntriesToPB returns independent transport messages.
func VerifierEntriesToPB(v []arbiter.VerifierEntry) []*pb.VerifierEntry {
	return mapSlice(v, func(e arbiter.VerifierEntry) *pb.VerifierEntry {
		return &pb.VerifierEntry{NodeId: e.NodeID, Ed25519Pubkey: cloneBytes(e.Ed25519Pubkey)}
	})
}
```

```go
}

// VerifierEntriesFromPB copies a repeated VerifierEntry with all eleven
// fields (plan S3-E1 contract §41): each key's bytes, host_indexer_id as a
// fresh pointer (absent stays nil, indexer 0 stays 0) and every member field.
// An empty list and an empty key decode to nil; validation belongs to
// authority normalisation, which refuses member fields on a pool entry.
func VerifierEntriesFromPB(ms []*pb.VerifierEntry) []arbiter.VerifierEntry {
	return mapSlice(ms, func(m *pb.VerifierEntry) arbiter.VerifierEntry {
		return arbiter.VerifierEntry{NodeID: m.GetNodeId(), Ed25519Pubkey: cloneBytes(m.GetEd25519Pubkey()),
			HostIndexerID: cloneUint64(m.HostIndexerId), ReplicaSigner: m.GetReplicaSigner(), ConsentJWS: m.GetConsentJws(),
			Weight: m.GetWeight(), FailureDomain: m.GetFailureDomain(),
			Verify: m.GetVerify(), Replicate: m.GetReplicate(), Counts: m.GetCounts(), SharedRMT: m.GetSharedRmt()}
	})
}

// VerifierEntriesToPB returns independent transport messages. A pool entry
// (no HostIndexerID, every member field zero) encodes to exactly the bytes of
// arbiter-proto v0.11.0's two-field VerifierEntry.
func VerifierEntriesToPB(v []arbiter.VerifierEntry) []*pb.VerifierEntry {
	return mapSlice(v, func(e arbiter.VerifierEntry) *pb.VerifierEntry {
		return &pb.VerifierEntry{NodeId: e.NodeID, Ed25519Pubkey: cloneBytes(e.Ed25519Pubkey),
			HostIndexerId: cloneUint64(e.HostIndexerID), ReplicaSigner: e.ReplicaSigner, ConsentJws: e.ConsentJWS,
			Weight: e.Weight, FailureDomain: e.FailureDomain,
			Verify: e.Verify, Replicate: e.Replicate, Counts: e.Counts, SharedRmt: e.SharedRMT}
	})
}

// Stage3ParamsFromPB copies the stage-3 parameter (housegate spec 2026-10-14
// §6.1, §10.4; plan S3-E1 contract §41): nil for an absent message, an empty
// indexer_failure_domains list as nil. Validation belongs to
// arbiter.Stage3Params.Validate and authority normalisation.
func Stage3ParamsFromPB(m *pb.Stage3Params) *arbiter.Stage3Params {
	if m == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return &arbiter.Stage3Params{
		GroupSize:          m.GetGroupSize(),
		NetworkFillDefault: m.GetNetworkFillDefault(),
		MinSafeCopies:      m.GetMinSafeCopies(),
		StrictCopies:       m.GetStrictCopies(),
		IndexerFailureDomains: mapSlice(m.GetIndexerFailureDomains(), func(d *pb.IndexerFailureDomain) arbiter.IndexerFailureDomain {
			return arbiter.IndexerFailureDomain{IndexerID: d.GetIndexerId(), FailureDomain: d.GetFailureDomain()}
		}),
		MaxLagPublications:            m.GetMaxLagPublications(),
		LagLow:                        m.GetLagLow(),
		EvidenceTimeoutL2Blocks:       m.GetEvidenceTimeoutL2Blocks(),
		MaxUncleanedPartsPerPartition: m.GetMaxUncleanedPartsPerPartition(),
		MaxUncleanedPartsPerTable:     m.GetMaxUncleanedPartsPerTable(),
		ExcludeQuarantinedHosts:       m.GetExcludeQuarantinedHosts(),
		Purge:                         m.GetPurge(),
		EvictionVoiding:               m.GetEvictionVoiding(),
		OwnerAwareSelection:           m.GetOwnerAwareSelection(),
		Placement:                     m.GetPlacement(),
		Reselection:                   m.GetReselection(),
		Checkpoints:                   m.GetCheckpoints(),
		NarrowedDrain:                 m.GetNarrowedDrain(),
	}
}

// Stage3ParamsToPB returns an independent transport message, nil for nil.
func Stage3ParamsToPB(v *arbiter.Stage3Params) *pb.Stage3Params {
	if v == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return &pb.Stage3Params{
		GroupSize:          v.GroupSize,
		NetworkFillDefault: v.NetworkFillDefault,
		MinSafeCopies:      v.MinSafeCopies,
		StrictCopies:       v.StrictCopies,
		IndexerFailureDomains: mapSlice(v.IndexerFailureDomains, func(d arbiter.IndexerFailureDomain) *pb.IndexerFailureDomain {
			return &pb.IndexerFailureDomain{IndexerId: d.IndexerID, FailureDomain: d.FailureDomain}
		}),
		MaxLagPublications:            v.MaxLagPublications,
		LagLow:                        v.LagLow,
		EvidenceTimeoutL2Blocks:       v.EvidenceTimeoutL2Blocks,
		MaxUncleanedPartsPerPartition: v.MaxUncleanedPartsPerPartition,
		MaxUncleanedPartsPerTable:     v.MaxUncleanedPartsPerTable,
		ExcludeQuarantinedHosts:       v.ExcludeQuarantinedHosts,
		Purge:                         v.Purge,
		EvictionVoiding:               v.EvictionVoiding,
		OwnerAwareSelection:           v.OwnerAwareSelection,
		Placement:                     v.Placement,
		Reselection:                   v.Reselection,
		Checkpoints:                   v.Checkpoints,
		NarrowedDrain:                 v.NarrowedDrain,
	}
}
```

- [ ] **Step 10: Create the stage-3 commands**

Create `wire/stage3.go`:

```go
package wire

import (
	"fmt"
	"slices"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
)

// The stage-3 commands (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §6.4, §7.4, §9.1-§9.2; plan
// S3-E1 contract §39, §41), Raft tags 38-42. Each request message is the Raft
// command itself (the RecordTablePurgedCmd precedent), so the request
// converters in requests.go are exact inverses that keep the signature, and
// Canonical (or Body) is the form authority hashes and signs. arbiter
// proposes these tags only after the v21 activation and the command's switch
// (contract §38): a voter whose decoder lacks them refuses them.

// RebalanceGroup mirrors pb.RebalanceGroupCmd (tag 38), both the
// ConsensusAdmin.RebalanceGroup request and the Raft command. Add and Remove
// are kept exactly as proposed; Canonical normalizes them.
type RebalanceGroup struct {
	OwnerIndexerID     uint64
	DatabaseID         string
	ExpectedGeneration uint64
	Add, Remove        []string
	NetworkFill        bool
	AuthorityJWS       string
}

// Canonical is the command's signing form (authority.RebalanceGroupHash): Add
// and Remove each sorted ascending without duplicates in a fresh slice, nil
// when empty.
func (c RebalanceGroup) Canonical() arbiter.RebalanceGroupCommand {
	return arbiter.RebalanceGroupCommand{OwnerIndexerID: c.OwnerIndexerID, DatabaseID: c.DatabaseID,
		ExpectedGeneration: c.ExpectedGeneration, Add: sortedUnique(c.Add), Remove: sortedUnique(c.Remove), NetworkFill: c.NetworkFill}
}

// ReselectVerifiers mirrors pb.ReselectVerifiersCmd (tag 39). The leader
// proposes it; there is no RPC.
type ReselectVerifiers struct {
	L3BlockSeq   uint64
	ExpectedSet  []string
	AuthorityJWS string
}

// Canonical is the command's signing form (authority.ReselectVerifiersHash):
// ExpectedSet sorted ascending without duplicates in a fresh slice.
func (c ReselectVerifiers) Canonical() arbiter.ReselectVerifiersCommand {
	return arbiter.ReselectVerifiersCommand{L3BlockSeq: c.L3BlockSeq, ExpectedSet: sortedUnique(c.ExpectedSet)}
}

// MarkMemberLagging mirrors pb.MarkMemberLaggingCmd (tag 42), both the
// ConsensusAdmin.MarkMemberLagging request and the Raft command.
type MarkMemberLagging struct {
	NodeID         string
	OwnerIndexerID uint64
	DatabaseID     string
	ObservedEntry  replay.TrackFrontier
	AuthorityJWS   string
}

// Canonical is the command's signing form (authority.MarkMemberLaggingHash).
func (c MarkMemberLagging) Canonical() arbiter.MarkMemberLaggingCommand {
	return arbiter.MarkMemberLaggingCommand{NodeID: c.NodeID, OwnerIndexerID: c.OwnerIndexerID,
		DatabaseID: c.DatabaseID, ObservedEntry: c.ObservedEntry}
}

// MemberReady mirrors pb.MemberReadyCmd (tag 40), both the
// VerifierGateway.SubmitMemberReady request and the Raft command.
// Ed25519Signature is hex, by the member's verifiers-entry ed25519 key.
type MemberReady struct {
	NodeID           string
	OwnerIndexerID   uint64
	DatabaseID       string
	Generation       uint64
	Ed25519Signature string
}

// Body is the signed message (authority.MemberReadyHash).
func (c MemberReady) Body() arbiter.MemberReadyBody {
	return arbiter.MemberReadyBody{NodeID: c.NodeID, OwnerIndexerID: c.OwnerIndexerID, DatabaseID: c.DatabaseID, Generation: c.Generation}
}

// MemberCheckpoint mirrors pb.MemberCheckpointCmd (tag 41), both the
// VerifierGateway.SubmitMemberCheckpoint request and the Raft command:
// Checkpoint is the signed body, ReplicaJWS the replica_signer's token.
type MemberCheckpoint struct {
	Checkpoint arbiter.MemberCheckpoint
	ReplicaJWS string
}

// sortedUnique returns ids sorted ascending without duplicates in a fresh
// slice, nil when there are none (the canonical empty form).
func sortedUnique(ids []string) []string {
	if len(ids) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return slices.Compact(slices.Sorted(slices.Values(ids)))
}

// exclusionReasonFromPB is the closed CheckpointExclusionReason set (plan
// S3-E1 K63); UNSPECIFIED is not in it.
var exclusionReasonFromPB = map[pb.CheckpointExclusionReason]arbiter.CheckpointExclusionReason{
	pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_NOT_INSTALLED:  arbiter.ExclusionNotInstalled,
	pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_DIVERGED:       arbiter.ExclusionDiverged,
	pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_FOREIGN:        arbiter.ExclusionForeign,
	pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_DISK_THRESHOLD: arbiter.ExclusionDiskThreshold,
	pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_AUDIT_PENDING:  arbiter.ExclusionAuditPending,
	pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_RETIRING:       arbiter.ExclusionRetiring,
}

// exclusionReasonToPB maps a reason outside the closed set to UNSPECIFIED,
// which every decoder refuses, so a bad value never becomes a known one.
func exclusionReasonToPB(r arbiter.CheckpointExclusionReason) pb.CheckpointExclusionReason {
	for k, v := range exclusionReasonFromPB {
		if v == r {
			return k
		}
	}
	return pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_UNSPECIFIED
}

// MemberCheckpointBodyFromPB converts a checkpoint body. A reason outside the
// closed set (UNSPECIFIED included) is refused here, on every voter alike,
// never applied. Repeated fields decode empty to nil; an absent entry decodes
// to the zero frontier, which authority.MemberCheckpointHash judges.
func MemberCheckpointBodyFromPB(m *pb.MemberCheckpoint) (arbiter.MemberCheckpoint, error) {
	out := arbiter.MemberCheckpoint{NodeID: m.GetNodeId(), OwnerIndexerID: m.GetOwnerIndexerId(), CheckpointSeq: m.GetCheckpointSeq(),
		SnapshotID: m.GetSnapshotId(), Entry: TrackFrontierFromPB(m.GetEntry())}
	for _, g := range m.GetGroups() {
		group := arbiter.CheckpointGroup{DatabaseID: g.GetDatabaseId(), GroupGeneration: g.GetGroupGeneration()}
		for _, e := range g.GetExcluded() {
			reason, ok := exclusionReasonFromPB[e.GetReason()]
			if !ok {
				return arbiter.MemberCheckpoint{}, fmt.Errorf("wire: member checkpoint excludes %s with reason %v, which is not a known CheckpointExclusionReason", e.GetTableId(), e.GetReason())
			}
			group.Excluded = append(group.Excluded, arbiter.ExcludedTable{TableID: e.GetTableId(), Reason: reason})
		}
		out.Groups = append(out.Groups, group)
	}
	return out, nil
}

// MemberCheckpointBodyToPB returns an independent transport message.
func MemberCheckpointBodyToPB(v arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) *pb.MemberCheckpoint {
	return &pb.MemberCheckpoint{NodeId: v.NodeID, OwnerIndexerId: v.OwnerIndexerID, CheckpointSeq: v.CheckpointSeq,
		Groups: mapSlice(v.Groups, func(g arbiter.CheckpointGroup) *pb.CheckpointGroup {
			return &pb.CheckpointGroup{DatabaseId: g.DatabaseID, GroupGeneration: g.GroupGeneration,
				Excluded: mapSlice(g.Excluded, func(e arbiter.ExcludedTable) *pb.ExcludedTable {
					return &pb.ExcludedTable{TableId: e.TableID, Reason: exclusionReasonToPB(e.Reason)}
				})}
		}),
		SnapshotId: v.SnapshotID, Entry: TrackFrontierToPB(v.Entry)}
}
```

```go
// RebalanceGroupFromRequest decodes a ConsensusAdmin.RebalanceGroup request,
// which is the RebalanceGroupCmd itself (plan S3-E1 contract §39). Add and
// Remove are copied as sent, an empty list as nil: Canonical normalizes them
// for signing.
func RebalanceGroupFromRequest(m *pb.RebalanceGroupCmd) RebalanceGroup {
	return RebalanceGroup{OwnerIndexerID: m.GetOwnerIndexerId(), DatabaseID: m.GetDatabaseId(),
		ExpectedGeneration: m.GetExpectedGeneration(),
		Add:                mapSlice(m.GetAdd(), func(id string) string { return id }),
		Remove:             mapSlice(m.GetRemove(), func(id string) string { return id }),
		NetworkFill:        m.GetNetworkFill(), AuthorityJWS: m.GetAuthorityJws()}
}

// RebalanceGroupToRequest builds the RebalanceGroup request (and the Raft
// command body) with independent copies of the lists.
func RebalanceGroupToRequest(c RebalanceGroup) *pb.RebalanceGroupCmd {
	return &pb.RebalanceGroupCmd{OwnerIndexerId: c.OwnerIndexerID, DatabaseId: c.DatabaseID,
		ExpectedGeneration: c.ExpectedGeneration,
		Add:                mapSlice(c.Add, func(id string) string { return id }),
		Remove:             mapSlice(c.Remove, func(id string) string { return id }),
		NetworkFill:        c.NetworkFill, AuthorityJws: c.AuthorityJWS}
}

// ReselectVerifiersFromRequest decodes a ReselectVerifiersCmd; the expected
// set is copied as sent, an empty one as nil.
func ReselectVerifiersFromRequest(m *pb.ReselectVerifiersCmd) ReselectVerifiers {
	return ReselectVerifiers{L3BlockSeq: m.GetL3BlockSeq(),
		ExpectedSet:  mapSlice(m.GetExpectedSet(), func(id string) string { return id }),
		AuthorityJWS: m.GetAuthorityJws()}
}

// ReselectVerifiersToRequest builds the Raft command body.
func ReselectVerifiersToRequest(c ReselectVerifiers) *pb.ReselectVerifiersCmd {
	return &pb.ReselectVerifiersCmd{L3BlockSeq: c.L3BlockSeq,
		ExpectedSet:  mapSlice(c.ExpectedSet, func(id string) string { return id }),
		AuthorityJws: c.AuthorityJWS}
}

// MarkMemberLaggingFromRequest decodes a ConsensusAdmin.MarkMemberLagging
// request, which is the MarkMemberLaggingCmd itself; an absent observed entry
// decodes to the zero frontier.
func MarkMemberLaggingFromRequest(m *pb.MarkMemberLaggingCmd) MarkMemberLagging {
	return MarkMemberLagging{NodeID: m.GetNodeId(), OwnerIndexerID: m.GetOwnerIndexerId(), DatabaseID: m.GetDatabaseId(),
		ObservedEntry: TrackFrontierFromPB(m.GetObservedEntry()), AuthorityJWS: m.GetAuthorityJws()}
}

// MarkMemberLaggingToRequest builds the MarkMemberLagging request (and the
// Raft command body).
func MarkMemberLaggingToRequest(c MarkMemberLagging) *pb.MarkMemberLaggingCmd {
	return &pb.MarkMemberLaggingCmd{NodeId: c.NodeID, OwnerIndexerId: c.OwnerIndexerID, DatabaseId: c.DatabaseID,
		ObservedEntry: TrackFrontierToPB(c.ObservedEntry), AuthorityJws: c.AuthorityJWS}
}

// MemberReadyFromRequest decodes a VerifierGateway.SubmitMemberReady request,
// which is the MemberReadyCmd itself.
func MemberReadyFromRequest(m *pb.MemberReadyCmd) MemberReady {
	return MemberReady{NodeID: m.GetNodeId(), OwnerIndexerID: m.GetOwnerIndexerId(), DatabaseID: m.GetDatabaseId(),
		Generation: m.GetGeneration(), Ed25519Signature: m.GetEd25519Signature()}
}

// MemberReadyToRequest builds the SubmitMemberReady request (and the Raft
// command body).
func MemberReadyToRequest(c MemberReady) *pb.MemberReadyCmd {
	return &pb.MemberReadyCmd{NodeId: c.NodeID, OwnerIndexerId: c.OwnerIndexerID, DatabaseId: c.DatabaseID,
		Generation: c.Generation, Ed25519Signature: c.Ed25519Signature}
}

// MemberCheckpointFromRequest decodes a VerifierGateway.SubmitMemberCheckpoint
// request, which is the MemberCheckpointCmd itself. It refuses an exclusion
// reason outside the closed set (MemberCheckpointBodyFromPB).
func MemberCheckpointFromRequest(m *pb.MemberCheckpointCmd) (MemberCheckpoint, error) {
	cp, err := MemberCheckpointBodyFromPB(m.GetCheckpoint())
	if err != nil {
		return MemberCheckpoint{}, err
	}
	return MemberCheckpoint{Checkpoint: cp, ReplicaJWS: m.GetReplicaJws()}, nil
}

// MemberCheckpointToRequest builds the SubmitMemberCheckpoint request (and the
// Raft command body).
func MemberCheckpointToRequest(c MemberCheckpoint) *pb.MemberCheckpointCmd {
	return &pb.MemberCheckpointCmd{Checkpoint: MemberCheckpointBodyToPB(c.Checkpoint), ReplicaJws: c.ReplicaJWS}
}
```

```go
func stage3RegistryFixture(t *testing.T) TableRegistrySnapshot {

	s := registrySnapshotFixture(t)

	s.Incarnations[3].ScopedKeeperPath = true
	s.Incarnations[3].PurgeMembers = []string{"member-a", "member-b"}
	host0, host1 := uint64(0), uint64(1)
	entry := replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: 0, SafeBlockSeq: 90, AppliedPromotionSeq: 40}
	observed := replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: 0, SafeBlockSeq: 70, AppliedPromotionSeq: 31}
	s.Groups = []DatabaseGroup{
		{OwnerIndexerID: 0, DatabaseID: "dex", NetworkFill: true, Generation: 3, GroupKey: "0xgroup-0-dex", PlacementSalt: "0xsalt-0-dex",
			Members: []GroupMember{
				{NodeID: "member-b", JoinedGeneration: 1, ReadyGeneration: 2, Class: MemberClassCaughtUp, HostIndexerID: &host1,
					Checkpoint: &MemberCheckpointRecord{ReplicaJWS: "r.j.s", Epoch: 6, Checkpoint: arbiter.MemberCheckpoint{
						NodeID: "member-b", OwnerIndexerID: 0, CheckpointSeq: 9, SnapshotID: "0xsnap", Entry: entry,
						Groups: []arbiter.CheckpointGroup{{DatabaseID: "dex", GroupGeneration: 3,
							Excluded: []arbiter.ExcludedTable{{TableID: "dex.pools", Reason: arbiter.ExclusionAuditPending}}}}}}},
				{NodeID: "member-c", JoinedGeneration: 3, Class: MemberClassLagging, ObservedEntry: &observed, LagAdvances: 5},
			},
			PastMembers: []string{"member-a"},
			Leaving: []LeavingMember{{NodeID: "member-a", RemovedGeneration: 3, ReleaseEntry: entry,
				FrozenMembers: []string{"member-b", "member-c"}, FrozenDomains: 2, Released: true}}},
		{OwnerIndexerID: 1, DatabaseID: "dex", Generation: 1, GroupKey: "0xgroup-1-dex", PlacementSalt: "0xsalt-1-dex",
			Members: []GroupMember{{NodeID: "member-a", JoinedGeneration: 1, ReadyGeneration: 1, Class: MemberClassBehind, HostIndexerID: &host0}},
			Leaving: []LeavingMember{{NodeID: "member-d", RemovedGeneration: 1,

	}

// TestTableRegistrySnapshotCarriesGroupsSeqsScopedPathsAndStage3: the
// registry view of groups, checkpoint sequences, scoped Keeper paths, purge
// members and the stage3 parameter survives both converters and the wire
// bytes (plan S3-E1 contract §41, K64), and the lookups answer from it. A
// snapshot from before the v21 activation has none of these fields on the
// wire, and empty lists decode to nil.
func TestTableRegistrySnapshotCarriesGroupsSeqsScopedPathsAndStage3(t *testing.T) {
	s := stage3RegistryFixture(t)
	m := TableRegistrySnapshotToPB(s)
	if inc := m.GetIncarnations()[3]; !inc.GetScopedKeeperPath() || !reflect.DeepEqual(inc.GetPurgeMembers(), []string{"member-a", "member-b"}) {
		t.Fatalf("incarnation 4 encoded as scoped %v, purge members %v", inc.GetScopedKeeperPath(), inc.GetPurgeMembers())
	}
	if len(m.GetGroups()) != 2 || len(m.GetMemberCheckpointSeqs()) != 3 || m.GetStage3().GetGroupSize() != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("stage-3 view encoded as %d groups, %d seqs, stage3 %v", len(m.GetGroups()), len(m.GetMemberCheckpointSeqs()), m.GetStage3())
	}
	var decoded pb.TableRegistrySnapshot
	if err := proto.Unmarshal(mustMarshal(t, m), &decoded); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	got, err := TableRegistrySnapshotFromPB(&decoded)
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(got, s) {
		t.Fatalf("round trip (%v)\n got %+v\nwant %+v", err, got, s)
	}

	if g, ok := got.Group(1, "dex"); !ok || g.Members[0].NodeID != "member-a" || g.GroupKey != "0xgroup-1-dex" {
		t.Fatalf("Group(1, dex) = %+v, %v", g, ok)
	}
	if _, ok := got.Group(2, "dex"); ok {
		t.Fatal("Group(2, dex) found a group that does not exist")
	}
	for node, want := range map[string][]string{
		"member-a": {"1/dex"}, // released from 0/dex, a member of 1/dex
		"member-b": {"0/dex"}, // a current member
		"member-c": {"0/dex"}, // delisted, still a member
		"member-d": {"1/dex"}, // Leaving and not yet released
		"member-x": nil,       // never a member
	} {
		var keys []string
		for _, g := range got.GroupsWithMember(node) {
			keys = append(keys, fmt.Sprintf("%d/%s", g.OwnerIndexerID, g.DatabaseID))
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(keys, want) {
			t.Errorf("GroupsWithMember(%s) = %v, want %v", node, keys, want)
		}
	}
	if seq, ok := got.PublishedCheckpointSeq("member-b", 2); !ok || seq.CheckpointSeq != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("PublishedCheckpointSeq(member-b, 2) = %+v, %v", seq, ok)
	}
	if _, ok := got.PublishedCheckpointSeq("member-b", 1); ok {
		t.Fatal("PublishedCheckpointSeq(member-b, 1) found a sequence that was never published")
	}

	before := TableRegistrySnapshotToPB(registrySnapshotFixture(t))
	for _, num := range wireFieldNumbers(t, mustMarshal(t, before)) {
		if num >= 10 && num <= 12 {
			t.Fatalf("a pre-stage-3 snapshot carries field %d", num)
		}
	}
	for _, inc := range before.GetIncarnations() {
		for _, num := range wireFieldNumbers(t, mustMarshal(t, inc)) {
			if num == 19 || num == 20 {
				t.Fatalf("a pre-stage-3 incarnation carries field %d", num)
			}
		}
	}
	plain, err := TableRegistrySnapshotFromPB(before)
	if err != nil || plain.Groups != nil || plain.MemberCheckpointSeqs != nil || plain.Stage3 != nil || plain.Incarnations[3].ScopedKeeperPath || plain.Incarnations[3].PurgeMembers != nil {
		t.Fatalf("a pre-stage-3 snapshot decoded with stage-3 fields: %+v, %v", plain, err)
	}
	m.Groups[1].PastMembers, m.Groups[1].Leaving[0].FrozenMembers, m.Incarnations[0].PurgeMembers = []string{}, []string{}, []string{}
	if got, err = TableRegistrySnapshotFromPB(m); err != nil || got.Groups[1].PastMembers != nil || got.Groups[1].Leaving[0].FrozenMembers != nil || got.Incarnations[0].PurgeMembers != nil {
		t.Fatalf("empty lists must decode to nil: %+v, %v", got.Groups[1], err)
	}
}

// TestTableRegistrySnapshotEveryStage3FieldRoundTrips: every stage-3 field of
// the registry view, seeded by reflection with its own value (the
// seedSnapshot precedent) and then given the few values the decoder requires,
// reaches the message and comes back unchanged through the wire bytes. Each
// Go view type has its message's field count, so a field added to either
// fails here until both converters carry it.
func TestTableRegistrySnapshotEveryStage3FieldRoundTrips(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		goValue any
		msg     proto.Message
	}{
		{DatabaseGroup{}, &pb.DatabaseGroup{}},
		{GroupMember{}, &pb.GroupMember{}},
		{LeavingMember{}, &pb.LeavingMember{}},
		{MemberCheckpointRecord{}, &pb.MemberCheckpointRecord{}},
		{MemberCheckpointSeq{}, &pb.MemberCheckpointSeq{}},
		{arbiter.Stage3Params{}, &pb.Stage3Params{}},
		{arbiter.IndexerFailureDomain{}, &pb.IndexerFailureDomain{}},
		{arbiter.MemberCheckpoint{}, &pb.MemberCheckpoint{}},
		{arbiter.CheckpointGroup{}, &pb.CheckpointGroup{}},
		{arbiter.ExcludedTable{}, &pb.ExcludedTable{}},
	} {
		if got, want := reflect.TypeOf(tc.goValue).NumField(), tc.msg.ProtoReflect().Descriptor().Fields().Len(); got != want {
			t.Errorf("%T has %d fields, %s has %d", tc.goValue, got, tc.msg.ProtoReflect().Descriptor().FullName(), want)
		}
	}

	s := registrySnapshotFixture(t)
	s.SIIndexers = []arbiter.SIIndexerEntry{siEntryW(1, 100, "snode-1"), siEntryW(2, 100, "snode-2")}
	var serial uint64
	seedSnapshot(reflect.ValueOf(&s.Groups).Elem(), "Groups", &serial)
	seedSnapshot(reflect.ValueOf(&s.MemberCheckpointSeqs).Elem(), "Seqs", &serial)
	seedSnapshot(reflect.ValueOf(&s.Stage3).Elem(), "Stage3", &serial)
	for i := range s.Incarnations {
		seedSnapshot(reflect.ValueOf(&s.Incarnations[i].ScopedKeeperPath).Elem(), "Scoped", &serial)
		seedSnapshot(reflect.ValueOf(&s.Incarnations[i].PurgeMembers).Elem(), fmt.Sprintf("Incarnations[%d].PurgeMembers", i), &serial)
	}
	// The decoder accepts only a view the arbiter can serve: enrolled owners,
	// known classes and reasons, and lag_low below max_lag_publications. Every
	// field stays non-zero.
	classes := []MemberClass{MemberClassCaughtUp, MemberClassLagging}
	reasons := []arbiter.CheckpointExclusionReason{arbiter.ExclusionDiverged, arbiter.ExclusionForeign}
	for gi := range s.Groups {
		g := &s.Groups[gi]
		g.OwnerIndexerID = uint64(gi) + 1
		for mi := range g.Members {
			g.Members[mi].Class = classes[mi]
			for ci := range g.Members[mi].Checkpoint.Checkpoint.Groups {
				for ei := range g.Members[mi].Checkpoint.Checkpoint.Groups[ci].Excluded {
					g.Members[mi].Checkpoint.Checkpoint.Groups[ci].Excluded[ei].Reason = reasons[ei]
				}
			}
		}
	}
	s.Stage3.LagLow = s.Stage3.MaxLagPublications - 1

	m := TableRegistrySnapshotToPB(s)
	for _, g := range m.GetGroups() {
		assertEveryFieldPopulated(t, g.ProtoReflect(), nil)
	}
	for _, seq := range m.GetMemberCheckpointSeqs() {
		assertEveryFieldPopulated(t, seq.ProtoReflect(), nil)
	}
	assertEveryFieldPopulated(t, m.GetStage3().ProtoReflect(), nil)
	for _, inc := range m.GetIncarnations() {
		if !inc.GetScopedKeeperPath() || len(inc.GetPurgeMembers()) != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("incarnation %d encoded as scoped %v, purge members %v", inc.GetSeq(), inc.GetScopedKeeperPath(), inc.GetPurgeMembers())
		}
	}
	var decoded pb.TableRegistrySnapshot
	if err := proto.Unmarshal(mustMarshal(t, m), &decoded); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	got, err := TableRegistrySnapshotFromPB(&decoded)
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(got, s) {
		t.Fatalf("round trip (%v)\n got %#v\nwant %#v", err, got, s)
	}
}

// TestTableRegistrySnapshotRefusesCorruptStage3Views: the decoder refuses,
// word for word, every stage-3 view the arbiter never serves (plan S3-E1
// contract §41), like an unknown status.
func TestTableRegistrySnapshotRefusesCorruptStage3Views(t *testing.T) {
	const (
		groupsOrder = "table registry snapshot: groups must be sorted by (owner_indexer_id, database_id) without duplicates"
		listsOrder  = "table registry snapshot: group 0/dex: members, past_members and leaving must each be sorted by node id without duplicates"
		seqsOrder   = "table registry snapshot: member_checkpoint_seqs must be sorted by (node_id, owner_indexer_id) without duplicates"
		purgeOrder  = "table registry snapshot: incarnation 4: purge_members must be sorted ascending without duplicates"
	)
	type snapshot = pb.TableRegistrySnapshot
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func(m *snapshot)
		want   string
	}{
		{"unsorted purge members", func(m *snapshot) { m.Incarnations[3].PurgeMembers = []string{"member-b", "member-a"} }, purgeOrder},
		{"duplicate purge member", func(m *snapshot) { m.Incarnations[3].PurgeMembers = []string{"member-a", "member-a"} }, purgeOrder},
		{"unsorted groups", func(m *snapshot) { m.Groups[0], m.Groups[1] = m.Groups[1], m.Groups[0] }, groupsOrder},
		{"duplicate group", func(m *snapshot) { m.Groups[1].OwnerIndexerId = 0 }, groupsOrder},
		{"owner without an entry", func(m *snapshot) { m.Groups[1].OwnerIndexerId = 9 },
			"table registry snapshot: group 9/dex is owned by indexer 9, which has no si_indexers entry"},
		{"unsorted members", func(m *snapshot) { ms := m.Groups[0].Members; ms[0], ms[1] = ms[1], ms[0] }, listsOrder},
		{"duplicate past member", func(m *snapshot) { m.Groups[0].PastMembers = []string{"member-a", "member-a"} }, listsOrder},
		{"unsorted leaving", func(m *snapshot) {
			m.Groups[0].Leaving = append(m.Groups[0].Leaving, &pb.LeavingMember{NodeId: "member-0"})
		}, listsOrder},
		{"unspecified class", func(m *snapshot) { m.Groups[0].Members[0].MemberClass = pb.MemberClass_MEMBER_CLASS_UNSPECIFIED },
			"table registry snapshot: group 0/dex: member member-b has unknown class MEMBER_CLASS_UNSPECIFIED"},
		{"future class", func(m *snapshot) { m.Groups[0].Members[0].MemberClass = pb.MemberClass(9) },
			"table registry snapshot: group 0/dex: member member-b has unknown class 9"},
		{"unknown exclusion reason", func(m *snapshot) {
			m.Groups[0].Members[0].Checkpoint.Checkpoint.Groups[0].Excluded[0].Reason = pb.CheckpointExclusionReason(7)
		}, "table registry snapshot: group 0/dex: member member-b: wire: member checkpoint excludes dex.pools with reason 7, which is not a known CheckpointExclusionReason"},
		{"unsorted seqs", func(m *snapshot) { ss := m.MemberCheckpointSeqs; ss[0], ss[1] = ss[1], ss[0] }, seqsOrder},
		{"duplicate seq", func(m *snapshot) { m.MemberCheckpointSeqs[2].OwnerIndexerId = 0 }, seqsOrder},
		{"invalid stage3", func(m *snapshot) { m.Stage3.GroupSize = 0 }, "table registry snapshot: stage3: group_size must be at least 1"},
		{"stage3 switch out of order", func(m *snapshot) { m.Stage3.Purge = false }, "table registry snapshot: stage3: switch eviction_voiding requires purge"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			m := TableRegistrySnapshotToPB(stage3RegistryFixture(t))
			tc.mutate(m)
			if _, err := TableRegistrySnapshotFromPB(m); err == nil || err.Error() != tc.want {
				t.Fatalf("err = %v, want %q", err, tc.want)
			}
		})
	}
}

// TestGroupMemberHostIndexerKeepsAbsenceAndIndexerZero: the served host of a
// member (cross-plan decision D27) keeps indexer 0 distinct from absent: a
// member hosted by indexer 0, one hosted by indexer 1 and a delisted one
// served without a host survive FromPB, ToPB and proto.Marshal unchanged, no
// decoder refuses the absent host, and the pointers are the converter's own.
func TestGroupMemberHostIndexerKeepsAbsenceAndIndexerZero(t *testing.T) {
	zero, one := uint64(0), uint64(1)
	s := stage3RegistryFixture(t)
	s.Groups = s.Groups[:1]
	s.Groups[0].Members = []GroupMember{
		{NodeID: "member-a", JoinedGeneration: 1, ReadyGeneration: 1, Class: MemberClassCaughtUp, HostIndexerID: &zero},
		{NodeID: "member-b", JoinedGeneration: 1, ReadyGeneration: 1, Class: MemberClassBehind, HostIndexerID: &one},
		{NodeID: "member-c", JoinedGeneration: 2, Class: MemberClassBootstrapping},
	}
	m := TableRegistrySnapshotToPB(s)
	members := m.GetGroups()[0].GetMembers()
	for i, want := range []*uint64{&zero, &one, nil} {
		got := members[i].HostIndexerId
		if (got == nil) != (want == nil) || (got != nil && *got != *want) {
			t.Fatalf("member %s encoded host %v, want %v", members[i].GetNodeId(), got, want)
		}
		hasField8 := false
		for _, num := range wireFieldNumbers(t, mustMarshal(t, members[i])) {
			hasField8 = hasField8 || num == 8
		}
		if hasField8 != (want != nil) {
			t.Fatalf("member %s: host_indexer_id on the wire = %v, want %v", members[i].GetNodeId(), hasField8, want != nil)
		}
	}
	raw := mustMarshal(t, m)
	var decoded pb.TableRegistrySnapshot
	if err := proto.Unmarshal(raw, &decoded); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	got, err := TableRegistrySnapshotFromPB(&decoded)
	if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(got, s) {
		t.Fatalf("round trip (%v)\n got %+v\nwant %+v", err, got.Groups, s.Groups)
	}
	if got.Groups[0].Members[0].HostIndexerID == &zero || members[0].HostIndexerId == &zero {
		t.Fatal("a converter shares the caller's host pointer")
	}
	if again := mustMarshal(t, TableRegistrySnapshotToPB(got)); !bytes.Equal(again, raw) {
		t.Fatalf("re-encoded bytes differ:\n got %x\nwant %x", again, raw)
	}
}

// TestGroupMemberReady: a member is ready once it reported its replicas at or
// after the generation it joined at; ReadyGeneration 0 means never.
func TestGroupMemberReady(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		joined, ready uint64
		want          bool
	}{
		{0, 0, false}, {1, 0, false}, {2, 1, false}, {1, 1, true}, {2, 3, true},
	} {
		if got := (GroupMember{JoinedGeneration: tc.joined, ReadyGeneration: tc.ready}).Ready(); got != tc.want {
			t.Errorf("joined %d, ready %d: Ready() = %v, want %v", tc.joined, tc.ready, got, tc.want)
		}
	}
}
```

Create `wire/stage3_registry.go`:

```go
package wire

import (
	"cmp"
	"fmt"
	"slices"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
)

// The registry view of database groups (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §6.2, §9.1,
// §9.2; plan S3-E1 contract §39, §41, K64). These are read replies: no Raft
// command reaches them, so they have no canonical signing form and no JSON
// tags. Every list decodes empty to nil; an absent message is a nil pointer
// (Checkpoint, ObservedEntry, HostIndexerID) or the zero value (ReleaseEntry).

// MemberClass mirrors pb.MemberClass (spec §9.2). A Leaving member is not in
// DatabaseGroup.Members; its record is in Leaving.
type MemberClass string

const (
	MemberClassBootstrapping MemberClass = "bootstrapping"
	MemberClassCaughtUp      MemberClass = "caught_up"
	MemberClassBehind        MemberClass = "behind"
	MemberClassLagging       MemberClass = "lagging"
)

var memberClassFromPB = map[pb.MemberClass]MemberClass{
	pb.MemberClass_MEMBER_CLASS_BOOTSTRAPPING: MemberClassBootstrapping,
	pb.MemberClass_MEMBER_CLASS_CAUGHT_UP:     MemberClassCaughtUp,
	pb.MemberClass_MEMBER_CLASS_BEHIND:        MemberClassBehind,
	pb.MemberClass_MEMBER_CLASS_LAGGING:       MemberClassLagging,
}

func memberClassToPB(c MemberClass) pb.MemberClass {
	for k, v := range memberClassFromPB {
		if v == c {
			return k
		}
	}
	return pb.MemberClass_MEMBER_CLASS_UNSPECIFIED
}

// MemberCheckpointRecord mirrors pb.MemberCheckpointRecord: a stored
// checkpoint, its replica_signer token and the epoch whose replica_signer
// verified it.
type MemberCheckpointRecord struct {
	Checkpoint arbiter.MemberCheckpoint
	ReplicaJWS string
	Epoch      uint64
}

// GroupMember mirrors pb.GroupMember: one current member of a group.
type GroupMember struct {
	NodeID           string
	JoinedGeneration uint64
	ReadyGeneration  uint64
	Class            MemberClass
	Checkpoint       *MemberCheckpointRecord
	ObservedEntry    *replay.TrackFrontier
	LagAdvances      uint64
	HostIndexerID    *uint64 // the served host_indexer_id (D27); nil while the member is delisted, indexer 0 kept
}

// Ready reports whether the member has reported its replicas at or after the
// generation it joined at (spec §6.4): ReadyGeneration is 0 until a
// MemberReady is recorded.
func (m GroupMember) Ready() bool {
	return m.ReadyGeneration != 0 && m.ReadyGeneration >= m.JoinedGeneration
}

// LeavingMember mirrors pb.LeavingMember: a member a RebalanceGroup removed.
type LeavingMember struct {
	NodeID            string
	RemovedGeneration uint64
	ReleaseEntry      replay.TrackFrontier
	FrozenMembers     []string
	FrozenDomains     uint32
	Released          bool
}

// DatabaseGroup mirrors pb.DatabaseGroup: G(owner, database) (spec §6.2).
type DatabaseGroup struct {
	OwnerIndexerID uint64
	DatabaseID     string
	Members        []GroupMember
	NetworkFill    bool
	Generation     uint64
	PastMembers    []string
	Leaving        []LeavingMember
	GroupKey       string
	PlacementSalt  string
}

// MemberCheckpointSeq mirrors pb.MemberCheckpointSeq: the highest accepted
// checkpoint_seq of one member for one owner under ReplicaSigner (spec §9.1).
type MemberCheckpointSeq struct {
	NodeID         string
	OwnerIndexerID uint64
	CheckpointSeq  uint64
	ReplicaSigner  string
}

// Group returns G(owner, databaseID) when the registry holds it. The group
// shares its lists with the snapshot.
func (s TableRegistrySnapshot) Group(owner uint64, databaseID string) (DatabaseGroup, bool) {
	for _, g := range s.Groups {
		if g.OwnerIndexerID == owner && g.DatabaseID == databaseID {
			return g, true
		}
	}
	return DatabaseGroup{}, false
}

// GroupsWithMember returns, in registry order, the groups nodeID is a current
// member of or is Leaving and not yet released from: the groups whose tables
// the node must keep. The groups share their lists with the snapshot.
func (s TableRegistrySnapshot) GroupsWithMember(nodeID string) []DatabaseGroup {
	var out []DatabaseGroup
	for _, g := range s.Groups {
		current := slices.ContainsFunc(g.Members, func(m GroupMember) bool { return m.NodeID == nodeID })
		leaving := slices.ContainsFunc(g.Leaving, func(l LeavingMember) bool { return l.NodeID == nodeID && !l.Released })
		if current || leaving {
			out = append(out, g)
		}
	}
	return out
}

// PublishedCheckpointSeq returns the highest checkpoint_seq the arbiter
// accepted from nodeID for owner; a member signs its next checkpoint above
// both its own journal and this value.
func (s TableRegistrySnapshot) PublishedCheckpointSeq(nodeID string, owner uint64) (MemberCheckpointSeq, bool) {
	for _, seq := range s.MemberCheckpointSeqs {
		if seq.NodeID == nodeID && seq.OwnerIndexerID == owner {
			return seq, true
		}
	}
	return MemberCheckpointSeq{}, false
}

func nodeIDs[T any](items []T, id func(T) string) []string {
	out := make([]string, len(items))
	for i, item := range items {
		out[i] = id(item)
	}
	return out
}

// groupsFromPB decodes the groups. The arbiter keeps them sorted by (owner,
// database), each owned by an enrolled indexer, with sorted member, past
// member and leaving lists and a known class per member; anything else is a
// corrupt view, refused like an unknown status.
func groupsFromPB(m *pb.TableRegistrySnapshot, enrolled func(uint64) bool) ([]DatabaseGroup, error) {
	var out []DatabaseGroup
	for i, g := range m.GetGroups() {
		owner, db := g.GetOwnerIndexerId(), g.GetDatabaseId()
		if i > 0 {
			prev := out[i-1]
			if cmp.Or(cmp.Compare(prev.OwnerIndexerID, owner), cmp.Compare(prev.DatabaseID, db)) >= 0 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("table registry snapshot: groups must be sorted by (owner_indexer_id, database_id) without duplicates")
			}
		}
		if !enrolled(owner) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("table registry snapshot: group %d/%s is owned by indexer %d, which has no si_indexers entry", owner, db, owner)
		}
		group := DatabaseGroup{OwnerIndexerID: owner, DatabaseID: db, NetworkFill: g.GetNetworkFill(), Generation: g.GetGeneration(),
			PastMembers: mapSlice(g.GetPastMembers(), func(id string) string { return id }),
			GroupKey:    g.GetGroupKey(), PlacementSalt: g.GetPlacementSalt()}
		for _, gm := range g.GetMembers() {
			member, err := groupMemberFromPB(gm)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("table registry snapshot: group %d/%s: %w", owner, db, err)
			}
			group.Members = append(group.Members, member)
		}
		for _, l := range g.GetLeaving() {
			group.Leaving = append(group.Leaving, LeavingMember{NodeID: l.GetNodeId(), RemovedGeneration: l.GetRemovedGeneration(),
				ReleaseEntry:  TrackFrontierFromPB(l.GetReleaseEntry()),
				FrozenMembers: mapSlice(l.GetFrozenMembers(), func(id string) string { return id }),
				FrozenDomains: l.GetFrozenDomains(), Released: l.GetReleased()})
		}
		if !ascendingUnique(nodeIDs(group.Members, func(m GroupMember) string { return m.NodeID })) ||
			!ascendingUnique(group.PastMembers) ||
			!ascendingUnique(nodeIDs(group.Leaving, func(l LeavingMember) string { return l.NodeID })) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("table registry snapshot: group %d/%s: members, past_members and leaving must each be sorted by node id without duplicates", owner, db)
		}
		out = append(out, group)
	}
	return out, nil
}

func groupMemberFromPB(m *pb.GroupMember) (GroupMember, error) {
	class, ok := memberClassFromPB[m.GetMemberClass()]
	if !ok {
		return GroupMember{}, fmt.Errorf("member %s has unknown class %v", m.GetNodeId(), m.GetMemberClass())
	}
	out := GroupMember{NodeID: m.GetNodeId(), JoinedGeneration: m.GetJoinedGeneration(), ReadyGeneration: m.GetReadyGeneration(),
		Class: class, LagAdvances: m.GetLagAdvances(), HostIndexerID: cloneUint64(m.HostIndexerId)}
	if r := m.GetCheckpoint(); r != nil {
		cp, err := MemberCheckpointBodyFromPB(r.GetCheckpoint())
		if err != nil {
			return GroupMember{}, fmt.Errorf("member %s: %w", m.GetNodeId(), err)
		}
		out.Checkpoint = &MemberCheckpointRecord{Checkpoint: cp, ReplicaJWS: r.GetReplicaJws(), Epoch: r.GetEpoch()}
	}
	if e := m.GetObservedEntry(); e != nil {
		entry := TrackFrontierFromPB(e)
		out.ObservedEntry = &entry
	}
	return out, nil
}

func groupsToPB(groups []DatabaseGroup) []*pb.DatabaseGroup {
	return mapSlice(groups, func(g DatabaseGroup) *pb.DatabaseGroup {
		return &pb.DatabaseGroup{OwnerIndexerId: g.OwnerIndexerID, DatabaseId: g.DatabaseID,
			Members:     mapSlice(g.Members, groupMemberToPB),
			NetworkFill: g.NetworkFill, Generation: g.Generation,
			PastMembers: mapSlice(g.PastMembers, func(id string) string { return id }),
			Leaving: mapSlice(g.Leaving, func(l LeavingMember) *pb.LeavingMember {
				return &pb.LeavingMember{NodeId: l.NodeID, RemovedGeneration: l.RemovedGeneration,
					ReleaseEntry:  TrackFrontierToPB(l.ReleaseEntry),
					FrozenMembers: mapSlice(l.FrozenMembers, func(id string) string { return id }),
					FrozenDomains: l.FrozenDomains, Released: l.Released}
			}),
			GroupKey: g.GroupKey, PlacementSalt: g.PlacementSalt}
	})
}

func groupMemberToPB(m GroupMember) *pb.GroupMember {
	out := &pb.GroupMember{NodeId: m.NodeID, JoinedGeneration: m.JoinedGeneration, ReadyGeneration: m.ReadyGeneration,
		MemberClass: memberClassToPB(m.Class), LagAdvances: m.LagAdvances, HostIndexerId: cloneUint64(m.HostIndexerID)}
	if m.Checkpoint != nil {
		out.Checkpoint = &pb.MemberCheckpointRecord{Checkpoint: MemberCheckpointBodyToPB(m.Checkpoint.Checkpoint),
			ReplicaJws: m.Checkpoint.ReplicaJWS, Epoch: m.Checkpoint.Epoch}
	}
	if m.ObservedEntry != nil {
		out.ObservedEntry = TrackFrontierToPB(*m.ObservedEntry)
	}
	return out
}

// memberCheckpointSeqsFromPB decodes member_checkpoint_seqs, sorted by
// (node_id, owner_indexer_id) without duplicates.
func memberCheckpointSeqsFromPB(m *pb.TableRegistrySnapshot) ([]MemberCheckpointSeq, error) {
	out := mapSlice(m.GetMemberCheckpointSeqs(), func(s *pb.MemberCheckpointSeq) MemberCheckpointSeq {
		return MemberCheckpointSeq{NodeID: s.GetNodeId(), OwnerIndexerID: s.GetOwnerIndexerId(),
			CheckpointSeq: s.GetCheckpointSeq(), ReplicaSigner: s.GetReplicaSigner()}
	})
	for i := 1; i < len(out); i++ {
		if cmp.Or(cmp.Compare(out[i-1].NodeID, out[i].NodeID), cmp.Compare(out[i-1].OwnerIndexerID, out[i].OwnerIndexerID)) >= 0 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("table registry snapshot: member_checkpoint_seqs must be sorted by (node_id, owner_indexer_id) without duplicates")
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}

func memberCheckpointSeqsToPB(seqs []MemberCheckpointSeq) []*pb.MemberCheckpointSeq {
	return mapSlice(seqs, func(s MemberCheckpointSeq) *pb.MemberCheckpointSeq {
		return &pb.MemberCheckpointSeq{NodeId: s.NodeID, OwnerIndexerId: s.OwnerIndexerID,
			CheckpointSeq: s.CheckpointSeq, ReplicaSigner: s.ReplicaSigner}
	})
}
```

## Task 61: arbiter-core — incarnation-scoped Keeper paths, both roots in every sweep, and the owner's report-only Keeper audit (S3-E1)

Spec §8.8 (incarnation-scoped Keeper paths, the owner sweep's alerts), §8.2 (who may hold a replica on an owner's path), §15 (the arbiter-core line) and §17 (the data-plane proofs: a stale unscoped last replica dropped after a scoped re-create, a same-name re-create on both path kinds); contract §42.1, clarification K60 (`purge_members`), Review Focus 4. Today every `hg_unsafe` replica of a table joins one Keeper path, `/sentio/<shard>/unsafe/<db__table>` (`dataplane/ddl/naming.go:42-46`), whatever its incarnation, and ClickHouse removes every child of a table's path when its last replica drops (Plan S3-A M10). A key re-created after a purge therefore lands on the path a stale replica of the purged incarnation may still hold, and from the purge switch (S3-E2 Task 69) the members' `hg_member_unsafe` replicas join these paths too. The arbiter marks every incarnation recorded after the switch `scoped_keeper_path` (Task 60's `wire.TableIncarnation.ScopedKeeperPath`); this task gives such an incarnation its own path `/sentio/<shard>/unsafe_inc/<db__table>/<seq>`, under a sibling root, and makes the data plane act on each incarnation's own path:

- `dataplane/ddl`: `KeeperScope` and `ZooKeeperPathFor`, with `IncarnationIntentsFor`, `EnsureTableFor`, `DropTableFor`, `KeeperReplicasAt` and `DropReplicaAt` acting on the scope's path; the existing `ZooKeeperPath`, `IncarnationIntents`, `EnsureTable`, `DropTable`, `KeeperReplicas`, `DropReplica` and `KeeperUnsafeTables` keep their signatures and delegate with the unscoped scope, byte for byte; the `REPLICA_ALREADY_EXISTS` recovery drops a stranded replica only on the scope's own path; `ListKeeperRoots` lists both roots and tells incarnation paths from every other replicated-table root under `unsafe_inc`;
- `wire`: `TableRegistrySnapshot.KnownKeeperReplica`, the set of nodes that may hold a replica on an owner's path;
- `dataplane/tableset`: `KeeperScopeOf`; create, verify, `clearDecommissioned`, purge, sweep and the leftover drops on the incarnation's own path; the owner SNode's sweep of surviving paths over both roots; and the owner's report-only Keeper audit (`Stats.KeeperFindings`, `Stats.KeeperAuditRuns`), which reports unknown replicas and non-incarnation roots and drops nothing.

Nothing changes on devnet2 with this code alone (contract §38, data-plane inertness): no incarnation is scoped before switch 1, so every statement on a legacy path is the one `CORE_TAG_P4` issues, the only new Keeper reads are the listing of `unsafe_inc` (empty there, `UNSAFE_INC_ROOT`) and the audit's reads every ten minutes, and the audit only reports.

Notes:
- **Base and branch.** The arbiter-core worktree `$HOME/src/remotesrc/claude/arbiter-core/multi-source-s3e1` (branch `urwt/claude/multi-source-s3e1`) that Task 59 created from `origin/main` at `CORE_TAG_P4` or later, with Tasks 59 and 60 committed; Tasks 59–63 share the branch and one PR, which Task 63 opens and merges before it cuts `CORE_TAG_P5`, so this task only commits. Line anchors are those of arbiter-core `origin/main` `cfd4f42`, identical to the header's `8f0bc43` for every file here. Of this task's files the releases and tasks in between change only these: Plan S3-D Task 50 appends `ReplicaIsActive` and `ScopedUnsafeRootChildren` at the end of `dataplane/ddl/table.go` (both stay as they are: they serve the rebuild fence, which requires `unsafe_inc` to be empty before the purge switch) and two tests at the end of `table_ch_test.go`; Plan S3-C2 Task 29 adds `ManifestOwner` right after `Owner` in `wire/table_registry_snapshot.go`; Task 60 adds `ScopedKeeperPath`, `PurgeMembers` and `Groups` there and the group types in `wire/stage3_registry.go`. Nothing in between touches `dataplane/ddl/naming.go` or `dataplane/tableset/reconciler.go`. Every hunk anchors on text those changes leave as it is (the hunk rule), and Step 1 checks it.
- **A sibling root.** ClickHouse removes every child of a table's path when its last replica drops (S3-A M10), so an incarnation path may never lie below a legacy table path. `unsafe` and `unsafe_inc` are siblings under `/sentio/<shard>` (contract §42.1's two constants); `TestScopedZooKeeperPathIsNeverUnderTheLegacyRoot` checks it for any table name, and `TestScopedRecreateSurvivesDroppingTheStaleLastUnscopedReplica` drops a stale last replica on `/sentio/<shard>/unsafe/<t>` after a scoped re-create and keeps writing to `/sentio/<shard>/unsafe_inc/<t>/<seq>`.
- **An incarnation's scope.** `KeeperScopeOf(inc)` is `{inc.Seq, inc.ScopedKeeperPath}`. The arbiter fixes the flag when it records the incarnation (S3-E2 Task 69), so an incarnation never moves between paths; a genesis table is never scoped (its target's scope carries the unmarked seq 0, and every function that acts on a path refuses a scoped scope with seq 0: `ddl: an incarnation-scoped Keeper path needs an incarnation seq of at least 1`). Local table names do not change: an incarnation's three tables keep `CHTableName`, only `hg_unsafe`'s `ReplicatedMergeTree` path differs, and `VerifyProtocolTable` compares the live `zookeeper_path` with the scope's, so a table on the wrong path is drift, fatal as today. `Intents` (`build.go`) still renders the legacy path, which `IncarnationIntentsFor` replaces for a scoped scope, so `BuildDDL` and every golden DDL stay byte-identical.
- **Both roots in the owner's sweep.** `sweepPurgedKeeperPaths` (only with `Config.SweepDecommissioned`, the owner SNode) lists both roots with `ListKeeperRoots` and keeps today's rule for a legacy path of a key whose live incarnation has no tables. Two cases are new: the legacy path of a key whose live incarnation is scoped (only retired incarnations used that path, so this node's own stranded replica and every replica outside the purge node set are removed, without touching the live incarnation's tables), and the incarnation path of a Purged or Refused scoped incarnation it owns (no other incarnation shares it). Every other path is left alone; the audit reports the ones that are no incarnation path at all.
- **The Keeper audit.** It runs only with `Config.SweepDecommissioned` (the owner SNode: verifiers and members never audit), at the first pass and then once `Config.KeeperAuditInterval` (0 → `DefaultKeeperAuditInterval`, ten minutes) has passed since the last audit that completed, after the sweep of the same pass, and only while the registry is followed. A legacy path is judged against every unscoped incarnation of its physical name this reconciler owns, an incarnation path against its own incarnation, and another owner's paths are left to that owner; each `KeeperRoots.NonIncarnation` path, and each incarnation path whose seq is no `scoped_keeper_path` incarnation of that table, is reported whoever owns the name. It reads the purge node set only when it lists a replica other than its own. Contract §42.1's two warn texts are logged once per finding, when it first appears (the `reportUnknown` precedent), and `Stats.KeeperFindings` holds the last audit's findings sorted by path then replica; a failed audit is logged as `keeper audit failed; the next pass retries it` and retried at the next pass. It drops nothing (`TestOwnerKeeperAuditDropsNothing`). sentio-node exports the findings as `sentio_node_storage_integrity_keeper_findings{reason}` in S3-E4 Task 79.
- **What `KnownKeeperReplica` counts.** Contract §42.1's four sets: the owner's SNode (`si_indexers[Owner(inc)].snode_node_id`), the purge node set (every registered, non-evicted SNode and verifier, so the network pool and registered members), a current or past member of `G(Owner(inc), inc.DatabaseID)`, and `inc.PurgeMembers`. A removed member is merged into `PastMembers` (S3-E3 contract §50, `RebalanceGroup` effect 3); the function also checks `Leaving` directly, so a Leaving member, which keeps its replicas until it is released, stays known however the view prunes `PastMembers`. An incarnation that names no owner belongs to the founding indexer (`Owner`).
- **Inertness, measured.** With no scoped incarnation, every DDL and Keeper statement is byte-identical (`TestZooKeeperPathForUnscopedIsByteIdentical` records the statements of the legacy entry points on a fake connection), and the existing ClickHouse suites of `ddl`, `tableset`, `snode` and `verifier` pass unchanged; the owner SNode issues one more Keeper read per pass (the `unsafe_inc` listing, plus one per table under it once there are any).
