- [ ] **Step 3: Write the failing Keeper-scope tests**

The unit tests drive a fake connection that records every statement and answers each `system.zookeeper` listing from a map, so they pin the exact statements of the legacy entry points. The ClickHouse test strands this node's replica of one table on both of its paths (a table of the second server under this node's replica name, detached) and checks that each create recovers on its own path only.

Create `dataplane/ddl/keeper_scope_test.go`:

```go
package ddl

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"
	"github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2/lib/driver"
)

// keeperFakeConn is a clickhouse.Conn that records every Exec and Query and
// answers each system.zookeeper listing from children (path -> child names).
// Any other method is unimplemented (the embedded nil Conn panics).
type keeperFakeConn struct {
	clickhouse.Conn
	children map[string][]string
	calls    []string
}

func (c *keeperFakeConn) Exec(_ context.Context, query string, args ...any) error {
	c.calls = append(c.calls, fmt.Sprintf("exec %s %v", query, args))
	return nil
}

func (c *keeperFakeConn) Query(_ context.Context, query string, args ...any) (driver.Rows, error) {
	c.calls = append(c.calls, fmt.Sprintf("query %s %v", query, args))
	if query != `SELECT name FROM system.zookeeper WHERE path = ?` || len(args) != 1 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("keeperFakeConn: unexpected query %q %v", query, args)
	}
	path, _ := args[0].(string)
	return &nameRows{names: slices.Clone(c.children[path])}, nil
}

// nameRows yields one name per row.
type nameRows struct {
	driver.Rows
	names []string
	cur   string
}

func (r *nameRows) Next() bool {
	if len(r.names) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	r.cur, r.names = r.names[0], r.names[1:]
	return true
}

func (r *nameRows) Scan(dest ...any) error {
	p, ok := dest[0].(*string)
	if len(dest) != 1 || !ok {
		return errors.New("nameRows: scan into one *string")
	}
	*p = r.cur
	return nil
}

func (r *nameRows) Err() error   { return nil }
func (r *nameRows) Close() error { return nil }

// TestZooKeeperPathForUnscopedIsByteIdentical: an unscoped scope, of any
// incarnation, is the legacy /sentio/<shard>/unsafe/<db__table> path every
// replica uses today (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §8.8), and every legacy entry
// point (ZooKeeperPath, IncarnationIntents, DropTable, KeeperReplicas,
// DropReplica, KeeperUnsafeTables) keeps its exact intents and statements.
func TestZooKeeperPathForUnscopedIsByteIdentical(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		shard   uint32
		tableID string
		want    string
	}{
		{0, "db.t", "/sentio/0/unsafe/db__t"},
		{0, "dex.swaps", "/sentio/0/unsafe/dex__swaps"},
		{7, "a.b.c", "/sentio/7/unsafe/a__b__c"},
	} {
		for _, seq := range []uint64{0, 1, 42} {
			if got := ZooKeeperPathFor(tc.shard, tc.tableID, KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: seq}); got != tc.want {
				t.Fatalf("ZooKeeperPathFor(%d, %q, unscoped %d) = %q, want %q", tc.shard, tc.tableID, seq, got, tc.want)
			}
		}
		p := goldenPinned()
		p.KeeperShardID = tc.shard
		if got := ZooKeeperPath(p, tc.tableID); got != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("ZooKeeperPath(shard %d, %q) = %q, want %q", tc.shard, tc.tableID, got, tc.want)
		}
	}

	p, sch := goldenPinned(), goldenSchema()
	for _, seq := range []uint64{0, 7} {
		u1, s1, p1, err1 := IncarnationIntents(p, sch, seq)
		u2, s2, p2, err2 := IncarnationIntentsFor(p, sch, KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: seq})
		if err1 != nil || err2 != nil {
			t.Fatalf("seq %d: %v, %v", seq, err1, err2)
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual([]TableIntent{u1, s1, p1}, []TableIntent{u2, s2, p2}) {
			t.Fatalf("seq %d: IncarnationIntents and the unscoped IncarnationIntentsFor differ:\n%+v\n%+v", seq, []TableIntent{u1, s1, p1}, []TableIntent{u2, s2, p2})
		}
	}
	unsafe, _, _, err := IncarnationIntentsFor(p, sch, KeeperScope{})
	if err != nil || unsafe.SQL() != goldenUnsafeDDL {
		t.Fatalf("unscoped genesis DDL = %q, %v; want the golden DDL", unsafe.SQL(), err)
	}

	// The Keeper half of DropTable, KeeperReplicas, DropReplica and
	// KeeperUnsafeTables issue exactly the statements they issued before.
	legacyPath := "/sentio/0/unsafe/db__t"
	run := func(f func(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn) error) []string {
		t.Helper()
		conn := &keeperFakeConn{children: map[string][]string{legacyPath + "/replicas": {"node-1", "verifier-1"}}}
		if err := f(context.Background(), conn); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return conn.calls
	}
	want := []string{
		"exec DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hg_promote`.`db__t` SYNC []",
		"exec DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hg_safe`.`db__t` SYNC []",
		"exec DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hg_unsafe`.`db__t` SYNC []",
		"query SELECT name FROM system.zookeeper WHERE path = ? [" + legacyPath + "/replicas]",
		"exec SYSTEM DROP REPLICA 'node-1' FROM ZKPATH '" + legacyPath + "' []",
	}
	for name, f := range map[string]func(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn) error{
		"DropTable": func(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn) error { return DropTable(ctx, conn, p, "db.t") },
		"DropTableFor unscoped 9": func(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn) error {
			return DropTableFor(ctx, conn, p, "db.t", KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 9})
		},
		"DropTableFor zero scope": func(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn) error {
			return DropTableFor(ctx, conn, p, "db.t", KeeperScope{})
		},
	} {
		if got := run(f); !slices.Equal(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("%s statements:\n%s\nwant:\n%s", name, strings.Join(got, "\n"), strings.Join(want, "\n"))
		}
	}
	replicasLegacy := run(func(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn) error {
		got, err := KeeperReplicas(ctx, conn, p, "db.t")
		if err == nil && !slices.Equal(got, []string{"node-1", "verifier-1"}) {
			err = fmt.Errorf("KeeperReplicas = %v", got)
		}
		return err
	})
	replicasAt := run(func(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn) error {
		got, err := KeeperReplicasAt(ctx, conn, 0, "db.t", KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 3})
		if err == nil && !slices.Equal(got, []string{"node-1", "verifier-1"}) {
			err = fmt.Errorf("KeeperReplicasAt = %v", got)
		}
		return err
	})
	if !slices.Equal(replicasLegacy, replicasAt) {
		t.Fatalf("KeeperReplicas %q != unscoped KeeperReplicasAt %q", replicasLegacy, replicasAt)
	}
	dropLegacy := run(func(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn) error {
		return DropReplica(ctx, conn, p, "db.t", "gone")
	})
	dropAt := run(func(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn) error {
		return DropReplicaAt(ctx, conn, 0, "db.t", KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 3}, "gone")
	})
	if want := []string{"exec SYSTEM DROP REPLICA 'gone' FROM ZKPATH '" + legacyPath + "' []"}; !slices.Equal(dropLegacy, want) || !slices.Equal(dropAt, want) {
		t.Fatalf("DropReplica %q, unscoped DropReplicaAt %q; want %q", dropLegacy, dropAt, want)
	}
	tables := run(func(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn) error {
		_, err := KeeperUnsafeTables(ctx, conn, p)
		return err
	})
	if want := []string{"query SELECT name FROM system.zookeeper WHERE path = ? [/sentio/0/unsafe]"}; !slices.Equal(tables, want) {
		t.Fatalf("KeeperUnsafeTables %q, want %q", tables, want)
	}
}

// TestScopedZooKeeperPathIsNeverUnderTheLegacyRoot: ClickHouse removes every
// child of a table's Keeper path when its last replica drops (S3-A M10), so
// no incarnation path may be a descendant of a legacy path, whatever the
// table is called (spec §8.8). A scoped path needs an incarnation.
func TestScopedZooKeeperPathIsNeverUnderTheLegacyRoot(t *testing.T) {
	ids := []string{"db.t", "unsafe.t", "unsafe_inc.t", "db.unsafe_inc", "a.b.c", "x.1"}
	for _, shard := range []uint32{0, 1, 17} {
		legacyRoot := fmt.Sprintf("/sentio/%d/unsafe", shard)
		for _, id := range ids {
			for _, seq := range []uint64{1, 2, 10, 1 << 40} {
				scoped := ZooKeeperPathFor(shard, id, KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: seq, Scoped: true})
				if want := fmt.Sprintf("/sentio/%d/unsafe_inc/%s/%d", shard, CHTableName(id), seq); scoped != want {
					t.Fatalf("scoped path = %q, want %q", scoped, want)
				}
				if strings.HasPrefix(scoped, legacyRoot+"/") {
					t.Fatalf("scoped path %q is under the legacy root %q", scoped, legacyRoot)
				}
				for _, other := range ids {
					if legacy := ZooKeeperPathFor(shard, other, KeeperScope{}); strings.HasPrefix(scoped, legacy+"/") {
						t.Fatalf("scoped path %q is a descendant of the legacy path %q", scoped, legacy)
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	zero := KeeperScope{Scoped: true}
	if _, _, _, err := IncarnationIntentsFor(goldenPinned(), goldenSchema(), zero); err == nil || err.Error() != "ddl: an incarnation-scoped Keeper path needs an incarnation seq of at least 1" {
		t.Fatalf("IncarnationIntentsFor with a scoped seq 0 = %v", err)
	}
	conn := &keeperFakeConn{}
	if _, err := KeeperReplicasAt(context.Background(), conn, 0, "db.t", zero); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("KeeperReplicasAt accepted a scoped seq 0")
	}
	if err := DropReplicaAt(context.Background(), conn, 0, "db.t", zero, "r"); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("DropReplicaAt accepted a scoped seq 0")
	}
	if len(conn.calls) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("a refused scope issued %q", conn.calls)
	}
}

// TestIncarnationIntentsForUsesTheIncarnationPath: a scoped incarnation's
// hg_unsafe replicates at its incarnation path under this node's replica
// name; the tables carry its marker and hg_safe / hg_promote are unchanged.
func TestIncarnationIntentsForUsesTheIncarnationPath(t *testing.T) {
	p, sch := goldenPinned(), goldenSchema()
	scope := KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 7, Scoped: true}
	unsafe, safe, promote, err := IncarnationIntentsFor(p, sch, scope)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if unsafe.ZooKeeperPath != "/sentio/0/unsafe_inc/db__t/7" || unsafe.ReplicaName != p.NodeID {
		t.Fatalf("unsafe path %q replica %q", unsafe.ZooKeeperPath, unsafe.ReplicaName)
	}
	wantSQL := strings.Replace(goldenUnsafeDDL, "'/sentio/0/unsafe/db__t'", "'/sentio/0/unsafe_inc/db__t/7'", 1) + "\nCOMMENT 'hg_incarnation=7'"
	if unsafe.SQL() != wantSQL {
		t.Fatalf("scoped unsafe DDL:\n got: %s\nwant: %s", unsafe.SQL(), wantSQL)
	}
	_, legacySafe, legacyPromote, err := IncarnationIntents(p, sch, 7)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(safe, legacySafe) || !reflect.DeepEqual(promote, legacyPromote) {
		t.Fatalf("hg_safe / hg_promote intents depend on the Keeper scope:\n%+v %+v\n%+v %+v", safe, promote, legacySafe, legacyPromote)
	}

	scopedPath := "/sentio/0/unsafe_inc/db__t/7"
	conn := &keeperFakeConn{children: map[string][]string{scopedPath + "/replicas": {"node-1"}, "/sentio/0/unsafe/db__t/replicas": {"node-1"}}}
	if err := DropTableFor(context.Background(), conn, p, "db.t", scope); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := []string{
		"exec DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hg_promote`.`db__t` SYNC []",
		"exec DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hg_safe`.`db__t` SYNC []",
		"exec DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hg_unsafe`.`db__t` SYNC []",
		"query SELECT name FROM system.zookeeper WHERE path = ? [" + scopedPath + "/replicas]",
		"exec SYSTEM DROP REPLICA 'node-1' FROM ZKPATH '" + scopedPath + "' []",
	}
	if !slices.Equal(conn.calls, want) {
		t.Fatalf("scoped DropTableFor statements:\n%s\nwant:\n%s", strings.Join(conn.calls, "\n"), strings.Join(want, "\n"))
	}
}
```

Create `dataplane/ddl/keeper_scope_ch_test.go`:

```go
package ddl

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha1"
	"encoding/binary"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"testing"
	"time"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/payloadexec"
)

// isolatedShard is a Keeper shard of the test's own. The ddl, tableset, snode
// and verifier targets share one Keeper in CI, and these tests create
// incarnation paths and read whole roots, so they never use shard 0.
func isolatedShard(t *testing.T) uint32 {
	t.Helper()
	sum := sha1.Sum([]byte("keeper-shard/" + t.Name()))
	return 1_000_000 + binary.BigEndian.Uint32(sum[:4])%1_000_000
}

// strandReplicaAt is strandReplica on the path of scope s: it leaves this
// node's replica of sch's hg_unsafe table registered there with no attached
// table, by creating the table in the database p.UnsafeDB + "_" + label of
// the second server and detaching it. A label per path lets one test strand
// the same table on both roots. The cleanup drops that database and then the
// replica, if it is still registered, so a rerun on the same Keeper starts
// clean.
func strandReplicaAt(t *testing.T, replicaConn clickhouse.Conn, p Pinned, sch payloadexec.TableSchema, s KeeperScope, label string) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx := context.Background()
	unsafe, _, _, err := IncarnationIntentsFor(p, sch, s)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	unsafe.Database = p.UnsafeDB + "_" + label
	if err := replicaConn.Exec(ctx, "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS "+quoteIdent(unsafe.Database)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		ctx := context.Background()
		_ = replicaConn.Exec(ctx, "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS "+quoteIdent(unsafe.Database)+" SYNC")
		if replicas, err := keeperChildren(ctx, replicaConn, unsafe.ZooKeeperPath+"/replicas"); err == nil && slices.Contains(replicas, p.NodeID) {
			_ = dropReplicaAtPath(ctx, replicaConn, unsafe.ZooKeeperPath, p.NodeID)
		}
	})
	if err := replicaConn.Exec(ctx, unsafe.SQL()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := replicaConn.Exec(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("DETACH TABLE %s.%s", quoteIdent(unsafe.Database), quoteIdent(unsafe.Table))); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

// replicaState is one replica's registration under a Keeper path: listed
// under <path>/replicas, and active while a server holds its table attached.
// A replica becomes active shortly after its CREATE, so a wanted active state
// is polled for up to ten seconds.
func replicaState(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn, path, replica string, wantActive bool) (listed, active bool) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second)
	for {
		replicas, err := keeperChildren(context.Background(), conn, path+"/replicas")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		children, err := keeperChildren(context.Background(), conn, path+"/replicas/"+replica)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		listed, active = slices.Contains(replicas, replica), slices.Contains(children, "is_active")
		if active == wantActive || time.Now().After(deadline) {
			return listed, active
		}
		time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
	}
}

// TestEnsureTableForRemovesAStrandedReplicaOnlyOnItsOwnPath: the
// REPLICA_ALREADY_EXISTS recovery removes this node's stranded replica from
// the path of the create's own scope only. A scoped create leaves the same
// replica name stranded on the legacy path, and a legacy create leaves it
// stranded on an incarnation path (plan S3-E1 contract §42.1).
func TestEnsureTableForRemovesAStrandedReplicaOnlyOnItsOwnPath(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	conn := requireCH(t)
	requireKeeper(t, conn)
	replicaConn := requireReplicaCH(t)
	p := testPinned(t)
	p.KeeperShardID = isolatedShard(t)
	dropDatabasesSync(t, conn, p)
	sch := ensureSchema(t)
	legacy, scoped4, scoped5 := KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 3}, KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 4, Scoped: true}, KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 5, Scoped: true}
	legacyPath := ZooKeeperPathFor(p.KeeperShardID, sch.TableID, legacy)
	scoped4Path := ZooKeeperPathFor(p.KeeperShardID, sch.TableID, scoped4)
	scoped5Path := ZooKeeperPathFor(p.KeeperShardID, sch.TableID, scoped5)
	attachedAt := func() string {
		t.Helper()
		var path string
		if err := conn.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT zookeeper_path FROM system.replicas WHERE database = ? AND table = ?`, p.UnsafeDB, CHTableName(sch.TableID)).Scan(&path); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return path
	}

	strandReplicaAt(t, replicaConn, p, sch, legacy, "legacy")
	strandReplicaAt(t, replicaConn, p, sch, scoped4, "scoped4")
	if err := EnsureTableFor(ctx, conn, p, sch, scoped4, ModeCreateAndVerify); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("scoped ensure over a stranded own replica: %v", err)
	}
	if path := attachedAt(); path != scoped4Path {
		t.Fatalf("hg_unsafe replicates at %q, want %q", path, scoped4Path)
	}
	if listed, active := replicaState(t, conn, scoped4Path, p.NodeID, true); !listed || !active {
		t.Fatalf("incarnation path: listed %v active %v; want this node's attached replica", listed, active)
	}
	if listed, active := replicaState(t, conn, legacyPath, p.NodeID, false); !listed || active {
		t.Fatalf("legacy path: listed %v active %v; a scoped create must leave the stranded legacy replica alone", listed, active)
	}

	if err := DropTableFor(ctx, conn, p, sch.TableID, scoped4); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	strandReplicaAt(t, replicaConn, p, sch, scoped5, "scoped5")
	if err := EnsureTableFor(ctx, conn, p, sch, legacy, ModeCreateAndVerify); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("legacy ensure over a stranded own replica: %v", err)
	}
	if path := attachedAt(); path != legacyPath {
		t.Fatalf("hg_unsafe replicates at %q, want %q", path, legacyPath)
	}
	if listed, active := replicaState(t, conn, legacyPath, p.NodeID, true); !listed || !active {
		t.Fatalf("legacy path: listed %v active %v; want this node's attached replica", listed, active)
	}
	if listed, active := replicaState(t, conn, scoped5Path, p.NodeID, false); !listed || active {
		t.Fatalf("incarnation path: listed %v active %v; a legacy create must leave the stranded scoped replica alone", listed, active)
	}
}
```

```go
// ZooKeeperPath is the anchored replication path of an hg_unsafe table:
// /sentio/<keeper_shard_id>/unsafe/<CHTableName>.
```

with:

```go
// The two Keeper roots of the SI unsafe replicas (housegate spec 2026-10-14
// §8.8). An incarnation recorded before the stage-3 purge switch replicates
// under the legacy root, one recorded after it under the incarnation-scoped
// root. The roots are siblings under /sentio/<shard>, so no incarnation path
// is ever a descendant of a legacy table path, whose last replica's drop
// removes every child of it.
const (
	KeeperUnsafeRoot       = "unsafe"     // /sentio/<shard>/unsafe/<db__table>
	KeeperScopedUnsafeRoot = "unsafe_inc" // /sentio/<shard>/unsafe_inc/<db__table>/<incarnation_seq>
)

// KeeperScope selects one incarnation's Keeper path; the zero value is the legacy unscoped path.
type KeeperScope struct {
	// IncarnationSeq is the registry incarnation. It marks the tables'
	// COMMENT (IncarnationComment; 0 for a genesis table, which carries
	// none) and, when Scoped, names the incarnation path.
	IncarnationSeq uint64
	// Scoped selects /sentio/<shard>/unsafe_inc/<db__table>/<IncarnationSeq>,
	// the path of an incarnation the registry marks scoped_keeper_path.
	Scoped bool
}

// validate refuses a scoped path without an incarnation: seq 0 is the
// unmarked genesis incarnation, which never uses an incarnation path.
func (s KeeperScope) validate() error {
	if s.Scoped && s.IncarnationSeq == 0 {
		return errors.New("ddl: an incarnation-scoped Keeper path needs an incarnation seq of at least 1")
	}
	return nil
}

// ZooKeeperPathFor is the replication path of tableID's hg_unsafe (or
// hg_member_unsafe) table in scope s: /sentio/<shard>/unsafe/<CHTableName>
// unscoped, /sentio/<shard>/unsafe_inc/<CHTableName>/<IncarnationSeq> scoped.
// Every function that acts on a path refuses a scoped s with seq 0.
func ZooKeeperPathFor(keeperShardID uint32, tableID string, s KeeperScope) string {
	if s.Scoped {
		return fmt.Sprintf("/sentio/%d/%s/%s/%d", keeperShardID, KeeperScopedUnsafeRoot, CHTableName(tableID), s.IncarnationSeq)
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("/sentio/%d/%s/%s", keeperShardID, KeeperUnsafeRoot, CHTableName(tableID))
}

// keeperRootPath is /sentio/<shard>/<root>.
func keeperRootPath(keeperShardID uint32, root string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("/sentio/%d/%s", keeperShardID, root)
}

// ZooKeeperPath is the anchored replication path of an hg_unsafe table on the
// legacy root: /sentio/<keeper_shard_id>/unsafe/<CHTableName>
// (ZooKeeperPathFor with the zero KeeperScope).
func ZooKeeperPath(p Pinned, tableID string) string {
	return ZooKeeperPathFor(p.KeeperShardID, tableID, KeeperScope{})
}
```

```go
// IncarnationIntents is Intents for one registry incarnation: incarnationSeq
// 0 renders the unmarked genesis tables, any other value marks all three with
// IncarnationComment(incarnationSeq).
func IncarnationIntents(p Pinned, t payloadexec.TableSchema, incarnationSeq uint64) (TableIntent, TableIntent, TableIntent, error) {
	unsafe, safe, promote, err := Intents(p, t)
	if err != nil {
		return TableIntent{}, TableIntent{}, TableIntent{}, err
	}
	if incarnationSeq != 0 {
		comment := IncarnationComment(incarnationSeq)
		unsafe.Comment, safe.Comment, promote.Comment = comment, comment, comment
	}
	return unsafe, safe, promote, nil
}
```

with:

```go
// IncarnationIntents is Intents for one registry incarnation on the legacy
// Keeper path: incarnationSeq 0 renders the unmarked genesis tables, any other
// value marks all three with IncarnationComment(incarnationSeq). It is
// IncarnationIntentsFor with KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: incarnationSeq}.
func IncarnationIntents(p Pinned, t payloadexec.TableSchema, incarnationSeq uint64) (TableIntent, TableIntent, TableIntent, error) {
	return IncarnationIntentsFor(p, t, KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: incarnationSeq})
}

// IncarnationIntentsFor is Intents for one registry incarnation in Keeper
// scope s: s.IncarnationSeq 0 renders the unmarked genesis tables, any other
// value marks all three with IncarnationComment(s.IncarnationSeq), and
// hg_unsafe replicates at ZooKeeperPathFor(p.KeeperShardID, t.TableID, s).
func IncarnationIntentsFor(p Pinned, t payloadexec.TableSchema, s KeeperScope) (TableIntent, TableIntent, TableIntent, error) {
	if err := s.validate(); err != nil {
		return TableIntent{}, TableIntent{}, TableIntent{}, err
	}
	unsafe, safe, promote, err := Intents(p, t)
	if err != nil {
		return TableIntent{}, TableIntent{}, TableIntent{}, err
	}
	unsafe.ZooKeeperPath = ZooKeeperPathFor(p.KeeperShardID, t.TableID, s)
	if s.IncarnationSeq != 0 {
		comment := IncarnationComment(s.IncarnationSeq)
		unsafe.Comment, safe.Comment, promote.Comment = comment, comment, comment
	}
	return unsafe, safe, promote, nil
}
```

```go
// EnsureTable creates (ModeCreateAndVerify) and verifies the hg_unsafe,
// hg_safe and hg_promote tables of one table; ModeVerifyOnly only verifies and
// ModeOff does nothing. incarnationSeq is 0 for a genesis table and the
// registry incarnation otherwise (IncarnationIntents). A crash between
// ClickHouse registering this node's hg_unsafe replica in Keeper and writing
// the local table leaves the replica behind, and the next CREATE fails with
// REPLICA_ALREADY_EXISTS; EnsureTable then removes the stale replica (refused
// by ClickHouse while any server holds it active) and creates once more. It
// does so only when the table is absent locally, attached or detached: a
// detached table's replica is its own Keeper metadata, never stale.

		return nil
	}
```

```go
// KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: incarnationSeq}, where incarnationSeq is 0 for
// a genesis table and the registry incarnation otherwise.
func EnsureTable(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, p Pinned, t payloadexec.TableSchema, incarnationSeq uint64, mode Mode) error {

// EnsureTableFor creates (ModeCreateAndVerify) and verifies the hg_unsafe,
// hg_safe and hg_promote tables of one table in Keeper scope s
// (IncarnationIntentsFor); ModeVerifyOnly only verifies and ModeOff does

// the next CREATE fails with REPLICA_ALREADY_EXISTS; EnsureTableFor then

	}

	}
```

In `dataplane/ddl/table.go`, replace `DropTable` through `DropReplica` (`:130-179`):

```go
// DropTable drops tableID's hg_promote, hg_safe and hg_unsafe tables, in that
// order, each with DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ... SYNC. Dropping hg_unsafe removes
// this node's replica from Keeper, and the last replica removes the table's
// Keeper path. If a crash separated the local drop from the Keeper removal,
// this node's replica is still listed with no local table; DropTable removes
// it too, so a repeated call converges.
func DropTable(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, p Pinned, tableID string) error {
	if err := validatePinned(conn, p); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	table := CHTableName(tableID)
	for _, database := range []string{p.PromoteDB, p.SafeDB, p.UnsafeDB} {
		if err := conn.Exec(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS %s.%s SYNC", quoteIdent(database), quoteIdent(table))); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("ddl: drop %s.%s: %w", database, table, err)
		}
	}
	replicas, err := KeeperReplicas(ctx, conn, p, tableID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, replica := range replicas {
		if replica == p.NodeID {
			return DropReplica(ctx, conn, p, tableID, replica)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// KeeperReplicas returns the sorted replica names registered under tableID's
// Keeper path; none when the path does not exist.
func KeeperReplicas(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, p Pinned, tableID string) ([]string, error) {
	return keeperChildren(ctx, conn, ZooKeeperPath(p, tableID)+"/replicas")
}

// KeeperUnsafeTables returns the physical table names that have a Keeper path
// under /sentio/<keeper_shard_id>/unsafe.
func KeeperUnsafeTables(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, p Pinned) ([]string, error) {
	return keeperChildren(ctx, conn, fmt.Sprintf("/sentio/%d/unsafe", p.KeeperShardID))
}

// DropReplica removes one replica of tableID's hg_unsafe table from Keeper
// (SYSTEM DROP REPLICA ... FROM ZKPATH). ClickHouse refuses an active replica;
// removing the last replica also removes the table's Keeper path.
func DropReplica(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, p Pinned, tableID, replica string) error {
	path := ZooKeeperPath(p, tableID)
	if err := conn.Exec(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("SYSTEM DROP REPLICA %s FROM ZKPATH %s", quoteLiteral(replica), quoteLiteral(path))); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("ddl: drop replica %s from %s: %w", replica, path, err)
	}
	return nil
}
```

with:

```go
// DropTable is DropTableFor on the legacy Keeper path (the zero KeeperScope).
func DropTable(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, p Pinned, tableID string) error {
	return DropTableFor(ctx, conn, p, tableID, KeeperScope{})
}

// DropTableFor drops tableID's hg_promote, hg_safe and hg_unsafe tables, in
// that order, each with DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ... SYNC. Dropping hg_unsafe
// removes this node's replica from Keeper, and the last replica removes the
// table's Keeper path. If a crash separated the local drop from the Keeper
// removal, this node's replica is still listed under the path of scope s with
// no local table; DropTableFor removes it there too, so a repeated call
// converges.
func DropTableFor(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, p Pinned, tableID string, s KeeperScope) error {
	if err := validatePinned(conn, p); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := s.validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	table := CHTableName(tableID)
	for _, database := range []string{p.PromoteDB, p.SafeDB, p.UnsafeDB} {
		if err := conn.Exec(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS %s.%s SYNC", quoteIdent(database), quoteIdent(table))); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("ddl: drop %s.%s: %w", database, table, err)
		}
	}
	replicas, err := KeeperReplicasAt(ctx, conn, p.KeeperShardID, tableID, s)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, replica := range replicas {
		if replica == p.NodeID {
			return DropReplicaAt(ctx, conn, p.KeeperShardID, tableID, s, replica)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// KeeperReplicas returns the sorted replica names registered under tableID's
// legacy Keeper path; none when the path does not exist.
func KeeperReplicas(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, p Pinned, tableID string) ([]string, error) {
	return KeeperReplicasAt(ctx, conn, p.KeeperShardID, tableID, KeeperScope{})
}

// KeeperReplicasAt returns the sorted replica names registered under tableID's
// Keeper path in scope s; none when the path does not exist.
func KeeperReplicasAt(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, keeperShardID uint32, tableID string, s KeeperScope) ([]string, error) {
	if err := s.validate(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return keeperChildren(ctx, conn, ZooKeeperPathFor(keeperShardID, tableID, s)+"/replicas")
}

// KeeperUnsafeTables returns the physical table names that have a Keeper path
// under the legacy root /sentio/<keeper_shard_id>/unsafe (ListKeeperRoots
// lists both roots).
func KeeperUnsafeTables(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, p Pinned) ([]string, error) {
	return keeperChildren(ctx, conn, keeperRootPath(p.KeeperShardID, KeeperUnsafeRoot))
}

// DropReplica removes one replica of tableID's hg_unsafe table from its legacy
// Keeper path (DropReplicaAt with the zero KeeperScope).
func DropReplica(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, p Pinned, tableID, replica string) error {
	return DropReplicaAt(ctx, conn, p.KeeperShardID, tableID, KeeperScope{}, replica)
}

// DropReplicaAt removes one replica of tableID's hg_unsafe (or
// hg_member_unsafe) table from its Keeper path in scope s (SYSTEM DROP
// REPLICA ... FROM ZKPATH). ClickHouse refuses an active replica; removing the
// last replica also removes that path and every child of it.
func DropReplicaAt(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, keeperShardID uint32, tableID string, s KeeperScope, replica string) error {
	if err := s.validate(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return dropReplicaAtPath(ctx, conn, ZooKeeperPathFor(keeperShardID, tableID, s), replica)
}

func dropReplicaAtPath(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, path, replica string) error {
	if err := conn.Exec(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("SYSTEM DROP REPLICA %s FROM ZKPATH %s", quoteLiteral(replica), quoteLiteral(path))); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("ddl: drop replica %s from %s: %w", replica, path, err)
	}
	return nil
}
```

```go
package ddl

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"
)

// createReplicatedAt creates database.table as a ReplicatedMergeTree replica
// named replica at path, whatever path that is, and drops the database when
// the test ends.
func createReplicatedAt(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn, database, table, path, replica string) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx := context.Background()
	if err := conn.Exec(ctx, "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS "+quoteIdent(database)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = conn.Exec(context.Background(), "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS "+quoteIdent(database)+" SYNC") })
	sql := fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s.%s (x UInt64) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree(%s, %s) ORDER BY x",
		quoteIdent(database), quoteIdent(table), quoteLiteral(path), quoteLiteral(replica))
	if err := conn.Exec(ctx, sql); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

// TestListKeeperRootsSeparatesIncarnationPathsFromOtherRoots: on a real
// Keeper, a legacy table, incarnation paths of two tables, and three
// replicated-table roots under unsafe_inc that are not incarnation paths (a
// non-decimal child, a non-canonical decimal, a table created directly at
// unsafe_inc/<t>) are told apart; dropping an incarnation's last replica
// removes its incarnation path only.
func TestListKeeperRootsSeparatesIncarnationPathsFromOtherRoots(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	conn := requireCH(t)
	requireKeeper(t, conn)
	p := testPinned(t)
	p.KeeperShardID = isolatedShard(t)
	dropDatabasesSync(t, conn, p)
	legacy := ensureSchema(t)
	scoped := legacy
	scoped.TableID = legacy.TableID + "_s"
	scope := KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 5, Scoped: true}
	if err := EnsureTableFor(ctx, conn, p, legacy, KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 1}, ModeCreateAndVerify); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := EnsureTableFor(ctx, conn, p, scoped, scope, ModeCreateAndVerify); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	root := fmt.Sprintf("/sentio/%d/unsafe_inc", p.KeeperShardID)
	stray := "hg_stray_" + uniqueSuffix(t)
	createReplicatedAt(t, conn, stray, "seq_7", root+"/db__multi/7", "r1")
	createReplicatedAt(t, conn, stray, "seq_12", root+"/db__multi/12", "r1")
	createReplicatedAt(t, conn, stray, "bogus", root+"/db__bogus/bogus", "r1")
	createReplicatedAt(t, conn, stray, "padded", root+"/db__bogus/007", "r1")
	createReplicatedAt(t, conn, stray, "direct", root+"/db__direct", "r1")

	got, err := ListKeeperRoots(ctx, conn, p.KeeperShardID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if want := []string{CHTableName(legacy.TableID)}; !slices.Equal(got.Legacy, want) {
		t.Fatalf("Legacy = %v, want %v", got.Legacy, want)
	}
	wantScoped := []ScopedKeeperPath{{"db__multi", 7}, {"db__multi", 12}, {CHTableName(scoped.TableID), 5}}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got.Scoped, wantScoped) {
		t.Fatalf("Scoped = %v, want %v", got.Scoped, wantScoped)
	}
	head := []string{root + "/db__bogus/007", root + "/db__bogus/bogus", root + "/db__direct"}
	if len(got.NonIncarnation) < len(head) || !slices.Equal(got.NonIncarnation[:len(head)], head) {
		t.Fatalf("NonIncarnation = %v, want it to start with %v", got.NonIncarnation, head)
	}
	for _, path := range got.NonIncarnation[len(head):] {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(path, root+"/db__direct/") {
			t.Fatalf("NonIncarnation lists %s, which is neither a stray root nor a child of the table created at %s/db__direct", path, root)
		}
	}
	if !slices.Contains(got.NonIncarnation, root+"/db__direct/replicas") {
		t.Fatalf("NonIncarnation = %v, want every non-decimal child of %s/db__direct", got.NonIncarnation, root)
	}
	if replicas, err := KeeperReplicasAt(ctx, conn, p.KeeperShardID, scoped.TableID, scope); err != nil || !slices.Equal(replicas, []string{p.NodeID}) {
		t.Fatalf("scoped replicas = %v, %v; want only %s", replicas, err, p.NodeID)
	}
	if tables, err := KeeperUnsafeTables(ctx, conn, p); err != nil || !slices.Equal(tables, []string{CHTableName(legacy.TableID)}) {
		t.Fatalf("KeeperUnsafeTables = %v, %v; the incarnation path is not on the legacy root", tables, err)
	}

	if err := DropTableFor(ctx, conn, p, scoped.TableID, scope); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	after, err := ListKeeperRoots(ctx, conn, p.KeeperShardID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if want := []ScopedKeeperPath{{"db__multi", 7}, {"db__multi", 12}}; !reflect.DeepEqual(after.Scoped, want) {
		t.Fatalf("Scoped after the drop = %v, want %v", after.Scoped, want)
	}
	if !slices.Equal(after.Legacy, got.Legacy) || !slices.Equal(after.NonIncarnation, got.NonIncarnation) {
		t.Fatalf("dropping one incarnation changed the other roots: %+v, was %+v", after, got)
	}
}
```

```go
package ddl

import (
	"context"
	"slices"
	"sort"
	"strconv"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"
)

// ScopedKeeperPath names one incarnation path,
// /sentio/<shard>/unsafe_inc/<Table>/<IncarnationSeq>.
type ScopedKeeperPath struct {
	Table          string // the physical table name (CHTableName)
	IncarnationSeq uint64
}

// KeeperRoots is what one Keeper shard holds under the two SI roots
// (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §8.8), for the owner's sweeps and Keeper audit.
// Each list is sorted: Legacy by name, Scoped by (Table, IncarnationSeq),
// NonIncarnation by path.
type KeeperRoots struct {
	Legacy         []string           // children of /sentio/<shard>/unsafe
	Scoped         []ScopedKeeperPath // /sentio/<shard>/unsafe_inc/<t>/<seq>, seq a canonical decimal >= 1
	NonIncarnation []string           // every other replicated-table root under unsafe_inc, as a full path
}

// ListKeeperRoots lists the two SI Keeper roots of keeperShardID. Under the
// legacy root every child is one table's path. Under the incarnation-scoped
// root every child /sentio/<shard>/unsafe_inc/<t> holds incarnation paths:
// a child of it that is a canonical decimal >= 1 is one (Scoped); every other
// child, and <t> itself when it has a replicas child (a replicated table
// created directly at <t>), is NonIncarnation. Only these two levels are
// read. An absent root lists nothing.
func ListKeeperRoots(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, keeperShardID uint32) (KeeperRoots, error) {
	var out KeeperRoots
	legacy, err := keeperChildren(ctx, conn, keeperRootPath(keeperShardID, KeeperUnsafeRoot))
	if err != nil {
		return KeeperRoots{}, err
	}
	out.Legacy = legacy
	scopedRoot := keeperRootPath(keeperShardID, KeeperScopedUnsafeRoot)
	tables, err := keeperChildren(ctx, conn, scopedRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return KeeperRoots{}, err
	}
	for _, table := range tables {
		tablePath := scopedRoot + "/" + table
		children, err := keeperChildren(ctx, conn, tablePath)
		if err != nil {
			return KeeperRoots{}, err
		}
		if slices.Contains(children, "replicas") {
			out.NonIncarnation = append(out.NonIncarnation, tablePath)
		}
		for _, child := range children {
			if seq, ok := canonicalIncarnationSeq(child); ok {
				out.Scoped = append(out.Scoped, ScopedKeeperPath{Table: table, IncarnationSeq: seq})
				continue
			}
			out.NonIncarnation = append(out.NonIncarnation, tablePath+"/"+child)
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(out.Scoped, func(i, j int) bool {
		if out.Scoped[i].Table != out.Scoped[j].Table {
			return out.Scoped[i].Table < out.Scoped[j].Table
		}
		return out.Scoped[i].IncarnationSeq < out.Scoped[j].IncarnationSeq
	})
	sort.Strings(out.NonIncarnation)
	return out, nil
}

// canonicalIncarnationSeq parses an incarnation path's last element: a
// decimal >= 1 without sign or leading zero ("007", "+5" and "0" are not one),
// the rule ParseIncarnationComment applies to markers.
func canonicalIncarnationSeq(name string) (uint64, bool) {
	seq, err := strconv.ParseUint(name, 10, 64)
	if err != nil || seq == 0 || strconv.FormatUint(seq, 10) != name {
		return 0, false
	}
	return seq, true
}
```

```go
// TestKnownKeeperReplicaCoversOwnerPoolMembersAndPurgeMembers: a replica on
// an owner's Keeper path is known when it is the owner's SNode, a node of the

func TestKnownKeeperReplicaCoversOwnerPoolMembersAndPurgeMembers(t *testing.T) {

	snap := TableRegistrySnapshot{
		Params: arbiter.TableRegistryParams{SIIndexerID: 0},
		SIIndexers: []arbiter.SIIndexerEntry{

			{OwnerIndexerID: 1, DatabaseID: "dex", Members: []GroupMember{{NodeID: "member-a"}},
				PastMembers: []string{"member-old"}, Leaving: []LeavingMember{{NodeID: "member-leaving"}}},
			{OwnerIndexerID: 1, DatabaseID: "nft", Members: []GroupMember{{NodeID: "member-nft"}}},
		},
	}
	inc := TableIncarnation{Seq: 4, DatabaseID: "dex", TableID: "swaps", OwnerIndexerID: &owner, ScopedKeeperPath: true,
		PurgeMembers: []string{"member-c"}}
	purgeNodeSet := []string{"snode-1", "snode-2", "verifier-1"}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		replica string
		want    bool
	}{
		{"snode-2", true},        // the owner's SNode
		{"verifier-1", true},     // a pool verifier (purge node set)
		{"snode-1", true},        // another registered SNode (purge node set)
		{"member-a", true},       // a current member of G(1, dex)
		{"member-old", true},     // a past member
		{"member-leaving", true}, // a Leaving member keeps its replicas until released
		{"member-c", true},       // a purge member of the incarnation
		{"member-x", false},      // a member of another owner's group of the same database
		{"member-nft", false},    // a member of another database's group
		{"intruder", false},
		{"", false},
	} {
		if got := snap.KnownKeeperReplica(inc, purgeNodeSet, tc.replica); got != tc.want {
			t.Errorf("KnownKeeperReplica(%q) = %v, want %v", tc.replica, got, tc.want)
		}
	}

	// Without a group or si_indexers (before placement and the signed-claims
	// activation) only the purge node set and the purge members are known; the
	// owner then is the founding indexer, and its SNode is a registered node.
	bare := TableRegistrySnapshot{}
	legacy := TableIncarnation{Seq: 1, DatabaseID: "dex", TableID: "swaps"}
	if !bare.KnownKeeperReplica(legacy, []string{"snode-1"}, "snode-1") || bare.KnownKeeperReplica(legacy, nil, "snode-1") {
		t.Fatal("a bare snapshot must know exactly the purge node set")
	}
	if !snap.KnownKeeperReplica(legacy, nil, "snode-1") || snap.KnownKeeperReplica(legacy, nil, "snode-2") {
		t.Fatal("an incarnation that names no owner belongs to the founding indexer, whose SNode is snode-1")
	}
	if !snap.KnownKeeperReplica(legacy, nil, "member-x") {
		t.Fatal("a member of the founding indexer's group is known on its incarnation's path")
	}
}
```

```go
func (s TableRegistrySnapshot) Owner(inc TableIncarnation) uint64 {
	if inc.OwnerIndexerID != nil {
		return *inc.OwnerIndexerID
	}
	return s.Params.SIIndexerID
}

// KnownKeeperReplica reports whether replica may hold a Keeper replica on the
// path of inc's hg_unsafe and hg_member_unsafe tables (housegate spec
// 2026-10-14 §8.2, §8.8): the owner's SNode, a node of purgeNodeSet (the
// arbiter's purge node set: every registered, non-evicted SNode and verifier,
// the network pool and registered members among them), a current or past
// member of the group G(Owner(inc), inc.DatabaseID) (a Leaving member, which
// keeps its replicas until its release, is a past member too), or a node of
// inc.PurgeMembers. The owner's Keeper audit reports every other replica.
func (s TableRegistrySnapshot) KnownKeeperReplica(inc TableIncarnation, purgeNodeSet []string, replica string) bool {
	if replica == "" {
		return false
	}
	owner := s.Owner(inc)
	if entry, ok := s.SIIndexer(owner); ok && entry.SNodeNodeID == replica {
		return true
	}
	if slices.Contains(purgeNodeSet, replica) || slices.Contains(inc.PurgeMembers, replica) {
		return true
	}
	group, ok := s.Group(owner, inc.DatabaseID)
	if !ok {
		return false
	}
	return slices.ContainsFunc(group.Members, func(m GroupMember) bool { return m.NodeID == replica }) ||
		slices.Contains(group.PastMembers, replica) ||
		slices.ContainsFunc(group.Leaving, func(l LeavingMember) bool { return l.NodeID == replica })
}
```

At `CORE_TAG_P4` Plan S3-C2's `ManifestOwner` follows `Owner`; `KnownKeeperReplica` goes between them.

```go
func TestKeeperScopeOfFollowsTheRegistryMark(t *testing.T) {
	legacy := wire.TableIncarnation{Seq: 4, DatabaseID: "db", TableID: "t"}
	scoped := legacy
	scoped.Seq, scoped.ScopedKeeperPath = 9, true
	if got := KeeperScopeOf(legacy); got != (ddl.KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 4}) {
		t.Fatalf("KeeperScopeOf(unscoped) = %+v", got)
	}
	if got := KeeperScopeOf(scoped); got != (ddl.KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 9, Scoped: true}) {
		t.Fatalf("KeeperScopeOf(scoped) = %+v", got)
	}
	if got := ddl.ZooKeeperPathFor(0, legacy.Key(), KeeperScopeOf(legacy)); got != "/sentio/0/unsafe/db__t" {
		t.Fatalf("unscoped path = %q", got)
	}
	if got := ddl.ZooKeeperPathFor(0, scoped.Key(), KeeperScopeOf(scoped)); got != "/sentio/0/unsafe_inc/db__t/9" {
		t.Fatalf("scoped path = %q", got)
	}
	genesis := target{inc: wire.TableIncarnation{Seq: 1, Origin: wire.TableOriginGenesis}}
	if got := genesis.scope(); got != (ddl.KeeperScope{}) {
		t.Fatalf("a genesis target's scope = %+v, want the unmarked legacy scope", got)
	}
	chain := target{inc: scoped, marker: scoped.Seq}
	if got := chain.scope(); got != KeeperScopeOf(scoped) {
		t.Fatalf("a chain target's scope = %+v, want %+v", got, KeeperScopeOf(scoped))
	}
}

// TestLeftoverScopesKeepTheLegacyDropForUnscopedLeftovers: leftovers of
// unscoped incarnations are dropped exactly as before (one legacy-path drop);
// a scoped leftover adds its own incarnation path.
func TestLeftoverScopesKeepTheLegacyDropForUnscopedLeftovers(t *testing.T) {
	snap := wire.TableRegistrySnapshot{Incarnations: []wire.TableIncarnation{
		{Seq: 1, DatabaseID: "db", TableID: "t", Origin: wire.TableOriginGenesis, Status: wire.TableStatusPurged},
		{Seq: 2, DatabaseID: "db", TableID: "t", Origin: wire.TableOriginChain, Status: wire.TableStatusPurged},
		{Seq: 3, DatabaseID: "db", TableID: "t", Origin: wire.TableOriginChain, Status: wire.TableStatusPurged, ScopedKeeperPath: true},
	}}
	legacy := []ddl.KeeperScope{{}}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		comments []string
		want     []ddl.KeeperScope
	}{
		{nil, legacy},
		{[]string{""}, legacy},
		{[]string{ddl.IncarnationComment(2), ddl.IncarnationComment(2), ""}, legacy},
		{[]string{ddl.IncarnationComment(3)}, []ddl.KeeperScope{{IncarnationSeq: 3, Scoped: true}}},
		{[]string{ddl.IncarnationComment(3), ddl.IncarnationComment(2)}, []ddl.KeeperScope{{IncarnationSeq: 3, Scoped: true}, {}}},
		{[]string{ddl.IncarnationComment(8)}, legacy},
	} {
		if got := leftoverScopes(snap, tc.comments); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, tc.want) {
			t.Fatalf("leftoverScopes(%q) = %+v, want %+v", tc.comments, got, tc.want)
		}
```

Create `dataplane/tableset/keeper_scope_ch_test.go`:

```go
package tableset

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha1"
	"encoding/binary"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"sort"
	"testing"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/lthash"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/payloadexec"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/ddl"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// isolatedShard is a Keeper shard of the test's own. The ddl, tableset, snode
// and verifier targets share one Keeper in CI, and these tests create
// incarnation paths and read whole roots, so they never use shard 0.
func isolatedShard(t *testing.T) uint32 {
	t.Helper()
	sum := sha1.Sum([]byte("keeper-shard/" + t.Name()))
	return 1_000_000 + binary.BigEndian.Uint32(sum[:4])%1_000_000
}

// isolatedPinned is testPinned on the test's own Keeper shard.
func isolatedPinned(t *testing.T, conns ...clickhouse.Conn) ddl.Pinned {
	t.Helper()
	p := testPinned(t, conns...)
	p.KeeperShardID = isolatedShard(t)
	return p
}

// scopedInc is chainInc for an incarnation the registry marks
// scoped_keeper_path.
func scopedInc(t *testing.T, seq uint64, schema payloadexec.TableSchema, st wire.TableIncarnationStatus) wire.TableIncarnation {
	t.Helper()
	inc := chainInc(t, seq, schema, st)
	inc.ScopedKeeperPath = true
	return inc
}

// setSnap installs snap (its Version bumped, Seeded) as the next version.
func (v *fakeView) setSnap(snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot) {
	v.mu.Lock()
	defer v.mu.Unlock()
	snap.Version = v.snap.Version + 1
	snap.Seeded = true
	v.snap = snap
	v.enabled = true
	close(v.changed)
	v.changed = make(chan struct{})
}

// peer is another node's Pinned on the second server: p's databases with a
// suffix, and node id name; its databases are dropped when the test ends.
func peer(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn, p ddl.Pinned, name string) ddl.Pinned {
	t.Helper()
	q := p
	tag := "_" + fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha1.Sum([]byte(name)))[:6]
	q.UnsafeDB, q.SafeDB, q.PromoteDB, q.NodeID = p.UnsafeDB+tag, p.SafeDB+tag, p.PromoteDB+tag, name
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		for _, db := range []string{q.UnsafeDB, q.SafeDB, q.PromoteDB} {
			_ = conn.Exec(context.Background(), "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS "+db+" SYNC")
		}
	})
	return q
}

// replicaOf creates q's tables of schema in scope s on conn: an attached,
// active replica on that path. With detach the hg_unsafe table is detached,
// the inactive replica a dead or evicted node leaves behind.
func replicaOf(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn, q ddl.Pinned, schema payloadexec.TableSchema, s ddl.KeeperScope, detach bool) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx := context.Background()
	if err := ddl.EnsureTableFor(ctx, conn, q, schema, s, ddl.ModeCreateAndVerify); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if detach {
		if err := conn.Exec(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("DETACH TABLE %s.%s", q.UnsafeDB, ddl.CHTableName(schema.TableID))); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
}

func replicasAt(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn, p ddl.Pinned, tableID string, s ddl.KeeperScope) []string {
	t.Helper()
	replicas, err := ddl.KeeperReplicasAt(context.Background(), conn, p.KeeperShardID, tableID, s)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return replicas
}

func keeperRoots(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn, p ddl.Pinned) ddl.KeeperRoots {
	t.Helper()
	roots, err := ddl.ListKeeperRoots(context.Background(), conn, p.KeeperShardID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return roots
}

func hasScoped(roots ddl.KeeperRoots, tableID string, seq uint64) bool {
	return slices.Contains(roots.Scoped, ddl.ScopedKeeperPath{Table: ddl.CHTableName(tableID), IncarnationSeq: seq})
}

// insertUnsafe inserts n rows into q's hg_unsafe table of schema (whose
// columns are schemaFor's p and v, plus any String extra).
func insertUnsafe(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn, q ddl.Pinned, schema payloadexec.TableSchema, n int) {
	t.Helper()
	cols, values := "`_hg_row_id`, `p`, `v`", "toFixedString(hex(MD5(toString(rand64()))), 32), 'a', number"
	for _, c := range schema.Columns[2:] {
		cols, values = cols+", `"+c.Name+"`", values+", ''"
	}
	sql := fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s.%s (%s) SELECT %s FROM numbers(%d)", q.UnsafeDB, ddl.CHTableName(schema.TableID), cols, values, n)
	if err := conn.Exec(context.Background(), sql); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func unsafeRows(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn, q ddl.Pinned, schema payloadexec.TableSchema) uint64 {
	t.Helper()
	var n uint64
	if err := conn.QueryRow(context.Background(), fmt.Sprintf("SELECT count() FROM %s.%s", q.UnsafeDB, ddl.CHTableName(schema.TableID))).Scan(&n); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return n
}

func syncReplica(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn, q ddl.Pinned, schema payloadexec.TableSchema) {
	t.Helper()
	if err := conn.Exec(context.Background(), fmt.Sprintf("SYSTEM SYNC REPLICA %s.%s", q.UnsafeDB, ddl.CHTableName(schema.TableID))); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func TestReconcilerCreatesAScopedIncarnationOnItsIncarnationPath(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	conn := requireCH(t)
	p := isolatedPinned(t, conn)
	view, arb := newFakeView(), &fakeArbiter{}
	r := newReconciler(t, conn, p, view, arb, nil)
	scoped, legacy := schemaFor(t, "scoped"), schemaFor(t, "legacy")
	view.set(chainInc(t, 1, legacy, wire.TableStatusActive), scopedInc(t, 3, scoped, wire.TableStatusPending))
	mustReconcile(t, r)
	if !r.Ready(scoped.TableID) || !r.Ready(legacy.TableID) {
		t.Fatalf("not ready: %+v", r.Stats())
	}
	scope := ddl.KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 3, Scoped: true}
	if got := replicasAt(t, conn, p, scoped.TableID, scope); !slices.Equal(got, []string{p.NodeID}) {
		t.Fatalf("incarnation-path replicas = %v, want only %s", got, p.NodeID)
	}
	var zk string
	if err := conn.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT zookeeper_path FROM system.replicas WHERE database = ? AND table = ?`, p.UnsafeDB, ddl.CHTableName(scoped.TableID)).Scan(&zk); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if want := ddl.ZooKeeperPathFor(p.KeeperShardID, scoped.TableID, scope); zk != want {
		t.Fatalf("zookeeper_path = %q, want %q", zk, want)
	}
	roots := keeperRoots(t, conn, p)
	if !slices.Equal(roots.Legacy, []string{ddl.CHTableName(legacy.TableID)}) || !hasScoped(roots, scoped.TableID, 3) || len(roots.Scoped) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("roots = %+v; want the legacy table on the legacy root and the scoped one at its incarnation path only", roots)
	}
	for db, c := range localComments(t, conn, p, scoped.TableID) {
		if c != "hg_incarnation=3" {
			t.Fatalf("%s comment = %q", db, c)
		}
	}
	view.set(chainInc(t, 1, legacy, wire.TableStatusActive), scopedInc(t, 3, scoped, wire.TableStatusActive))
	mustReconcile(t, r)
	if !r.Ready(scoped.TableID) || r.Stats().States[StateReady] != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("the scoped table must verify on its incarnation path: %+v", r.Stats())
	}
}

func TestReconcilerPurgesAndSweepsBothPathKinds(t *testing.T) {
	conn := requireCH(t)
	replicaConn := requireReplicaCH(t)
	p := isolatedPinned(t, conn, replicaConn)
	view, arb := newFakeView(), &fakeArbiter{}
	source := newReconciler(t, conn, p, view, arb, func(c *Config, _ *Deps) { c.SweepDecommissioned = true })
	legacy, scoped := schemaFor(t, "legacy"), schemaFor(t, "scoped")
	legacyScope, scopedScope := ddl.KeeperScope{}, ddl.KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 2, Scoped: true}
	view.set(chainInc(t, 1, legacy, wire.TableStatusActive), scopedInc(t, 2, scoped, wire.TableStatusActive))
	mustReconcile(t, source)
	// On each path, verifier-live is a current node that has not purged yet;
	// verifier-gone is decommissioned (detached).
	live, gone := peer(t, replicaConn, p, "verifier-live"), peer(t, replicaConn, p, "verifier-gone")
	for _, q := range []ddl.Pinned{live, gone} {
		replicaOf(t, replicaConn, q, legacy, ddl.KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 1}, q.NodeID == gone.NodeID)
		replicaOf(t, replicaConn, q, scoped, scopedScope, q.NodeID == gone.NodeID)
	}
	arb.nodeSet = []string{p.NodeID, "verifier-live"}
	view.set(chainInc(t, 1, legacy, wire.TableStatusPurging), scopedInc(t, 2, scoped, wire.TableStatusPurging))
	mustReconcile(t, source)
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		schema payloadexec.TableSchema
		scope  ddl.KeeperScope
	}{{legacy, legacyScope}, {scoped, scopedScope}} {
		if got := replicasAt(t, conn, p, tc.schema.TableID, tc.scope); !slices.Equal(got, []string{"verifier-live"}) {
			t.Fatalf("%s replicas = %v; want only the current verifier-live", tc.schema.TableID, got)
		}
		if left := localComments(t, conn, p, tc.schema.TableID); len(left) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("%s tables left: %v", tc.schema.TableID, left)
		}
	}
	if got := arb.reported(); !slices.Equal(got, []string{p.NodeID + "/1", p.NodeID + "/2"}) {
		t.Fatalf("reports = %v", got)
	}
	// verifier-live purges its own tables: each last replica removes its path.
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		schema payloadexec.TableSchema
		scope  ddl.KeeperScope
	}{{legacy, legacyScope}, {scoped, scopedScope}} {
		if err := ddl.DropTableFor(context.Background(), replicaConn, live, tc.schema.TableID, tc.scope); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	roots := keeperRoots(t, conn, p)
	if slices.Contains(roots.Legacy, ddl.CHTableName(legacy.TableID)) || hasScoped(roots, scoped.TableID, 2) {
		t.Fatalf("roots = %+v; both paths must be gone once every current node dropped", roots)
	}
}

func TestClearDecommissionedCoversTheScopedRoot(t *testing.T) {
	conn := requireCH(t)
	replicaConn := requireReplicaCH(t)
	p := isolatedPinned(t, conn, replicaConn)
	v := p
	v.NodeID = "verifier-" + suffix(t)
	s := schemaFor(t, "t")
	scope := ddl.KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 2, Scoped: true}
	// An evicted node's replica of incarnation 2 on its incarnation path, and
	// an evicted node's replica of incarnation 1 on the legacy path.
	replicaOf(t, replicaConn, peer(t, replicaConn, p, "verifier-gone"), s, scope, true)
	replicaOf(t, replicaConn, peer(t, replicaConn, p, "verifier-gone-legacy"), s, ddl.KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 1}, true)
	view, arb := newFakeView(), &fakeArbiter{nodeSet: []string{p.NodeID, v.NodeID}}
	view.set(chainInc(t, 1, s, wire.TableStatusPurged), scopedInc(t, 2, s, wire.TableStatusPending))
	verifier := newReconciler(t, replicaConn, v, view, arb, nil)
	source := newReconciler(t, conn, p, view, arb, func(c *Config, _ *Deps) { c.SweepDecommissioned = true })

	mustReconcile(t, verifier)
	if verifier.Ready(s.TableID) || len(localComments(t, replicaConn, v, s.TableID)) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("a non-source node must not create over a decommissioned replica on the incarnation path")
	}
	if st := verifier.Stats(); st.Failures[s.TableID] != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("the refusal is a per-table failure: %+v", st)
	}
	if got := replicasAt(t, conn, p, s.TableID, scope); !slices.Equal(got, []string{"verifier-gone"}) {
		t.Fatalf("incarnation-path replicas = %v; a non-source node must not remove a replica", got)
	}

	mustReconcile(t, source)
	if !source.Ready(s.TableID) {
		t.Fatalf("the source must remove the decommissioned replica and create: %+v", source.Stats())
	}
	if got := replicasAt(t, conn, p, s.TableID, scope); !slices.Equal(got, []string{p.NodeID}) {
		t.Fatalf("incarnation-path replicas = %v; want only the source", got)
	}
	// The live incarnation is scoped, so the legacy path holds only a retired
	// incarnation's replicas: the source's sweep removes the evicted one there
	// too, without touching its own tables.
	if got := replicasAt(t, conn, p, s.TableID, ddl.KeeperScope{}); len(got) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("legacy replicas = %v; the source's sweep must remove the evicted replica", got)
	}

	verifier.Trigger()
	mustReconcile(t, verifier)
	if !verifier.Ready(s.TableID) {
		t.Fatalf("the verifier creates once the source removed the replica: %+v", verifier.Stats())
	}
	want := []string{p.NodeID, v.NodeID}
	sort.Strings(want)
	if got := replicasAt(t, conn, p, s.TableID, scope); !slices.Equal(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("incarnation-path replicas = %v, want %v", got, want)
	}
}

func TestSweepPurgedKeeperPathsCoversBothRoots(t *testing.T) {
	conn := requireCH(t)
	replicaConn := requireReplicaCH(t)
	p := isolatedPinned(t, conn, replicaConn)
	gone := peer(t, replicaConn, p, "verifier-gone")
	legacy, scoped, recreated := schemaFor(t, "legacy"), schemaFor(t, "scoped"), schemaFor(t, "recreated")
	// Three paths that survived their purge because verifier-gone was
	// evicted after the source's sweep: a legacy path, an incarnation path,
	// and the incarnation path of a key re-created since (incarnation 4).
	replicaOf(t, replicaConn, gone, legacy, ddl.KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 1}, true)
	replicaOf(t, replicaConn, gone, scoped, ddl.KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 2, Scoped: true}, true)
	replicaOf(t, replicaConn, gone, recreated, ddl.KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 3, Scoped: true}, true)
	v := peer(t, replicaConn, p, "verifier-"+suffix(t))
	view, arb := newFakeView(), &fakeArbiter{nodeSet: []string{p.NodeID, v.NodeID}}
	view.set(chainInc(t, 1, legacy, wire.TableStatusPurged), scopedInc(t, 2, scoped, wire.TableStatusPurged),
		scopedInc(t, 3, recreated, wire.TableStatusPurged), scopedInc(t, 4, recreated, wire.TableStatusActive))
	source := newReconciler(t, conn, p, view, arb, func(c *Config, _ *Deps) { c.SweepDecommissioned = true })
	verifier := newReconciler(t, replicaConn, v, view, arb, nil)

	mustReconcile(t, verifier)
	if roots := keeperRoots(t, conn, p); !slices.Contains(roots.Legacy, ddl.CHTableName(legacy.TableID)) || !hasScoped(roots, scoped.TableID, 2) || !hasScoped(roots, recreated.TableID, 3) {
		t.Fatalf("roots = %+v; only the source sweeps", roots)
	}
	mustReconcile(t, source)
	roots := keeperRoots(t, conn, p)
	if slices.Contains(roots.Legacy, ddl.CHTableName(legacy.TableID)) {
		t.Fatalf("legacy roots = %v; the surviving legacy path must be swept", roots.Legacy)
	}
	if hasScoped(roots, scoped.TableID, 2) || hasScoped(roots, recreated.TableID, 3) {
		t.Fatalf("scoped roots = %v; the surviving incarnation paths must be swept", roots.Scoped)
	}
	if !hasScoped(roots, recreated.TableID, 4) || !source.Ready(recreated.TableID) {
		t.Fatalf("the re-created key's live incarnation must stay: roots %v, stats %+v", roots.Scoped, source.Stats())
	}
	if c := localComments(t, conn, p, recreated.TableID); len(c) != 3 || c[p.UnsafeDB] != "hg_incarnation=4" {
		t.Fatalf("the live incarnation's tables = %v", c)
	}
	if got := arb.reported(); len(got) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("a sweep reports nothing: %v", got)
	}
}

func TestSameNameRecreateAfterAPurgeOnBothPathKinds(t *testing.T) {
	for _, kind := range []struct {
		name   string
		scoped bool
	}{{"legacy", false}, {"scoped", true}} {
		t.Run(kind.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			conn := requireCH(t)
			replicaConn := requireReplicaCH(t)
			p := isolatedPinned(t, conn, replicaConn)
			incOf := func(seq uint64, schema payloadexec.TableSchema, st wire.TableIncarnationStatus) wire.TableIncarnation {
				inc := chainInc(t, seq, schema, st)
				inc.ScopedKeeperPath = kind.scoped
				return inc
			}
			view, arb := newFakeView(), &fakeArbiter{}
			source := newReconciler(t, conn, p, view, arb, func(c *Config, _ *Deps) { c.SweepDecommissioned = true })
			s := schemaFor(t, "t")
			first := incOf(1, s, wire.TableStatusActive)
			view.set(first)
			mustReconcile(t, source)
			// A member holds a replica of incarnation 1 and its rows, then dies:
			// its table is detached and its Keeper replica stays.
			member := peer(t, replicaConn, p, "member-dead")
			replicaOf(t, replicaConn, member, s, KeeperScopeOf(first), false)
			insertUnsafe(t, conn, p, s, 3)
			syncReplica(t, replicaConn, member, s)
			if n := unsafeRows(t, replicaConn, member, s); n != 3 {
				t.Fatalf("member rows = %d, want 3", n)
			}
			if err := replicaConn.Exec(context.Background(), fmt.Sprintf("DETACH TABLE %s.%s", member.UnsafeDB, ddl.CHTableName(s.TableID))); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			// The purge runs while the dead member is still registered: the
			// owner drops its own replica, keeps the member's and reports.
			arb.nodeSet = []string{p.NodeID, "member-dead"}
			view.set(incOf(1, s, wire.TableStatusPurging))
			mustReconcile(t, source)
			if got := replicasAt(t, conn, p, s.TableID, KeeperScopeOf(first)); !slices.Equal(got, []string{"member-dead"}) {
				t.Fatalf("replicas after the owner's purge = %v, want only the dead member's", got)
			}
			if got := arb.reported(); !slices.Equal(got, []string{p.NodeID + "/1"}) {
				t.Fatalf("reports = %v", got)
			}
			// EvictNode completes the purge; the name is re-created with a new
			// structure.
			arb.nodeSet = []string{p.NodeID}
			again := schemaFor(t, "t", lthash.Column{Name: "w", Type: "String"})
			second := incOf(2, again, wire.TableStatusPending)
			view.set(incOf(1, s, wire.TableStatusPurged), second)
			mustReconcile(t, source)
			if !source.Ready(again.TableID) {
				t.Fatalf("the re-created incarnation must be created: %+v", source.Stats())
			}
			if got := replicasAt(t, conn, p, again.TableID, KeeperScopeOf(second)); !slices.Equal(got, []string{p.NodeID}) {
				t.Fatalf("re-created replicas = %v, want only the owner", got)
			}
			if got := replicasAt(t, conn, p, s.TableID, KeeperScopeOf(first)); slices.Contains(got, "member-dead") || (kind.scoped && len(got) != 0) {
				t.Fatalf("incarnation 1's path still holds %v; the owner must remove the evicted member's replica", got)
			}
			if n := unsafeRows(t, conn, p, again); n != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("the re-created table holds %d rows of the purged incarnation", n)
			}
			insertUnsafe(t, conn, p, again, 1)
			if n := unsafeRows(t, conn, p, again); n != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("re-created rows = %d, want 1", n)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestScopedRecreateSurvivesDroppingTheStaleLastUnscopedReplica(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	conn := requireCH(t)
	replicaConn := requireReplicaCH(t)
	p := isolatedPinned(t, conn, replicaConn)
	view, arb := newFakeView(), &fakeArbiter{}
	source := newReconciler(t, conn, p, view, arb, func(c *Config, _ *Deps) { c.SweepDecommissioned = true })
	s := schemaFor(t, "t")
	view.set(chainInc(t, 1, s, wire.TableStatusActive))
	mustReconcile(t, source)
	// verifier-gone's replica of incarnation 1, left inactive by a node that
	// died before the purge and stays registered through it.
	replicaOf(t, replicaConn, peer(t, replicaConn, p, "verifier-gone"), s, ddl.KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 1}, true)
	arb.nodeSet = []string{p.NodeID, "verifier-gone"}
	view.set(chainInc(t, 1, s, wire.TableStatusPurging))
	mustReconcile(t, source)
	legacyPath := ddl.ZooKeeperPathFor(p.KeeperShardID, s.TableID, ddl.KeeperScope{})
	if got := replicasAt(t, conn, p, s.TableID, ddl.KeeperScope{}); !slices.Equal(got, []string{"verifier-gone"}) {
		t.Fatalf("%s replicas = %v, want only the stale verifier-gone", legacyPath, got)
	}
	// The scoped re-create while the stale replica is the last one on the
	// legacy path: nothing waits for it.
	scope := ddl.KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 2, Scoped: true}
	view.set(chainInc(t, 1, s, wire.TableStatusPurged), scopedInc(t, 2, s, wire.TableStatusActive))
	mustReconcile(t, source)
	if !source.Ready(s.TableID) {
		t.Fatalf("the scoped re-create must not wait for the stale legacy replica: %+v", source.Stats())
	}
	insertUnsafe(t, conn, p, s, 5)
	if got := replicasAt(t, conn, p, s.TableID, ddl.KeeperScope{}); !slices.Equal(got, []string{"verifier-gone"}) {
		t.Fatalf("legacy replicas = %v; a registered node's replica is not swept", got)
	}
	// verifier-gone is evicted: the owner's sweep drops the stale last
	// replica, which removes the legacy path and every child of it.
	arb.nodeSet = []string{p.NodeID}
	source.Trigger()
	mustReconcile(t, source)
	if roots := keeperRoots(t, conn, p); slices.Contains(roots.Legacy, ddl.CHTableName(s.TableID)) || !hasScoped(roots, s.TableID, 2) {
		t.Fatalf("roots = %+v; want the legacy path gone and the incarnation path kept", roots)
	}
	if got := replicasAt(t, conn, p, s.TableID, scope); !slices.Equal(got, []string{p.NodeID}) {
		t.Fatalf("incarnation-path replicas = %v, want only the owner", got)
	}
	var zk string
	var readonly uint8
	if err := conn.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT zookeeper_path, is_readonly FROM system.replicas WHERE database = ? AND table = ?`, p.UnsafeDB, ddl.CHTableName(s.TableID)).Scan(&zk, &readonly); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if zk != ddl.ZooKeeperPathFor(p.KeeperShardID, s.TableID, scope) || readonly != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("replica at %q readonly %d; want a writable replica at its incarnation path", zk, readonly)
	}
	if n := unsafeRows(t, conn, p, s); n != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("rows = %d, want the 5 written before the drop", n)
	}
	insertUnsafe(t, conn, p, s, 2)
	if n := unsafeRows(t, conn, p, s); n != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("rows = %d, want 7 after a write that follows the drop", n)
	}
	mustReconcile(t, source)
	if !source.Ready(s.TableID) {
		t.Fatalf("the scoped table must still verify: %+v", source.Stats())
	}
}
```

```go
type target struct {
	inc    wire.TableIncarnation
	schema payloadexec.TableSchema
	mode   ddl.Mode
	marker uint64
}

// scope is the Keeper scope t's tables are created in: inc's path
// (KeeperScopeOf) with t.marker as the incarnation the tables carry, 0 for a
// genesis table, which is unmarked and never scoped.
func (t target) scope() ddl.KeeperScope {
	return ddl.KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: t.marker, Scoped: t.inc.ScopedKeeperPath}
}

// KeeperScopeOf is the Keeper scope of inc's hg_unsafe and hg_member_unsafe
// replicas: the incarnation path when the registry marks inc
// scoped_keeper_path, else the legacy path (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §8.8).
func KeeperScopeOf(inc wire.TableIncarnation) ddl.KeeperScope {
	return ddl.KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: inc.Seq, Scoped: inc.ScopedKeeperPath}
}
```

In `dataplane/tableset/reconciler.go`, replace `sweepPurgedKeeperPaths` and the head of `dropLeftover` (`:815-844`):

```go
// sweepPurgedKeeperPaths catches a Keeper path that survived its purge
// because a node was evicted after this node's sweep: for every key whose
// live incarnation has no tables but whose path still exists, drop this
// node's own stranded replica and sweep the rest. skip names the physical
// tables it must leave alone: the desired ones and retired ones whose local
// tables carry an unattributable marker.
func (r *Reconciler) sweepPurgedKeeperPaths(ctx context.Context, history map[string][]string, skip map[string]bool) {
	paths, err := ddl.KeeperUnsafeTables(ctx, r.d.Conn, r.cfg.Pinned)
	if err != nil {
		r.d.Logger.Warn("list keeper table paths", "err", err)
		return
	}
	for _, physical := range paths {
		keys, ok := history[physical]
		if !ok || skip[physical] {
			continue
		}
		key := keys[0]
		if err := ddl.DropTable(ctx, r.d.Conn, r.cfg.Pinned, key); err != nil {
			r.d.Logger.Warn("drop stranded replica", "table", key, "err", err)
			continue
		}
		if err := r.sweep(ctx, key); err != nil {
			r.d.Logger.Warn("sweep surviving keeper path", "table", key, "err", err)
		}
	}
}

func (r *Reconciler) dropLeftover(ctx context.Context, key string) {
	if err := ddl.DropTable(ctx, r.d.Conn, r.cfg.Pinned, key); err != nil {
```

with:

```go
// sweepPurgedKeeperPaths catches a Keeper path that survived its purge
// because a node was evicted after this node's sweep, on both roots
// (ddl.ListKeeperRoots; housegate spec 2026-10-14 §8.8):
//   - a legacy path of a key whose live incarnation has no tables: drop this
//     node's own stranded replica (with any leftover local table, as
//     ddl.DropTable does) and sweep the rest. skip names the physical tables
//     it must leave alone: the desired ones and retired ones whose local
//     tables carry an unattributable marker;
//   - a legacy path of a key whose live incarnation replicates on its
//     incarnation path (scopedLive): only retired incarnations used that
//     path, so its replicas are swept the same way, without touching the live
//     incarnation's local tables (sweepRetiredPath);
//   - the incarnation path of a Purged or Refused incarnation this node owns,
//     whatever the key's live incarnation, because no other incarnation
//     shares it (sweepRetiredPath), unless its physical name has local tables
//     with an unattributable marker.
//
// A path that is no incarnation path of this node's is left alone; the
// Keeper audit reports the ones that are no incarnation path at all.
func (r *Reconciler) sweepPurgedKeeperPaths(ctx context.Context, snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, history map[string][]string, skip, unattributable map[string]bool, scopedLive map[string]string) {
	roots, err := ddl.ListKeeperRoots(ctx, r.d.Conn, r.cfg.Pinned.KeeperShardID)
	if err != nil {
		r.d.Logger.Warn("list keeper table paths", "err", err)
		return
	}
	for _, physical := range roots.Legacy {
		if keys, ok := history[physical]; ok && !skip[physical] {
			key := keys[0]
			if err := ddl.DropTable(ctx, r.d.Conn, r.cfg.Pinned, key); err != nil {
				r.d.Logger.Warn("drop stranded replica", "table", key, "err", err)
				continue
			}
			if err := r.sweep(ctx, key, ddl.KeeperScope{}); err != nil {
				r.d.Logger.Warn("sweep surviving keeper path", "table", key, "err", err)
			}
			continue
		}
		if key, ok := scopedLive[physical]; ok {
			r.sweepRetiredPath(ctx, key, ddl.KeeperScope{})
		}
	}
	for _, path := range roots.Scoped {
		inc := incarnation(snap, path.IncarnationSeq)
		if inc == nil || !inc.ScopedKeeperPath || ddl.CHTableName(inc.Key()) != path.Table || !r.owns(snap, *inc) {
			continue
		}
		if inc.Status != wire.TableStatusPurged && inc.Status != wire.TableStatusRefused {
			continue
		}
		if unattributable[path.Table] {
			continue
		}
		r.sweepRetiredPath(ctx, inc.Key(), KeeperScopeOf(*inc))
	}
}

// sweepRetiredPath empties key's Keeper path in scope s, which no live
// incarnation uses: it removes this node's own stranded replica (ClickHouse
// refuses an active one) and sweeps every replica outside the arbiter's purge
// node set. It never drops a local table.
func (r *Reconciler) sweepRetiredPath(ctx context.Context, key string, s ddl.KeeperScope) {
	shard := r.cfg.Pinned.KeeperShardID
	replicas, err := ddl.KeeperReplicasAt(ctx, r.d.Conn, shard, key, s)
	if err != nil {
		r.d.Logger.Warn("sweep surviving keeper path", "table", key, "path", ddl.ZooKeeperPathFor(shard, key, s), "err", err)
		return
	}
	if slices.Contains(replicas, r.cfg.Pinned.NodeID) {
		if err := ddl.DropReplicaAt(ctx, r.d.Conn, shard, key, s, r.cfg.Pinned.NodeID); err != nil {
			r.d.Logger.Warn("drop stranded replica", "table", key, "path", ddl.ZooKeeperPathFor(shard, key, s), "err", err)
			return
		}
	}
	if err := r.sweep(ctx, key, s); err != nil {
		r.d.Logger.Warn("sweep surviving keeper path", "table", key, "path", ddl.ZooKeeperPathFor(shard, key, s), "err", err)
	}
}

// dropTables drops key's local tables and this node's stranded replica on
// the path of each scope (the first call drops the tables; each later one
// finds none and checks its own path).
func (r *Reconciler) dropTables(ctx context.Context, key string, scopes []ddl.KeeperScope) error {
	for _, scope := range scopes {
		if err := ddl.DropTableFor(ctx, r.d.Conn, r.cfg.Pinned, key, scope); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// leftoverScopes returns the Keeper scopes of the earlier incarnations whose
// local tables carry comments, in order and without duplicates: a marker
// names its incarnation, and an unmarked table is the genesis incarnation's,
// which is never scoped. It is the legacy scope alone when none is scoped,
// so an unscoped leftover is dropped exactly as before.
func leftoverScopes(snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, comments []string) []ddl.KeeperScope {
	var out []ddl.KeeperScope
	for _, comment := range comments {
		scope := ddl.KeeperScope{}
		if seq, ok := ddl.ParseIncarnationComment(comment); ok {
			if inc := incarnation(snap, seq); inc != nil && inc.ScopedKeeperPath {
				scope = KeeperScopeOf(*inc)
			}
		}
		if !slices.Contains(out, scope) {
			out = append(out, scope)
		}
	}
	if len(out) == 0 {
		out = []ddl.KeeperScope{{}}
	}
	return out
}

func (r *Reconciler) dropLeftover(ctx context.Context, snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, key string, comments []string) {
	if err := r.dropTables(ctx, key, leftoverScopes(snap, comments)); err != nil {
```
