```go
// groupSnapshot is an enabled registry snapshot with the purge switch as
// given, the incarnations, and one group G(0, dex) whose members are given.
func groupSnapshot(purge bool, members []string, leaving []wire.LeavingMember, incs ...wire.TableIncarnation) wire.TableRegistrySnapshot {
	snap := wire.TableRegistrySnapshot{Version: 1, Incarnations: incs,
		Stage3: &arbiter.Stage3Params{GroupSize: 3, MinSafeCopies: 1, Purge: purge, Placement: true}}
	if members != nil || leaving != nil {
		g := wire.DatabaseGroup{OwnerIndexerID: testOwner, DatabaseID: "dex", Generation: 1, Leaving: leaving}
		for _, m := range members {
			g.Members = append(g.Members, wire.GroupMember{NodeID: m, JoinedGeneration: 1})
		}
		snap.Groups = []wire.DatabaseGroup{g}
	}
	return snap
}

// viewFake is a registry view whose snapshot a test sets.
type viewFake struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	snap    wire.TableRegistrySnapshot
	enabled bool
	changed chan struct{}
}

func newViewFake(snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot) *viewFake {
	return &viewFake{snap: snap, enabled: true, changed: make(chan struct{})}
}

func (v *viewFake) View() (wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, bool) {
	v.mu.Lock()
	defer v.mu.Unlock()
	return v.snap, v.enabled
}

func (v *viewFake) Changed() <-chan struct{} {
	v.mu.Lock()
	defer v.mu.Unlock()
	return v.changed
}

func (v *viewFake) Ready() <-chan struct{} {
	ch := make(chan struct{})
	close(ch)
	return ch
}

func (v *viewFake) set(snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot) {
	v.mu.Lock()
	defer v.mu.Unlock()
	v.snap = snap
	close(v.changed)
	v.changed = make(chan struct{})
}

// arbiterFake is the reconciler's tableset.Arbiter: PurgeNodeSet answers
// nodes; a purge report is a test failure (the reconciler never reports).
type arbiterFake struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	nodes   []string
	err     error
	calls   int
	reports int
}

func (a *arbiterFake) PurgeNodeSet(context.Context) ([]string, error) {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	a.calls++
	return slices.Clone(a.nodes), a.err
}

func (a *arbiterFake) SubmitTablePurged(context.Context, string, uint64) error {
	a.mu.Lock()
	defer a.mu.Unlock()
	a.reports++
	return errors.New("test: the reconciler must never report a purge")
}

// chTable is one table of the fake server.
type chTable struct {
	database, name, comment, engine, engineFull, sortingKey, partitionKey string
	zkPath, replica                                                       string
	columns                                                               []lthash.Column
}

// chFake is a clickhouse.Conn that keeps the tables of hg_member_unsafe:
// it answers the reconciler's DDL and system.tables listing, the queries of
// ddl.VerifyProtocolTable and the byte-side scan query, and records every
// statement. createErr makes the CREATE of one table name fail. Any other
// method panics (nil embedded Conn).
type chFake struct {
	clickhouse.Conn
	mu        sync.Mutex
	tables    map[string]*chTable // by database.name
	statement []string
	createErr map[string]error
	scanRows  map[string][][]any // by qualified table, rows of the scan query
	scanQuery []string
}

func newCHFake() *chFake {
	return &chFake{tables: map[string]*chTable{}, createErr: map[string]error{}, scanRows: map[string][][]any{}}
}

var (
	createTablePattern = regexp.MustCompile("(?s)^CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `([^`]+)`\\.`([^`]+)` \\(.*\\) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree\\('([^']*)', '([^']*)'\\).*COMMENT '([^']*)'$")
	dropTablePattern   = regexp.MustCompile("^DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `([^`]+)`\\.`([^`]+)` SYNC$")
)

func (c *chFake) Exec(_ context.Context, query string, _ ...any) error {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.statement = append(c.statement, query)
	switch {
	case query == "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS `hg_member_unsafe`":
		return nil
	case createTablePattern.MatchString(query):
		m := createTablePattern.FindStringSubmatch(query)
		if err := c.createErr[m[2]]; err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, ok := c.tables[m[1]+"."+m[2]]; ok {
			return nil // IF NOT EXISTS
		}
		c.tables[m[1]+"."+m[2]] = &chTable{database: m[1], name: m[2], comment: m[5], engine: ddl.EngineReplicatedMergeTree,
			engineFull: fmt.Sprintf("ReplicatedMergeTree('%s', '%s') ORDER BY _hg_row_id SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192", m[3], m[4]),
			zkPath:     m[3], replica: m[4]}
		return nil
	case dropTablePattern.MatchString(query):
		m := dropTablePattern.FindStringSubmatch(query)
		delete(c.tables, m[1]+"."+m[2])
		return nil
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("chFake: unexpected statement %q", query)
}

func (c *chFake) Query(_ context.Context, query string, args ...any) (driver.Rows, error) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.statement = append(c.statement, query)
	switch {
	case strings.HasPrefix(query, "SELECT name, comment, engine_full FROM system.tables WHERE database = ?"):
		var rows [][]any
		for _, t := range c.sortedLocked(args[0].(string)) {
			rows = append(rows, []any{t.name, t.comment, t.engineFull})
		}
		return &rowsFake{rows: rows}, nil
	case strings.HasPrefix(query, "SELECT name, type FROM system.columns"):
		t, ok := c.tables[args[0].(string)+"."+args[1].(string)]
		var rows [][]any
		if ok {
			for _, col := range t.columns {
				rows = append(rows, []any{col.Name, col.Type})
			}
		}
		return &rowsFake{rows: rows}, nil
	case strings.HasPrefix(query, "SELECT _part, _hg_row_id"):
		c.scanQuery = append(c.scanQuery, query)
		for qualified, rows := range c.scanRows {
			if strings.Contains(query, " FROM "+qualified+" WHERE _part IN (") {
				return &rowsFake{rows: rows}, nil
			}
		}
		return &rowsFake{}, nil
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("chFake: unexpected query %q", query)
}

func (c *chFake) QueryRow(_ context.Context, query string, args ...any) driver.Row {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.statement = append(c.statement, query)
	switch {
	case strings.Contains(query, "SELECT engine, engine_full, sorting_key, partition_key, comment"):
		t, ok := c.tables[args[0].(string)+"."+args[1].(string)]
		if !ok {
			return rowFake{err: sql.ErrNoRows}
		}
		return rowFake{values: []any{t.engine, t.engineFull, t.sortingKey, t.partitionKey, t.comment}}
	case strings.HasPrefix(query, "SELECT zookeeper_path, replica_name FROM system.replicas"):
		t, ok := c.tables[args[0].(string)+"."+args[1].(string)]
		if !ok {
			return rowFake{err: sql.ErrNoRows}
		}
		return rowFake{values: []any{t.zkPath, t.replica}}
	}
	return rowFake{err: fmt.Errorf("chFake: unexpected query %q", query)}
}

// addIntent adds a table exactly as ClickHouse would show the one intent
// creates.
func (c *chFake) addIntent(intent ddl.TableIntent) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	settings := make([]string, 0, len(intent.Settings)+1)
	for _, s := range intent.Settings {
		settings = append(settings, s.Name+" = "+s.Value)
	}
	settings = append(settings, "index_granularity = 8192")
	head := fmt.Sprintf("ReplicatedMergeTree('%s', '%s')", intent.ZooKeeperPath, intent.ReplicaName)
	if intent.PartitionKey != "" {
		head += " PARTITION BY " + intent.PartitionKey
	}
	c.tables[intent.Database+"."+intent.Table] = &chTable{database: intent.Database, name: intent.Table, comment: intent.Comment,
		engine: intent.Engine, engineFull: head + " ORDER BY (" + strings.Join(intent.SortingKey, ", ") + ") SETTINGS " + strings.Join(settings, ", "),
		sortingKey: strings.Join(intent.SortingKey, ", "), partitionKey: intent.PartitionKey,
		zkPath: intent.ZooKeeperPath, replica: intent.ReplicaName, columns: slices.Clone(intent.Columns)}
}

// addRaw adds a table with the given comment and engine_full only.
func (c *chFake) addRaw(database, name, comment, engineFull string) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	c.tables[database+"."+name] = &chTable{database: database, name: name, comment: comment, engine: ddl.EngineReplicatedMergeTree, engineFull: engineFull}
}

func (c *chFake) has(database, name string) bool {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	_, ok := c.tables[database+"."+name]
	return ok
}

func (c *chFake) statements() []string {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(c.statement)
}

// writes lists the recorded Exec statements (DDL), not the reads.
func (c *chFake) writes() []string {
	var out []string
	for _, s := range c.statements() {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(s, "SELECT") && !strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(s), "SELECT") {
			out = append(out, s)
		}
	}
	return out
}

func (c *chFake) sortedLocked(database string) []*chTable {
	var out []*chTable
	for _, t := range c.tables {
		if t.database == database {
			out = append(out, t)
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].name < out[j].name })
	return out
}

// rowsFake is driver.Rows over fixed rows: Scan assigns each value to the
// destination it points to. Any other method panics (nil embedded Rows).
type rowsFake struct {
	driver.Rows
	rows [][]any
	i    int
}

func (r *rowsFake) Next() bool {
	if r.i >= len(r.rows) {
		return false
	}
	r.i++
	return true
}

func (r *rowsFake) Scan(dest ...any) error { return assign(r.rows[r.i-1], dest) }
func (r *rowsFake) Err() error             { return nil }
func (r *rowsFake) Close() error           { return nil }

// rowFake is driver.Row over one fixed row or an error.
type rowFake struct {
	values []any
	err    error
}

func (r rowFake) Err() error { return r.err }

func (r rowFake) Scan(dest ...any) error {
	if r.err != nil {
		return r.err
	}
	return assign(r.values, dest)
}

func (r rowFake) ScanStruct(any) error { return errors.New("rowFake: ScanStruct is not supported") }

func assign(values, dest []any) error {
	if len(values) != len(dest) {
		return fmt.Errorf("scan %d values into %d destinations", len(values), len(dest))
	}
	for i, v := range values {
		d := reflect.ValueOf(dest[i])
		if d.Kind() != reflect.Pointer || !reflect.ValueOf(v).Type().AssignableTo(d.Elem().Type()) {
			return fmt.Errorf("scan %T into %T", v, dest[i])
		}
		d.Elem().Set(reflect.ValueOf(v))
	}
	return nil
}

// gatewayFake serves the arbiter RPCs the member calls: Membership
// (RegisterNode, MarkActive), the verifier dispatch stream and evidence
// submissions, and SafeState.GetBlockVerification from blocks.
type gatewayFake struct {
	pb.UnimplementedVerifierGatewayServer
	pb.UnimplementedMembershipServer
	pb.UnimplementedSafeStateServer

	mu           sync.Mutex
	regs         []*pb.NodeRegistration
	marks        []*pb.NodeRef
	hellos       []string
	attestations []*pb.ReplayAttestation
	scans        []*pb.ByteSideScanMsg
	blocks       map[uint64]*pb.BlockVerification
	reads        []uint64
	dispatch     chan *pb.VerifierDispatch
}

func newGatewayFake() *gatewayFake {
	return &gatewayFake{blocks: map[uint64]*pb.BlockVerification{}, dispatch: make(chan *pb.VerifierDispatch, 8)}
}

func (f *gatewayFake) RegisterNode(_ context.Context, m *pb.NodeRegistration) (*pb.Ack, error) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	f.regs = append(f.regs, m)
	return &pb.Ack{}, nil
}

func (f *gatewayFake) MarkActive(_ context.Context, m *pb.NodeRef) (*pb.Ack, error) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	f.marks = append(f.marks, m)
	return &pb.Ack{}, nil
}

func (f *gatewayFake) SubscribeVerifierDispatch(hello *pb.VerifierHello, stream grpc.ServerStreamingServer[pb.VerifierDispatch]) error {
	f.mu.Lock()
	f.hellos = append(f.hellos, hello.GetReplicaId())
	f.mu.Unlock()
	for {
		select {
		case <-stream.Context().Done():
			return stream.Context().Err()
		case d := <-f.dispatch:
			if err := stream.Send(d); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	}
}

func (f *gatewayFake) SubmitAttestation(_ context.Context, m *pb.ReplayAttestation) (*pb.Ack, error) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	f.attestations = append(f.attestations, m)
	return &pb.Ack{}, nil
}

func (f *gatewayFake) SubmitByteSideScan(_ context.Context, m *pb.ByteSideScanMsg) (*pb.Ack, error) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	f.scans = append(f.scans, m)
	return &pb.Ack{}, nil
}

func (f *gatewayFake) GetBlockVerification(_ context.Context, ref *pb.L3BlockRef) (*pb.BlockVerification, error) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	f.reads = append(f.reads, ref.GetL3BlockSeq())
	bv, ok := f.blocks[ref.GetL3BlockSeq()]
	if !ok {
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "no sealed block %d", ref.GetL3BlockSeq())
	}
	return bv, nil
}

func (f *gatewayFake) snapshot() (regs []*pb.NodeRegistration, marks []*pb.NodeRef, hellos []string, atts []*pb.ReplayAttestation, scans []*pb.ByteSideScanMsg) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(f.regs), slices.Clone(f.marks), slices.Clone(f.hellos), slices.Clone(f.attestations), slices.Clone(f.scans)
}

// blockView is a sealed block's verification view as GetBlockVerification
// answers it.
func blockView(seq uint64, verifierSet []string, verdict bool) *pb.BlockVerification {
	return &pb.BlockVerification{Header: &pb.L3BlockHeader{L3BlockSeq: seq}, VerifierSet: verifierSet, VerdictEvaluated: verdict}
}

// startGatewayFake serves f on a loopback port and returns a client for it.
func startGatewayFake(t *testing.T, f *gatewayFake) *dataplane.Client {
	t.Helper()
	ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	srv := grpc.NewServer()
	pb.RegisterVerifierGatewayServer(srv, f)
	pb.RegisterMembershipServer(srv, f)
	pb.RegisterSafeStateServer(srv, f)
	done := make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		_ = srv.Serve(ln)
		close(done)
	}()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		srv.Stop()
		<-done
	})
	client, err := dataplane.New(dataplane.Config{Peers: []dataplane.Peer{{ID: "n1", GRPCAddr: ln.Addr().String()}}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(client.Close)
	return client
}

// replayFake answers every job with att and records it; before, when set,
// runs first inside Verify.
type replayFake struct {
	mu     sync.Mutex
	jobs   []replay.ReplayJob
	att    replay.ReplayAttestation
	before func(job replay.ReplayJob)
}

func (r *replayFake) Verify(_ context.Context, job replay.ReplayJob) (replay.ReplayAttestation, error) {
	if r.before != nil {
		r.before(job)
	}
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	r.jobs = append(r.jobs, job)
	return r.att, nil
}

func (r *replayFake) count() int {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	return len(r.jobs)
}

// syncBuffer is a goroutine-safe log sink.
type syncBuffer struct {
	mu  sync.Mutex
	buf bytes.Buffer
}

func (b *syncBuffer) Write(p []byte) (int, error) {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	return b.buf.Write(p)
}

func (b *syncBuffer) String() string {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	return b.buf.String()
}

func textLogger(w *syncBuffer) *slog.Logger { return slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(w, nil)) }

// swapsJob is block seq's replay job with one INSERT into dex.swaps.
func swapsJob(seq uint64) replay.ReplayJob {
	return replay.ReplayJob{BlockSeq: seq, PrevSafeSnapshotID: "snap-1", PrevStateRoot: "0xprev", SchemaSnapshotID: "schema",
		ExecutorProfileID: "housegate-replay-mvp-v0", SourceClaimRoot: "0xsource",
		Statements: []replay.Statement{{StatementID: "st-1", StatementSeq: 1, TargetTableID: "dex.swaps"}}}
}
```

```go
func newTestRole(t *testing.T, cfg Config, client VerifyDeps, core evidence.ReplayCore) *VerifyRole {

	d := client
	if d.Manifests == nil {
		d.Manifests = payloadexec.NewMemSnapshotStore()

	}

	}
	if core == nil {

		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return v
	}

}

func TestMemberVerifyRoleRegistersAsAVerifierWithARegistrationSeq(t *testing.T) {
	gw := newGatewayFake()
	client := startGatewayFake(t, gw)
	cfg := testConfig(t)
	cfg.Register = true
	now := time.UnixMilli(int64(authoritytest.RegistrationSeq))
	v := newTestRole(t, cfg, VerifyDeps{Client: client, Registry: newViewFake(groupSnapshot(true, nil, nil)), Conn: newCHFake(),
		Now: func() time.Time { return now }}, nil)
	if err := v.Register(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// A clock that went back still gives a higher seq.
	now = now.Add(-time.Hour)
	if err := v.Register(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	regs, marks, _, _, _ := gw.snapshot()
	if len(regs) != 2 || len(marks) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("%d registrations and %d activations, want 2 each", len(regs), len(marks))
	}
	ctx := authority.MessageContext{NetworkID: testNetworkID, GenesisSnapshotID: testGenesisID}
	pub := authoritytest.MemberKeyB().Public().(ed25519.PublicKey)
	for i, want := range []uint64{authoritytest.RegistrationSeq, authoritytest.RegistrationSeq + 1} {
		reg, mark := regs[i], marks[i]
		if reg.GetNodeId() != testNodeID || !slices.Equal(reg.GetRoles(), []pb.NodeRole{pb.NodeRole_NODE_ROLE_VERIFIER}) ||
			!slices.Equal(reg.GetEd25519Pubkey(), pub) || reg.GetRegistrationSeq() != want || reg.GetSignerJws() != "" ||
			!slices.Equal(reg.GetFeatures(), arbiter.LocalNodeFeatures()) {
			t.Fatalf("registration %d = %v", i, reg)
		}
		body := arbiter.NodeRegistration{NodeID: testNodeID, Roles: []arbiter.NodeRole{arbiter.NodeRoleVerifier}, Ed25519Pubkey: pub, RegistrationSeq: want}
		if err := authority.VerifyVerifierMessage(pub, authority.VerifierMessageRegistration, ctx, body, reg.GetEd25519Signature()); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("registration %d signature: %v", i, err)
		}
		if mark.GetNodeId() != testNodeID || mark.GetRegistrationSeq() != want {
			t.Fatalf("activation %d = %v", i, mark)
		}
		if err := authority.VerifyVerifierMessage(pub, authority.VerifierMessageMarkActive, ctx,
			authority.MarkActiveBody{NodeID: testNodeID, RegistrationSeq: want}, mark.GetEd25519Signature()); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("activation %d signature: %v", i, err)
		}
	}
	b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(cfg.StateDir, evidence.RegistrationStateFile))
	if err != nil || string(b) != `{"registration_seq":1760054400001}` {
		t.Fatalf("registration.json = %q, %v", b, err)
	}
}

func TestMemberVerifyRoleScansItsMemberUnsafeReplica(t *testing.T) {
	gw := newGatewayFake()
	client := startGatewayFake(t, gw)
	cfg := testConfig(t)
	cfg.Register = true
	conn := newCHFake()
	rid := make([]byte, 32)
	rid[0] = 7
	conn.scanRows["`hg_member_unsafe`.`dex__swaps`"] = [][]any{{"p_a_3_3_0", rid, "a", uint64(42)}}
	v := newTestRole(t, cfg, VerifyDeps{Client: client, Registry: newViewFake(groupSnapshot(true, []string{testNodeID}, nil,
		chainIncarnation(t, 3, swapsSchema, wire.TableStatusActive, true))), Conn: conn}, nil)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { done <- v.Run(ctx) }()
	gw.dispatch <- wire.ByteSideScanDispatch(5, []arbiter.PartRef{{TableID: "dex.swaps", PartitionID: "p_a", PartRowLtHash: "0xclaimed", PartName: "p_a_3_3_0"}})
	deadline := time.Now().Add(10 * time.Second)
	var scans []*pb.ByteSideScanMsg
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		var hellos []string
		_, _, hellos, _, scans = gw.snapshot()
		if len(scans) == 1 {
			if !slices.Equal(hellos, []string{testNodeID}) {
				t.Fatalf("subscribed as %v, want %s", hellos, testNodeID)
			}
			break
		}
		time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	if len(scans) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("no byte-side scan was submitted")
	}
	h, err := payloadexec.RowElementHash(swapsSchema, rid, []any{"a", uint64(42)})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	acc := lthash.New()
	acc.AddHash(h)
	want := "0x" + hex.EncodeToString(acc.Bytes())
	msg := wire.ScanFromPB(scans[0])
	if msg.ReplicaID != testNodeID || msg.BlockSeq != 5 || len(msg.Parts) != 1 || msg.Parts[0].ScannedPartRowLtHash != want ||
		msg.Parts[0].ClaimedPartRowLtHash != "0xclaimed" || msg.Parts[0].LivePartName != "p_a_3_3_0" {
		t.Fatalf("scan = %+v, want member-b's scan of hg_member_unsafe.dex__swaps with row hash %s", msg, want)
	}
	hash, err := replay.CanonicalDigest(arbiter.DomainByteSideScan, msg.Body())
	if err != nil || hash != msg.ScanHash {
		t.Fatalf("scan hash %s, recomputed %s (%v)", msg.ScanHash, hash, err)
	}
	sig, err := hex.DecodeString(msg.Signature)
	if err != nil || !ed25519.Verify(authoritytest.MemberKeyB().Public().(ed25519.PublicKey), []byte(hash), sig) {
		t.Fatalf("scan signature does not verify under member-b's ed25519 key (%v)", err)
	}
	if q := conn.scanQuery; len(q) != 1 || !strings.Contains(q[0], "FROM `hg_member_unsafe`.`dex__swaps` WHERE _part IN (?)") {
		t.Fatalf("scan queries %q, want one read of hg_member_unsafe.dex__swaps", q)
	}
	cancel()
	if err := <-done; !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		t.Fatalf("Run = %v", err)
	}
}

		ready bool
	}{
		{"no replica", nil, false},
		{"a replica of an earlier incarnation", &stale, false},
		{"the live incarnation's replica", &intent, true},

		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {

				t.Fatalf("HandleReplayJob = %v with %d replays and %d attestations, want ErrMemberTableNotReady and none", err, core.count(), len(atts))
			}
			if !strings.Contains(logs.String(), `msg="a job table has no ready hg_member_unsafe replica on this member; refusing to attest"`) {
				t.Fatalf("logs = %s", logs.String())
			}
		})
	}

		{"no state dir", func(c *Config, _ *VerifyDeps) { c.StateDir = "" }, "member consensus: state dir is required"},
		{"a short seed", func(c *Config, _ *VerifyDeps) { c.Ed25519Seed = c.Ed25519Seed[:31] }, "member consensus: ed25519 seed must be 32 bytes"},
		{"a negative interval", func(c *Config, _ *VerifyDeps) { c.ResolveInterval = -time.Second }, "member consensus: resolve interval must not be negative"},
		{"no connection", func(_ *Config, d *VerifyDeps) { d.Conn = nil },

		{"no boot nonce", func(_ *Config, d *VerifyDeps) { d.BootNonce = "" },
			`member consensus: boot nonce "" must be 8 lowercase hex characters (install.NewBootNonce)`},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			cfg, d := good, deps
			tc.edit(&cfg, &d)
			if _, err := NewVerifyRole(cfg, d); err == nil || err.Error() != tc.want {
				t.Fatalf("NewVerifyRole = %v, want %q", err, tc.want)
			}
		})
	}
```

```go
package consensus

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

func readLedgerFile(t *testing.T, dir string) string {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, QuiescenceFile))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return string(b)
}

func TestQuiescenceLedgerIsDurableBeforeTheJobRuns(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := testConfig(t)
	inc := chainIncarnation(t, 3, swapsSchema, wire.TableStatusActive, true)
	intent, err := ddl.MemberUnsafeIntent(ddl.DefaultMemberPinned(testNodeID, 0, ""), swapsSchema, 3, "/sentio/0/unsafe_inc/dex__swaps/3")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	conn := newCHFake()
	conn.addIntent(intent)
	gw := newGatewayFake()
	core := &replayFake{att: replay.ReplayAttestation{ReplicaID: testNodeID, ReceiptHash: "0xr", Signature: "0xs", MatchSourceRoot: true}}
	core.before = func(job replay.ReplayJob) {
		// A second process reads the ledger while the job runs.
		l, err := ReadQuiescence(cfg.StateDir)
		if err != nil {
			t.Errorf("ReadQuiescence during block %d: %v", job.BlockSeq, err)
		}
		if l.Quiet("dex.swaps", 3) {
			t.Errorf("dex.swaps@3 is quiet while block %d replays", job.BlockSeq)
		}
	}
	v := newTestRole(t, cfg, VerifyDeps{Client: startGatewayFake(t, gw),
		Registry: newViewFake(groupSnapshot(true, []string{testNodeID}, nil, inc)), Conn: conn}, core)
	for range 2 { // the second delivery is the arbiter's redelivery of the same block
		if err := v.handler.HandleReplayJob(context.Background(), wire.ReplayJobToPB(swapsJob(5))); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if core.count() != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("%d replays, want 2", core.count())
	}
	const want = `{"version":1,"blocks":[{"block_seq":5,"tables":[{"table_id":"dex.swaps","incarnation_seq":3}]}]}`
	if got := readLedgerFile(t, cfg.StateDir); got != want {
		t.Fatalf("quiescence.json = %s, want %s", got, want)
	}
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(cfg.StateDir)
	if err != nil || len(entries) != 1 || entries[0].Name() != QuiescenceFile {
		t.Fatalf("state dir holds %v (%v), want only %s", entries, err, QuiescenceFile)
	}

	// A ledger that cannot be written refuses the job before its replay.
	if err := os.RemoveAll(cfg.StateDir); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(cfg.StateDir, []byte("not a directory"), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := v.handler.HandleReplayJob(context.Background(), wire.ReplayJobToPB(swapsJob(6))); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("a job whose ledger write failed was attested")
	}
	if core.count() != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("a job whose ledger write failed was replayed (%d replays)", core.count())
	}
}

func TestQuiescenceResolvesALatchedOrReselectedBlock(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	q, err := OpenQuiescence(dir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	swaps, pools := QuiescentTable{TableID: "dex.swaps", IncarnationSeq: 3}, QuiescentTable{TableID: "dex.pools", IncarnationSeq: 4}
	for _, b := range []struct {
		seq    uint64
		tables []QuiescentTable
	}{{5, []QuiescentTable{swaps}}, {6, []QuiescentTable{pools}}, {7, []QuiescentTable{swaps}}, {8, []QuiescentTable{pools}}} {
		if err := q.Observe(b.seq, b.tables); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	gw := newGatewayFake()
	gw.blocks[5] = blockView(5, []string{testNodeID, "verifier-1", "verifier-2"}, true)  // latched
	gw.blocks[6] = blockView(6, []string{"member-c", "verifier-1", "verifier-2"}, false) // re-selected away
	gw.blocks[7] = blockView(7, []string{testNodeID, "verifier-1", "verifier-2"}, false) // still needs our evidence
	client := startGatewayFake(t, gw)
	err = q.Resolve(context.Background(), client, testNodeID)
	if !errors.Is(err, dataplane.ErrBlockNotSealed) || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "member consensus: resolve block 8: ") {
		t.Fatalf("Resolve = %v, want block 8's read error", err)
	}
	l, err := ReadQuiescence(dir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if l.Quiet("dex.swaps", 3) || l.Quiet("dex.pools", 4) {
		t.Fatalf("after the first resolve: swaps@3 quiet %v (block 7 open), pools@4 quiet %v (block 8 unreadable)", l.Quiet("dex.swaps", 3), l.Quiet("dex.pools", 4))
	}
	const afterFirst = `{"version":1,"blocks":[{"block_seq":7,"tables":[{"table_id":"dex.swaps","incarnation_seq":3}]},{"block_seq":8,"tables":[{"table_id":"dex.pools","incarnation_seq":4}]}]}`
	if got := readLedgerFile(t, dir); got != afterFirst {
		t.Fatalf("quiescence.json = %s, want %s", got, afterFirst)
	}
	// The verdict of block 7 latches and block 8 becomes readable.
	gw.mu.Lock()
	gw.blocks[7] = blockView(7, []string{testNodeID, "verifier-1", "verifier-2"}, true)
	gw.blocks[8] = blockView(8, []string{"verifier-1", "verifier-2", "verifier-3"}, false)
	gw.mu.Unlock()
	if err := q.Resolve(context.Background(), client, testNodeID); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if l, err := ReadQuiescence(dir); err != nil || !l.Quiet("dex.swaps", 3) || !l.Quiet("dex.pools", 4) {
		t.Fatalf("after the second resolve the ledger still names a table (%v)", err)
	}
	if got := readLedgerFile(t, dir); got != `{"version":1,"blocks":[]}` {
		t.Fatalf("quiescence.json = %s", got)
	}
	// A reopened ledger starts from the file.
	if err := q.Observe(9, []QuiescentTable{pools}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	reopened, err := OpenQuiescence(dir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	gw.mu.Lock()
	gw.reads = nil
	gw.blocks[9] = blockView(9, []string{testNodeID, "verifier-1", "verifier-2"}, false)
	gw.mu.Unlock()
	if err := reopened.Resolve(context.Background(), client, testNodeID); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	gw.mu.Lock()
	reads := slices.Clone(gw.reads)
	gw.mu.Unlock()
	if !slices.Equal(reads, []uint64{9}) {
		t.Fatalf("a reopened ledger read blocks %v, want [9]", reads)
	}
}

func TestReadQuiescenceRefusesACorruptOrUnknownLedger(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	if l, err := ReadQuiescence(dir); err != nil || !l.Quiet("dex.swaps", 3) {
		t.Fatalf("a missing ledger = %v, %v; want an empty one", l, err)
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct{ body, want string }{
		{`{`, "member consensus: quiescence.json is corrupt: unexpected end of JSON input"},
		{`{"version":2,"blocks":[]}`, "member consensus: quiescence.json has version 2, want 1"},
	} {
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, QuiescenceFile), []byte(tc.body), 0o600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if _, err := ReadQuiescence(dir); err == nil || err.Error() != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("ReadQuiescence(%s) = %v, want %q", tc.body, err, tc.want)
		}
		if _, err := OpenQuiescence(dir); err == nil || err.Error() != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("OpenQuiescence(%s) = %v, want %q", tc.body, err, tc.want)
		}
	}
	if _, err := OpenQuiescence(""); err == nil || err.Error() != "member consensus: the quiescence ledger needs a state dir" {
		t.Fatalf("OpenQuiescence(\"\") = %v", err)
	}
}
```

```go
// TestMemberUnsafeIntentIsCalledOnlyByTheMemberConsensusMode: from Plan
// S3-E1 Task 62 on, MemberUnsafeIntent is named only in member/consensus, by
// the hg_member_unsafe reconciler (unsafe_reconciler.go), which creates the
// member's replicas as si_member_ddl, and by the verify role's readiness check
// (verify_role.go), which verifies them as si_member. No other non-test Go
// file of this module names it, so no other path creates a replicated table
// in a member database (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §8.2, §8.3). It replaces
// Plan S3-C2's TestMemberUnsafeIntentHasNoCallerInP2.
func TestMemberUnsafeIntentIsCalledOnlyByTheMemberConsensusMode(t *testing.T) {
	allowed := map[string]bool{"member/consensus/unsafe_reconciler.go": true, "member/consensus/verify_role.go": true}
	root := moduleRoot(t)
	fset := token.NewFileSet()
	declared := false
	var uses, outside []string
	err := filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if d.IsDir() {
			if path != root && (strings.HasPrefix(d.Name(), ".") || strings.HasPrefix(d.Name(), "bazel-") || d.Name() == "testdata") {
				return filepath.SkipDir
			}
			return nil
		}
		if !d.Type().IsRegular() || !strings.HasSuffix(path, ".go") || strings.HasSuffix(path, "_test.go") {
			return nil
		}
		file, err := parser.ParseFile(fset, path, nil, parser.SkipObjectResolution)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		rel, err := filepath.Rel(root, path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		rel = filepath.ToSlash(rel)
		var declaration *ast.Ident
		if rel == "dataplane/ddl/member.go" {
			for _, decl := range file.Decls {
				if fn, ok := decl.(*ast.FuncDecl); ok && fn.Recv == nil && fn.Name.Name == "MemberUnsafeIntent" {
					declaration, declared = fn.Name, true
				}
			}
		}
		ast.Inspect(file, func(n ast.Node) bool {
			if id, ok := n.(*ast.Ident); ok && id.Name == "MemberUnsafeIntent" && id != declaration {
				uses = append(uses, fset.Position(id.Pos()).String())
				if !allowed[rel] {
					outside = append(outside, fset.Position(id.Pos()).String())
				}
			}
			return true
		})
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("walk %s: %v", root, err)
	}
	if !declared {
		t.Fatalf("found no declaration of MemberUnsafeIntent in %s/dataplane/ddl/member.go", root)
	}
	if len(outside) > 0 {
		t.Fatalf("MemberUnsafeIntent is named outside the member consensus mode's reconciler and readiness check: %v", outside)
	}
	if len(uses) == 0 {
		t.Fatal("MemberUnsafeIntent has no caller: the member consensus mode (member/consensus) creates and verifies the hg_member_unsafe replicas with it")
	}
}
```

Create `member/consensus/config.go`:

```go
// Package consensus is the stage-3 member's consensus mode (housegate spec
// 2026-10-14 §8.1-§8.3, §8.8, §9.1; plan S3-E1 contract §42.3, K66): the
// verify role, which registers the member as a VERIFIER and answers its
// replay jobs and byte-side scans over its own hg_member_unsafe replicas and
// hg_rstage scratch; the quiescence ledger, which records every table a
// dispatched block names until that block no longer needs this member's
// evidence; and the group-scoped hg_member_unsafe reconciler, which runs in
// its own process as si_member_ddl. Nothing here runs unless the member is
// configured for it (member.Config.Consensus), and nothing registers or
// creates a replica until Config.Register and ReconcilerConfig.CreateReplicas
// are set (S3-F steps 4 and 6).
package consensus

import (
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"regexp"
	"time"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/payloadexec"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/ddl"
)

const (
	// DefaultReadinessInterval is how often the member announces the groups
	// whose replicas it holds (MemberReady) while placement is on.
	DefaultReadinessInterval = 10 * time.Second
	// DefaultCheckpointInterval is how often the member signs a checkpoint
	// per owner while the checkpoints switch is on.
	DefaultCheckpointInterval = 30 * time.Second
	// DefaultResolveInterval is how often the verify role asks the arbiter
	// whether the blocks of its quiescence ledger still need its evidence.
	DefaultResolveInterval = 5 * time.Second
	// CheckpointSeqFile holds the member's last checkpoint_seq per owner.
	CheckpointSeqFile = "checkpoint_seq.json"
	// QuiescenceFile holds the quiescence ledger, in the member state
	// directory that the reconciler process mounts read-only.
	QuiescenceFile = "quiescence.json"
)

// Config is the member's consensus mode. A member without one is the P2/P3
// member byte for byte.
type Config struct {
	NodeID              string // the P2 member id (S3-C2 K29: member-a|b|c), its verifiers-entry node_id
	NetworkID           string
	GenesisSnapshotID   string
	StateDir            string // the member state directory of S3-C2
	Ed25519Seed         []byte // seed of the entry's ed25519_pubkey
	ReplicaSignerKeyHex string // secp256k1 key of the entry's replica_signer
	KeeperShardID       uint32
	Tables              []payloadexec.TableSchema
	Register            bool // S3-F step 4: register and mark active as a VERIFIER
	ReadinessInterval   time.Duration
	CheckpointInterval  time.Duration
	ResolveInterval     time.Duration
}

// ReconcilerConfig is the hg_member_unsafe reconciler's, the process that
// holds si_member_ddl.
type ReconcilerConfig struct {
	NodeID         string
	StateDir       string // read-only here: quiescence.json written by the main process
	KeeperShardID  uint32
	CreateReplicas bool          // S3-F step 6
	Interval       time.Duration // 0 = ddl.DefaultReconcileInterval
	// NetworkID and Tables resolve each incarnation's schema
	// (dataplane.IncarnationSchema): Tables is the genesis table set, which
	// supplies the schemas of genesis-origin incarnations.
	NetworkID string
	Tables    []payloadexec.TableSchema
	// StoragePolicy is the member storage policy of every hg_member_unsafe
	// replica (ddl.MemberPinned.StoragePolicy); "" keeps the server's
	// default policy.
	StoragePolicy string
}

// nodeIDPattern is the member id rule of Plan S3-C2 (member.Role refuses any
// other): it also keeps the node id a valid scratch-name prefix.
var nodeIDPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,30}[a-z0-9]$`)

// validate checks the fields the verify role reads and sets the interval
// defaults. ReplicaSignerKeyHex is checked where the checkpoint signer is
// built.
func (c *Config) validate() error {
	var errs []error
	if !nodeIDPattern.MatchString(c.NodeID) {
		errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: node id %q must match %s", c.NodeID, nodeIDPattern))
	}
	if c.NetworkID == "" {
		errs = append(errs, errors.New("member consensus: network id is required"))
	}
	if c.GenesisSnapshotID == "" {
		errs = append(errs, errors.New("member consensus: genesis snapshot id is required"))
	}
	if c.StateDir == "" {
		errs = append(errs, errors.New("member consensus: state dir is required"))
	}
	if len(c.Ed25519Seed) != ed25519.SeedSize {
		errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: ed25519 seed must be %d bytes", ed25519.SeedSize))
	}
	if err := ddl.ValidatePhysicalTableNames(c.Tables); err != nil {
		errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: %w", err))
	}
	for _, d := range []struct {
		name  string
		value *time.Duration
		def   time.Duration
	}{
		{"readiness", &c.ReadinessInterval, DefaultReadinessInterval},
		{"checkpoint", &c.CheckpointInterval, DefaultCheckpointInterval},
		{"resolve", &c.ResolveInterval, DefaultResolveInterval},
	} {
		switch {
		case *d.value < 0:
			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: %s interval must not be negative", d.name))
		case *d.value == 0:
			*d.value = d.def
		}
	}
	return errors.Join(errs...)
}

// validate checks the reconciler's configuration and sets its interval.
func (c *ReconcilerConfig) validate() error {
	var errs []error
	if !nodeIDPattern.MatchString(c.NodeID) {
		errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: node id %q must match %s", c.NodeID, nodeIDPattern))
	}
	if c.StateDir == "" {
		errs = append(errs, errors.New("member consensus: state dir is required"))
	}
	if c.NetworkID == "" {
		errs = append(errs, errors.New("member consensus: network id is required"))
	}
	if err := ddl.ValidatePhysicalTableNames(c.Tables); err != nil {
		errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: %w", err))
	}
	if c.Interval < 0 {
		errs = append(errs, errors.New("member consensus: reconcile interval must not be negative"))
	} else if c.Interval == 0 {
		c.Interval = ddl.DefaultReconcileInterval
	}
	if err := ddl.ValidateMemberPinned(c.pinned(), protocolDatabases); err != nil {
		errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: %w", err))
	}
	return errors.Join(errs...)
}

// protocolDatabases are the host SNode's databases, which no member database
// may be (the defaults of the SNode and of S3-C2's member.Config.Protocol).
var protocolDatabases = ddl.Pinned{UnsafeDB: "hg_unsafe", SafeDB: "hg_safe", PromoteDB: "hg_promote"}

// pinned is the member database set the reconciler creates its replicas in.
func (c ReconcilerConfig) pinned() ddl.MemberPinned {
	return ddl.DefaultMemberPinned(c.NodeID, c.KeeperShardID, c.StoragePolicy)
}
```

Create `member/consensus/quiescence.go`:

```go
package consensus

import (
	"cmp"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"slices"
	"sync"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane"
)

// quiescenceVersion is the only quiescence.json version.
const quiescenceVersion = 1

// QuiescentTable is one table, at one incarnation, that a dispatched block's
// replay job names.
type QuiescentTable struct {
	TableID        string `json:"table_id"`
	IncarnationSeq uint64 `json:"incarnation_seq"`
}

// quiescenceBlock is one unresolved block of the ledger.
type quiescenceBlock struct {
	BlockSeq uint64           `json:"block_seq"`
	Tables   []QuiescentTable `json:"tables"`
}

// quiescenceFile is quiescence.json: the unresolved blocks, ascending.
type quiescenceFile struct {
	Version int               `json:"version"`
	Blocks  []quiescenceBlock `json:"blocks"`
}

// Quiescence is the main process's quiescence ledger (spec §8.8): every
// block whose replay job reached this member, with the tables it names,
// until the block no longer needs the member's evidence. The reconciler
// drops an hg_member_unsafe replica only while no unresolved block names its
// table at that incarnation, so a block the member may still be asked to
// byte-scan never loses the replica it scans. Safe for concurrent use.
type Quiescence struct {
	dir    string
	mu     sync.Mutex
	blocks []quiescenceBlock
}

// OpenQuiescence opens the ledger in stateDir (QuiescenceFile); a missing
// file is an empty ledger.
func OpenQuiescence(stateDir string) (*Quiescence, error) {
	if stateDir == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("member consensus: the quiescence ledger needs a state dir")
	}
	l, err := ReadQuiescence(stateDir)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &Quiescence{dir: stateDir, blocks: l.blocks}, nil
}

// Observe records that block blockSeq names tables. It is durable in
// quiescence.json (temp file, fsync, rename, directory fsync) before it
// returns, so the record exists before the job's replay and scan run. A
// block observed again (a redelivery) gains the tables it did not name yet;
// an Observe that adds nothing writes nothing.
func (q *Quiescence) Observe(blockSeq uint64, tables []QuiescentTable) error {
	if blockSeq == 0 {
		return errors.New("member consensus: quiescence needs a block seq")
	}
	if len(tables) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	q.mu.Lock()
	defer q.mu.Unlock()
	next := slices.Clone(q.blocks)
	i, found := slices.BinarySearchFunc(next, blockSeq, func(b quiescenceBlock, seq uint64) int { return cmp.Compare(b.BlockSeq, seq) })
	if !found {
		next = slices.Insert(next, i, quiescenceBlock{BlockSeq: blockSeq})
	}
	merged := mergeTables(next[i].Tables, tables)
	if found && slices.Equal(merged, next[i].Tables) {
		return nil
	}
	next[i].Tables = merged
	if err := writeQuiescence(q.dir, next); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	q.blocks = next
	return nil
}

// Resolve asks the arbiter about every unresolved block and drops each one
// that no longer needs this member's evidence: its verdict is evaluated
// (latched), or nodeID is no longer in its verifier set (re-selected away).
// It keeps a block it could not read and returns those errors joined, after
// persisting what it resolved.
func (q *Quiescence) Resolve(ctx context.Context, client *dataplane.Client, nodeID string) error {
	q.mu.Lock()
	pending := make([]uint64, 0, len(q.blocks))
	for _, b := range q.blocks {
		pending = append(pending, b.BlockSeq)
	}
	q.mu.Unlock()
	resolved := map[uint64]bool{}
	var errs []error
	for _, seq := range pending {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		bv, err := client.GetBlockVerification(ctx, seq)
		if err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: resolve block %d: %w", seq, err))
			continue
		}
		if bv.VerdictEvaluated || !slices.Contains(bv.VerifierSet, nodeID) {
			resolved[seq] = true
		}
	}
	if len(resolved) > 0 {
		q.mu.Lock()
		next := slices.DeleteFunc(slices.Clone(q.blocks), func(b quiescenceBlock) bool { return resolved[b.BlockSeq] })
		err := writeQuiescence(q.dir, next)
		if err == nil {
			q.blocks = next
		}
		q.mu.Unlock()
		if err != nil {
			errs = append(errs, err)
		}
	}
	return errors.Join(errs...)
}

// QuiescenceLedger is a read-only copy of quiescence.json, as the reconciler
// process reads it.
type QuiescenceLedger struct {
	blocks []quiescenceBlock
}

// ReadQuiescence reads the ledger in stateDir; a missing file is an empty
// ledger.
func ReadQuiescence(stateDir string) (QuiescenceLedger, error) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(stateDir, QuiescenceFile))
	if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return QuiescenceLedger{}, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return QuiescenceLedger{}, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: read %s: %w", QuiescenceFile, err)
	}
	var f quiescenceFile
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &f); err != nil {
		return QuiescenceLedger{}, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: %s is corrupt: %w", QuiescenceFile, err)
	}
	if f.Version != quiescenceVersion {
		return QuiescenceLedger{}, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: %s has version %d, want %d", QuiescenceFile, f.Version, quiescenceVersion)
	}
	return QuiescenceLedger{blocks: f.Blocks}, nil
}

// Quiet reports whether no unresolved block names tableID at incarnationSeq.
func (l QuiescenceLedger) Quiet(tableID string, incarnationSeq uint64) bool {
	want := QuiescentTable{TableID: tableID, IncarnationSeq: incarnationSeq}
	for _, b := range l.blocks {
		if slices.Contains(b.Tables, want) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// mergeTables is the sorted, deduplicated union of a and b.
func mergeTables(a, b []QuiescentTable) []QuiescentTable {
	out := append(slices.Clone(a), b...)
	slices.SortFunc(out, func(x, y QuiescentTable) int {
		return cmp.Or(cmp.Compare(x.TableID, y.TableID), cmp.Compare(x.IncarnationSeq, y.IncarnationSeq))
	})
	return slices.Compact(out)
}

// writeQuiescence persists blocks like the SNode's state.json
// (snode/state.go persistStateLocked): temp file, fsync, rename, directory
// fsync.
func writeQuiescence(dir string, blocks []quiescenceBlock) error {
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o750); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: state dir: %w", err)
	}
	if blocks == nil {
		blocks = []quiescenceBlock{}
	}
	b, err := json.Marshal(quiescenceFile{Version: quiescenceVersion, Blocks: blocks})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(dir, ".quiescence-*")
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: write %s: %w", QuiescenceFile, err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = os.Remove(tmp.Name()) }()
	if _, err := tmp.Write(b); err != nil {
		_ = tmp.Close()
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: write %s: %w", QuiescenceFile, err)
	}
	if err := tmp.Sync(); err != nil {
		_ = tmp.Close()
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: write %s: %w", QuiescenceFile, err)
	}
	if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: write %s: %w", QuiescenceFile, err)
	}
	if err := os.Rename(tmp.Name(), filepath.Join(dir, QuiescenceFile)); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: write %s: %w", QuiescenceFile, err)
	}
	d, err := os.Open(dir)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: write %s: %w", QuiescenceFile, err)
	}
	defer d.Close()
	return d.Sync()
}
```

Create `member/consensus/verify_role.go`:

```go
package consensus

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log/slog"
	"regexp"
	"slices"
	"time"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"
	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/grpc"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/chexec"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/ddl"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/evidence"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/tableset"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member/install"
)

// ErrMemberTableNotReady refuses to attest a block naming a table whose
// hg_member_unsafe replica this member does not hold at the table's live
// incarnation and Keeper path.
var ErrMemberTableNotReady = errors.New("member consensus: hg_member_unsafe table is not ready")

// errRegisterOff refuses Register before S3-F step 4.
var errRegisterOff = errors.New("member consensus: Register is off")

// errSnapshotQueryNotServed refuses a snapshot-query job: a member does not
// serve that lane.
var errSnapshotQueryNotServed = errors.New("member consensus: a member does not serve the snapshot-query lane")

// memberNotReadyLog is the warn line of an ErrMemberTableNotReady refusal.
const memberNotReadyLog = "a job table has no ready hg_member_unsafe replica on this member; refusing to attest"

// bootNoncePattern is install.NewBootNonce's shape.
var bootNoncePattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{8}$`)

// VerifyDeps are the verify role's collaborators.
type VerifyDeps struct {
	Client    *dataplane.Client
	Registry  dataplane.RegistryView
	Conn      clickhouse.Conn /* si_member */
	Manifests replay.SnapshotStore
	Payloads  replay.PayloadStore
	Logger    *slog.Logger
	Now       func() time.Time
	// BootNonce is member.Role's boot nonce (install.NewBootNonce): the
	// replay scratch prefix carries it, so S3-C2's startup drop under
	// install.NodePrefix removes every earlier boot's scratch.
	BootNonce string
}

// VerifyRole is the member's verify role: a VERIFIER-role node whose
// evidence comes from its own hg_member_unsafe replicas (byte-side scans)
// and its hg_rstage scratch (replays).
type VerifyRole struct {
	cfg     Config
	d       VerifyDeps
	log     *slog.Logger
	priv    ed25519.PrivateKey
	pinned  ddl.MemberPinned
	seq     *evidence.RegistrationSeq
	quiet   *Quiescence
	handler *evidence.Handler
}

// NewVerifyRole validates cfg and d and assembles the role: the evidence
// handler over a scanner of hg_member_unsafe and a replay core whose scratch
// lives in hg_rstage under ReplayScratchPrefix(cfg.NodeID, d.BootNonce).
func NewVerifyRole(cfg Config, d VerifyDeps) (*VerifyRole, error) {
	if err := cfg.validate(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if d.Client == nil || d.Registry == nil || d.Conn == nil || d.Manifests == nil || d.Payloads == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("member consensus: client, registry, clickhouse connection, manifests and payloads are required")
	}
	m, err := NewReplayMaterializer(cfg.NetworkID, d.Conn, cfg.NodeID, d.BootNonce)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	core, err := evidence.NewReplayCore(evidence.ReplayCoreConfig{
		NetworkID: cfg.NetworkID, ReplicaID: cfg.NodeID, Ed25519Seed: cfg.Ed25519Seed, Tables: cfg.Tables,
	}, m, d.Manifests, d.Payloads)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: %w", err)
	}
	scanner := evidence.NewCHScanner(cfg.NetworkID, cfg.Tables, ddl.MemberUnsafeDatabase, d.Conn, d.Registry)
	return newVerifyRole(cfg, d, core, scanner)
}

// newVerifyRole assembles a role over the given replay core and scanner;
// cfg is validated.
func newVerifyRole(cfg Config, d VerifyDeps, core evidence.ReplayCore, scanner evidence.Scanner) (*VerifyRole, error) {
	quiet, err := OpenQuiescence(cfg.StateDir)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	log := d.Logger
	if log == nil {
		log = slog.Default()
	}
	v := &VerifyRole{
		cfg: cfg, d: d, log: log, priv: ed25519.NewKeyFromSeed(cfg.Ed25519Seed),
		pinned: ddl.DefaultMemberPinned(cfg.NodeID, cfg.KeeperShardID, ""),
		seq:    evidence.NewRegistrationSeq(cfg.StateDir), quiet: quiet,
	}
	v.handler, err = evidence.NewHandler(evidence.Config{ReplicaID: cfg.NodeID, Ed25519Seed: cfg.Ed25519Seed}, evidence.Deps{
		Client: d.Client, Replay: core, Scanner: scanner,
		TablesReady: v.tablesReady, NotReady: ErrMemberTableNotReady, NotReadyLog: memberNotReadyLog,
		Observe: v.observe, Logger: log,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: %w", err)
	}
	return v, nil
}

// ReplayScratchPrefix is the verify role's replay scratch prefix in
// hg_rstage: install.ScratchPrefix(nodeID, bootNonce) + "v". It is under
// install.NodePrefix(nodeID), so S3-C2's startup drop removes it, and it
// differs from the shadow's ReplayPrefix (… + "r") and from every
// install.ScratchName (… + a decimal), so a still-running shadow, the
// installer and the verify role never share a scratch name.
func ReplayScratchPrefix(nodeID, bootNonce string) string {
	return install.ScratchPrefix(nodeID, bootNonce) + "v"
}

// NewReplayMaterializer is the verify role's replay materializer: its
// scratch tables are `hg_rstage`.`<ReplayScratchPrefix>replay_<n>`, each
// created with an explicit ENGINE = MergeTree, filled, read back and dropped
// (DROP TABLE IF EXISTS), all inside si_member's hg_rstage rights.
func NewReplayMaterializer(networkID string, conn clickhouse.Conn, nodeID, bootNonce string) (*chexec.Materializer, error) {
	if !bootNoncePattern.MatchString(bootNonce) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: boot nonce %q must be 8 lowercase hex characters (install.NewBootNonce)", bootNonce)
	}
	m, err := chexec.NewMaterializerIn(networkID, conn, ddl.StageDatabase, ReplayScratchPrefix(nodeID, bootNonce))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: %w", err)
	}
	return m, nil
}

// Register registers the member and marks it active as a VERIFIER-role node
// with one fresh registration_seq (registration.json in the state dir),
// signed with its ed25519 key and advertising arbiter.LocalNodeFeatures. It
// is refused until cfg.Register (S3-F step 4).
func (v *VerifyRole) Register(ctx context.Context) error {
	if !v.cfg.Register {
		return errRegisterOff
	}
	seq, err := v.seq.Next(v.nowMillis())
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: register: %w", err)
	}
	reg, mark, err := evidence.VerifierRegistrationRequests(v.priv, v.cfg.NodeID, seq,
		authority.MessageContext{NetworkID: v.cfg.NetworkID, GenesisSnapshotID: v.cfg.GenesisSnapshotID})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: register: %w", err)
	}
	if err := v.d.Client.WithLeaderRetry(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, conn *grpc.ClientConn) error {
		_, err := pb.NewMembershipClient(conn).RegisterNode(ctx, reg)
		return err
	}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: register: %w", err)
	}
	if err := v.d.Client.WithLeaderRetry(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, conn *grpc.ClientConn) error {
		_, err := pb.NewMembershipClient(conn).MarkActive(ctx, mark)
		return err
	}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: mark active: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

// Run resolves the quiescence ledger every ResolveInterval and, with
// cfg.Register, follows the member's verifier dispatch until ctx ends.
// Without cfg.Register it subscribes to nothing and waits for ctx (a ledger
// left by an earlier registered run still resolves).
func (v *VerifyRole) Run(ctx context.Context) error {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	defer cancel()
	resolved := make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		defer close(resolved)
		v.resolveLoop(ctx)
	}()
	var err error
	if v.cfg.Register {
		err = v.d.Client.RunVerifierSubscription(ctx, v.cfg.NodeID, v.onDispatch(ctx))
	} else {
		<-ctx.Done()
		err = ctx.Err()
	}
	cancel()
	<-resolved
	return err
}

// onDispatch answers one verifier dispatch. A handler error does not end the
// subscription: the arbiter re-dispatches unrecorded work.
func (v *VerifyRole) onDispatch(ctx context.Context) func(*pb.VerifierDispatch) error {
	return func(d *pb.VerifierDispatch) error {
		if d == nil {
			return nil
		}
		switch msg := d.GetDispatch().(type) {
		case *pb.VerifierDispatch_ReplayJob:
			return v.handler.HandleReplayJob(ctx, msg.ReplayJob)
		case *pb.VerifierDispatch_ByteSideScan:
			return v.handler.HandleScanRequest(ctx, msg.ByteSideScan)
		case *pb.VerifierDispatch_SnapshotQueryJob:
			v.log.Warn("snapshot query job dispatched to a member; refusing", "block", msg.SnapshotQueryJob.GetBlockSeq())
			return errSnapshotQueryNotServed
		default:
			v.log.Warn("unknown verifier dispatch", "type", fmt.Sprintf("%T", d.GetDispatch()))
			return nil
		}
	}
}

// resolveLoop runs Resolve every ResolveInterval until ctx ends; a failure
// is logged and retried at the next interval.
func (v *VerifyRole) resolveLoop(ctx context.Context) {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(v.cfg.ResolveInterval)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
		if err := v.quiet.Resolve(ctx, v.d.Client, v.cfg.NodeID); err != nil && ctx.Err() == nil {
			v.log.Warn("quiescence ledger resolve failed; retrying", "retry_in", v.cfg.ResolveInterval, "err", err)
		}
	}
}

// jobTables lists, sorted and deduplicated, the tables a job names: the
// target of every statement and every table a table-set transition adds.
func jobTables(job replay.ReplayJob) []string {
	var out []string
	for _, st := range job.Statements {
		out = append(out, st.TargetTableID)
	}
	if job.TableSetTransition != nil {
		for _, add := range job.TableSetTransition.Adds {
			out = append(out, add.TableID)
		}
	}
	slices.Sort(out)
	return slices.Compact(out)
}

// observe writes the job's tables, at their live incarnations, into the
// quiescence ledger before the job runs.
func (v *VerifyRole) observe(job replay.ReplayJob) error {
	keys := jobTables(job)
	if len(keys) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	snap, enabled := v.d.Registry.View()
	if !enabled {
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: block %d: the table registry is not enabled", job.BlockSeq)
	}
	tables := make([]QuiescentTable, 0, len(keys))
	for _, key := range keys {
		inc := snap.Live(key)
		if inc == nil || !inc.HasPhysicalTables() {
			return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: block %d names %s, which has no physical incarnation in the table registry", job.BlockSeq, key)
		}
		tables = append(tables, QuiescentTable{TableID: key, IncarnationSeq: inc.Seq})
	}
	return v.quiet.Observe(job.BlockSeq, tables)
}

// tablesReady is the attestation gate: every table the job names has this
// member's hg_member_unsafe replica of its live incarnation, at that
// incarnation's Keeper path, verified like an hg_unsafe table
// (ddl.VerifyProtocolTable as si_member). It never waits: the arbiter
// re-dispatches an unattested job.
func (v *VerifyRole) tablesReady(ctx context.Context, job replay.ReplayJob) error {
	keys := jobTables(job)
	if len(keys) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	snap, enabled := v.d.Registry.View()
	if !enabled {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: block %d: the table registry is not enabled", ErrMemberTableNotReady, job.BlockSeq)
	}
	for _, key := range keys {
		inc := snap.Live(key)
		if inc == nil || !inc.HasPhysicalTables() {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: block %d names %s, which has no physical incarnation in the table registry", ErrMemberTableNotReady, job.BlockSeq, key)
		}
		schema, err := dataplane.IncarnationSchema(v.cfg.NetworkID, v.cfg.Tables, *inc)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: block %d: %s: %v", ErrMemberTableNotReady, job.BlockSeq, key, err)
		}
		path := ddl.ZooKeeperPathFor(v.cfg.KeeperShardID, key, tableset.KeeperScopeOf(*inc))
		intent, err := ddl.MemberUnsafeIntent(v.pinned, schema, inc.Seq, path)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: block %d: %s: %v", ErrMemberTableNotReady, job.BlockSeq, key, err)
		}
		if err := ddl.VerifyProtocolTable(ctx, v.d.Conn, intent); err != nil {
			if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
				return ctxErr
			}
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: block %d: %s.%s (incarnation %d): %v", ErrMemberTableNotReady, job.BlockSeq, intent.Database, intent.Table, inc.Seq, err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (v *VerifyRole) nowMillis() uint64 {
	now := time.Now
	if v.d.Now != nil {
		now = v.d.Now
	}
	if ms := now().UnixMilli(); ms > 0 {
		return uint64(ms)
	}
	return 0
}
```

```go
package consensus

)

var poolsSchema = payloadexec.TableSchema{TableID: "dex.pools", Columns: []lthash.Column{{Name: "id", Type: "String"}}}

const createDatabase = "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS `hg_member_unsafe`"

type reconcilerHarness struct {
	r     *UnsafeReconciler
	conn  *chFake
	view  *viewFake
	arb   *arbiterFake
	dir   string
	logs  *syncBuffer
	shard uint32
}

// newReconciler is member-b's reconciler over the fakes; the purge node set
// lists member-b.
func newReconciler(t *testing.T, create bool, shard uint32, snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot) *reconcilerHarness {
	t.Helper()
	h := &reconcilerHarness{conn: newCHFake(), view: newViewFake(snap), arb: &arbiterFake{nodes: []string{"snode-1", testNodeID}},
		dir: t.TempDir(), logs: &syncBuffer{}, shard: shard}
	r, err := NewUnsafeReconciler(ReconcilerConfig{NodeID: testNodeID, StateDir: h.dir, KeeperShardID: shard, CreateReplicas: create, NetworkID: testNetworkID},
		ReconcilerDeps{DDLConn: h.conn, Registry: h.view, Arbiter: h.arb, Logger: textLogger(h.logs)})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	h.r = r
	return h
}

// createSQL is the CREATE TABLE of member-b's replica of inc at path.
func createSQL(t *testing.T, schema payloadexec.TableSchema, seq uint64, path string) string {
	t.Helper()
	intent, err := ddl.MemberUnsafeIntent(ddl.DefaultMemberPinned(testNodeID, 0, ""), schema, seq, path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return intent.SQL()
}

func (h *reconcilerHarness) pass(t *testing.T) error {
	t.Helper()
	return h.r.reconcile(context.Background())
}

func (h *reconcilerHarness) mustPass(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	if err := h.pass(t); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

// noSystemStatement fails if any statement the reconciler issued is a
// SYSTEM statement (SYSTEM DROP REPLICA above all).
func (h *reconcilerHarness) noSystemStatement(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	for _, s := range h.conn.statements() {
		if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(s)), "SYSTEM") {
			t.Fatalf("the reconciler issued %q", s)
		}
	}
}

func writeLedger(t *testing.T, dir, body string) {
	t.Helper()
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, QuiescenceFile), []byte(body), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
```
