```go
		{"not placed", true, true, []string{testNodeID}, []string{"member-c"}, nil, wire.TableStatusActive, false, true},
		{"no group", true, true, []string{testNodeID}, nil, nil, wire.TableStatusActive, false, true},
		{"retiring is never created", true, true, []string{testNodeID}, []string{testNodeID}, nil, wire.TableStatusRetiring, false, true},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			h := newReconciler(t, tc.create, 0, groupSnapshot(tc.purge, tc.members, tc.leaving, chainIncarnation(t, 3, swapsSchema, tc.status, true)))
			h.arb.nodes = tc.nodes
			h.mustPass(t)
			writes := h.conn.writes()
			if tc.want {
				if !slices.Equal(writes, []string{createDatabase, createSQL(t, swapsSchema, 3, path)}) {
					t.Fatalf("writes = %q, want the database and member-b's replica at %s", writes, path)
				}
				if got := h.r.Stats().Replicas; got != 1 {
					t.Fatalf("Replicas = %d, want 1", got)
				}
			} else if len(writes) != 0 || h.r.Stats().Replicas != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("writes = %q, Replicas %d: want none", writes, h.r.Stats().Replicas)
			}
			if asked := h.arb.calls > 0; asked != tc.askedSet {
				t.Fatalf("purge node set asked %v, want %v", asked, tc.askedSet)
			}
			if h.arb.reports != 0 {
				t.Fatal("the reconciler reported a purge")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestUnsafeReconcilerUsesTheIncarnationKeeperPath(t *testing.T) {
	scoped := chainIncarnation(t, 3, swapsSchema, wire.TableStatusActive, true)
	unscoped := chainIncarnation(t, 2, poolsSchema, wire.TableStatusActive, false)
	h := newReconciler(t, true, 4, groupSnapshot(true, []string{testNodeID}, nil, unscoped, scoped))
	h.mustPass(t)
	poolsIntent, err := ddl.MemberUnsafeIntent(ddl.DefaultMemberPinned(testNodeID, 4, ""), poolsSchema, 2, "/sentio/4/unsafe/dex__pools")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	swapsIntent, err := ddl.MemberUnsafeIntent(ddl.DefaultMemberPinned(testNodeID, 4, ""), swapsSchema, 3, "/sentio/4/unsafe_inc/dex__swaps/3")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := []string{createDatabase, poolsIntent.SQL(), createDatabase, swapsIntent.SQL()}
	if got := h.conn.writes(); !slices.Equal(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("writes = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
	if want := ddl.ZooKeeperPathFor(4, "dex.pools", ddl.KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: 2}); want != "/sentio/4/unsafe/dex__pools" {
		t.Fatalf("the unscoped path is %s", want)
	}
	// A second pass finds both replicas at their paths and changes nothing.
	h.mustPass(t)
	if got := h.conn.writes(); len(got) != 4 || h.r.Stats().Replicas != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("a second pass wrote %q (Replicas %d)", got[4:], h.r.Stats().Replicas)
	}
}

func TestUnsafeReconcilerStopsOnReplicaAlreadyExistsAndNeverDropsAReplica(t *testing.T) {
	path := "/sentio/0/unsafe_inc/dex__swaps/3"
	h := newReconciler(t, true, 0, groupSnapshot(true, []string{testNodeID}, nil,
		chainIncarnation(t, 2, poolsSchema, wire.TableStatusActive, true), chainIncarnation(t, 3, swapsSchema, wire.TableStatusActive, true)))
	h.conn.createErr["dex__swaps"] = &clickhouse.Exception{Code: 253, Name: "DB::Exception",
		Message: "Replica /sentio/0/unsafe_inc/dex__swaps/3/replicas/member-b already exists. (REPLICA_ALREADY_EXISTS)"}
	const text = "member consensus: hg_member_unsafe.dex__swaps: replica member-b already exists at /sentio/0/unsafe_inc/dex__swaps/3; not dropping it (si_member_ddl holds no SYSTEM DROP REPLICA); the owner's sweep removes it after an eviction"
	err := h.pass(t)
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrReplicaAlreadyExists) || err.Error() != text {
		t.Fatalf("pass = %v, want ErrReplicaAlreadyExists with %q", err, text)
	}
	st := h.r.Stats()
	if st.ReplicaAlreadyExists != 1 || st.Failures["dex.swaps"] != 1 || st.Replicas != 1 || !h.conn.has(ddl.MemberUnsafeDatabase, "dex__pools") {
		t.Fatalf("stats %+v: want one stop, one failure of dex.swaps and dex.pools created", st)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(h.logs.String(), "level=ERROR msg=\""+text+"\"") {
		t.Fatalf("logs = %s", h.logs.String())
	}
	// The table stays stopped: no second CREATE, no drop of anything.
	creates := 0
	if err := h.pass(t); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("a second pass = %v", err)
	}
	for _, s := range h.conn.writes() {
		if s == createSQL(t, swapsSchema, 3, path) {
			creates++
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(s, "DROP") {
			t.Fatalf("the reconciler dropped %q", s)
		}
	}
	if creates != 1 || h.r.Stats().ReplicaAlreadyExists != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("%d CREATEs of dex__swaps after a stop, %d stops; want 1 and 1", creates, h.r.Stats().ReplicaAlreadyExists)
	}
	h.noSystemStatement(t)
}

func TestUnsafeReconcilerKeepsTheReplicaThroughRetiringAndDropsItAtPurgingWhenQuiet(t *testing.T) {
	inc := chainIncarnation(t, 3, swapsSchema, wire.TableStatusActive, true)
	h := newReconciler(t, true, 0, groupSnapshot(true, []string{testNodeID}, nil, inc))
	h.mustPass(t)
	if !h.conn.has(ddl.MemberUnsafeDatabase, "dex__swaps") {
		t.Fatal("the active replica was not created")
	}
	written := len(h.conn.writes())
	inc.Status = wire.TableStatusRetiring
	h.view.set(groupSnapshot(true, []string{testNodeID}, nil, inc))
	h.mustPass(t)
	if got := h.conn.writes(); len(got) != written || h.r.Stats().Replicas != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("a retiring incarnation's replica was touched: %q", got[written:])
	}
	inc.Status = wire.TableStatusPurging
	h.view.set(groupSnapshot(true, []string{testNodeID}, nil, inc))
	// An unresolved block still names the table: keep it.
	writeLedger(t, h.dir, `{"version":1,"blocks":[{"block_seq":9,"tables":[{"table_id":"dex.swaps","incarnation_seq":3}]}]}`)
	h.mustPass(t)
	if got := h.conn.writes(); len(got) != written || h.r.Stats().Replicas != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("a purging replica named by an unresolved block was dropped: %q", got[written:])
	}
	// A ledger that cannot be read keeps it too.
	writeLedger(t, h.dir, `{`)
	if err := h.pass(t); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "quiescence.json is corrupt") {
		t.Fatalf("a corrupt ledger gave %v", err)
	}
	if !h.conn.has(ddl.MemberUnsafeDatabase, "dex__swaps") {
		t.Fatal("a purging replica was dropped without a readable ledger")
	}
	// Quiet: drop it, with DROP TABLE SYNC and nothing else.
	writeLedger(t, h.dir, `{"version":1,"blocks":[]}`)
	h.mustPass(t)
	want := "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hg_member_unsafe`.`dex__swaps` SYNC"
	if got := h.conn.writes(); len(got) != written+1 || got[written] != want || h.r.Stats().Replicas != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("writes after quiescence = %q, want only %q", got[written:], want)
	}
	h.mustPass(t)
	if got := h.conn.writes(); len(got) != written+1 {
		t.Fatalf("a purging incarnation was created again: %q", got[written+1:])
	}
	h.noSystemStatement(t)
}

func TestUnsafeReconcilerDropsAReleasedLeavingMembersReplicas(t *testing.T) {
	swaps := chainIncarnation(t, 3, swapsSchema, wire.TableStatusActive, true)
	pools := chainIncarnation(t, 2, poolsSchema, wire.TableStatusActive, true)
	leaving := []wire.LeavingMember{{NodeID: testNodeID, RemovedGeneration: 2}}
	h := newReconciler(t, true, 0, groupSnapshot(true, []string{"member-c"}, leaving, pools, swaps))
	h.mustPass(t)
	if h.r.Stats().Replicas != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("an unreleased Leaving member holds %d replicas, want 2", h.r.Stats().Replicas)
	}
	written := len(h.conn.writes())
	leaving[0].Released = true
	h.view.set(groupSnapshot(true, []string{"member-c"}, leaving, pools, swaps))
	writeLedger(t, h.dir, `{"version":1,"blocks":[{"block_seq":9,"tables":[{"table_id":"dex.swaps","incarnation_seq":3}]}]}`)
	h.mustPass(t)
	want := []string{"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hg_member_unsafe`.`dex__pools` SYNC"}
	if got := h.conn.writes()[written:]; !slices.Equal(got, want) || h.r.Stats().Replicas != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("released with swaps unresolved: writes %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
	writeLedger(t, h.dir, `{"version":1,"blocks":[]}`)
	h.mustPass(t)
	want = append(want, "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hg_member_unsafe`.`dex__swaps` SYNC")
	if got := h.conn.writes()[written:]; !slices.Equal(got, want) || h.r.Stats().Replicas != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("released and quiet: writes %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
	h.mustPass(t)
	if got := h.conn.writes()[written:]; len(got) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("a released member created a replica again: %q", got[2:])
	}
	h.noSystemStatement(t)
}

func TestUnsafeReconcilerLeavesATableItCannotAttribute(t *testing.T) {
	inc := chainIncarnation(t, 3, swapsSchema, wire.TableStatusPurging, true)
	h := newReconciler(t, true, 0, groupSnapshot(true, []string{testNodeID}, nil, inc))
	// A replicated root above the incarnation path, a replica named after
	// another node, and a table without an incarnation comment.
	h.conn.addRaw(ddl.MemberUnsafeDatabase, "dex__swaps", "hg_incarnation=3", "ReplicatedMergeTree('/sentio/0/unsafe_inc/dex__swaps', 'member-b') ORDER BY _hg_row_id")
	h.conn.addRaw(ddl.MemberUnsafeDatabase, "dex__trades", "", "ReplicatedMergeTree('/sentio/0/unsafe/dex__trades', 'member-b') ORDER BY _hg_row_id")
	h.mustPass(t)
	h.mustPass(t)
	if got := h.conn.writes(); len(got) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("the reconciler touched tables it cannot attribute: %q", got)
	}
	if n := strings.Count(h.logs.String(), "hg_member_unsafe table is not this member's replica of a known incarnation at its Keeper path; leaving it for an operator"); n != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("%d warnings over two passes, want one per table: %s", n, h.logs.String())
	}
}

func TestUnsafeReconcilerRecreatesASameNameTableAfterThePurge(t *testing.T) {
	old := chainIncarnation(t, 3, swapsSchema, wire.TableStatusActive, false)
	h := newReconciler(t, true, 0, groupSnapshot(true, []string{testNodeID}, nil, old))
	h.mustPass(t)
	old.Status = wire.TableStatusPurged
	recreated := chainIncarnation(t, 5, swapsSchema, wire.TableStatusPending, true)
	h.view.set(groupSnapshot(true, []string{testNodeID}, nil, old, recreated))
	h.mustPass(t)
	want := []string{createDatabase, createSQL(t, swapsSchema, 3, "/sentio/0/unsafe/dex__swaps"),
		"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hg_member_unsafe`.`dex__swaps` SYNC", createDatabase, createSQL(t, swapsSchema, 5, "/sentio/0/unsafe_inc/dex__swaps/5")}
	if got := h.conn.writes(); !slices.Equal(got, want) || h.r.Stats().Replicas != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("writes = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}

func TestUnsafeReconcilerRunsAtEveryRegistryChange(t *testing.T) {
	inc := chainIncarnation(t, 3, swapsSchema, wire.TableStatusActive, true)
	h := newReconciler(t, true, 0, groupSnapshot(false, []string{testNodeID}, nil, inc))
	h.r.cfg.Interval = time.Hour
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { done <- h.r.Run(ctx) }()
	time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)
	if h.conn.has(ddl.MemberUnsafeDatabase, "dex__swaps") {
		t.Fatal("a replica was created with the purge switch off")
	}
	h.view.set(groupSnapshot(true, []string{testNodeID}, nil, inc))
	deadline := time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second)
	for !h.conn.has(ddl.MemberUnsafeDatabase, "dex__swaps") {
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatal("the purge switch-on did not wake the reconciler")
		}
		time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	cancel()
	if err := <-done; !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		t.Fatalf("Run = %v", err)
	}
}

func TestNewUnsafeReconcilerRefusesAnIncompleteConfig(t *testing.T) {
	good := ReconcilerConfig{NodeID: testNodeID, StateDir: t.TempDir(), NetworkID: testNetworkID}
	deps := ReconcilerDeps{DDLConn: newCHFake(), Registry: newViewFake(wire.TableRegistrySnapshot{}), Arbiter: &arbiterFake{}}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name string
		edit func(*ReconcilerConfig, *ReconcilerDeps)
		want string
	}{
		{"no network id", func(c *ReconcilerConfig, _ *ReconcilerDeps) { c.NetworkID = "" }, "member consensus: network id is required"},
		{"no state dir", func(c *ReconcilerConfig, _ *ReconcilerDeps) { c.StateDir = "" }, "member consensus: state dir is required"},
		{"a bad storage policy", func(c *ReconcilerConfig, _ *ReconcilerDeps) { c.StoragePolicy = "member disk" },
			`member consensus: ddl: MemberPinned.StoragePolicy "member disk" must be a ClickHouse storage policy name ([A-Za-z0-9_]+)`},
		{"a negative interval", func(c *ReconcilerConfig, _ *ReconcilerDeps) { c.Interval = -time.Second }, "member consensus: reconcile interval must not be negative"},
		{"no arbiter", func(_ *ReconcilerConfig, d *ReconcilerDeps) { d.Arbiter = nil },
			"member consensus: the reconciler needs its si_member_ddl connection, the registry and the arbiter"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			cfg, d := good, deps
			tc.edit(&cfg, &d)
			if _, err := NewUnsafeReconciler(cfg, d); err == nil || err.Error() != tc.want {
				t.Fatalf("NewUnsafeReconciler = %v, want %q", err, tc.want)
			}
		})
	}
	r, err := NewUnsafeReconciler(good, deps)
	if err != nil || r.cfg.Interval != ddl.DefaultReconcileInterval {
		t.Fatalf("NewUnsafeReconciler = %v with interval %v, want the default", err, r.cfg.Interval)
	}
}
```

Create `member/confinement/consensus_test.go` (it runs only inside the confinement runner, with Plan S3-C2 Task 34's `setup`: a fenced 26.3 server with `table_engines_require_grant`, an embedded Keeper and `si_member` made from `SI_MEMBER_GRANTS`; `s.ddlUser()` makes `si_member_ddl` with its `CONST` profile):

```go
package confinement

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"regexp"
	"slices"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"
	"github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2/lib/driver"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/payloadexec"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/ddl"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member/consensus"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member/install"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// The stage-3 member consensus mode on the fenced server (Plan S3-E1 Task
// 62): the verify role's replay scratch as si_member, and the
// hg_member_unsafe reconciler as si_member_ddl.

const consensusNetwork = "confnet"

// statementRecorder passes every call to its connection and records the
// statement text of each Exec, Query, QueryRow and PrepareBatch.
type statementRecorder struct {
	clickhouse.Conn
	mu    sync.Mutex
	stmts []string
}

func (r *statementRecorder) record(q string) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	r.stmts = append(r.stmts, q)
}

func (r *statementRecorder) Exec(ctx context.Context, q string, args ...any) error {
	r.record(q)
	return r.Conn.Exec(ctx, q, args...)
}

func (r *statementRecorder) Query(ctx context.Context, q string, args ...any) (driver.Rows, error) {
	r.record(q)
	return r.Conn.Query(ctx, q, args...)
}

func (r *statementRecorder) QueryRow(ctx context.Context, q string, args ...any) driver.Row {
	r.record(q)
	return r.Conn.QueryRow(ctx, q, args...)
}

func (r *statementRecorder) PrepareBatch(ctx context.Context, q string, opts ...driver.PrepareBatchOption) (driver.Batch, error) {
	r.record(q)
	return r.Conn.PrepareBatch(ctx, q, opts...)
}

func (r *statementRecorder) statements() []string {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(r.stmts)
}

func TestMemberReplayScratchLivesInRstageUnderTheMemberPrefix(t *testing.T) {
	s := setup(t)
	nonce, err := install.NewBootNonce()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	prefix := consensus.ReplayScratchPrefix(memberNodeID, nonce)
	if !strings.HasPrefix(prefix, install.NodePrefix(memberNodeID)) || prefix != install.ScratchPrefix(memberNodeID, nonce)+"v" {
		t.Fatalf("replay prefix %q is not under the member's scratch prefix", prefix)
	}
	rec := &statementRecorder{Conn: s.member}
	m, err := consensus.NewReplayMaterializer(consensusNetwork, rec, memberNodeID, nonce)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	schema := testSchema(s.name("replay"))
	st := replay.PreparedStatement{Statement: replay.Statement{StatementID: "st-1", TargetTableID: schema.TableID,
		PayloadFormat: payloadexec.PayloadFormatCSVWithNames}, Payload: []byte("p,v\na,1\nb,2\n")}
	for range 2 {
		rows, err := m.Materialize(context.Background(), schema, st)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("Materialize as %s: %v", memberUser, err) // a 497 lands here
		}
		if len(rows) != 2 {
			t.Fatalf("Materialize read back %d rows, want 2", len(rows))
		}
	}
	scratch := regexp.MustCompile("`([^`]+)`\\.`([^`]+)`")
	seen := map[string][]string{}
	for _, q := range rec.statements() {
		refs := scratch.FindAllStringSubmatch(q, -1)
		if len(refs) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("statement %q names %d tables, want one scratch", q, len(refs))
		}
		db, table := refs[0][1], refs[0][2]
		if db != ddl.StageDatabase || !regexp.MustCompile("^"+regexp.QuoteMeta(prefix)+"replay_[0-9]+$").MatchString(table) {
			t.Fatalf("statement %q names %s.%s, want %s.%sreplay_<n>", q, db, table, ddl.StageDatabase, prefix)
		}
		verb := strings.Fields(q)[0]
		if verb == "CREATE" && !strings.Contains(q, ") ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()") {
			t.Fatalf("scratch %s is not created with an explicit MergeTree engine: %q", table, q)
		}
		seen[table] = append(seen[table], verb)
	}
	want := []string{"CREATE", "INSERT", "SELECT", "DROP"}
	if len(seen) != 2 || !slices.Equal(seen[prefix+"replay_1"], want) || !slices.Equal(seen[prefix+"replay_2"], want) {
		t.Fatalf("scratch statements %v, want %v for replay_1 and replay_2", seen, want)
	}
	if n := s.count(s.admin, "SELECT count() FROM system.tables WHERE database = ? AND startsWith(name, ?)", ddl.StageDatabase, prefix); n != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("%d replay scratch tables are left in %s", n, ddl.StageDatabase)
	}
}

// consensusView is an enabled registry view whose snapshot the test sets.
type consensusView struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	snap    wire.TableRegistrySnapshot
	changed chan struct{}
}

func newConsensusView(snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot) *consensusView {
	return &consensusView{snap: snap, changed: make(chan struct{})}
}

func (v *consensusView) View() (wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, bool) {
	v.mu.Lock()
	defer v.mu.Unlock()
	return v.snap, true
}

func (v *consensusView) Changed() <-chan struct{} {
	v.mu.Lock()
	defer v.mu.Unlock()
	return v.changed
}

func (v *consensusView) Ready() <-chan struct{} {
	ch := make(chan struct{})
	close(ch)
	return ch
}

func (v *consensusView) set(snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot) {
	v.mu.Lock()
	defer v.mu.Unlock()
	v.snap = snap
	close(v.changed)
	v.changed = make(chan struct{})
}

// consensusArbiter lists the owner's SNode and the member in the purge node
// set; a purge report fails the test (the reconciler never reports).
type consensusArbiter struct{ t *testing.T }

func (consensusArbiter) PurgeNodeSet(context.Context) ([]string, error) {
	return []string{memberNodeID, protocol.NodeID}, nil
}

func (a consensusArbiter) SubmitTablePurged(context.Context, string, uint64) error {
	a.t.Error("the member reconciler reported a purge")
	return errors.New("unexpected purge report")
}

// memberIncarnation is a chain incarnation of schema owned by indexer 0 on
// the incarnation-scoped Keeper path.
func memberIncarnation(t *testing.T, seq uint64, schema payloadexec.TableSchema, status wire.TableIncarnationStatus) wire.TableIncarnation {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := json.Marshal(schema)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	db, table, _ := strings.Cut(schema.TableID, ".")
	owner := uint64(0)
	return wire.TableIncarnation{Seq: seq, DatabaseID: db, TableID: table, Origin: wire.TableOriginChain, Status: status,
		SchemaJSON: string(b), SchemaHash: payloadexec.TableSchemaHash(consensusNetwork, schema), OwnerIndexerID: &owner, ScopedKeeperPath: true}
}

// memberGroupSnapshot places the member in G(0, <database>) with the purge
// switch on.
func memberGroupSnapshot(database string, incs ...wire.TableIncarnation) wire.TableRegistrySnapshot {
	return wire.TableRegistrySnapshot{Version: uint64(len(incs)) + 1, Incarnations: incs,
		Stage3: &arbiter.Stage3Params{GroupSize: 3, MinSafeCopies: 1, Purge: true, Placement: true},
		Groups: []wire.DatabaseGroup{{OwnerIndexerID: 0, DatabaseID: database, Generation: 1,
			Members: []wire.GroupMember{{NodeID: memberNodeID, JoinedGeneration: 1}}}}}
}

// activeParts lists a table's active parts as "name hash_of_all_files".
func (s *suite) activeParts(db, table string) []string {
	s.t.Helper()
	rows, err := s.admin.Query(context.Background(), "SELECT name, hash_of_all_files FROM system.parts WHERE database = ? AND table = ? AND active ORDER BY name", db, table)
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var out []string
	for rows.Next() {
		var name, hash string
		if err := rows.Scan(&name, &hash); err != nil {
			s.t.Fatal(err)
		}
		out = append(out, name+" "+hash)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		s.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return out
}

// keeperReplicas lists the replicas registered under a Keeper path.
func (s *suite) keeperReplicas(path string) []string {
	s.t.Helper()
	rows, err := s.admin.Query(context.Background(), "SELECT name FROM system.zookeeper WHERE path = ?", path+"/replicas")
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var out []string
	for rows.Next() {
		var name string
		if err := rows.Scan(&name); err != nil {
			s.t.Fatal(err)
		}
		out = append(out, name)
	}
	sort.Strings(out)
	return out
}

func waitFor(t *testing.T, what string, cond func() bool) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(60 * time.Second)
	for !cond() {
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatalf("timed out waiting for %s", what)
		}
		time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
	}
}

// runReconciler runs a reconciler as si_member_ddl until the test ends.
func runReconciler(t *testing.T, ddlConn clickhouse.Conn, view *consensusView, stateDir string) *consensus.UnsafeReconciler {
	t.Helper()
	r, err := consensus.NewUnsafeReconciler(consensus.ReconcilerConfig{NodeID: memberNodeID, StateDir: stateDir, KeeperShardID: 0,
		CreateReplicas: true, Interval: 200 * time.Millisecond, NetworkID: consensusNetwork},
		consensus.ReconcilerDeps{DDLConn: ddlConn, Registry: view, Arbiter: consensusArbiter{t: t}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { done <- r.Run(ctx) }()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		cancel()
		if err := <-done; !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
			t.Errorf("reconciler Run = %v", err)
		}
	})
	return r
}

func TestMemberUnsafeReplicaAsSIMemberDDLReplicatesTheOwnersParts(t *testing.T) {
	s := setup(t)
	ddlConn := s.ddlUser()
	database := "confdb_" + s.sfx
	schema := payloadexec.TableSchema{TableID: database + ".swaps", PartitionBy: "p", Columns: testSchema("x").Columns}
	table := ddl.CHTableName(schema.TableID)
	const seq = 7
	path := ddl.ZooKeeperPathFor(0, schema.TableID, ddl.KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: seq, Scoped: true})
	if path != "/sentio/0/unsafe_inc/"+table+"/7" {
		t.Fatalf("incarnation path %s", path)
	}

	// The owner's hg_unsafe replica of incarnation 7, made by the admin as the
	// owner's SNode makes it, with two parts.
	owner, _, _, err := ddl.Intents(protocol, schema)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	owner.ZooKeeperPath, owner.Comment = path, ddl.IncarnationComment(seq)
	s.exec(s.admin, "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS hg_unsafe")
	s.exec(s.admin, owner.SQL())
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		_ = s.admin.Exec(context.Background(), "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "+qualified(ddl.MemberUnsafeDatabase, table)+" SYNC")
		_ = s.admin.Exec(context.Background(), "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "+qualified("hg_unsafe", table)+" SYNC")
	})
	for i, p := range []string{"a", "b"} {
		s.exec(s.admin, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s (_hg_row_id, p, v) VALUES ('%s', '%s', %d)", qualified("hg_unsafe", table), rowID(i), p, i+1))
	}
	ownerParts := s.activeParts("hg_unsafe", table)
	if len(ownerParts) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("owner parts %v, want 2", ownerParts)
	}

	// The reconciler, as si_member_ddl, creates member-conf's replica at the
	// incarnation's path, and it fetches the owner's parts byte for byte.
	inc := memberIncarnation(t, seq, schema, wire.TableStatusActive)
	view := newConsensusView(memberGroupSnapshot(database, inc))
	r := runReconciler(t, ddlConn, view, t.TempDir())
	waitFor(t, "the member replica", func() bool { return r.Stats().Replicas == 1 })
	s.exec(s.member, "SYSTEM SYNC REPLICA "+qualified(ddl.MemberUnsafeDatabase, table))
	if got := s.activeParts(ddl.MemberUnsafeDatabase, table); !slices.Equal(got, ownerParts) {
		t.Fatalf("member parts %v, want the owner's %v (same names and hash_of_all_files)", got, ownerParts)
	}
	if got := s.keeperReplicas(path); !slices.Equal(got, []string{memberNodeID, protocol.NodeID}) {
		t.Fatalf("replicas at %s: %v", path, got)
	}
	// The verify role's readiness check passes as si_member.
	intent, err := ddl.MemberUnsafeIntent(pinned, schema, seq, path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := ddl.VerifyProtocolTable(context.Background(), s.member, intent); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("VerifyProtocolTable as %s: %v", memberUser, err)
	}

	// Purging and quiet: the replica is dropped with DROP TABLE … SYNC; the
	// owner's table, its parts and its Keeper replica stay.
	inc.Status = wire.TableStatusPurging
	view.set(memberGroupSnapshot(database, inc))
	waitFor(t, "the member replica to be dropped", func() bool {
		return r.Stats().Replicas == 0 && !s.tableExists(ddl.MemberUnsafeDatabase, table)
	})
	if got := s.keeperReplicas(path); !slices.Equal(got, []string{protocol.NodeID}) {
		t.Fatalf("replicas at %s after the drop: %v, want only the owner's", path, got)
	}
	if got := s.activeParts("hg_unsafe", table); !slices.Equal(got, ownerParts) {
		t.Fatalf("owner parts after the member drop %v, want %v", got, ownerParts)
	}
}

func TestMemberUnsafeReconcilerStopsOnAStaleReplicaAndDropsNothing(t *testing.T) {
	s := setup(t)
	ddlConn := s.ddlUser()
	database := "confdb_" + s.sfx
	schema := payloadexec.TableSchema{TableID: database + ".pools", PartitionBy: "p", Columns: testSchema("x").Columns}
	table := ddl.CHTableName(schema.TableID)
	const seq = 8
	path := ddl.ZooKeeperPathFor(0, schema.TableID, ddl.KeeperScope{IncarnationSeq: seq, Scoped: true})
	// A replica named member-conf already exists at the path: the admin's
	// table stands in for one a member left when it lost its state.
	stale := "stale_" + s.sfx
	s.exec(s.admin, "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS hg_unsafe")
	s.exec(s.admin, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s (_hg_row_id FixedString(32), p String, v UInt64) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree(%s, %s) PARTITION BY p ORDER BY (p, _hg_row_id)",
		qualified("hg_unsafe", stale), literal(path), literal(memberNodeID)))
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		_ = s.admin.Exec(context.Background(), "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS "+qualified("hg_unsafe", stale)+" SYNC")
	})
	view := newConsensusView(memberGroupSnapshot(database, memberIncarnation(t, seq, schema, wire.TableStatusActive)))
	r := runReconciler(t, ddlConn, view, t.TempDir())
	waitFor(t, "the REPLICA_ALREADY_EXISTS stop", func() bool { return r.Stats().ReplicaAlreadyExists == 1 })
	time.Sleep(time.Second) // several more passes
	if st := r.Stats(); st.ReplicaAlreadyExists != 1 || st.Replicas != 0 || st.Failures[schema.TableID] != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("stats %+v: want one stop and no replica", st)
	}
	if s.tableExists(ddl.MemberUnsafeDatabase, table) || !s.tableExists("hg_unsafe", stale) {
		t.Fatal("the stop created a member table or dropped the stale replica's table")
	}
	if got := s.keeperReplicas(path); !slices.Equal(got, []string{memberNodeID}) {
		t.Fatalf("replicas at %s: %v, want the stale member-conf left in place", path, got)
	}
}
```

Create `member/consensus/unsafe_reconciler.go`:

```go
package consensus

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log/slog"
	"maps"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/ddl"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/tableset"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// codeReplicaAlreadyExists is ClickHouse's REPLICA_ALREADY_EXISTS.
const codeReplicaAlreadyExists = 253

// ErrReplicaAlreadyExists stops the reconciler for one table: a replica
// named after this member already exists at the table's Keeper path, and
// si_member_ddl holds no SYSTEM DROP REPLICA to remove it.
var ErrReplicaAlreadyExists = errors.New("member consensus: replica already exists")

// replicaExistsError is ErrReplicaAlreadyExists with its table, replica and
// path.
type replicaExistsError struct{ table, replica, path string }

func (e replicaExistsError) Error() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("member consensus: hg_member_unsafe.%s: replica %s already exists at %s; not dropping it (si_member_ddl holds no SYSTEM DROP REPLICA); the owner's sweep removes it after an eviction", e.table, e.replica, e.path)
}

func (e replicaExistsError) Unwrap() error { return ErrReplicaAlreadyExists }

// ReconcilerDeps are the reconciler's collaborators.
type ReconcilerDeps struct {
	DDLConn  clickhouse.Conn /* si_member_ddl */
	Registry dataplane.RegistryView
	Arbiter  tableset.Arbiter /* PurgeNodeSet only */
	Logger   *slog.Logger
}

// ReconcilerStats is a point-in-time copy of the reconciler's metrics.
type ReconcilerStats struct {
	// Replicas counts this member's hg_member_unsafe replicas of known
	// incarnations after the last pass.
	Replicas int
	// ReplicaAlreadyExists counts the tables the reconciler stopped for.
	ReplicaAlreadyExists uint64
	// Failures counts failed creates and drops per table key.
	Failures map[string]uint64
}

// UnsafeReconciler creates and drops the member's hg_member_unsafe replicas
// for the groups it belongs to (spec §8.3, §8.8). It is the only code that
// runs as si_member_ddl, and it issues exactly CREATE DATABASE IF NOT
// EXISTS (no ENGINE), CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS of ddl.MemberUnsafeIntent,
// DROP TABLE IF EXISTS … SYNC of its own replicas, and reads system.tables;
// never SYSTEM DROP REPLICA.
type UnsafeReconciler struct {
	cfg    ReconcilerConfig
	d      ReconcilerDeps
	log    *slog.Logger
	pinned ddl.MemberPinned

	passMu sync.Mutex

	mu       sync.Mutex
	replicas int
	exists   uint64
	failures map[string]uint64
	// stopped names, as "<key>@<seq>", every incarnation whose create met
	// REPLICA_ALREADY_EXISTS; it is not created again by this process.
	stopped map[string]bool
	// unattributed names the local tables already reported as not this
	// member's replica of a known incarnation.
	unattributed map[string]bool
}

// NewUnsafeReconciler validates cfg and d.
func NewUnsafeReconciler(cfg ReconcilerConfig, d ReconcilerDeps) (*UnsafeReconciler, error) {
	if err := cfg.validate(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if d.DDLConn == nil || d.Registry == nil || d.Arbiter == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("member consensus: the reconciler needs its si_member_ddl connection, the registry and the arbiter")
	}
	log := d.Logger
	if log == nil {
		log = slog.Default()
	}
	return &UnsafeReconciler{
		cfg: cfg, d: d, log: log, pinned: cfg.pinned(),
		failures: map[string]uint64{}, stopped: map[string]bool{}, unattributed: map[string]bool{},
	}, nil
}

// Run reconciles at every registry change and every Interval until ctx
// ends; a failed pass is retried with ddl.ReconcileBackoff.
func (r *UnsafeReconciler) Run(ctx context.Context) error {
	failures := 0
	for {
		changed := r.d.Registry.Changed()
		err := r.reconcile(ctx)
		delay := r.cfg.Interval
		switch {
		case ctx.Err() != nil:
			return ctx.Err()
		case err != nil:
			failures++
			delay = ddl.ReconcileBackoff(failures, r.cfg.Interval)
			r.log.Warn("member hg_member_unsafe reconcile failed; retrying", "consecutive_failures", failures, "retry_in", delay, "err", err)
		default:
			failures = 0
		}
		timer := time.NewTimer(delay)
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			timer.Stop()
			return ctx.Err()
		case <-timer.C:
		case <-changed:
			timer.Stop()
		}
	}
}

// Stats returns a copy of the reconciler's metrics.
func (r *UnsafeReconciler) Stats() ReconcilerStats {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	return ReconcilerStats{Replicas: r.replicas, ReplicaAlreadyExists: r.exists, Failures: maps.Clone(r.failures)}
}

// localReplica is one table of hg_member_unsafe as si_member_ddl sees it in
// system.tables.
type localReplica struct {
	name, comment, engineFull string
}

// reconcile is one pass. A replica is wanted while the member is placed in
// the incarnation's group (a current member, or Leaving and not released)
// and the incarnation is Pending, Active or Retiring; it is created only
// while CreateReplicas is set, the member is in the purge node set, the
// purge switch is on and the incarnation is Pending or Active. Every other
// replica the member holds of a known incarnation (Purging, a released
// Leaving record, no longer placed, not physical) is dropped once its table
// is quiet. A table that is not this member's replica of a known incarnation
// at that incarnation's Keeper path is reported and never dropped.
func (r *UnsafeReconciler) reconcile(ctx context.Context) error {
	r.passMu.Lock()
	defer r.passMu.Unlock()
	snap, enabled := r.d.Registry.View()
	if !enabled {
		return nil
	}
	local, err := r.listLocal(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	byName := make(map[string]localReplica, len(local))
	for _, l := range local {
		byName[l.name] = l
	}
	purgeOn := snap.Stage3 != nil && snap.Stage3.Purge
	createOK := false
	if r.cfg.CreateReplicas && purgeOn {
		nodes, err := r.d.Arbiter.PurgeNodeSet(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: purge node set: %w", err)
		}
		createOK = slices.Contains(nodes, r.cfg.NodeID)
	}
	ledger, ledgerErr := ReadQuiescence(r.cfg.StateDir)

	var errs []error
	held := 0
	attributed := map[string]bool{}
	for _, inc := range snap.Incarnations {
		key := inc.Key()
		name := ddl.CHTableName(key)
		path := ddl.ZooKeeperPathFor(r.cfg.KeeperShardID, key, tableset.KeeperScopeOf(inc))
		placed := r.placed(snap, inc)
		l, present := byName[name]
		if !present {
			creatable := inc.Status == wire.TableStatusPending || inc.Status == wire.TableStatusActive
			if !createOK || !placed || !creatable || r.isStopped(key, inc.Seq) {
				continue
			}
			if err := r.create(ctx, inc, path); err != nil {
				r.fail(key)
				errs = append(errs, err)
				continue
			}
			byName[name] = localReplica{name: name, comment: ddl.IncarnationComment(inc.Seq), engineFull: engineHead(path, r.cfg.NodeID)}
			attributed[name] = true
			held++
			r.log.Info("member hg_member_unsafe replica created", "table", name, "incarnation", inc.Seq, "zookeeper_path", path)
			continue
		}
		if seq, ok := ddl.ParseIncarnationComment(l.comment); !ok || seq != inc.Seq {
			continue // another incarnation's table holds the name (or none's)
		}
		if !strings.HasPrefix(l.engineFull, engineHead(path, r.cfg.NodeID)) {
			continue // not at this incarnation's Keeper path: reported below
		}
		attributed[name] = true
		wanted := placed && (inc.Status == wire.TableStatusPending || inc.Status == wire.TableStatusActive || inc.Status == wire.TableStatusRetiring)
		switch {
		case wanted:
			held++
		case ledgerErr != nil:
			errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: keep %s.%s: %w", r.pinned.MemberUnsafeDB, name, ledgerErr))
			held++
		case !ledger.Quiet(key, inc.Seq):
			r.log.Debug("member hg_member_unsafe replica waits for quiescence", "table", name, "incarnation", inc.Seq)
			held++
		default:
			if err := r.drop(ctx, name); err != nil {
				r.fail(key)
				errs = append(errs, err)
				held++
				continue
			}
			delete(byName, name)
			r.log.Info("member hg_member_unsafe replica dropped", "table", name, "incarnation", inc.Seq, "status", inc.Status, "placed", placed)
		}
	}
	for _, l := range local {
		if attributed[l.name] {
			continue
		}
		r.mu.Lock()
		reported := r.unattributed[l.name]
		r.unattributed[l.name] = true
		r.mu.Unlock()
		if !reported {
			r.log.Warn("hg_member_unsafe table is not this member's replica of a known incarnation at its Keeper path; leaving it for an operator",
				"table", l.name, "comment", l.comment, "engine_full", l.engineFull)
		}
	}
	r.mu.Lock()
	r.replicas = held
	r.mu.Unlock()
	return errors.Join(errs...)
}

// placed reports whether the member is in inc's group: a current member, or
// Leaving and not released.
func (r *UnsafeReconciler) placed(snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, inc wire.TableIncarnation) bool {
	g, ok := snap.Group(snap.Owner(inc), inc.DatabaseID)
	if !ok {
		return false
	}
	for _, m := range g.Members {
		if m.NodeID == r.cfg.NodeID {
			return true
		}
	}
	for _, l := range g.Leaving {
		if l.NodeID == r.cfg.NodeID && !l.Released {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// create makes the replica of inc at path. REPLICA_ALREADY_EXISTS stops
// the incarnation for this process (ErrReplicaAlreadyExists): the replica
// named after this member is never dropped from here.
func (r *UnsafeReconciler) create(ctx context.Context, inc wire.TableIncarnation, path string) error {
	key := inc.Key()
	schema, err := dataplane.IncarnationSchema(r.cfg.NetworkID, r.cfg.Tables, inc)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: %s: %w", key, err)
	}
	intent, err := ddl.MemberUnsafeIntent(r.pinned, schema, inc.Seq, path)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: %s: %w", key, err)
	}
	if err := r.d.DDLConn.Exec(ctx, "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS "+quoteIdent(r.pinned.MemberUnsafeDB)); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: create database %s: %w", r.pinned.MemberUnsafeDB, err)
	}
	if err := r.d.DDLConn.Exec(ctx, intent.SQL()); err != nil {
		var ex *clickhouse.Exception
		if errors.As(err, &ex) && ex.Code == codeReplicaAlreadyExists {
			stop := replicaExistsError{table: intent.Table, replica: r.cfg.NodeID, path: path}
			r.mu.Lock()
			r.stopped[stopKey(key, inc.Seq)] = true
			r.exists++
			r.mu.Unlock()
			r.log.Error(stop.Error(), "table", intent.Table, "incarnation", inc.Seq, "zookeeper_path", path)
			return stop
		}
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: create %s.%s: %w", intent.Database, intent.Table, err)
	}
	return nil
}

// drop removes one of the member's own replicas: DROP TABLE … SYNC removes
// the local table and this member's replica from Keeper.
func (r *UnsafeReconciler) drop(ctx context.Context, name string) error {
	q := fmt.Sprintf("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS %s.%s SYNC", quoteIdent(r.pinned.MemberUnsafeDB), quoteIdent(name))
	if err := r.d.DDLConn.Exec(ctx, q); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: drop %s.%s: %w", r.pinned.MemberUnsafeDB, name, err)
	}
	return nil
}

// listLocal reads hg_member_unsafe's tables from system.tables, the one
// system table si_member_ddl can read.
func (r *UnsafeReconciler) listLocal(ctx context.Context) ([]localReplica, error) {
	rows, err := r.d.DDLConn.Query(ctx, `SELECT name, comment, engine_full FROM system.tables WHERE database = ? ORDER BY name`, r.pinned.MemberUnsafeDB)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: list %s: %w", r.pinned.MemberUnsafeDB, err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var out []localReplica
	for rows.Next() {
		var l localReplica
		if err := rows.Scan(&l.name, &l.comment, &l.engineFull); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: list %s: %w", r.pinned.MemberUnsafeDB, err)
		}
		out = append(out, l)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: list %s: %w", r.pinned.MemberUnsafeDB, err)
	}
	return out, nil
}

func (r *UnsafeReconciler) isStopped(key string, seq uint64) bool {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	return r.stopped[stopKey(key, seq)]
}

func (r *UnsafeReconciler) fail(key string) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	r.failures[key]++
}

func stopKey(key string, seq uint64) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%s@%d", key, seq) }

// engineHead is how system.tables.engine_full starts for a replica at path
// named replica: ClickHouse renders the two engine arguments as quoted
// literals.
func engineHead(path, replica string) string {
	return "ReplicatedMergeTree(" + quoteLiteral(path) + ", " + quoteLiteral(replica) + ")"
}

func quoteIdent(id string) string {
	return "`" + strings.NewReplacer(`\`, `\\`, "`", "``").Replace(id) + "`"
}

func quoteLiteral(s string) string {
	return "'" + strings.NewReplacer(`\`, `\\`, `'`, `\'`).Replace(s) + "'"
}
```

## Task 63: arbiter-core — member gateway clients, readiness and checkpoint signing, the hard-link source, purge reports, `stage3_v1` and release CORE_TAG_P5 (S3-E1)

Spec §6.4 (`MemberReady`, signed with the node's ed25519 key), §8.6 first bullet (the member's own `hg_member_unsafe` as byte source), §8.8 (purge reports after the drop and the quiescence hook; at once for an incarnation never held), §9.1 (`MemberCheckpoint`, `checkpoint_seq` above the journal and the published value), §10.3 (`stage3_v1`), §15 and §16 P5; contract §42.3 (Task 63), §43; clarifications K63, K65, K66, K67. Tasks 59–62 left on the branch `urwt/claude/multi-source-s3e1` of arbiter-core the canonical types and purposes (Task 59), the wire converters and the registry view of groups (Task 60), the incarnation-scoped Keeper paths (Task 61), and the shared evidence handler with the member's verify role, quiescence ledger and `hg_member_unsafe` reconciler (Task 62). This task finishes the member consensus mode on top of them and releases the branch:

- `dataplane.Client.SubmitMemberReady` / `SubmitMemberCheckpoint` with `dataplane.ErrStage3SwitchOff` for the leader's refusal before a switch (K67);
- in `member/consensus`: readiness (`PlanReadiness`, `LocalReplicas` read after `SYSTEM SYNC REPLICA`), checkpoint planning over the install journal (`OwnerInstallState`, `TableInstallState`, `PlanCheckpoint`) with the closed exclusion reasons, the durable `checkpoint_seq` (`CheckpointSeqStore`, `checkpoint_seq.json`), the `replica_signer` checkpoint signer (`CheckpointSigner`), purge reports, the status the serving view carries (`Status`, `GroupStatus`) and the member series (`Metrics`), run by one `consensus.Mode`;
- the hard-link byte source `sources.MemberUnsafeHardlink` (`member_unsafe_hardlink`), first in consensus mode;
- `member.Config.Consensus` (nil keeps the P2/P3 member byte for byte), `Role.ConsensusMetrics()` and `serve.ServingView.Consensus`;
- `arbiter.Stage3Feature` (`stage3_v1`) in `LocalNodeFeatures()` (K65);
- the housegate pin `HG_TAG_P5`, the README, the one PR of Tasks 59–63, the release `CORE_TAG_P5` and its record in Appendix C.

Nothing here changes consensus state or devnet2: every step of the mode waits for its `stage3` switch, which no arbiter sets before S3-E2–E4, and the mode itself runs only with `member.Config.Consensus`, which nothing sets before S3-E4 Task 79's config keys and S3-F's values.

Notes:
- **Base.** The URWT worktree `~/src/remotesrc/claude/arbiter-core/multi-source-s3e1` of Task 59, on `urwt/claude/multi-source-s3e1`, holding Tasks 59–62's commits on `CORE_TAG_P4` (Plan S3-D Task 50); this task adds its commits to the same branch and opens the branch's one PR (contract §43). Step 1 checks, by their contract signatures, every name this task consumes from Tasks 59–62. The line anchors of the hunks below are those of the scratch base described under Measured; S3-D and Tasks 59–62 move some of them, so each hunk anchors on text and applies the intent where a line moved (the hunk rule of the Global Constraints).
- **One mode, one name beyond the contract.** Contract §42.3 lists the parts of the consensus mode but no type that runs them. `consensus.Mode` (`NewMode`, `ModeDeps`, `InstallView`, `(*Mode).Run`, `Status`, `Metrics`) is that runner: `member.Role` builds it in `New` with the member's own connections and runs it in startup step (9) beside the copyset, the feed and the serving server, handing it the feed's verified manifest store and the installer. The mode builds Task 62's `VerifyRole` itself (it needs the manifest store, which exists only from step 7). Names added beyond contract §42.3 (Appendix B): `Mode`, `NewMode`, `ModeDeps`, `InstallView`, `InstallStateOf`, `ReplicaPaths`, `ReadLocalReplicas`, `ReplicaSyncTimeout`, `(*CheckpointSigner).Address`, `OffStatus`, `ModeOff`, `ModeConsensus`, `ClassLeaving`, the label constants `EvidenceReplay`, `EvidenceScan`, `EvidenceSubmitted`, `EvidenceRefused`, `CheckpointAccepted`, `CheckpointSwitchOff`, `CheckpointRefused`, `ReconcilerMetrics` / `NewReconcilerMetrics` (the reconciler process's two series, for S3-E4 Task 79), `sources.SourceMemberUnsafeHardlink`, `serve.Deps.Consensus`; tests `TestReadLocalReplicasReportsOnlyTheIncarnationsSyncedReplica`, `TestModeRegistersBeforeItReportsAndRetriesARefusedRegistration`, `TestConsensusMetricsExportEveryLabelIncludingZeros`, `TestVerifyRoleCountsItsEvidence`, `TestConsensusConfigWiresTheModeIntoTheRole`, `TestServingViewCarriesTheConsensusStatus`.
- **Every step waits for its switch and for the registration.** Readiness runs only while the registry's `stage3.placement` is on, checkpoints only while `stage3.checkpoints` is on, and both only once the member registered as a VERIFIER in this process (`Config.Register`, S3-F step 4): Apply refuses either from a node that is not a registered verifier (Plan S3-E3 §52.1 refusal 5, §52.3 refusal 4), so a member that has not registered sends nothing. Purge reports do not wait for the registration, so a member that registered in an earlier run never holds a purge.
- **The switch refusal and the FSM's refusals arrive alike.** The arbiter answers a member command before its switch with FAILED_PRECONDITION and the K67 text, and also maps every Apply refusal of `MemberReady` and `MemberCheckpoint` to FAILED_PRECONDITION with the FSM's text (Plan S3-E3 §52.1 RPC step 5, §52.3 RPC step 5). `dataplane.ErrStage3SwitchOff` therefore wraps both, as contract §42.3 defines it (any leader precondition without a NotLeader detail); the mode reads the switch refusal by its K67 text, counts it `switch_off` and logs it at info, and counts any other refusal `refused` and logs it at warn. Neither pages; both are retried at the next interval, and a refused checkpoint is signed again under the next `checkpoint_seq`.
- **Readiness covers the replicas the reconciler keeps.** `PlanReadiness` reports a group ready once the live incarnation of each table of its database owned by its owner that is Pending, Active or Retiring has a synced local replica at that incarnation's Keeper path. Contract §42.3 says "every physical incarnation"; a Purging one is left out, because the reconciler drops a Purging incarnation's replica once it is quiet and never creates one (contract §42.3), so including it would hold a joining member's readiness until the purge completed. Recorded in Appendix B as a refinement of §42.3.
- **What a checkpoint excludes.** A group of the checkpoint lists, sorted by table id, every table of its database whose live incarnation is physical and owned by the owner and that the member has not installed at the checkpoint's manifest (Plan S3-E3 §52.3 refusal 10 accepts exactly such tables): a copy marked Foreign or Diverged as `foreign` or `diverged`; any other copy as `audit_pending` while the installer's audit is not clean (the global flag the serving view reads too, S3-C4); a copy behind the manifest as `disk_threshold` while installs are paused, else `not_installed`, which also names a Pending or Active table without a copy and a copy of an earlier incarnation of a re-created table; a Retiring or Purging table as `retiring`. Over-exclusion only lowers what the floor counts.
- **Quiescence.** Task 62's verify role observes every job into `quiescence.json` and resolves the ledger every `Config.ResolveInterval` (contract §42.3 gives `Resolve` and its interval to Task 62's `Quiescence`); this task only reads it, through `ReadQuiescence`, as the reconciler process does. Open question for the orchestrator: if Task 62's `VerifyRole.Run` does not run `Resolve`, no block ever resolves and no purge is reported, which fails safe (no drop, no premature report) but holds every purge.
- **The verify role's boot nonce.** Contract §42.3 puts the verify role's replay scratch under `install.ScratchPrefix(NodeID, bootNonce) + "v"` "with `member.Role`'s boot nonce", but neither `consensus.Config` nor `VerifyDeps` carries one, and `Role` draws its nonce only in startup step (7). This task assumes Task 62's `NewVerifyRole` draws its own with `install.NewBootNonce()`: the prefix is still under `install.NodePrefix(NodeID)`, so the role's startup drop removes its scratch, and a nonce other than the installer's never meets an install scratch name. Open question for the orchestrator: if Task 62 adds a field for it instead, `Mode.Run` gains the role's nonce as a parameter and `runParts` passes it.
- **Evidence counts.** `sentio_node_si_member_evidence_total{kind,result}` needs the result of each dispatch the verify role handles. Step 10 edits Task 62's `member/consensus` sources with a short checked script: it adds the field `metrics *Metrics` to `VerifyRole` and wraps the role's one call of the evidence handler's `HandleReplayJob` and of its `HandleScanRequest` in `v.countEvidence(...)`, refusing to write anything unless each occurs exactly once.
- **The serving view.** `serve.ServingView` gains `Consensus consensus.Status` (`json:"consensus"`), filled from the new `serve.Deps.Consensus`; without it (and without `member.Config.Consensus`) the view says `{"mode":"off","registered":false,"groups":[]}`. The P3 view of a role without `Config.Serve` stays `serve.ServingView{}`.
- **Two pre-existing pins learn something beyond contract §42.** S3-C2 Task 34's `TestLocalNodeFeaturesAreUnchangedThroughP2` (`member/role_test.go`) pins exactly three features; it learns `stage3_v1` with the two pins contract §42.3 names (Appendix B: a contract issue, the test is outside §42's list). `sources.SourceNames` (pinned by S3-C2's `source_test.go`) stays the P2 list; the hard-link source's name is its own constant, and `member.Stats().Installs` carries `member_unsafe_hardlink` at zero only in consensus mode, so the P2/P3 member's series are unchanged.
- **CI.** CI's `data-plane integration` job (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) gains `//member/consensus:consensus_test`, unless Task 62 added it, so `TestReadLocalReplicasReportsOnlyTheIncarnationsSyncedReplica` runs on its two-node pair with shared Keeper; `//member/sources:sources_test`, where the hard-link test lives, is in the job already.
- **Helper names.** The unexported helpers this task adds to `member/consensus` (`memberIdent`, `liveTablesOf`, `readinessTables`, `awaitingReadiness`, `statusOf`, `readyGroupCount`, `switchOff`, the `fixture*` and `mode*` test helpers) are chosen not to meet Task 62's; if one does, rename this task's and record it.

- [ ] **Step 2: Write the failing tests of the member gateway clients**

Create `dataplane/member_commands_test.go`:

```go
package dataplane

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/grpc"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// memberGateway serves the two member RPCs of VerifierGateway and records
// every request. A peer with hint answers NotLeader naming it; one with err
// refuses with it; otherwise it acknowledges.
type memberGateway struct {
	pb.UnimplementedVerifierGatewayServer

	mu          sync.Mutex
	hint        string
	err         error
	ready       []*pb.MemberReadyCmd
	checkpoints []*pb.MemberCheckpointCmd
}

func (g *memberGateway) refusal() error {
	if g.hint != "" {
		st, err := status.New(codes.FailedPrecondition, "not leader").WithDetails(&pb.NotLeader{LeaderAddr: g.hint})
		if err != nil {
			return status.Error(codes.Internal, err.Error())
		}
		return st.Err()
	}
	return g.err
}

func (g *memberGateway) SubmitMemberReady(_ context.Context, cmd *pb.MemberReadyCmd) (*pb.Ack, error) {
	g.mu.Lock()
	defer g.mu.Unlock()
	g.ready = append(g.ready, cmd)
	if err := g.refusal(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &pb.Ack{}, nil
}

func (g *memberGateway) SubmitMemberCheckpoint(_ context.Context, cmd *pb.MemberCheckpointCmd) (*pb.Ack, error) {
	g.mu.Lock()
	defer g.mu.Unlock()
	g.checkpoints = append(g.checkpoints, cmd)
	if err := g.refusal(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &pb.Ack{}, nil
}

func (g *memberGateway) setErr(err error) {
	g.mu.Lock()
	defer g.mu.Unlock()
	g.err = err
}

func (g *memberGateway) requests() ([]*pb.MemberReadyCmd, []*pb.MemberCheckpointCmd) {
	g.mu.Lock()
	defer g.mu.Unlock()
	return append([]*pb.MemberReadyCmd(nil), g.ready...), append([]*pb.MemberCheckpointCmd(nil), g.checkpoints...)
}

func startMemberGateway(t *testing.T, g *memberGateway) string {
	t.Helper()
	srv := grpc.NewServer()
	pb.RegisterVerifierGatewayServer(srv, g)
	return serveGRPCForDataplaneTest(t, srv)
}

func memberReadyFixture() wire.MemberReady {
	return wire.MemberReady{NodeID: "member-b", OwnerIndexerID: 0, DatabaseID: "dex", Generation: 3, Ed25519Signature: "ab12"}
}

func memberCheckpointFixture() wire.MemberCheckpoint {
	return wire.MemberCheckpoint{
		Checkpoint: arbiter.MemberCheckpoint{
			NodeID: "member-b", OwnerIndexerID: 0, CheckpointSeq: 7, SnapshotID: "0xsnap",
			Groups: []arbiter.CheckpointGroup{{DatabaseID: "dex", GroupGeneration: 3,
				Excluded: []arbiter.ExcludedTable{{TableID: "dex.pools", Reason: arbiter.ExclusionNotInstalled}}}},
			Entry: replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: 0, SafeBlockSeq: 90, AppliedPromotionSeq: 40},
		},
		ReplicaJWS: "h.p.s",
	}
}

// switchOffErr is the leader's answer before a stage-3 switch (plan S3-E1
// K67): FAILED_PRECONDITION without a NotLeader detail.
func switchOffErr(text string) error { return status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, text) }

// TestSubmitMemberReadyAcksAndMapsTheSwitchRefusal: a follower's NotLeader is
// followed and the leader receives the request as given; an Ack is nil; the
// leader's refusal before the placement switch wraps ErrStage3SwitchOff with
// its text and is not retried; any other refusal comes back unchanged.
func TestSubmitMemberReadyAcksAndMapsTheSwitchRefusal(t *testing.T) {
	follower := &memberGateway{hint: "n2"}
	leader := &memberGateway{}
	c := newTestClient(t, Peer{ID: "n1", GRPCAddr: startMemberGateway(t, follower)}, Peer{ID: "n2", GRPCAddr: startMemberGateway(t, leader)})
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	cmd := memberReadyFixture()

	if err := c.SubmitMemberReady(ctx, cmd); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("SubmitMemberReady: %v", err)
	}
	followerReqs, _ := follower.requests()
	leaderReqs, _ := leader.requests()
	if len(followerReqs) != 1 || len(leaderReqs) != 1 || !proto.Equal(leaderReqs[0], wire.MemberReadyToRequest(cmd)) {
		t.Fatalf("requests: follower %v, leader %v; want one each, the leader's equal to %v", followerReqs, leaderReqs, wire.MemberReadyToRequest(cmd))
	}

	const text = "member readiness is refused until the placement switch is on"
	leader.setErr(switchOffErr(text))
	err := c.SubmitMemberReady(ctx, cmd)
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrStage3SwitchOff) || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), text) {
		t.Fatalf("SubmitMemberReady before the placement switch = %v, want ErrStage3SwitchOff carrying %q", err, text)
	}
	if leaderReqs, _ = leader.requests(); len(leaderReqs) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("the switch refusal was asked %d times in all, want 2 (one per call, never retried)", len(leaderReqs))
	}

	leader.setErr(status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "member ready: signature does not verify"))
	err = c.SubmitMemberReady(ctx, cmd)
	if errors.Is(err, ErrStage3SwitchOff) || status.Code(err) != codes.InvalidArgument {
		t.Fatalf("SubmitMemberReady refused with InvalidArgument = %v, want the gRPC error unchanged", err)
	}
}

// TestSubmitMemberCheckpointAcksAndMapsTheSwitchRefusal: the same for the
// checkpoint, with every field of the signed checkpoint on the wire.
func TestSubmitMemberCheckpointAcksAndMapsTheSwitchRefusal(t *testing.T) {
	follower := &memberGateway{hint: "n2"}
	leader := &memberGateway{}
	c := newTestClient(t, Peer{ID: "n1", GRPCAddr: startMemberGateway(t, follower)}, Peer{ID: "n2", GRPCAddr: startMemberGateway(t, leader)})
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	cmd := memberCheckpointFixture()

	if err := c.SubmitMemberCheckpoint(ctx, cmd); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("SubmitMemberCheckpoint: %v", err)
	}
	_, followerReqs := follower.requests()
	_, leaderReqs := leader.requests()
	if len(followerReqs) != 1 || len(leaderReqs) != 1 || !proto.Equal(leaderReqs[0], wire.MemberCheckpointToRequest(cmd)) {
		t.Fatalf("requests: follower %v, leader %v; want one each, the leader's equal to %v", followerReqs, leaderReqs, wire.MemberCheckpointToRequest(cmd))
	}
	if got := leaderReqs[0].GetCheckpoint(); got.GetCheckpointSeq() != 7 || got.GetEntry().GetSafeBlockSeq() != 90 ||
		got.GetGroups()[0].GetExcluded()[0].GetReason() != pb.CheckpointExclusionReason_CHECKPOINT_EXCLUSION_REASON_NOT_INSTALLED || leaderReqs[0].GetReplicaJws() != "h.p.s" {
		t.Fatalf("checkpoint on the wire = %v", leaderReqs[0])
	}

	const text = "member checkpoints are refused until the checkpoints switch is on"
	leader.setErr(switchOffErr(text))
	err := c.SubmitMemberCheckpoint(ctx, cmd)
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrStage3SwitchOff) || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), text) {
		t.Fatalf("SubmitMemberCheckpoint before the checkpoints switch = %v, want ErrStage3SwitchOff carrying %q", err, text)
	}
	if _, leaderReqs = leader.requests(); len(leaderReqs) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("the switch refusal was asked %d times in all, want 2 (one per call, never retried)", len(leaderReqs))
	}

	leader.setErr(status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "member checkpoint: checkpoint_seq 7 is not above the stored 9"))
	err = c.SubmitMemberCheckpoint(ctx, cmd)
	if errors.Is(err, ErrStage3SwitchOff) || status.Code(err) != codes.InvalidArgument {
		t.Fatalf("SubmitMemberCheckpoint refused with InvalidArgument = %v, want the gRPC error unchanged", err)
	}
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Add the two gateway clients and `ErrStage3SwitchOff`, and commit**

`WithLeaderRetry` reads every FAILED_PRECONDITION as a leader miss and tries the next peer; a leader's own precondition (no NotLeader detail, `leaderPrecondition`) is intercepted inside the call, as `SubmitTablePurgedReport` does (`dataplane/table_purge.go`), so it ends the call at once. Create `dataplane/member_commands.go`:

```go
package dataplane

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/grpc"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// ErrStage3SwitchOff is a stage-3 member RPC's answer before its switch (plan
// S3-E1 K67): the leader's FAILED_PRECONDITION without a NotLeader detail. A
// member reads it as "not yet": it retries at its interval and never pages.
var ErrStage3SwitchOff = errors.New("dataplane: the arbiter refuses this stage-3 command until its switch is on")

// SubmitMemberReady submits one signed MemberReady (Raft tag 40) to the
// leader. It returns nil on Ack (a repeat at the same generation is
// idempotent), an error wrapping ErrStage3SwitchOff with the leader's message
// on a FAILED_PRECONDITION without a NotLeader detail (before the placement
// switch), and the gRPC error otherwise.
func (c *Client) SubmitMemberReady(ctx context.Context, cmd wire.MemberReady) error {
	req := wire.MemberReadyToRequest(cmd)
	return c.submitStage3(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, conn *grpc.ClientConn) error {
		_, err := pb.NewVerifierGatewayClient(conn).SubmitMemberReady(ctx, req)
		return err
	})
}

// SubmitMemberCheckpoint submits one signed MemberCheckpoint (Raft tag 41) to
// the leader, with the answers of SubmitMemberReady (the switch is the
// checkpoints switch).
func (c *Client) SubmitMemberCheckpoint(ctx context.Context, cmd wire.MemberCheckpoint) error {
	req := wire.MemberCheckpointToRequest(cmd)
	return c.submitStage3(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, conn *grpc.ClientConn) error {
		_, err := pb.NewVerifierGatewayClient(conn).SubmitMemberCheckpoint(ctx, req)
		return err
	})
}

// submitStage3 runs call through WithLeaderRetry, which treats every
// FAILED_PRECONDITION as a leader miss; a leader's own precondition is
// intercepted here, so it ends the call instead of being retried.
func (c *Client) submitStage3(ctx context.Context, call func(ctx context.Context, conn *grpc.ClientConn) error) error {
	var switchOff error
	err := c.WithLeaderRetry(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, conn *grpc.ClientConn) error {
		err := call(ctx, conn)
		if st, ok := leaderPrecondition(err); ok {
			switchOff = fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrStage3SwitchOff, st.Message())
			return nil
		}
		return err
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return switchOff
}
```

```go
package consensus

import (
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority/authoritytest"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// The registry fixtures of this task's tests: member-b (the authoritytest
// member fixture) hosted by indexer 1, owners 0 and 2.
const (
	fixtureNode    = authoritytest.MemberNodeIDB
	fixtureNetwork = "s3e1-member-consensus"
	fixtureGenesis = "0xgenesis"
)

func fixtureContext() authority.MessageContext {
	return authority.MessageContext{NetworkID: fixtureNetwork, GenesisSnapshotID: fixtureGenesis}
}

// fixtureInc is incarnation seq of db.table owned by owner.
func fixtureInc(seq uint64, db, table string, owner uint64, status wire.TableIncarnationStatus) wire.TableIncarnation {
	o := owner
	return wire.TableIncarnation{Seq: seq, DatabaseID: db, TableID: table, Status: status, OwnerIndexerID: &o, AddBlockSeq: seq}
}

// fixtureMember is a current member that joined at joined and is ready at
// ready (0: not ready).
func fixtureMember(node string, joined, ready uint64, class wire.MemberClass) wire.GroupMember {
	return wire.GroupMember{NodeID: node, JoinedGeneration: joined, ReadyGeneration: ready, Class: class}
}

func fixtureGroup(owner uint64, db string, generation uint64, members ...wire.GroupMember) wire.DatabaseGroup {
	return wire.DatabaseGroup{OwnerIndexerID: owner, DatabaseID: db, Generation: generation, Members: members}
}

// fixtureSnapshot is a registry view with stage3 (nil: before the stage-3
// parameter), groups and incarnations, listed in seq order.
func fixtureSnapshot(stage3 *arbiter.Stage3Params, groups []wire.DatabaseGroup, incs ...wire.TableIncarnation) wire.TableRegistrySnapshot {
	return wire.TableRegistrySnapshot{Version: 9, Seeded: true, Incarnations: incs, Groups: groups, Stage3: stage3}
}

// fixtureStage3 is the stage-3 parameter with the named switches on.
func fixtureStage3(switches ...string) *arbiter.Stage3Params {
	p := &arbiter.Stage3Params{GroupSize: 3, NetworkFillDefault: true, MinSafeCopies: 1, MaxLagPublications: 4, LagLow: 2,
		EvidenceTimeoutL2Blocks: 30, MaxUncleanedPartsPerPartition: 2400, MaxUncleanedPartsPerTable: 20000}
	for _, s := range switches {
		switch s {
		case "purge":
			p.Purge = true
		case "placement":
			p.Placement = true
		case "checkpoints":
			p.Checkpoints = true
		}
	}
	return p
}

func fixtureEntry(owner, block, promotion uint64) replay.TrackFrontier {
	return replay.TrackFrontier{IndexerID: owner, SafeBlockSeq: block, AppliedPromotionSeq: promotion}
}
```

```go
package consensus

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority/authoritytest"
)

// otherSigner is a second replica_signer address, for the rotation tests.
const otherSigner = "0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000aa"

func openSeqs(t *testing.T, dir string) *CheckpointSeqStore {
	t.Helper()
	s, err := OpenCheckpointSeqStore(dir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("OpenCheckpointSeqStore: %v", err)
	}
	return s
}

func nextSeq(t *testing.T, s *CheckpointSeqStore, owner uint64, signer string, published, want uint64) {
	t.Helper()
	got, err := s.Next(owner, signer, published)
	if err != nil || got != want {
		t.Fatalf("Next(%d, %s, %d) = %d, %v; want %d", owner, signer, published, got, err, want)
	}
}

func journalText(t *testing.T, dir string) string {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, CheckpointSeqFile))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return string(b)
}

// TestCheckpointSeqIsAboveTheJournalAndThePublishedValue: each seq is one
// above the larger of the journal's value and the published one, per owner,
// and the journal survives a reopen.
func TestCheckpointSeqIsAboveTheJournalAndThePublishedValue(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	s := openSeqs(t, dir)
	signer := authoritytest.ReplicaAddrB
	nextSeq(t, s, 0, signer, 0, 1)
	nextSeq(t, s, 0, signer, 0, 2)
	nextSeq(t, s, 0, signer, 10, 11) // the published value is above the journal
	nextSeq(t, s, 0, signer, 3, 12)  // the journal is above the published value
	nextSeq(t, s, 2, signer, 0, 1)   // owners are independent
	want := `{"owners":[{"owner_indexer_id":0,"replica_signer":"` + signer + `","checkpoint_seq":12},{"owner_indexer_id":2,"replica_signer":"` + signer + `","checkpoint_seq":1}]}` + "\n"
	if got := journalText(t, dir); got != want {
		t.Fatalf("%s = %s, want %s", CheckpointSeqFile, got, want)
	}
	nextSeq(t, openSeqs(t, dir), 0, signer, 0, 13)
	if _, err := s.Next(0, "0xEAB0E192C789A8342F51891D8467DE2ACD7E416A", 0); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("Next accepted an upper-case replica_signer")
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, CheckpointSeqFile), []byte(`{"owners":[{"owner_indexer_id":0,"replica_signer":"`+signer+`","checkpoint_seq":0}]}`), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := OpenCheckpointSeqStore(dir); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("OpenCheckpointSeqStore accepted a journal entry with checkpoint_seq 0")
	}
}

// TestCheckpointSeqIsDurableBeforeSubmit: Sign writes the seq to the journal
// before it returns the signed checkpoint, so a member that crashes before
// the submit never signs that seq again; a journal write that fails signs
// nothing and uses no seq.
func TestCheckpointSeqIsDurableBeforeSubmit(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	signer, err := NewCheckpointSigner(authoritytest.ReplicaKeyHexB, fixtureContext(), openSeqs(t, dir))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if signer.Address() != authoritytest.ReplicaAddrB {
		t.Fatalf("signer address %s, want %s", signer.Address(), authoritytest.ReplicaAddrB)
	}
	cp := arbiter.MemberCheckpoint{NodeID: fixtureNode, OwnerIndexerID: 0, SnapshotID: "0xsnap", Entry: fixtureEntry(0, 90, 40),
		Groups: []arbiter.CheckpointGroup{{DatabaseID: "dex", GroupGeneration: 1}}}
	signed, err := signer.Sign(cp, 0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if signed.Checkpoint.CheckpointSeq != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("first checkpoint_seq = %d, want 1", signed.Checkpoint.CheckpointSeq)
	}
	if err := authority.VerifyMemberCheckpoint(fixtureContext(), signed.Checkpoint, signed.ReplicaJWS, authoritytest.ReplicaAddrB); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("the signed checkpoint does not verify under its replica_signer: %v", err)
	}
	want := `{"owners":[{"owner_indexer_id":0,"replica_signer":"` + authoritytest.ReplicaAddrB + `","checkpoint_seq":1}]}` + "\n"
	if got := journalText(t, dir); got != want {
		t.Fatalf("before any submit the journal is %s, want %s", got, want)
	}
	// The member crashes before the submit and restarts on its state dir.
	restarted, err := NewCheckpointSigner(authoritytest.ReplicaKeyHexB, fixtureContext(), openSeqs(t, dir))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	again, err := restarted.Sign(cp, 0)
	if err != nil || again.Checkpoint.CheckpointSeq != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("after a restart Sign = %d, %v; want checkpoint_seq 2 (1 was signed before the crash)", again.Checkpoint.CheckpointSeq, err)
	}
	bad := cp
	bad.Groups = nil
	if _, err := restarted.Sign(bad, 0); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("Sign accepted a checkpoint without groups")
	}
	if os.Geteuid() == 0 {
		t.Log("running as root: the read-only state dir check is skipped")
		return
	}
	if err := os.Chmod(dir, 0o500); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = os.Chmod(dir, 0o700) })
	if _, err := restarted.Sign(cp, 0); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("Sign returned a checkpoint although its seq could not be journaled")
	}
	if err := os.Chmod(dir, 0o700); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if third, err := restarted.Sign(cp, 0); err != nil || third.Checkpoint.CheckpointSeq != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("after the failed write Sign = %d, %v; want checkpoint_seq 3", third.Checkpoint.CheckpointSeq, err)
	}
}

// TestCheckpointSeqRestartsWhenTheReplicaSignerRotates: a journal entry under
// a retired replica_signer does not count, as Apply restarts the stored
// value when the key rotates (spec §9.1); the new key's seqs start above the
// value published under the new key.
func TestCheckpointSeqRestartsWhenTheReplicaSignerRotates(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	s := openSeqs(t, dir)
	nextSeq(t, s, 0, authoritytest.ReplicaAddrB, 0, 1)
	nextSeq(t, s, 0, authoritytest.ReplicaAddrB, 0, 2)
	nextSeq(t, s, 0, otherSigner, 0, 1)
	want := `{"owners":[{"owner_indexer_id":0,"replica_signer":"` + otherSigner + `","checkpoint_seq":1}]}` + "\n"
	if got := journalText(t, dir); got != want {
		t.Fatalf("after the rotation the journal is %s, want %s", got, want)
	}
	nextSeq(t, s, 0, otherSigner, 5, 6)
	nextSeq(t, openSeqs(t, dir), 0, authoritytest.ReplicaAddrB, 0, 1)
}
```

```go
package consensus

import (

// checkpointSnapshot: member-b is a current member of owner 0's dex and nft
// groups and of owner 2's lp group, and Leaving in owner 0's old group;
// member-c alone is in owner 0's other group.
func checkpointSnapshot() wire.TableRegistrySnapshot {
	old := fixtureGroup(0, "old", 5, fixtureMember("member-c", 1, 1, wire.MemberClassCaughtUp))
	old.Leaving = []wire.LeavingMember{{NodeID: fixtureNode, RemovedGeneration: 5}}
	return fixtureSnapshot(fixtureStage3("purge", "placement", "checkpoints"), []wire.DatabaseGroup{

		fixtureGroup(0, "dex", 3, fixtureMember(fixtureNode, 1, 1, wire.MemberClassCaughtUp)),

		fixtureGroup(0, "other", 1, fixtureMember("member-c", 1, 1, wire.MemberClassCaughtUp)),
		fixtureGroup(2, "lp", 4, fixtureMember(fixtureNode, 2, 3, wire.MemberClassCaughtUp)),
	},
		fixtureInc(1, "dex", "pools", 0, wire.TableStatusActive),
		fixtureInc(2, "nft", "mints", 0, wire.TableStatusActive),
		fixtureInc(3, "old", "t", 0, wire.TableStatusActive),
		fixtureInc(4, "other", "t", 0, wire.TableStatusActive),
		fixtureInc(5, "lp", "pairs", 2, wire.TableStatusActive),
	)
}

func installed(owner uint64, snapshot string, keys ...string) OwnerInstallState {
	st := OwnerInstallState{SnapshotID: snapshot, Entry: fixtureEntry(owner, 90, 40)}
	for _, k := range keys {
		st.Tables = append(st.Tables, TableInstallState{TableID: k})
	}
	return st
}

// TestPlanCheckpointListsOnlyTheMembersGroupsOfOneOwner: the checkpoint of
// owner 0 lists exactly owner 0's groups that name member-b as a current
// member, sorted by database, at each group's generation; a Leaving record,
// another member's group and owner 2's group are left out, and there is no
// checkpoint without a journaled manifest, for an entry of another owner, or
// for an owner of whose groups the node is in none.
func TestPlanCheckpointListsOnlyTheMembersGroupsOfOneOwner(t *testing.T) {
	snap := checkpointSnapshot()
	cp, ok := PlanCheckpoint(snap, fixtureNode, 0, installed(0, "0xsnap", "dex.pools", "nft.mints"))
	want := arbiter.MemberCheckpoint{NodeID: fixtureNode, OwnerIndexerID: 0, SnapshotID: "0xsnap", Entry: fixtureEntry(0, 90, 40),
		Groups: []arbiter.CheckpointGroup{{DatabaseID: "dex", GroupGeneration: 3}, {DatabaseID: "nft", GroupGeneration: 2}}}
	if !ok || !reflect.DeepEqual(cp, want) {
		t.Fatalf("PlanCheckpoint(owner 0) = %+v, %v; want %+v", cp, ok, want)
	}
	if cp, ok := PlanCheckpoint(snap, fixtureNode, 2, installed(2, "0xsnap", "lp.pairs")); !ok || len(cp.Groups) != 1 || cp.Groups[0].DatabaseID != "lp" || cp.Groups[0].GroupGeneration != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("PlanCheckpoint(owner 2) = %+v, %v; want the lp group alone at generation 4", cp, ok)
	}
	if _, ok := PlanCheckpoint(snap, fixtureNode, 0, installed(0, "", "dex.pools")); ok {
		t.Fatal("a checkpoint was planned without a journaled manifest")
	}
	if _, ok := PlanCheckpoint(snap, fixtureNode, 0, installed(2, "0xsnap", "dex.pools")); ok {
		t.Fatal("a checkpoint of owner 0 was planned at owner 2's entry")
	}
	if _, ok := PlanCheckpoint(snap, "member-d", 0, installed(0, "0xsnap")); ok {
		t.Fatal("a checkpoint was planned for a node that is in no group of the owner")
	}
}

// TestPlanCheckpointExcludesTablesWithClosedReasons: every table of a group's
// database that the member has not installed at the manifest is excluded
// with a reason of the closed set, sorted by table id: foreign and diverged
// from the journal, audit_pending while the audit is not clean, not_installed
// or disk_threshold for a copy behind the manifest or none at all, retiring
// for a Retiring or Purging table; a copy of an earlier incarnation of a
// re-created table installs nothing of the live one.
func TestPlanCheckpointExcludesTablesWithClosedReasons(t *testing.T) {
	snap := fixtureSnapshot(fixtureStage3("checkpoints"), []wire.DatabaseGroup{
		fixtureGroup(0, "dex", 3, fixtureMember(fixtureNode, 1, 1, wire.MemberClassCaughtUp)),
	},
		fixtureInc(1, "dex", "a", 0, wire.TableStatusActive),
		fixtureInc(2, "dex", "b", 0, wire.TableStatusActive),
		fixtureInc(3, "dex", "c", 0, wire.TableStatusActive),
		fixtureInc(4, "dex", "d", 0, wire.TableStatusActive),
		fixtureInc(5, "dex", "e", 0, wire.TableStatusPending),
		fixtureInc(6, "dex", "f", 0, wire.TableStatusRetiring),
		fixtureInc(7, "dex", "g", 0, wire.TableStatusPurging),
		fixtureInc(8, "dex", "h", 0, wire.TableStatusRefused),
		fixtureInc(9, "dex", "i", 0, wire.TableStatusPurged),
		fixtureInc(10, "dex", "j", 0, wire.TableStatusRetiring),
		fixtureInc(11, "dex", "j", 0, wire.TableStatusActive),
		fixtureInc(12, "dex", "k", 2, wire.TableStatusActive),
	)
	journal := install.OwnerJournal{SnapshotID: "0xsnap", Entry: fixtureEntry(0, 90, 40)}
	at := func(key string, seq uint64) install.TableState {
		return install.TableState{Owner: 0, TableKey: key, IncarnationSeq: seq, SnapshotID: "0xsnap", Entry: journal.Entry}
	}
	behind := at("dex.c", 3)
	behind.SnapshotID, behind.Entry = "0xolder", fixtureEntry(0, 80, 39)
	foreign, diverged := at("dex.a", 1), at("dex.b", 2)
	foreign.Foreign, diverged.Diverged = true, true
	tables := []install.TableState{foreign, diverged, behind, at("dex.d", 4), at("dex.e", 5), at("dex.j", 10)}
	plan := func(stats install.Stats) []arbiter.ExcludedTable {
		t.Helper()
		cp, ok := PlanCheckpoint(snap, fixtureNode, 0, InstallStateOf(snap, 0, journal, tables, stats))
		if !ok || len(cp.Groups) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("PlanCheckpoint = %+v, %v; want one group", cp, ok)
		}
		return cp.Groups[0].Excluded
	}
	ex := func(key string, reason arbiter.CheckpointExclusionReason) arbiter.ExcludedTable {
		return arbiter.ExcludedTable{TableID: key, Reason: reason}
	}
	want := []arbiter.ExcludedTable{ex("dex.a", arbiter.ExclusionForeign), ex("dex.b", arbiter.ExclusionDiverged), ex("dex.c", arbiter.ExclusionNotInstalled),
		ex("dex.f", arbiter.ExclusionRetiring), ex("dex.g", arbiter.ExclusionRetiring), ex("dex.j", arbiter.ExclusionNotInstalled)}
	if got := plan(install.Stats{AuditClean: true}); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("excluded = %v, want %v", got, want)

	want[2] = ex("dex.c", arbiter.ExclusionDiskThreshold)
	if got := plan(install.Stats{AuditClean: true, InstallsPaused: true}); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("with installs paused, excluded = %v, want %v", got, want)
	}
	want = []arbiter.ExcludedTable{ex("dex.a", arbiter.ExclusionForeign), ex("dex.b", arbiter.ExclusionDiverged), ex("dex.c", arbiter.ExclusionAuditPending),
		ex("dex.d", arbiter.ExclusionAuditPending), ex("dex.e", arbiter.ExclusionAuditPending), ex("dex.f", arbiter.ExclusionRetiring),
		ex("dex.g", arbiter.ExclusionRetiring), ex("dex.j", arbiter.ExclusionNotInstalled)}
	if got := plan(install.Stats{AuditClean: false}); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("with the audit pending, excluded = %v, want %v", got, want)
	}
	known := map[arbiter.CheckpointExclusionReason]bool{arbiter.ExclusionNotInstalled: true, arbiter.ExclusionDiverged: true, arbiter.ExclusionForeign: true,
		arbiter.ExclusionDiskThreshold: true, arbiter.ExclusionAuditPending: true, arbiter.ExclusionRetiring: true}
	for _, e := range want {
		if !known[e.Reason] {
			t.Fatalf("%s is excluded with %q, outside the closed set", e.TableID, e.Reason)
		}
	}
```
