```go
	"slices"
	"sync"
)

// replicaSignerAddress is a normalized replica_signer: lowercase 0x and 40
// hex characters, the form authority.Signer.Address returns.
var replicaSignerAddress = regexp.MustCompile(`^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$`)

// CheckpointSeqStore is the member's checkpoint_seq journal, CheckpointSeqFile
// in the member state directory (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §9.1; plan S3-E1
// contract §42.3): per owner, the replica_signer address and the highest
// checkpoint_seq this member signed under it. Next writes a seq to disk (temp
// file, fsync, rename, directory fsync) before it returns it, so no seq is
// ever signed twice, across crashes included. It is safe for concurrent use.
type CheckpointSeqStore struct {
	mu   sync.Mutex
	path string
	seqs map[uint64]checkpointSeqEntry
}

// checkpointSeqEntry is one owner's line of the journal.
type checkpointSeqEntry struct {
	OwnerIndexerID uint64 `json:"owner_indexer_id"`
	ReplicaSigner  string `json:"replica_signer"`
	CheckpointSeq  uint64 `json:"checkpoint_seq"`
}

// checkpointSeqDocument is the journal file,
// {"owners":[{"owner_indexer_id":0,"replica_signer":"0x…","checkpoint_seq":7}]},
// sorted by owner.
type checkpointSeqDocument struct {
	Owners []checkpointSeqEntry `json:"owners"`
}

// OpenCheckpointSeqStore reads stateDir's journal. A missing file is an empty
// journal (a fresh member, or one that lost its state: Next then resumes from
// the published value). A journal that does not parse, or that names an owner
// twice, an unnormalized signer or a zero seq, is refused.
func OpenCheckpointSeqStore(stateDir string) (*CheckpointSeqStore, error) {
	if stateDir == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("member consensus: the checkpoint_seq journal needs a state directory")
	}
	s := &CheckpointSeqStore{path: filepath.Join(stateDir, CheckpointSeqFile), seqs: map[uint64]checkpointSeqEntry{}}
	b, err := os.ReadFile(s.path)
	if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return s, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: read %s: %w", s.path, err)
	}
	var doc checkpointSeqDocument
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &doc); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: %s does not parse: %w", s.path, err)
	}
	for _, e := range doc.Owners {
		if _, dup := s.seqs[e.OwnerIndexerID]; dup || !replicaSignerAddress.MatchString(e.ReplicaSigner) || e.CheckpointSeq == 0 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: %s: owner %d: want one entry per owner with a lowercase 0x replica_signer and a checkpoint_seq of at least 1", s.path, e.OwnerIndexerID)
		}
		s.seqs[e.OwnerIndexerID] = e
	}
	return s, nil
}

// Next returns the checkpoint_seq of owner's next checkpoint under
// replicaSigner: one above both the journal's value under that signer and
// published, the registry's value for this member and owner, which the caller
// passes only when the registry names the same signer (else 0). A journal
// entry under another signer belongs to a retired key and restarts from
// published, as Apply restarts the stored value when replica_signer rotates
// (spec §9.1). The new value is durable in the journal before Next returns;
// when the write fails the journal is unchanged and Next returns the error.
func (s *CheckpointSeqStore) Next(owner uint64, replicaSigner string, published uint64) (uint64, error) {
	if !replicaSignerAddress.MatchString(replicaSigner) {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: replica_signer %q is not a lowercase 0x-prefixed 20-byte address", replicaSigner)
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	last := published
	if e, ok := s.seqs[owner]; ok && e.ReplicaSigner == replicaSigner {
		last = max(last, e.CheckpointSeq)
	}
	if last == math.MaxUint64 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: owner %d: checkpoint_seq is exhausted", owner)
	}
	next := checkpointSeqEntry{OwnerIndexerID: owner, ReplicaSigner: replicaSigner, CheckpointSeq: last + 1}
	seqs := maps.Clone(s.seqs)
	seqs[owner] = next
	if err := writeCheckpointSeqs(s.path, seqs); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	s.seqs = seqs
	return next.CheckpointSeq, nil
}

// writeCheckpointSeqs writes the journal atomically: a temp file in the same
// directory, fsync, rename over the journal, fsync of the directory.
func writeCheckpointSeqs(path string, seqs map[uint64]checkpointSeqEntry) error {
	doc := checkpointSeqDocument{Owners: slices.Collect(maps.Values(seqs))}
	slices.SortFunc(doc.Owners, func(a, b checkpointSeqEntry) int { return cmp.Compare(a.OwnerIndexerID, b.OwnerIndexerID) })
	b, err := json.Marshal(doc)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: encode %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	dir := filepath.Dir(path)
	tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(dir, CheckpointSeqFile+".tmp-*")
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: write %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = os.Remove(tmp.Name()) }()
	if _, err := tmp.Write(append(b, '\n')); err != nil {
		_ = tmp.Close()
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: write %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	if err := tmp.Sync(); err != nil {
		_ = tmp.Close()
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: sync %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: write %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	if err := os.Rename(tmp.Name(), path); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: replace %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	d, err := os.Open(dir)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: sync %s: %w", dir, err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = d.Close() }()
	if err := d.Sync(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("member consensus: sync %s: %w", dir, err)
	}
	return nil
}
```

```go
package consensus

import (
	"cmp"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"strings"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member/install"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// OwnerInstallState is one owner's install state as a checkpoint states it
// (plan S3-E1 contract §42.3): the manifest and track entry the member's
// install journal records for the owner, and every table the member holds a
// copy of, with the reason it is excluded ("" when it is installed at
// SnapshotID).
type OwnerInstallState struct {
	SnapshotID string
	Entry      replay.TrackFrontier
	Tables     []TableInstallState
}

// TableInstallState is one copied table; Excluded is "" for a table installed
// at the owner's journaled manifest.
type TableInstallState struct {
	TableID  string
	Excluded arbiter.CheckpointExclusionReason
}

// InstallStateOf adapts owner's install journal of Plan S3-C2 (the
// installer's Entry, Tables and Stats) to an OwnerInstallState. A copy counts
// only when it is a copy of the live incarnation of its table owned by owner
// in snap (a copy of an earlier incarnation of the same name installs nothing
// of the live one). Its reason, in this order: foreign or diverged as the
// journal marks it; audit_pending while the installer's audit is not clean
// (an audit completed since the start or the last ClickHouse restart and no
// copy awaits a repair, spec §8.7), so a checkpoint never claims a copy the
// last audit did not see clean; then, for a copy whose journal is not at the
// owner's manifest, disk_threshold while installs are paused by the member
// disk budget (Plan S3-C2 K35), else not_installed.
func InstallStateOf(snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, owner uint64, j install.OwnerJournal, tables []install.TableState, stats install.Stats) OwnerInstallState {
	out := OwnerInstallState{SnapshotID: j.SnapshotID, Entry: j.Entry, Tables: make([]TableInstallState, 0, len(tables))}
	for _, t := range tables {
		live := snap.Live(t.TableKey)
		if live == nil || live.Seq != t.IncarnationSeq || snap.Owner(*live) != owner {
			continue
		}
		var reason arbiter.CheckpointExclusionReason
		switch {
		case t.Foreign:
			reason = arbiter.ExclusionForeign
		case t.Diverged:
			reason = arbiter.ExclusionDiverged
		case !stats.AuditClean:
			reason = arbiter.ExclusionAuditPending
		case t.SnapshotID != j.SnapshotID || t.Entry != j.Entry:
			reason = arbiter.ExclusionNotInstalled
			if stats.InstallsPaused {
				reason = arbiter.ExclusionDiskThreshold
			}
		}
		out.Tables = append(out.Tables, TableInstallState{TableID: t.TableKey, Excluded: reason})
	}
	slices.SortFunc(out.Tables, func(a, b TableInstallState) int { return strings.Compare(a.TableID, b.TableID) })
	return out
}

// PlanCheckpoint plans nodeID's checkpoint for owner (spec §9.1): one group
// per database group of owner that lists the node as a current member (a
// Leaving record is no membership), sorted by database, at the group's
// generation. Each group excludes, sorted by table id, every table of its
// database whose live incarnation is physical and owned by owner and that
// the member has not installed at st.SnapshotID: a Pending or Active one with
// its install reason, or not_installed when st lists no copy of it; a
// Retiring or Purging one as retiring, because the member drops its copy from
// Retiring on (spec §8.8). CheckpointSeq is left 0 for CheckpointSigner.Sign.
// It answers false when the node is a current member of no group of owner,
// the journal records no manifest for owner, or the journaled entry is not
// owner's.
func PlanCheckpoint(snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, nodeID string, owner uint64, st OwnerInstallState) (arbiter.MemberCheckpoint, bool) {
	if st.SnapshotID == "" || st.Entry.IndexerID != owner {
		return arbiter.MemberCheckpoint{}, false
	}
	installed := make(map[string]arbiter.CheckpointExclusionReason, len(st.Tables))
	for _, t := range st.Tables {
		installed[t.TableID] = t.Excluded
	}
	cp := arbiter.MemberCheckpoint{NodeID: nodeID, OwnerIndexerID: owner, SnapshotID: st.SnapshotID, Entry: st.Entry}
	for _, g := range snap.Groups {
		if g.OwnerIndexerID != owner || !slices.ContainsFunc(g.Members, func(m wire.GroupMember) bool { return m.NodeID == nodeID }) {
			continue
		}
		cg := arbiter.CheckpointGroup{DatabaseID: g.DatabaseID, GroupGeneration: g.Generation}
		for _, live := range liveTablesOf(snap, owner, g.DatabaseID) {
			var reason arbiter.CheckpointExclusionReason
			switch live.Status {
			case wire.TableStatusPending, wire.TableStatusActive:
				r, ok := installed[live.Key()]
				if !ok {
					r = arbiter.ExclusionNotInstalled
				}
				reason = r
			case wire.TableStatusRetiring, wire.TableStatusPurging:
				reason = arbiter.ExclusionRetiring
			}
			if reason != "" {
				cg.Excluded = append(cg.Excluded, arbiter.ExcludedTable{TableID: live.Key(), Reason: reason})
			}
		}
		cp.Groups = append(cp.Groups, cg)
	}
	if len(cp.Groups) == 0 {
		return arbiter.MemberCheckpoint{}, false
	}
	slices.SortFunc(cp.Groups, func(a, b arbiter.CheckpointGroup) int { return cmp.Compare(a.DatabaseID, b.DatabaseID) })
	return cp, true
}

// liveTablesOf lists, sorted by table key, the live incarnation of every
// table of database that is physical and owned by owner.
func liveTablesOf(snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, owner uint64, database string) []wire.TableIncarnation {
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	var out []wire.TableIncarnation
	for _, inc := range snap.Incarnations {
		key := inc.Key()
		if inc.DatabaseID != database || seen[key] {
			continue
		}
		seen[key] = true
		if live := snap.Live(key); live != nil && live.HasPhysicalTables() && snap.Owner(*live) == owner {
			out = append(out, *live)
		}
	}
	slices.SortFunc(out, func(a, b wire.TableIncarnation) int { return strings.Compare(a.Key(), b.Key()) })
	return out
}

// CheckpointSigner signs a member's checkpoints with its replica_signer key
// (purpose arbiter-member-checkpoint-v1, plan S3-E1 K63), each under a fresh
// checkpoint_seq from the store.
type CheckpointSigner struct {
	signer *authority.Signer
	ctx    authority.MessageContext
	store  *CheckpointSeqStore
}

// NewCheckpointSigner loads replicaSignerKeyHex, a secp256k1 private key in
// hex with or without 0x. The key never appears in an error or a log.
func NewCheckpointSigner(replicaSignerKeyHex string, ctx authority.MessageContext, store *CheckpointSeqStore) (*CheckpointSigner, error) {
	if store == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("member consensus: a checkpoint signer needs a checkpoint_seq store")
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(ctx.NetworkID) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(ctx.GenesisSnapshotID) == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("member consensus: a checkpoint signer needs the network id and the genesis snapshot id")
	}
	signer, err := authority.NewSignerFromHex(replicaSignerKeyHex)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errReplicaSignerKey
	}
	return &CheckpointSigner{signer: signer, ctx: ctx, store: store}, nil
}

// errReplicaSignerKey is the refusal of a key that does not load; it carries
// no part of the key.
var errReplicaSignerKey = errors.New("member consensus: the replica_signer key is not a secp256k1 private key in hex")

// Address is the replica_signer address this signer signs as.
func (s *CheckpointSigner) Address() string { return s.signer.Address() }

// Sign gives cp the next checkpoint_seq of its owner, durable before Sign
// returns (CheckpointSeqStore.Next; published is the registry's value under
// this signer, else 0), and signs it. A checkpoint the signing hash refuses
// is refused before a seq is used.
func (s *CheckpointSigner) Sign(cp arbiter.MemberCheckpoint, published uint64) (wire.MemberCheckpoint, error) {
	probe := cp
	probe.CheckpointSeq = 1
	if _, err := authority.MemberCheckpointHash(s.ctx, probe); err != nil {
		return wire.MemberCheckpoint{}, err
	}
	seq, err := s.store.Next(cp.OwnerIndexerID, s.signer.Address(), published)
	if err != nil {
		return wire.MemberCheckpoint{}, err
	}
	cp.CheckpointSeq = seq
	jws, err := s.signer.SignMemberCheckpoint(s.ctx, cp)
	if err != nil {
		return wire.MemberCheckpoint{}, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: sign checkpoint %d of owner %d: %w", seq, cp.OwnerIndexerID, err)
	}
	return wire.MemberCheckpoint{Checkpoint: cp, ReplicaJWS: jws}, nil
}
```

```go
package consensus

// readinessSnapshot: member-b waits for readiness in two groups of owner 0
// (dex at generation 3, nft at generation 2) and in one of owner 2 (dex at
// generation 1, no physical table yet), and is ready in owner 2's lp group.
// dex.pools of owner 0 was re-created: incarnation 3 is Purging on the
// unscoped path, incarnation 7 is the live, scoped one. nft.mints is
// Retiring, nft.drops Pending. member-c's groups never count.
func readinessSnapshot() wire.TableRegistrySnapshot {

	pools7.ScopedKeeperPath = true
	return fixtureSnapshot(fixtureStage3("purge", "placement"), []wire.DatabaseGroup{

		fixtureGroup(0, "nft", 2, fixtureMember(fixtureNode, 2, 0, wire.MemberClassBootstrapping)),
		fixtureGroup(2, "dex", 1, fixtureMember(fixtureNode, 1, 0, wire.MemberClassBootstrapping)),
		fixtureGroup(2, "lp", 4, fixtureMember(fixtureNode, 2, 3, wire.MemberClassCaughtUp)),
		fixtureGroup(0, "other", 1, fixtureMember("member-c", 1, 0, wire.MemberClassBootstrapping)),
	},
		fixtureInc(3, "dex", "pools", 0, wire.TableStatusPurging),
		fixtureInc(4, "dex", "swaps", 0, wire.TableStatusActive),
		fixtureInc(5, "nft", "mints", 0, wire.TableStatusRetiring),
		fixtureInc(6, "nft", "drops", 0, wire.TableStatusPending),
		pools7,
		fixtureInc(8, "lp", "pairs", 2, wire.TableStatusActive),
		fixtureInc(9, "other", "t", 0, wire.TableStatusActive),
		fixtureInc(10, "dex", "gone", 0, wire.TableStatusPurged),
	)
}

// TestPlanReadinessAnnouncesOnlySyncedGroups: a group is announced, at its
// current generation, once every Pending, Active or Retiring live table of
// its database has a synced local replica at that incarnation's Keeper path;
// a ready member, another member's group and a group without such a table
// are never announced.
func TestPlanReadinessAnnouncesOnlySyncedGroups(t *testing.T) {
	snap := readinessSnapshot()
	paths := ReplicaPaths(snap, fixtureNode, 0)
	wantPaths := map[string]string{
		"dex__pools": "/sentio/0/unsafe_inc/dex__pools/7",
		"dex__swaps": "/sentio/0/unsafe/dex__swaps",
		"nft__mints": "/sentio/0/unsafe/nft__mints",
		"nft__drops": "/sentio/0/unsafe/nft__drops",
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(paths, wantPaths) {

	}

		t.Fatalf("with dex__swaps not synced and nft__drops missing, PlanReadiness = %v, want nothing", got)

	want := []arbiter.MemberReadyBody{{NodeID: fixtureNode, OwnerIndexerID: 0, DatabaseID: "dex", Generation: 3}}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("with dex synced, PlanReadiness = %v, want %v", got, want)

	got = PlanReadiness(snap, fixtureNode, LocalReplicas{"dex__pools": true, "dex__swaps": true, "nft__mints": true, "nft__drops": true})

	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("with dex and nft synced, PlanReadiness = %v, want %v", got, want)
	}
	if got := PlanReadiness(snap, "member-c", LocalReplicas{"other__t": true}); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, []arbiter.MemberReadyBody{{NodeID: "member-c", OwnerIndexerID: 0, DatabaseID: "other", Generation: 1}}) {
		t.Fatalf("member-c's plan = %v, want only its own waiting group", got)
	}
}
```

```go
package consensus

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"testing"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/chtest"
)

// readinessCH opens CH_ADDR as the test's admin user (ARBITER_CH_INTEGRATION=1)
// and requires Keeper: skipped without it, failed under ARBITER_CH_KEEPER=1.
func readinessCH(t *testing.T) (clickhouse.Conn, string) {
	t.Helper()
	if os.Getenv("ARBITER_CH_INTEGRATION") != "1" {
		t.Skip("set ARBITER_CH_INTEGRATION=1 (and run ClickHouse with Keeper on CH_ADDR or localhost:9000) to run")
	}
	addr := os.Getenv("CH_ADDR")
	if addr == "" {
		addr = "127.0.0.1:9000"
	}
	conn := chtest.Open(t, addr)
	var n uint64
	if err := conn.QueryRow(context.Background(), "SELECT count() FROM system.zookeeper WHERE path = '/'").Scan(&n); err != nil {
		if os.Getenv("ARBITER_CH_KEEPER") == "1" {
			t.Fatalf("ARBITER_CH_KEEPER=1 but ClickHouse has no Keeper: %v", err)
		}
		t.Skipf("ClickHouse has no Keeper configured; skipping: %v", err)
	}
	return conn, addr
}

func readinessExec(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn, query string) {
	t.Helper()
	if err := conn.Exec(context.Background(), query); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s: %v", query, err)
	}
}

// readinessCleanup runs query on a fresh admin connection when the test ends.
func readinessCleanup(t *testing.T, addr, query string) {
	t.Helper()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		conn, err := clickhouse.Open(chtest.Options(addr))
		if err != nil {
			t.Logf("cleanup %s: %v", query, err)
			return
		}
		defer func() { _ = conn.Close() }()
		if err := conn.Exec(context.Background(), query); err != nil {
			t.Logf("cleanup %s: %v", query, err)
		}
	})
}

func TestReadLocalReplicasReportsOnlyTheIncarnationsSyncedReplica(t *testing.T) {
	admin, addr := readinessCH(t)

	readinessExec(t, admin, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s.`dex__other` (v UInt64) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('%s', 'member-c') ORDER BY v", memberIdent(db), root+"/unsafe/dex__other"))
	readinessExec(t, admin, "INSERT INTO "+memberIdent(db)+".`dex__pools` VALUES (1), (2)")
	user := "readiness_" + sfx

	readinessCleanup(t, addr, "DROP USER IF EXISTS "+memberIdent(user))

		t.Fatalf("create user %s: %v", user, err)
	}

		"dex__pools": pools, "dex__missing": root + "/unsafe/dex__missing", "dex__other": root + "/unsafe/dex__other",
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ReadLocalReplicas: %v", err)
	}
	if want := (LocalReplicas{"dex__pools": true, "dex__missing": false, "dex__other": false}); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("ReadLocalReplicas = %v, want %v", got, want)
	}
	got, err = ReadLocalReplicas(context.Background(), conn, db, fixtureNode, map[string]string{"dex__pools": root + "/unsafe/dex__pools"})
	if err != nil || got["dex__pools"] {
		t.Fatalf("the replica asked at the unscoped path = %v, %v; want not synced", got, err)
	}
}
```

```go
package consensus

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"maps"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"time"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/ddl"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/tableset"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// ReplicaSyncTimeout bounds the SYSTEM SYNC REPLICA of one hg_member_unsafe
// table in ReadLocalReplicas; a replica that does not catch up in time is not
// ready at this pass.
const ReplicaSyncTimeout = 30 * time.Second

// LocalReplicas maps an hg_member_unsafe physical table name (ddl.CHTableName)
// to whether this member holds an active, synced replica of the incarnation
// PlanReadiness waits for, read from system.replicas after SYSTEM SYNC
// REPLICA as si_member (plan S3-E1 contract §42.3).
type LocalReplicas map[string]bool

// readinessTables lists the incarnations whose hg_member_unsafe replicas a
// member of g holds before it reports ready: the live incarnation of every
// table of g's database owned by g's owner, when it is Pending, Active or
// Retiring. A Purging incarnation's replica is the one the reconciler drops
// once quiet (spec §8.8), so it never holds readiness back.
func readinessTables(snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, g wire.DatabaseGroup) []wire.TableIncarnation {
	var out []wire.TableIncarnation
	for _, live := range liveTablesOf(snap, g.OwnerIndexerID, g.DatabaseID) {
		switch live.Status {
		case wire.TableStatusPending, wire.TableStatusActive, wire.TableStatusRetiring:
			out = append(out, live)
		}
	}
	return out
}

// awaitingReadiness lists, in the snapshot's group order, the groups that
// name nodeID as a current member that is not Ready().
func awaitingReadiness(snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, nodeID string) []wire.DatabaseGroup {
	var out []wire.DatabaseGroup
	for _, g := range snap.Groups {
		if i := slices.IndexFunc(g.Members, func(m wire.GroupMember) bool { return m.NodeID == nodeID }); i >= 0 && !g.Members[i].Ready() {
			out = append(out, g)
		}
	}
	return out
}

// PlanReadiness plans nodeID's MemberReady messages (spec §6.4): one body per
// group that names the node as a current member that is not Ready(), at the
// group's current generation, once the live incarnation of every table of
// the group's database owned by its owner that is Pending, Active or
// Retiring (at least one) has an active, synced local replica. local comes
// from ReadLocalReplicas over ReplicaPaths of the same snapshot, which checks
// each replica's Keeper path, so a replica of another incarnation of the same
// name never counts.
func PlanReadiness(snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, nodeID string, local LocalReplicas) []arbiter.MemberReadyBody {
	var out []arbiter.MemberReadyBody
	for _, g := range awaitingReadiness(snap, nodeID) {
		tables := readinessTables(snap, g)
		if len(tables) == 0 || slices.ContainsFunc(tables, func(inc wire.TableIncarnation) bool { return !local[ddl.CHTableName(inc.Key())] }) {
			continue
		}
		out = append(out, arbiter.MemberReadyBody{NodeID: nodeID, OwnerIndexerID: g.OwnerIndexerID, DatabaseID: g.DatabaseID, Generation: g.Generation})
	}
	return out
}

// ReplicaPaths maps the hg_member_unsafe table of every incarnation
// PlanReadiness waits for to that incarnation's Keeper path
// (ddl.ZooKeeperPathFor with tableset.KeeperScopeOf).
func ReplicaPaths(snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, nodeID string, keeperShardID uint32) map[string]string {
	paths := map[string]string{}
	for _, g := range awaitingReadiness(snap, nodeID) {
		for _, inc := range readinessTables(snap, g) {
			paths[ddl.CHTableName(inc.Key())] = ddl.ZooKeeperPathFor(keeperShardID, inc.Key(), tableset.KeeperScopeOf(inc))
		}
	}
	return paths
}

// codeUnknownTable is ClickHouse's UNKNOWN_TABLE.
const codeUnknownTable int32 = 60

// ReadLocalReplicas runs, as si_member, SYSTEM SYNC REPLICA on each table of
// paths in memberUnsafeDB (each bounded by ReplicaSyncTimeout) and then reads
// its system.replicas row: a table is synced when the row names its path and
// nodeID as the replica and the replica is neither read-only nor without a
// Keeper session. A missing table and a sync that fails or times out are
// false; a failed read of system.replicas is an error.
func ReadLocalReplicas(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, memberUnsafeDB, nodeID string, paths map[string]string) (LocalReplicas, error) {
	out := make(LocalReplicas, len(paths))
	for _, name := range slices.Sorted(maps.Keys(paths)) {
		out[name] = false
		syncCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, ReplicaSyncTimeout)
		err := conn.Exec(syncCtx, "SYSTEM SYNC REPLICA "+memberIdent(memberUnsafeDB)+"."+memberIdent(name))
		cancel()
		if err != nil {
			if ctx.Err() != nil {
				return nil, ctx.Err()
			}
			continue
		}
		synced, err := replicaSynced(ctx, conn, memberUnsafeDB, name, paths[name], nodeID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		out[name] = synced
	}
	return out, nil
}

func replicaSynced(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, database, table, path, nodeID string) (bool, error) {
	rows, err := conn.Query(ctx, "SELECT zookeeper_path, replica_name, is_readonly, is_session_expired FROM system.replicas WHERE database = ? AND table = ?", database, table)
	if err != nil {
		var exception *clickhouse.Exception
		if errors.As(err, &exception) && exception.Code == codeUnknownTable {
			return false, nil
		}
		return false, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: read system.replicas for %s.%s: %w", database, table, err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	synced := false
	for rows.Next() {
		var (
			zkPath, replica   string
			readOnly, expired uint8
		)
		if err := rows.Scan(&zkPath, &replica, &readOnly, &expired); err != nil {
			return false, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: scan system.replicas for %s.%s: %w", database, table, err)
		}
		synced = zkPath == path && replica == nodeID && readOnly == 0 && expired == 0
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: read system.replicas for %s.%s: %w", database, table, err)
	}
	return synced, nil
}

// memberIdent backquotes an identifier with dataplane/ddl's rule.
func memberIdent(id string) string {
	id = strings.ReplaceAll(id, `\`, `\\`)
	return "`" + strings.ReplaceAll(id, "`", "``") + "`"
}
```

```go
package consensus

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"
	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority/authoritytest"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member/install"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// modeRegistry is a registry follower whose view the test sets.
type modeRegistry struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	snap    wire.TableRegistrySnapshot
	enabled bool
	ready   chan struct{}
}

func newModeRegistry(snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot) *modeRegistry {
	r := &modeRegistry{snap: snap, enabled: true, ready: make(chan struct{})}
	close(r.ready)
	return r
}

func (r *modeRegistry) View() (wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, bool) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	return r.snap, r.enabled
}
func (r *modeRegistry) Changed() <-chan struct{} { return make(chan struct{}) }
func (r *modeRegistry) Ready() <-chan struct{}   { return r.ready }

func (r *modeRegistry) set(snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	r.snap = snap
}

// modeTestConn is a ClickHouse connection the mode tests never use: every
// call the mode makes on it goes through a seam.
type modeTestConn struct{ clickhouse.Conn }

type modeTestPayloads struct{}

func (modeTestPayloads) GetPayload(context.Context, string) ([]byte, error) {
	return nil, errors.New("no payloads in this test")
}

// fakeVerifyRunner is the verify role of the mode tests: Register fails with
// each error of registerErrs in turn, then succeeds; Run waits for ctx.
type fakeVerifyRunner struct {
	mu           sync.Mutex
	registerErrs []error
	registers    int
	runs         int
}

func (f *fakeVerifyRunner) Register(ctx context.Context) error {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	f.registers++
	if len(f.registerErrs) > 0 {
		err := f.registerErrs[0]
		f.registerErrs = f.registerErrs[1:]
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func (f *fakeVerifyRunner) Run(ctx context.Context) error {
	f.mu.Lock()
	f.runs++
	f.mu.Unlock()
	<-ctx.Done()
	return ctx.Err()
}

func (f *fakeVerifyRunner) counts() (int, int) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	return f.registers, f.runs
}

// fakeInstall is the installer the checkpoint step reads.
type fakeInstall struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	entries map[uint64]install.OwnerJournal
	tables  map[uint64][]install.TableState
	stats   install.Stats
}

func (f *fakeInstall) Entry(owner uint64) (install.OwnerJournal, bool) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	j, ok := f.entries[owner]
	return j, ok
}

func (f *fakeInstall) Tables(owner uint64) []install.TableState {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(f.tables[owner])
}

func (f *fakeInstall) Stats() install.Stats {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	return f.stats
}

// journalAt journals owner at snapshot with every listed table installed.
func (f *fakeInstall) journalAt(owner uint64, snapshot string, entry replay.TrackFrontier, keys ...string) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	f.entries[owner] = install.OwnerJournal{SnapshotID: snapshot, Entry: entry}
	f.tables[owner] = nil
	for i, k := range keys {
		f.tables[owner] = append(f.tables[owner], install.TableState{Owner: owner, TableKey: k, IncarnationSeq: uint64(i + 1), SnapshotID: snapshot, Entry: entry})
	}
}

// modeHarness is one Mode on a fake registry with every ClickHouse and
// arbiter call replaced, recording what the mode sends.
type modeHarness struct {
	t        *testing.T
	reg      *modeRegistry
	mode     *Mode
	verify   *fakeVerifyRunner
	inst     *fakeInstall
	stateDir string

	mu          sync.Mutex
	local       LocalReplicas
	localPaths  []map[string]string
	ready       []wire.MemberReady
	readyErr    error
	checkpoints []wire.MemberCheckpoint
	cpErr       error
	held        map[uint64]bool
	replicas    map[uint64][]string
	reports     []uint64
	reportErr   error
}

func newModeHarness(t *testing.T, snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, register bool) *modeHarness {
	t.Helper()
	return newModeHarnessIn(t, t.TempDir(), snap, register)
}

func newModeHarnessIn(t *testing.T, stateDir string, snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, register bool) *modeHarness {
	t.Helper()
	client, err := dataplane.New(dataplane.Config{Peers: []dataplane.Peer{{ID: "n1", GRPCAddr: "127.0.0.1:1"}}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(client.Close)
	h := &modeHarness{t: t, reg: newModeRegistry(snap), verify: &fakeVerifyRunner{}, stateDir: stateDir,
		inst: &fakeInstall{entries: map[uint64]install.OwnerJournal{}, tables: map[uint64][]install.TableState{}, stats: install.Stats{AuditClean: true}},
		held: map[uint64]bool{}, replicas: map[uint64][]string{}}
	m, err := NewMode(Config{
		NodeID: fixtureNode, NetworkID: fixtureNetwork, GenesisSnapshotID: fixtureGenesis, StateDir: stateDir,
		Ed25519Seed: authoritytest.MemberKeyB().Seed(), ReplicaSignerKeyHex: authoritytest.ReplicaKeyHexB, Register: register,
		ReadinessInterval: 10 * time.Millisecond, CheckpointInterval: 10 * time.Millisecond, ResolveInterval: 10 * time.Millisecond,
	}, ModeDeps{Client: client, Registry: h.reg, Conn: modeTestConn{}, Payloads: modeTestPayloads{}, MemberUnsafeDB: "hg_member_unsafe", Owners: []uint64{2, 0}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewMode: %v", err)
	}
	m.env.newVerifyRole = func(Config, VerifyDeps, *Metrics) (verifyRunner, error) { return h.verify, nil }
	m.env.localReplicas = func(_ context.Context, paths map[string]string) (LocalReplicas, error) {
		h.mu.Lock()
		defer h.mu.Unlock()
		h.localPaths = append(h.localPaths, paths)
		return h.local, nil
	}
	m.env.submitReady = func(_ context.Context, cmd wire.MemberReady) error {
		h.mu.Lock()
		defer h.mu.Unlock()
		h.ready = append(h.ready, cmd)
		return h.readyErr
	}
	m.env.submitCheckpoint = func(_ context.Context, cmd wire.MemberCheckpoint) error {
		h.mu.Lock()
		defer h.mu.Unlock()
		h.checkpoints = append(h.checkpoints, cmd)
		return h.cpErr
	}
	m.env.reporter = h
	m.env.probe = h
	h.mode = m
	return h
}

func (h *modeHarness) SubmitTablePurged(_ context.Context, nodeID string, seq uint64) error {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	if nodeID != fixtureNode {
		h.t.Errorf("purge report for %s, want %s", nodeID, fixtureNode)
	}
	h.reports = append(h.reports, seq)
	return h.reportErr
}

func (h *modeHarness) MemberTableHeld(_ context.Context, inc wire.TableIncarnation) (bool, error) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	return h.held[inc.Seq], nil
}

func (h *modeHarness) KeeperReplicas(_ context.Context, inc wire.TableIncarnation) ([]string, error) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(h.replicas[inc.Seq]), nil
}

// prepare does what Run does before its loops, so a test drives the steps
// itself.
func (h *modeHarness) prepare() {
	h.t.Helper()
	if _, err := h.mode.prepare(modeTestStore{}); err != nil {
		h.t.Fatalf("prepare: %v", err)
	}
}

func (h *modeHarness) sent() ([]wire.MemberReady, []wire.MemberCheckpoint, []uint64) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(h.ready), slices.Clone(h.checkpoints), slices.Clone(h.reports)
}

func (h *modeHarness) set(f func(h *modeHarness)) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	f(h)
}

type modeTestStore struct{}

func (modeTestStore) GetSafeSnapshot(context.Context, string) (replay.SafeSnapshotManifest, error) {
	return replay.SafeSnapshotManifest{}, errors.New("no manifests in this test")
}

func switchOffError(text string) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", dataplane.ErrStage3SwitchOff, text)
}

// metricValues registers m on a fresh registry and returns every sample by
// name and labels, name{label=value}..., the precedent of member/serve's
// tests.
func metricValues(t *testing.T, m *Metrics) map[string]float64 {
	t.Helper()
	reg := prometheus.NewPedanticRegistry()
	if err := m.Register(reg); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Register: %v", err)
	}
	families, err := reg.Gather()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Gather: %v", err)
	}
	out := map[string]float64{}
	for _, mf := range families {
		for _, metric := range mf.GetMetric() {
			key := mf.GetName()
			for _, l := range metric.GetLabel() {
				key += "{" + l.GetName() + "=" + l.GetValue() + "}"
			}
			out[key] = metric.GetGauge().GetValue() + metric.GetCounter().GetValue()
		}
	}
	return out
}

// TestReadinessLoopIdlesUntilThePlacementSwitch: before the stage-3
// parameter, with the placement switch off, and before the member registered
// in this process, the readiness step reads no replica and sends nothing;
// then it reports every synced group, signed with the member's ed25519 key,
// and a switch refusal is retried at the next step.
func TestReadinessLoopIdlesUntilThePlacementSwitch(t *testing.T) {
	snap := readinessSnapshot()
	off := snap
	off.Stage3 = nil
	h := newModeHarness(t, off, true)
	h.prepare()
	h.set(func(h *modeHarness) {
		h.local = LocalReplicas{"dex__pools": true, "dex__swaps": true, "nft__mints": true}
	})
	ctx := context.Background()
	h.mode.markRegistered()
	h.mode.readinessStep(ctx)
	placementOff := snap
	placementOff.Stage3 = fixtureStage3("purge")
	h.reg.set(placementOff)
	h.mode.readinessStep(ctx)
	if ready, _, _ := h.sent(); len(ready) != 0 || len(h.localPaths) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("before the placement switch the step sent %v and read replicas %v", ready, h.localPaths)
	}
	if got := metricValues(t, h.mode.metrics)["sentio_node_si_member_ready_groups"]; got != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("ready_groups = %v, want 1 (owner 2's lp group)", got)
	}

	unregistered := newModeHarness(t, snap, true)
	unregistered.prepare()
	unregistered.mode.readinessStep(ctx)
	if ready, _, _ := unregistered.sent(); len(ready) != 0 || len(unregistered.localPaths) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("before the registration the step sent %v and read replicas %v", ready, unregistered.localPaths)
	}

	h.reg.set(snap)
	h.mode.readinessStep(ctx)
	ready, _, _ := h.sent()
	if len(ready) != 1 || len(h.localPaths) != 1 || !reflect.DeepEqual(h.localPaths[0], ReplicaPaths(snap, fixtureNode, 0)) {
		t.Fatalf("after the switch the step sent %v and read %v; want one MemberReady over ReplicaPaths", ready, h.localPaths)
	}
	cmd := ready[0]
	if cmd.NodeID != fixtureNode || cmd.OwnerIndexerID != 0 || cmd.DatabaseID != "dex" || cmd.Generation != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("MemberReady = %+v, want member-b, owner 0, dex, generation 3", cmd)
	}
	pub := authoritytest.MemberKeyB().Public().(ed25519.PublicKey)
	if err := authority.VerifyMemberReady(pub, fixtureContext(), cmd.Body(), cmd.Ed25519Signature); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("the MemberReady signature does not verify under the member key: %v", err)
	}

	h.set(func(h *modeHarness) { h.readyErr = switchOffError(placementSwitchOffText) })
	h.mode.readinessStep(ctx)
	h.mode.readinessStep(ctx)
	if ready, _, _ := h.sent(); len(ready) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("a switch refusal must be retried at every step; sent %d MemberReady, want 3", len(ready))
	}
}

// TestModeRegistersBeforeItReportsAndRetriesARefusedRegistration: with
// Register the mode registers through the verify role, retrying a refusal,
// before it runs the role and reports anything; without Register it runs the
// role at once, registers nothing and never reports readiness.
func TestModeRegistersBeforeItReportsAndRetriesARefusedRegistration(t *testing.T) {
	h := newModeHarness(t, readinessSnapshot(), true)
	h.verify.registerErrs = []error{errors.New("arbiter unavailable")}
	h.set(func(h *modeHarness) {
		h.local = LocalReplicas{"dex__pools": true, "dex__swaps": true, "nft__mints": true}
	})
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { done <- h.mode.Run(ctx, modeTestStore{}, h.inst) }()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(5 * time.Second)
	for {
		if ready, _, _ := h.sent(); len(ready) > 0 {
			break
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatal("the mode never reported readiness after registering")
		}
		time.Sleep(5 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	if registers, runs := h.verify.counts(); registers != 2 || runs != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("Register called %d times and Run %d times; want 2 (one refused) and 1", registers, runs)
	}
	if got := metricValues(t, h.mode.metrics)["sentio_node_si_member_consensus_registered"]; got != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("consensus_registered = %v, want 1", got)
	}
	cancel()
	if err := <-done; !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		t.Fatalf("Run = %v, want context.Canceled", err)
	}

	passive := newModeHarness(t, readinessSnapshot(), false)
	passive.set(func(h *modeHarness) {
		h.local = LocalReplicas{"dex__pools": true, "dex__swaps": true, "nft__mints": true}
	})
	ctx, cancel = context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 100*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel()
	if err := passive.mode.Run(ctx, modeTestStore{}, passive.inst); !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
		t.Fatalf("Run = %v, want the deadline", err)
	}
	if registers, runs := passive.verify.counts(); registers != 0 || runs != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("without Register: Register called %d times and Run %d times; want 0 and 1", registers, runs)
	}
	if ready, _, _ := passive.sent(); len(ready) != 0 || metricValues(t, passive.mode.metrics)["sentio_node_si_member_consensus_registered"] != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("without Register the mode sent %v", ready)
	}
}

// TestCheckpointLoopIdlesUntilTheCheckpointsSwitch: nothing is signed before
// the switch or the registration; then one checkpoint per journaled owner,
// verifiable under the replica_signer, and none while its content is what
// the arbiter holds (this process's last accepted one, or after a restart
// the registry's stored one); a new manifest signs the next seq; refusals
// are counted by kind.
func TestCheckpointLoopIdlesUntilTheCheckpointsSwitch(t *testing.T) {
	snap := checkpointSnapshot()
	before := snap
	before.Stage3 = fixtureStage3("purge", "placement")
	h := newModeHarness(t, before, true)
	h.prepare()
	h.inst.journalAt(0, "0xsnap", fixtureEntry(0, 90, 40), "dex.pools", "nft.mints")
	ctx := context.Background()
	h.mode.markRegistered()
	h.mode.checkpointStep(ctx, h.inst)
	h.reg.set(snap)
	unregistered := newModeHarness(t, snap, true)
	unregistered.prepare()
	unregistered.inst.journalAt(0, "0xsnap", fixtureEntry(0, 90, 40), "dex.pools", "nft.mints")
	unregistered.mode.checkpointStep(ctx, unregistered.inst)
	if _, cps, _ := h.sent(); len(cps) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("before the checkpoints switch the step sent %v", cps)
	}
	if _, cps, _ := unregistered.sent(); len(cps) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("before the registration the step sent %v", cps)
	}

	h.mode.checkpointStep(ctx, h.inst)
	_, cps, _ := h.sent()
	if len(cps) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("after the switch the step sent %d checkpoints, want 1 (owner 2 has no journal)", len(cps))
	}
	first := cps[0]
	if first.Checkpoint.CheckpointSeq != 1 || first.Checkpoint.OwnerIndexerID != 0 || len(first.Checkpoint.Groups) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("checkpoint = %+v, want seq 1 of owner 0 over dex and nft", first.Checkpoint)
	}
	if err := authority.VerifyMemberCheckpoint(fixtureContext(), first.Checkpoint, first.ReplicaJWS, authoritytest.ReplicaAddrB); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("the checkpoint does not verify under the replica_signer: %v", err)
	}
	if got := metricValues(t, h.mode.metrics)["sentio_node_si_member_checkpoint_seq{owner=0}"]; got != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("checkpoint_seq{owner=0} = %v, want 1", got)
	}
	h.mode.checkpointStep(ctx, h.inst)
	if _, cps, _ := h.sent(); len(cps) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("an unchanged plan was signed again: %d checkpoints", len(cps))
	}

	h.inst.journalAt(0, "0xsnap2", fixtureEntry(0, 95, 41), "dex.pools", "nft.mints")
	h.set(func(h *modeHarness) { h.cpErr = switchOffError(checkpointsSwitchOffText) })
	h.mode.checkpointStep(ctx, h.inst)
	h.set(func(h *modeHarness) {
		h.cpErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: member checkpoint: snapshot 0xsnap2 is not a published manifest", dataplane.ErrStage3SwitchOff)
	})
	h.mode.checkpointStep(ctx, h.inst)
	h.set(func(h *modeHarness) { h.cpErr = nil })
	h.mode.checkpointStep(ctx, h.inst)
	_, cps, _ = h.sent()
	if len(cps) != 4 || cps[1].Checkpoint.CheckpointSeq != 2 || cps[2].Checkpoint.CheckpointSeq != 3 || cps[3].Checkpoint.CheckpointSeq != 4 ||
		cps[3].Checkpoint.SnapshotID != "0xsnap2" {
		t.Fatalf("checkpoints after the new manifest = %+v, want seqs 2, 3 and 4 at 0xsnap2", cps)
	}
	for result, want := range map[string]float64{CheckpointAccepted: 2, CheckpointSwitchOff: 1, CheckpointRefused: 1} {
		if got := metricValues(t, h.mode.metrics)["sentio_node_si_member_checkpoints_total{owner=0}{result="+result+"}"]; got != want {
			t.Fatalf("checkpoints_total{owner=0,result=%s} = %v, want %v", result, got, want)
		}
	}

	// A restart on the same state dir, with the registry storing the
	// accepted checkpoint for both groups: nothing to sign.
	stored := snap
	stored.Groups = slices.Clone(snap.Groups)
	for i, g := range stored.Groups {
		if g.OwnerIndexerID == 0 && (g.DatabaseID == "dex" || g.DatabaseID == "nft") {
			g.Members = slices.Clone(g.Members)
			g.Members[0].Checkpoint = &wire.MemberCheckpointRecord{Checkpoint: cps[3].Checkpoint, ReplicaJWS: cps[3].ReplicaJWS, Epoch: 2}
			stored.Groups[i] = g
		}
	}
	restarted := newModeHarnessIn(t, h.stateDir, stored, true)
	restarted.prepare()
	restarted.mode.markRegistered()
	restarted.inst.journalAt(0, "0xsnap2", fixtureEntry(0, 95, 41), "dex.pools", "nft.mints")
	restarted.mode.checkpointStep(ctx, restarted.inst)
	if _, cps, _ := restarted.sent(); len(cps) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("after a restart the registry's stored checkpoint was signed again: %v", cps)
	}
	restarted.inst.journalAt(0, "0xsnap3", fixtureEntry(0, 99, 42), "dex.pools", "nft.mints")
	restarted.mode.checkpointStep(ctx, restarted.inst)
	if _, cps, _ := restarted.sent(); len(cps) != 1 || cps[0].Checkpoint.CheckpointSeq != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("after a restart the next checkpoint = %v, want checkpoint_seq 5 from the journal", cps)
	}
}

// TestMemberThatLostItsStateResumesFromThePublishedCheckpointSeq (spec §17):
// a member whose state directory is gone signs its next checkpoint above the
// checkpoint_seq the registry publishes for it under its replica_signer, so
// Apply's "above the stored one" accepts it; a value published under another
// signer does not count.
func TestMemberThatLostItsStateResumesFromThePublishedCheckpointSeq(t *testing.T) {
	snap := checkpointSnapshot()
	snap.MemberCheckpointSeqs = []wire.MemberCheckpointSeq{
		{NodeID: fixtureNode, OwnerIndexerID: 0, CheckpointSeq: 7, ReplicaSigner: authoritytest.ReplicaAddrB},
		{NodeID: fixtureNode, OwnerIndexerID: 2, CheckpointSeq: 9, ReplicaSigner: otherSigner},
	}
	h := newModeHarness(t, snap, true)
	h.prepare()
	h.mode.markRegistered()
	h.inst.journalAt(0, "0xsnap", fixtureEntry(0, 90, 40), "dex.pools", "nft.mints")
	h.inst.journalAt(2, "0xsnap", fixtureEntry(2, 90, 40), "lp.pairs")
	h.mode.checkpointStep(context.Background(), h.inst)
	_, cps, _ := h.sent()
	seqs := map[uint64]uint64{}
	for _, cp := range cps {
		seqs[cp.Checkpoint.OwnerIndexerID] = cp.Checkpoint.CheckpointSeq
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(seqs, map[uint64]uint64{0: 8, 2: 1}) {
		t.Fatalf("checkpoint_seq per owner = %v, want 8 above owner 0's published 7 and 1 for owner 2 (published under another signer)", seqs)
	}
	if got := journalText(t, h.stateDir); !strings.Contains(got, `"checkpoint_seq":8`) {
		t.Fatalf("the journal does not hold the resumed seq: %s", got)
	}
}

// purgeSnapshot: incarnation 3 of dex.pools is Purging with member-b in its
// purge set; incarnation 5 lists member-b as purged already; incarnation 6
// is Purging without member-b.
func purgeSnapshot() wire.TableRegistrySnapshot {
	pools := fixtureInc(3, "dex", "pools", 0, wire.TableStatusPurging)
	pools.PurgeMembers = []string{"member-a", fixtureNode}
	done := fixtureInc(5, "dex", "done", 0, wire.TableStatusPurging)
	done.PurgeMembers, done.PurgedBy = []string{fixtureNode}, []string{fixtureNode}
	other := fixtureInc(6, "dex", "other", 0, wire.TableStatusPurging)
	other.PurgeMembers = []string{"member-a"}
	return fixtureSnapshot(fixtureStage3("purge"), nil, pools, done, other)
}

// TestMemberReportsAPurgeOnlyAfterTheDropAndQuiescence: a Purging
// incarnation is reported only once its hg_member_unsafe table is gone, its
// own Keeper replica is gone and no unresolved block names it; then exactly
// once, signed with the member key.
func TestMemberReportsAPurgeOnlyAfterTheDropAndQuiescence(t *testing.T) {
	h := newModeHarness(t, purgeSnapshot(), true)
	q, err := OpenQuiescence(h.stateDir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := q.Observe(41, []QuiescentTable{{TableID: "dex.pools", IncarnationSeq: 3}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	h.set(func(h *modeHarness) { h.held[3], h.replicas[3] = true, []string{"member-a", fixtureNode} })
	h.mode.purgeStep(ctx)
	h.set(func(h *modeHarness) { h.held[3] = false })
	h.mode.purgeStep(ctx)
	h.set(func(h *modeHarness) { h.replicas[3] = []string{"member-a"} })
	h.mode.purgeStep(ctx)
	if _, _, reports := h.sent(); len(reports) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("reported %v before the table, the replica and the quiescence hook allowed it", reports)
	}
	// Task 62's Resolve removes the block once its verdict is evaluated; an
	// empty ledger is a missing file.
	if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(h.stateDir, QuiescenceFile)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	h.set(func(h *modeHarness) { h.reportErr = fmt.Errorf("%w: not yet", dataplane.ErrTableNotPurging) })
	h.mode.purgeStep(ctx)
	h.set(func(h *modeHarness) { h.reportErr = nil })
	h.mode.purgeStep(ctx)
	h.mode.purgeStep(ctx)
	if _, _, reports := h.sent(); !reflect.DeepEqual(reports, []uint64{3, 3}) {
		t.Fatalf("reports = %v, want incarnation 3 refused once, then accepted once and never again", reports)
	}
	if got := metricValues(t, h.mode.metrics)["sentio_node_si_member_purge_reports_total"]; got != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("purge_reports_total = %v, want 1", got)
	}
	signed, err := h.mode.signTablePurged(fixtureNode, 3)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	pub := authoritytest.MemberKeyB().Public().(ed25519.PublicKey)
	if err := authority.VerifyVerifierMessage(pub, authority.VerifierMessageTablePurged, fixtureContext(),
		authority.TablePurgedBody{NodeID: fixtureNode, IncarnationSeq: 3}, signed.Ed25519Signature); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("the purge report signature does not verify under the member key: %v", err)
	}
}

// TestMemberReportsAtOnceAPurgingIncarnationItNeverHeld: an incarnation the
// member never held (no table, no replica, no observed block) is reported at
// the first step that sees it Purging.
func TestMemberReportsAtOnceAPurgingIncarnationItNeverHeld(t *testing.T) {
	h := newModeHarness(t, purgeSnapshot(), false)
	h.mode.purgeStep(context.Background())
	if _, _, reports := h.sent(); !reflect.DeepEqual(reports, []uint64{3}) {
		t.Fatalf("reports = %v, want incarnation 3 at once", reports)
	}
}

// TestMemberStatusCarriesReadinessAndCheckpointSeq: the status lists every
// group that names the member, current or Leaving, in registry order, with
// its generation, readiness, class and stored checkpoint_seq.
func TestMemberStatusCarriesReadinessAndCheckpointSeq(t *testing.T) {
	snap := checkpointSnapshot()
	dex := slices.IndexFunc(snap.Groups, func(g wire.DatabaseGroup) bool { return g.OwnerIndexerID == 0 && g.DatabaseID == "dex" })
	snap.Groups[dex].Members[0].Checkpoint = &wire.MemberCheckpointRecord{Checkpoint: arbiter.MemberCheckpoint{CheckpointSeq: 7}}
	h := newModeHarness(t, snap, true)
	got := h.mode.Status()
	want := Status{Mode: ModeConsensus, Registered: false, Groups: []GroupStatus{
		{OwnerIndexerID: 0, DatabaseID: "nft", Generation: 2, Ready: true, Class: "behind"},
		{OwnerIndexerID: 0, DatabaseID: "dex", Generation: 3, Ready: true, Class: "caught_up", CheckpointSeq: 7},
		{OwnerIndexerID: 0, DatabaseID: "old", Generation: 5, Class: ClassLeaving},
		{OwnerIndexerID: 2, DatabaseID: "lp", Generation: 4, Ready: true, Class: "caught_up"},
	}}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("Status = %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
	h.mode.markRegistered()
	b, err := json.Marshal(h.mode.Status().Groups[1])
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if string(b) != `{"owner_indexer_id":0,"database_id":"dex","generation":3,"ready":true,"class":"caught_up","checkpoint_seq":7}` || !h.mode.Status().Registered {
		t.Fatalf("group status JSON = %s, registered %v", b, h.mode.Status().Registered)
	}
	b, err = json.Marshal(OffStatus())
	if err != nil || string(b) != `{"mode":"off","registered":false,"groups":[]}` {
		t.Fatalf("OffStatus JSON = %s, %v", b, err)
	}
}

// TestConsensusMetricsExportEveryLabelIncludingZeros: every series of the
// main process and of the reconciler process exists from the start, with
// every owner, result and kind.
func TestConsensusMetricsExportEveryLabelIncludingZeros(t *testing.T) {
	h := newModeHarness(t, checkpointSnapshot(), true)
	reg := prometheus.NewPedanticRegistry()
	if err := h.mode.Metrics().Register(reg); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	rec := NewReconcilerMetrics(func() ReconcilerStats { return ReconcilerStats{Replicas: 3, ReplicaAlreadyExists: 1} })
	if err := rec.Register(reg); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	families, err := reg.Gather()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	got := map[string]int{}
	for _, f := range families {
		got[f.GetName()] = len(f.GetMetric())
	}
	want := map[string]int{
		"sentio_node_si_member_consensus_registered":         1,
		"sentio_node_si_member_ready_groups":                 1,
		"sentio_node_si_member_checkpoint_seq":               2,
		"sentio_node_si_member_checkpoints_total":            6,
		"sentio_node_si_member_evidence_total":               4,
		"sentio_node_si_member_purge_reports_total":          1,
		"sentio_node_si_member_unsafe_replicas":              1,
		"sentio_node_si_member_replica_already_exists_total": 1,
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("series = %v, want %v", got, want)
	}
}

// TestVerifyRoleCountsItsEvidence: a dispatch that returned nil counts as
// submitted, one that failed as refused, one cut short by its context not at
// all, and a role without metrics counts nothing.
func TestVerifyRoleCountsItsEvidence(t *testing.T) {
	m := NewMetrics()
	v := &VerifyRole{metrics: m}
	failed := errors.New("replay verify failed")
	if v.countEvidence(EvidenceReplay, nil) != nil || v.countEvidence(EvidenceScan, failed) != failed ||
		!errors.Is(v.countEvidence(EvidenceReplay, context.Canceled), context.Canceled) {
		t.Fatal("countEvidence must return the dispatch's error unchanged")
	}
	for _, c := range []struct {
		kind, result string
		want         float64
	}{{EvidenceReplay, EvidenceSubmitted, 1}, {EvidenceReplay, EvidenceRefused, 0}, {EvidenceScan, EvidenceSubmitted, 0}, {EvidenceScan, EvidenceRefused, 1}} {
		if got := metricValues(t, m)["sentio_node_si_member_evidence_total{kind="+c.kind+"}{result="+c.result+"}"]; got != c.want {
			t.Fatalf("evidence_total{kind=%s,result=%s} = %v, want %v", c.kind, c.result, got, c.want)
		}
	}
	if err := (&VerifyRole{}).countEvidence(EvidenceScan, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
```

```go
package consensus

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log/slog"
	"slices"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member/install"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// The leader's FAILED_PRECONDITION texts before a switch (plan S3-E1 K67).
// dataplane.ErrStage3SwitchOff wraps every leader precondition, the FSM's
// own refusals of a member command included, so the mode reads the switch
// refusal by its text.
const (
	placementSwitchOffText   = "member readiness is refused until the placement switch is on"
	checkpointsSwitchOffText = "member checkpoints are refused until the checkpoints switch is on"
)

// InstallView is what the mode reads of the member's installer
// (*install.Installer): the per-owner journal, the copied tables and the
// audit and disk state.
type InstallView interface {
	Entry(owner uint64) (install.OwnerJournal, bool)
	Tables(owner uint64) []install.TableState
	Stats() install.Stats
}

// ModeDeps are the mode's connections; member.Role passes its own. The mode
// opens and closes none of them.
type ModeDeps struct {
	Client   *dataplane.Client
	Registry dataplane.RegistryView
	// Conn is the member's ClickHouse as si_member.
	Conn clickhouse.Conn
	// Payloads reads DA payloads for the verify role's replays.
	Payloads replay.PayloadStore
	// MemberUnsafeDB is the member's hg_member_unsafe database
	// (ddl.MemberPinned.MemberUnsafeDB).
	MemberUnsafeDB string
	// Owners are the member's configured peers, the owners it checkpoints;
	// each is exported in the checkpoint series from the start.
	Owners []uint64
	Logger *slog.Logger
	Now    func() time.Time
}

// verifyRunner is what the mode uses of *VerifyRole.
type verifyRunner interface {
	Register(ctx context.Context) error
	Run(ctx context.Context) error
}

// modeSeams are the mode's calls on ClickHouse and the arbiter. NewMode
// installs the real ones; the package's tests replace them.
type modeSeams struct {
	newVerifyRole    func(cfg Config, d VerifyDeps, metrics *Metrics) (verifyRunner, error)
	localReplicas    func(ctx context.Context, paths map[string]string) (LocalReplicas, error)
	submitReady      func(ctx context.Context, cmd wire.MemberReady) error
	submitCheckpoint func(ctx context.Context, cmd wire.MemberCheckpoint) error
	reporter         purgeReporter
	probe            purgeProbe
}

// Mode is a member's consensus mode (plan S3-E1 K66): the VERIFIER
// registration and the verify role of Task 62, MemberReady once the
// placement switch is on, signed checkpoints once the checkpoints switch is
// on, and purge reports. member.Role builds it only with
// member.Config.Consensus and runs it beside its other parts.
type Mode struct {
	cfg     Config
	d       ModeDeps
	log     *slog.Logger
	now     func() time.Time
	priv    ed25519.PrivateKey
	msgCtx  authority.MessageContext
	owners  []uint64
	metrics *Metrics
	env     modeSeams

	mu         sync.Mutex
	registered bool
	signer     *CheckpointSigner
	accepted   map[uint64]arbiter.MemberCheckpoint // the last accepted checkpoint per owner
	reported   map[uint64]bool                     // incarnations whose purge report was accepted
}

// NewMode validates cfg and d and fills cfg's zero intervals with their
// defaults. It opens nothing and writes nothing.
func NewMode(cfg Config, d ModeDeps) (*Mode, error) {
	if cfg.NodeID == "" || cfg.NetworkID == "" || cfg.GenesisSnapshotID == "" || cfg.StateDir == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("member consensus: NodeID, NetworkID, GenesisSnapshotID and StateDir are required")
	}
	if len(cfg.Ed25519Seed) != ed25519.SeedSize {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: the ed25519 seed must be %d bytes", ed25519.SeedSize)
	}
	if _, err := authority.NewSignerFromHex(cfg.ReplicaSignerKeyHex); err != nil {
		return nil, errReplicaSignerKey
	}
	if d.Client == nil || d.Registry == nil || d.Conn == nil || d.Payloads == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("member consensus: ModeDeps.Client, Registry, Conn and Payloads are required")
	}
	if d.MemberUnsafeDB == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("member consensus: ModeDeps.MemberUnsafeDB is required")
	}
	if cfg.ReadinessInterval < 0 || cfg.CheckpointInterval < 0 || cfg.ResolveInterval < 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("member consensus: intervals must not be negative")
	}
	if cfg.ReadinessInterval == 0 {
		cfg.ReadinessInterval = DefaultReadinessInterval
	}
	if cfg.CheckpointInterval == 0 {
		cfg.CheckpointInterval = DefaultCheckpointInterval
	}
	if cfg.ResolveInterval == 0 {
		cfg.ResolveInterval = DefaultResolveInterval
	}
	logger := d.Logger
	if logger == nil {
		logger = slog.Default()
	}
	now := d.Now
	if now == nil {
		now = time.Now
	}
	owners := slices.Clone(d.Owners)
	slices.Sort(owners)
	m := &Mode{
		cfg: cfg, d: d, log: logger.With("member_consensus", cfg.NodeID), now: now,
		priv:     ed25519.NewKeyFromSeed(cfg.Ed25519Seed),
		msgCtx:   authority.MessageContext{NetworkID: cfg.NetworkID, GenesisSnapshotID: cfg.GenesisSnapshotID},
		owners:   slices.Compact(owners),
		metrics:  NewMetrics(),
		accepted: map[uint64]arbiter.MemberCheckpoint{}, reported: map[uint64]bool{},
	}
	m.metrics.declareOwners(m.owners)
	m.env = modeSeams{
		newVerifyRole: func(cfg Config, d VerifyDeps, metrics *Metrics) (verifyRunner, error) {
			v, err := NewVerifyRole(cfg, d)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			v.metrics = metrics
			return v, nil
		},
		localReplicas: func(ctx context.Context, paths map[string]string) (LocalReplicas, error) {
			return ReadLocalReplicas(ctx, d.Conn, d.MemberUnsafeDB, cfg.NodeID, paths)
		},
		submitReady:      d.Client.SubmitMemberReady,
		submitCheckpoint: d.Client.SubmitMemberCheckpoint,
		reporter:         dataplane.PurgeReporter{Client: d.Client, Sign: m.signTablePurged},
		probe:            chPurgeProbe{conn: d.Conn, memberUnsafeDB: d.MemberUnsafeDB, keeperShardID: cfg.KeeperShardID},
	}
	return m, nil
}

// Metrics are the mode's series, for the si-member process's registry.
func (m *Mode) Metrics() *Metrics { return m.metrics }

// Status is the mode's part of the serving view: whether the member
// registered in this process and its standing in every group the registry
// names it in.
func (m *Mode) Status() Status {
	snap, enabled := m.d.Registry.View()
	if !enabled {
		return Status{Mode: ModeConsensus, Registered: m.isRegistered(), Groups: []GroupStatus{}}
	}
	return statusOf(snap, m.cfg.NodeID, m.isRegistered())
}

// Run runs the mode until ctx ends: the verify role (registering first while
// Config.Register is on, retried every ReadinessInterval until it succeeds),
// the readiness step every ReadinessInterval, the checkpoint step every
// CheckpointInterval and the purge step every ResolveInterval. manifests is
// the member feed's verified manifest store and inst its installer; both
// exist only once member.Role's startup reached step (9). Run returns ctx's
// error, or the verify role's failure. A step's failure is logged and
// retried at its next interval, and a switch refusal never pages.
func (m *Mode) Run(ctx context.Context, manifests replay.SnapshotStore, inst InstallView) error {
	if manifests == nil || inst == nil {
		return errors.New("member consensus: Run needs the manifest store and the installer")
	}
	vr, err := m.prepare(manifests)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	runCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	defer cancel()
	failed := make(chan error, 1)
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	wg.Go(func() {
		if err := m.runVerifyRole(runCtx, vr); err != nil && runCtx.Err() == nil {
			failed <- fmt.Errorf("member consensus: verify role: %w", err)
		}
	})
	wg.Go(func() { m.every(runCtx, m.cfg.ReadinessInterval, m.readinessStep) })
	wg.Go(func() {
		m.every(runCtx, m.cfg.CheckpointInterval, func(ctx context.Context) { m.checkpointStep(ctx, inst) })
	})
	wg.Go(func() { m.every(runCtx, m.cfg.ResolveInterval, m.purgeStep) })
	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
		err = ctx.Err()
	case err = <-failed:
	}
	cancel()
	wg.Wait()
	return err
}

// prepare opens the checkpoint_seq journal, loads the checkpoint signer and
// builds the verify role; it registers nothing.
func (m *Mode) prepare(manifests replay.SnapshotStore) (verifyRunner, error) {
	store, err := OpenCheckpointSeqStore(m.cfg.StateDir)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	signer, err := NewCheckpointSigner(m.cfg.ReplicaSignerKeyHex, m.msgCtx, store)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	vr, err := m.env.newVerifyRole(m.cfg, VerifyDeps{
		Client: m.d.Client, Registry: m.d.Registry, Conn: m.d.Conn, Manifests: manifests, Payloads: m.d.Payloads, Logger: m.log, Now: m.now,
	}, m.metrics)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: verify role: %w", err)
	}
	m.mu.Lock()
	m.signer = signer
	m.mu.Unlock()
	return vr, nil
}

// every runs step at once and then every interval until ctx ends.
func (m *Mode) every(ctx context.Context, interval time.Duration, step func(context.Context)) {
	t := time.NewTicker(interval)
	defer t.Stop()
	for {
		step(ctx)
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		case <-t.C:
		}
	}
}

// runVerifyRole registers the member as a VERIFIER while Config.Register is
// on (S3-F step 4), retrying every ReadinessInterval until it succeeds, and
// then runs the verify role. Without Register it runs the role at once,
// which subscribes to nothing (Task 62).
func (m *Mode) runVerifyRole(ctx context.Context, vr verifyRunner) error {
	if m.cfg.Register {
		for {
			err := vr.Register(ctx)
			if err == nil {
				break
			}
			if ctx.Err() != nil {
				return ctx.Err()
			}
			m.log.Warn("member consensus: registration as a verifier failed; retrying", "retry_in", m.cfg.ReadinessInterval, "err", err)
			select {
			case <-ctx.Done():
				return ctx.Err()
			case <-time.After(m.cfg.ReadinessInterval):
			}
		}
		m.markRegistered()
		m.log.Info("member consensus: registered and marked active as a verifier")
	}
	return vr.Run(ctx)
}

func (m *Mode) markRegistered() {
	m.mu.Lock()
	m.registered = true
	m.mu.Unlock()
	m.metrics.registered.Set(1)
}

func (m *Mode) isRegistered() bool {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	return m.registered
}

// switchOff reports whether err is the leader's refusal before the switch
// whose K67 text is text.
func switchOff(err error, text string) bool {
	return errors.Is(err, dataplane.ErrStage3SwitchOff) && strings.Contains(err.Error(), text)
}

// readinessStep reports readiness once the placement switch is on and the
// member registered in this process: it reads the local replicas of every
// group still waiting for the member, plans the MemberReady bodies and
// submits each, signed with the member's ed25519 key. The ready-groups gauge
// follows the registry.
func (m *Mode) readinessStep(ctx context.Context) {
	snap, enabled := m.d.Registry.View()
	if !enabled {
		return
	}
	m.metrics.readyGroups.Set(float64(readyGroupCount(snap, m.cfg.NodeID)))
	if snap.Stage3 == nil || !snap.Stage3.Placement || !m.isRegistered() {
		return
	}
	paths := ReplicaPaths(snap, m.cfg.NodeID, m.cfg.KeeperShardID)
	if len(paths) == 0 {
		return
	}
	local, err := m.env.localReplicas(ctx, paths)
	if err != nil {
		if ctx.Err() == nil {
			m.log.Warn("member consensus: reading the local hg_member_unsafe replicas failed; the next step retries", "err", err)
		}
		return
	}
	for _, body := range PlanReadiness(snap, m.cfg.NodeID, local) {
		sig, err := authority.SignMemberReady(m.priv, m.msgCtx, body)
		if err != nil {
			m.log.Warn("member consensus: signing a MemberReady failed", "owner", body.OwnerIndexerID, "database", body.DatabaseID, "err", err)
			continue
		}
		cmd := wire.MemberReady{NodeID: body.NodeID, OwnerIndexerID: body.OwnerIndexerID, DatabaseID: body.DatabaseID, Generation: body.Generation, Ed25519Signature: sig}
		switch err := m.env.submitReady(ctx, cmd); {
		case err == nil:
			m.log.Info("member consensus: reported the group's replicas ready", "owner", body.OwnerIndexerID, "database", body.DatabaseID, "generation", body.Generation)
		case switchOff(err, placementSwitchOffText):
			m.log.Info("member consensus: the arbiter refuses readiness until its placement switch is on; retrying", "owner", body.OwnerIndexerID, "database", body.DatabaseID)
		case ctx.Err() != nil:
			return
		default:
			m.log.Warn("member consensus: MemberReady refused; the next step retries", "owner", body.OwnerIndexerID, "database", body.DatabaseID, "generation", body.Generation, "err", err)
		}
	}
}

func (m *Mode) checkpointSigner() *CheckpointSigner {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	return m.signer
}

// checkpointStep signs and submits, once the checkpoints switch is on and
// the member registered in this process, one checkpoint per configured owner
// whose plan differs from the last checkpoint the arbiter accepted for it
// (this process's, or after a restart the one the registry stores for every
// group of the plan). Its checkpoint_seq is above both the journal and the
// value the registry publishes under this signer.
func (m *Mode) checkpointStep(ctx context.Context, inst InstallView) {
	snap, enabled := m.d.Registry.View()
	if !enabled || snap.Stage3 == nil || !snap.Stage3.Checkpoints || !m.isRegistered() {
		return
	}
	signer := m.checkpointSigner()
	if signer == nil {
		return
	}
	stats := inst.Stats()
	for _, owner := range m.owners {
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return
		}
		j, ok := inst.Entry(owner)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		cp, ok := PlanCheckpoint(snap, m.cfg.NodeID, owner, InstallStateOf(snap, owner, j, inst.Tables(owner), stats))
		if !ok || m.checkpointCurrent(snap, cp) {
			continue
		}
		var published uint64
		if seq, ok := snap.PublishedCheckpointSeq(m.cfg.NodeID, owner); ok && seq.ReplicaSigner == signer.Address() {
			published = seq.CheckpointSeq
		}
		signed, err := signer.Sign(cp, published)
		if err != nil {
			m.log.Warn("member consensus: signing a checkpoint failed", "owner", owner, "err", err)
			continue
		}
		switch err := m.env.submitCheckpoint(ctx, signed); {
		case err == nil:
			m.mu.Lock()
			m.accepted[owner] = signed.Checkpoint
			m.mu.Unlock()
			m.metrics.countCheckpoint(owner, CheckpointAccepted)
			m.metrics.checkpointSeq.WithLabelValues(strconv.FormatUint(owner, 10)).Set(float64(signed.Checkpoint.CheckpointSeq))
			m.log.Info("member consensus: checkpoint accepted", "owner", owner, "checkpoint_seq", signed.Checkpoint.CheckpointSeq, "snapshot_id", cp.SnapshotID)
		case switchOff(err, checkpointsSwitchOffText):
			m.metrics.countCheckpoint(owner, CheckpointSwitchOff)
			m.log.Info("member consensus: the arbiter refuses checkpoints until its checkpoints switch is on; retrying", "owner", owner)
		case ctx.Err() != nil:
			return
		default:
			m.metrics.countCheckpoint(owner, CheckpointRefused)
			m.log.Warn("member consensus: checkpoint refused; the next step signs a new one", "owner", owner, "checkpoint_seq", signed.Checkpoint.CheckpointSeq, "err", err)
		}
	}
}

// checkpointCurrent reports whether the arbiter already holds cp's content
// (everything but checkpoint_seq): this process's last accepted checkpoint
// for the owner, or, after a restart, the stored checkpoint of every group cp
// lists.
func (m *Mode) checkpointCurrent(snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, cp arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) bool {
	m.mu.Lock()
	last, ok := m.accepted[cp.OwnerIndexerID]
	m.mu.Unlock()
	if ok && sameCheckpointContent(last, cp) {
		return true
	}
	for _, cg := range cp.Groups {
		g, ok := snap.Group(cp.OwnerIndexerID, cg.DatabaseID)
		if !ok {
			return false
		}
		i := slices.IndexFunc(g.Members, func(mem wire.GroupMember) bool { return mem.NodeID == cp.NodeID })
		if i < 0 || g.Members[i].Checkpoint == nil {
			return false
		}
		stored := g.Members[i].Checkpoint.Checkpoint
		j := slices.IndexFunc(stored.Groups, func(sg arbiter.CheckpointGroup) bool { return sg.DatabaseID == cg.DatabaseID })
		if stored.SnapshotID != cp.SnapshotID || stored.Entry != cp.Entry || j < 0 || !sameCheckpointGroup(stored.Groups[j], cg) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func sameCheckpointContent(a, b arbiter.MemberCheckpoint) bool {
	return a.NodeID == b.NodeID && a.OwnerIndexerID == b.OwnerIndexerID && a.SnapshotID == b.SnapshotID && a.Entry == b.Entry &&
		slices.EqualFunc(a.Groups, b.Groups, sameCheckpointGroup)
}

func sameCheckpointGroup(a, b arbiter.CheckpointGroup) bool {
	return a.DatabaseID == b.DatabaseID && a.GroupGeneration == b.GroupGeneration && slices.Equal(a.Excluded, b.Excluded)
}
```

Create `member/consensus/purge.go`:

```go
package consensus

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"slices"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/ddl"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/tableset"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// purgeProbe is what the purge reports read of the member's ClickHouse as
// si_member: whether it still holds an incarnation's hg_member_unsafe table,
// and the replicas on the incarnation's own Keeper path.
type purgeProbe interface {
	MemberTableHeld(ctx context.Context, inc wire.TableIncarnation) (bool, error)
	KeeperReplicas(ctx context.Context, inc wire.TableIncarnation) ([]string, error)
}

// chPurgeProbe is the purgeProbe of a running member.
type chPurgeProbe struct {
	conn           clickhouse.Conn
	memberUnsafeDB string
	keeperShardID  uint32
}

// MemberTableHeld reports whether memberUnsafeDB holds inc's table: a table
// of its physical name whose COMMENT does not name another incarnation (the
// member DDL marks every hg_member_unsafe table with ddl.IncarnationComment;
// a table without a readable comment counts as held).
func (p chPurgeProbe) MemberTableHeld(ctx context.Context, inc wire.TableIncarnation) (bool, error) {
	name := ddl.CHTableName(inc.Key())
	rows, err := p.conn.Query(ctx, "SELECT comment FROM system.tables WHERE database = ? AND name = ?", p.memberUnsafeDB, name)
	if err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: read system.tables for %s.%s: %w", p.memberUnsafeDB, name, err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	held := false
	for rows.Next() {
		var comment string
		if err := rows.Scan(&comment); err != nil {
			return false, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: scan system.tables for %s.%s: %w", p.memberUnsafeDB, name, err)
		}
		seq, ok := ddl.ParseIncarnationComment(comment)
		held = !ok || seq == inc.Seq
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("member consensus: read system.tables for %s.%s: %w", p.memberUnsafeDB, name, err)
	}
	return held, nil
}

// KeeperReplicas lists the replicas on inc's own Keeper path, unscoped or
// incarnation-scoped (tableset.KeeperScopeOf); none when it does not exist.
func (p chPurgeProbe) KeeperReplicas(ctx context.Context, inc wire.TableIncarnation) ([]string, error) {
	return ddl.KeeperReplicasAt(ctx, p.conn, p.keeperShardID, inc.Key(), tableset.KeeperScopeOf(inc))
}

// purgeReporter submits one signed purge report (dataplane.PurgeReporter).
type purgeReporter interface {
	SubmitTablePurged(ctx context.Context, nodeID string, incarnationSeq uint64) error
}

// signTablePurged signs a purge report as the verifier message table_purged
// under the member's ed25519 key, the key of its verifiers entry
// (authority.VerifierMessageTablePurged, the verifier's precedent).
func (m *Mode) signTablePurged(nodeID string, incarnationSeq uint64) (wire.RecordTablePurged, error) {
	sig, err := authority.SignVerifierMessage(m.priv, authority.VerifierMessageTablePurged, m.msgCtx,
		authority.TablePurgedBody{NodeID: nodeID, IncarnationSeq: incarnationSeq})
	if err != nil {
		return wire.RecordTablePurged{}, err
	}
	return wire.RecordTablePurged{NodeID: nodeID, IncarnationSeq: incarnationSeq, Ed25519Signature: sig}, nil
}

// purgeStep reports every Purging incarnation that lists the node in
// PurgeMembers and not yet in PurgedBy (spec §8.8; plan S3-E1 K60) once the
// member no longer holds its hg_member_unsafe table, its own replica is gone
// from the incarnation's Keeper path, and the quiescence ledger names no
// unresolved block of it. The reconciler process drops the table, as
// si_member_ddl, only once the table is quiet, so the order is drop, then
// report. An incarnation the member never held passes all three at once and
// is reported at the first step that sees it Purging. A report the leader
// answers "not purging yet", or any failed report, is retried at the next
// step.
func (m *Mode) purgeStep(ctx context.Context) {
	snap, enabled := m.d.Registry.View()
	if !enabled {
		return
	}
	var due []wire.TableIncarnation
	for _, inc := range snap.Incarnations {
		if inc.Status == wire.TableStatusPurging && slices.Contains(inc.PurgeMembers, m.cfg.NodeID) &&
			!slices.Contains(inc.PurgedBy, m.cfg.NodeID) && !m.purgeReported(inc.Seq) {
			due = append(due, inc)
		}
	}
	if len(due) == 0 {
		return
	}
	ledger, err := ReadQuiescence(m.cfg.StateDir)
	if err != nil {
		m.log.Warn("member consensus: the quiescence ledger is unreadable; no purge is reported until it is", "err", err)
		return
	}
	for _, inc := range due {
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return
		}
		held, err := m.env.probe.MemberTableHeld(ctx, inc)
		if err != nil {
			m.log.Warn("member consensus: purge check failed; the next step retries", "table", inc.Key(), "incarnation", inc.Seq, "err", err)
			continue
		}
		if held {
			continue
		}
		replicas, err := m.env.probe.KeeperReplicas(ctx, inc)
		if err != nil {
			m.log.Warn("member consensus: purge check failed; the next step retries", "table", inc.Key(), "incarnation", inc.Seq, "err", err)
			continue
		}
		if slices.Contains(replicas, m.cfg.NodeID) || !ledger.Quiet(inc.Key(), inc.Seq) {
			continue
		}
		switch err := m.env.reporter.SubmitTablePurged(ctx, m.cfg.NodeID, inc.Seq); {
		case err == nil:
			m.markPurgeReported(inc.Seq)
			m.metrics.purgeReports.Inc()
			m.log.Info("member consensus: reported a purged incarnation", "table", inc.Key(), "incarnation", inc.Seq)
		case errors.Is(err, dataplane.ErrTableNotPurging):
			m.log.Info("member consensus: the arbiter does not see the incarnation purging yet; retrying", "table", inc.Key(), "incarnation", inc.Seq)
		case ctx.Err() == nil:
			m.log.Warn("member consensus: purge report failed; the next step retries", "table", inc.Key(), "incarnation", inc.Seq, "err", err)
		}
	}
}

func (m *Mode) purgeReported(seq uint64) bool {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	return m.reported[seq]
}

func (m *Mode) markPurgeReported(seq uint64) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	m.reported[seq] = true
}
```

Create `member/consensus/status.go`:

```go
package consensus

import (
	"slices"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// The modes and the extra class a member's status reports (plan S3-E1
// contract §42.3).
const (
	// ModeOff: the member runs without member.Config.Consensus (P2/P3).
	ModeOff = "off"
	// ModeConsensus: the member consensus mode is configured.
	ModeConsensus = "consensus"
	// ClassLeaving is the class of a group whose unreleased Leaving record
	// names the member: a Leaving member is in no group's members (spec
	// §9.2), so it has no member class of its own.
	ClassLeaving = "leaving"
)

// Status is the member consensus mode's part of the serving view
// (serve.ServingView.Consensus, GET /v1/serving).
type Status struct {
	Mode       string        `json:"mode"`
	Registered bool          `json:"registered"`
	Groups     []GroupStatus `json:"groups"`
}

// GroupStatus is the member's standing in one database group as the registry
// publishes it: ready at the group's generation, its class, and the
// checkpoint_seq of its stored checkpoint for the group (0 before the
// first).
type GroupStatus struct {
	OwnerIndexerID uint64 `json:"owner_indexer_id"`
	DatabaseID     string `json:"database_id"`
	Generation     uint64 `json:"generation"`
	Ready          bool   `json:"ready"`
	Class          string `json:"class"`
	CheckpointSeq  uint64 `json:"checkpoint_seq"`
}

// OffStatus is the status of a member without the consensus mode.
func OffStatus() Status { return Status{Mode: ModeOff, Groups: []GroupStatus{}} }

// statusOf is the consensus status of nodeID in snap: every group that names
// it as a current member or in an unreleased Leaving record, in the
// registry's group order.
func statusOf(snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, nodeID string, registered bool) Status {
	st := Status{Mode: ModeConsensus, Registered: registered, Groups: []GroupStatus{}}
	for _, g := range snap.GroupsWithMember(nodeID) {
		gs := GroupStatus{OwnerIndexerID: g.OwnerIndexerID, DatabaseID: g.DatabaseID, Generation: g.Generation, Class: ClassLeaving}
		if i := slices.IndexFunc(g.Members, func(m wire.GroupMember) bool { return m.NodeID == nodeID }); i >= 0 {
			m := g.Members[i]
			gs.Ready, gs.Class = m.Ready(), string(m.Class)
			if m.Checkpoint != nil {
				gs.CheckpointSeq = m.Checkpoint.Checkpoint.CheckpointSeq
			}
		}
		st.Groups = append(st.Groups, gs)
	}
	return st
}

// readyGroupCount counts the groups that name nodeID as a ready current
// member.
func readyGroupCount(snap wire.TableRegistrySnapshot, nodeID string) int {
	n := 0
	for _, g := range snap.Groups {
		if i := slices.IndexFunc(g.Members, func(m wire.GroupMember) bool { return m.NodeID == nodeID }); i >= 0 && g.Members[i].Ready() {
			n++
		}
	}
	return n
}
```
